title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Google & Meta Ads
description:
**Job Description: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Google & Meta Ads**

**Company:**
SimpliAxis

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Department:**
Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About SimpliAxis**

SimpliAxis is a global professional training, consulting, and technology services company serving customers across multiple markets.

We are looking for an experienced, results-driven Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead our paid advertising initiatives across Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).

The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in campaign management, bidding strategies, budget optimization, lead generation, conversion tracking, and performance marketing analytics.

The candidate will be responsible for driving qualified leads, improving conversion rates, optimizing advertising expenditure, and achieving measurable business growth.

We are looking for someone who can take complete ownership of performance marketing results rather than simply execute campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Google Ads Management**

* Plan, execute, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types.
* Develop effective bidding strategies, including Maximize Conversions, Target CPA, Target ROAS, and other suitable automated or manual bidding approaches.
* Manage campaign budgets and optimize spending based on lead quality, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and revenue.
* Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, negative keyword optimization, competitor analysis, and audience targeting.
* Optimize ad copy, landing pages, campaign structure, and quality-related metrics to improve performance.
* Monitor impression share, CPC, CPL, conversion rates, and other relevant campaign metrics.
* Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.
* Diagnose campaign performance issues and implement corrective actions quickly.

**2. Meta Ads Management (Facebook & Instagram)**

* Manage and optimize Meta advertising campaigns for lead generation, website conversions, remarketing, and customer acquisition.
* Develop campaign structures, audience strategies, retargeting strategies, and creative testing frameworks.
* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and campaign optimization.
* Conduct A/B testing of creatives, ad copy, landing pages, audiences, and campaign objectives.
* Work with the creative and content teams to develop high-performing advertisements, videos, and promotional campaigns.
* Optimize CPL, qualified lead cost, conversion rates, and customer acquisition costs.
* Analyze campaign fatigue, audience saturation, frequency, and declining performance.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining lead quality and cost efficiency.

**3. Performance Marketing Strategy & Growth**

* Develop and execute paid advertising strategies aligned with business revenue targets.
* Establish campaign-level, channel-level, and monthly performance targets.
* Manage advertising budgets across Google and Meta based on business priorities and measurable results.
* Build structured experimentation plans to identify new opportunities for lead generation and customer acquisition.
* Analyze the complete marketing funnel, from impressions and clicks to leads, qualified opportunities, sales, and revenue.
* Identify bottlenecks in lead generation and recommend improvements to landing pages, lead forms, targeting, and conversion processes.
* Work closely with the Sales and Business Development teams to improve lead quality and lead-to-sale conversion rates.
* Develop scalable paid acquisition strategies for multiple products, courses, markets, and customer segments.

**4. Bidding, Budget & Cost Optimization**

* Take ownership of bidding strategies and budget allocation across advertising platforms.
* Monitor daily campaign performance and make timely bidding and budget adjustments.
* Identify campaigns consuming excessive budgets without generating quality leads or conversions.
* Optimize cost per lead, cost per qualified lead, cost per acquisition, and return on advertising spend, as applicable.
* Develop budget allocation strategies based on campaign performance and business priorities.
* Ensure that campaign scaling decisions are supported by reliable performance data.
* Maintain appropriate testing budgets while protecting overall marketing efficiency.
* Forecast lead volumes and advertising expenditure based on historical performance and business targets.

**5. Conversion Tracking & Marketing Analytics**

* Implement, validate, and maintain conversion tracking across Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API.
* Track website leads, form submissions, phone enquiries, and other relevant conversion actions.
* Integrate advertising data with CRM systems wherever possible.
* Analyze lead quality and downstream sales performance rather than relying solely on platform-reported leads.
* Identify tracking discrepancies, attribution issues, and data-quality problems.
* Prepare performance dashboards and actionable reports for management.
* Use data to identify growth opportunities, performance gaps, and corrective actions.

**6. Team Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead and guide performance marketing executives and other team members involved in paid advertising.
* Define daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets.
* Review campaign performance and ensure timely execution of optimization activities.
* Establish accountability for campaign results, reporting, and execution quality.
* Coordinate with the Sales, Content, Design, Website, and Technology teams.
* Provide clear instructions to team members and ensure campaigns are launched and optimized on schedule.
* Identify skill gaps and improve team capabilities through training, coaching, and performance reviews.
* Take responsibility for overall paid marketing performance and recommend corrective actions when targets are missed.

**7. Reporting & Management Accountability**

The candidate must provide structured performance updates to management.

**Daily reporting should include:**

* Advertising spend across Google and Meta.
* Number of leads generated.
* Cost per lead by campaign and channel.
* Qualified leads, where data is available.
* Significant campaign performance changes.
* Campaigns requiring immediate intervention.
* Actions taken to improve performance.

**Weekly reporting should include:**

* Channel-wise and campaign-wise performance.
* Lead quality and sales conversion insights.
* Budget utilization and efficiency.
* Successful experiments and unsuccessful campaigns.
* Key optimization actions completed.
* Priorities and action plans for the following week.

**Monthly reporting should include:**

* Total advertising expenditure.
* Total leads and qualified leads generated.
* Cost per lead and cost per qualified lead.
* Sales conversions and customer acquisition cost, where measurable.
* Revenue attributable to paid marketing, where reliable attribution is available.
* Performance against agreed targets.
* Recommendations for the next month's strategy and budget allocation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing.
* Strong expertise in Google Ads campaign management and bidding optimization.
* Strong expertise in Meta Ads campaign management and performance optimization.
* Proven experience in lead generation and conversion-focused advertising.
* Practical experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaign performance.
* Strong knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking.
* Experience with landing page optimization, audience targeting, remarketing, and A/B testing.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign data.
* Experience working with CRM systems and lead management processes.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, products, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication, reporting, problem-solving, and team coordination skills.
* A data-driven mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in:

* EdTech and online professional training.
* Certification and professional education businesses.
* Online learning platforms.
* B2B and B2C lead-generation businesses.
* Education, SaaS, consulting, or other performance-driven digital businesses.

Experience generating leads for professional courses, certification programs, or high-consideration products will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate's performance will be evaluated against mutually agreed targets, including:

1. Cost per lead (CPL).
2. Cost per qualified lead (CPQL).
3. Lead quality and sales acceptance rate.
4. Lead-to-enrolment or lead-to-sale conversion rate.
5. Advertising spend efficiency.
6. Number of qualified leads generated.
7. Customer acquisition cost (CAC), where measurable.
8. Revenue generated through paid marketing, where reliable attribution is available.
9. Achievement of agreed campaign and business targets.
10. Accuracy and timeliness of reporting.
11. Speed of identifying and resolving campaign performance issues.
12. Team productivity and execution quality.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is a hands-on performance marketing expert, not just a team coordinator.
* Understands the technical and strategic aspects of Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Can independently identify why campaigns are underperforming and take corrective action.
* Understands the difference between generating inexpensive leads and generating leads that convert into paying customers.
* Can manage budgets responsibly and justify advertising expenditure through performance data.
* Takes ownership of results instead of waiting for instructions from management.
* Can work effectively with Sales, Marketing, Content, and Technology teams.

**How to Apply**

title: Marketing Specialist, Media Data and Optimization
description:
**About The Team**
We are the team that enables cross-line of business data and optimization support for Zillow's paid media organization. We ensure the data powering our marketing decisions is clean, reliable, and actionable and that our media investments are continuously optimized for performance. The team is fast-paced and data-driven, and we operate with a high degree of both collaboration and autonomy. We partner closely with Paid Marketing, Marketing Tech and Operations, Marketing Data Science, and Marketing Strategy to support business objectives across all paid media channels.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Marketing Specialist, Media Data and Optimization to play a critical role in maintaining data integrity, supporting budget optimization, and enabling the execution of tests and reporting across all paid media channels. This role will report into the Senior Manager, Media Data and Analytics. This is the right role for someone who is energized by working in a complex, cross-functional environment; someone who can navigate many stakeholders with ease, move quickly, and make sound, independent decisions when needed.
  
  
**You Will Get To:**

* Own data cleanliness and QA processes across paid media platforms and internal reporting systems to ensure accuracy and reliability
* Build and evaluate budget optimization scenarios to support investment decisions across lines of business and channels
* Support the set-up and deployment of marketing tests across paid media channels including TV, Online Video, Paid Social, SEM, Programmatic Display, and more
* Own and maintain recurring business reporting to surface media performance and trends to key stakeholders
* Create data-backed narratives for monthly reporting
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Paid Marketing, Marketing Tech and Operations, Marketing Data Science, and Marketing Strategy to support shared initiatives

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* Minimum of 2 years of work experience in a marketing data and optimization role, with hands-on experience supporting paid media programs
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and working with large data sets
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau and Databricks
* Familiarity with advertising platforms across paid media channels like CM360, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads
* Strong attention to detail with a commitment to data quality — you catch the things others miss
* Able to work both collaboratively across a wide set of stakeholders and independently, making well-reasoned decisions and moving swiftly when needed
* BS degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience

**Transferable Skills**
Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.
  
  
Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
  
  
*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Marketing Capabilities Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**
The Marketing Operations team at McAfee enables scalable, data-driven marketing execution by connecting strategy, processes, technology, and analytics across the customer lifecycle. The team is responsible for the marketing technology ecosystem, campaign operations, customer communications, data governance, audience activation, and performance measurement. We are seeking a Marketing Capabilities Specialist to serve as the bridge between Marketing Operations, business stakeholders and MarTech enablement and Product Management.
  
  
This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India development center. You will be required to be on-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
  
  
**Position Details**
**About The Role**

* As a Marketing Capabilities Specialist, you will serve as the bridge between Marketing Operations, business stakeholders, MarTech enablement, Product Management, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* In this role, you will identify and evaluate marketing capability gaps, process inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities across customer acquisition, engagement, retention, personalization and measurement, translating business needs into clearly defined capability requirements and use cases.
* You will lead discovery sessions to understand business needs, current-state processes, data flows, platform usage, operational constraints, and strategic priorities across CRM, CDP, analytics, campaign orchestration, and digital experience platforms.
* The ideal candidate will assess business needs against existing marketing capabilities and identify opportunities to optimize processes, enhance integrations, or introduce new solutions.
* You will translate business objectives into clear capability requirements, use cases, functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, success metrics, and business cases that Product, Engineering, and Operations teams can evaluate and deliver.
* The scope for you is to help support capability and investment prioritization by evaluating business value, customer impact, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, operational effort, dependencies, scalability, strategic alignment, and risk.
* Additionally, you will own and continuously improve Marketing Capabilities documentation, including backlogs, playbooks, process maps, governance guidelines, training materials, and knowledge repositories, while communicating capability and data releases to support stakeholder adoption.

**About You**

* You have 5 to 7 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer journey operations, messaging, or marketing operations within a complex omnichannel marketing environment.
* You possess a strong understanding of marketing technology ecosystems, including CRM, Customer Data Platforms, analytics, campaign orchestration, and customer and digital experience platforms.
* You have experience supporting capabilities and customer data schemas across platforms such as Braze and Hightouch, including segmentation, audience activation, personalization, campaign execution, measurement, reporting, and experimentation.
* You bring strong expertise across customer engagement channels, including Email, Mobile Push, SMS, and Windows, Mac/In-product messaging.
* You are experienced in translating complex business, technical, data, and operational needs into clear requirements, scalable processes, governance models, capability frameworks, and user-friendly documentation.
* You are comfortable working in agile, cross-functional environments and can effectively collaborate with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Technology, and Operations teams.
* Additionally, you have excellent written communication, organizational, and analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across IST, EMEA, and US time zones.

**Company Overview**
McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.
  
  
**Company Benefits And Perks**
We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.
  
  
We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
  
  

* Bonus Program
* Pension and Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced, result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager with a strong background in 
**real estate marketing, farmland sales, and high-quality lead generation**
.

The primary responsibility is to generate genuine, qualified leads from potential farmland buyers and investors through digital marketing campaigns. The candidate must have hands-on experience managing social media platforms, running paid advertising campaigns, optimizing marketing budgets, and converting digital enquiries into qualified sales opportunities.

The ideal candidate should focus on 
**lead quality, conversion rates, and actual site visits rather than just clicks, followers, or enquiry volume.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Quality Lead Generation – Primary Responsibility**

**· Generate high-quality leads for farmland, farm plots, agricultural land, and real estate projects.**

**· Plan and execute lead-generation campaigns through Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.**

**· Identify and target potential buyers, HNI customers, investors, business owners, NRIs, and other suitable customer segments.**

**· Develop targeted campaigns based on location, investment capacity, buyer interests, and project requirements.**

**· Optimize campaigns to improve lead quality, reduce cost per qualified lead, and increase site visits.**

**· Coordinate with the sales team to track lead status, follow-ups, site visits, and final conversions.**

**·  Regularly analyze why leads are converting or failing to convert and improve campaign performance accordingly.**

**2. Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing**

**· Independently plan, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.**

**· Manage lead forms, landing pages, conversion tracking, remarketing, and audience segmentation.**

**· Monitor campaign budgets, cost per lead (CPL), cost per qualified lead (CPQL), and return on ad spend (ROAS).**

**· Conduct A/B testing of advertisements, creatives, videos, headlines, and audience groups.**

**· Create marketing strategies for new project launches, promotional offers, investor campaigns, and site-visit drives.**

**· Allocate advertising budgets efficiently to maximize qualified leads and sales opportunities.**

**3. Social Media Management**

1. **Manage and maintain all company social media accounts, including:**

* **Facebook**
* **Instagram**
* **YouTube**
* **LinkedIn**
* **Other relevant social media platforms**

title: Marketing Executive

**Be a Part of Simulating Future Innovations**

We at COMSOL, create our own simulation software and provide it to technology enterprises, government facilities, and academic research institutions. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is the premier modeling tool for simulating technical applications in almost all engineering industries and scientific disciplines. Users of the COMSOL® software are the preeminent engineers and scientists in their respective fields who require simulations to advance their innovations and objectives. They invent and optimize new and existing processes and products that matter to the future of our world.

COMSOL is seeking a full-time Marketing Executive to join the team in the Bengaluru Office.

**Job Description**

The objective of this role is to increase brand awareness and demand for the COMSOL Multiphysics® simulation software in India. This position is ideal for a young professional with up to two years of experience in marketing. If successful, you will join a close-knit team of sales, marketing, and technical specialists that form an important part of this rapidly expanding global company.

**Responsibilities**

While the role will continue to grow and evolve, starting responsibilities may include:

• Plan and execute targeted ABM (Account-Based Marketing) campaigns in collaboration with internal teams and key stakeholders, using personalized, multi-channel engagement strategies to reach priority accounts.

• Manage end-to-end participation in sponsored exhibitions and industry events, including event selection, vendor coordination, onsite execution, lead management, post-event analysis, and reporting.

• Represent COMSOL at conferences, trade shows, exhibitions, and other technical and industry gatherings to strengthen brand visibility and engage with relevant audiences.

• Plan and execute end-to-end technical webinars, and other online engagement programs, including media vendor management, coordination, and post-event follow-up.

• Regularly process and maintain customer and prospect information and support CRM-related activities and projects to improve data quality and marketing effectiveness.

• Manage campaigns with media partners and identify new partnership and collaboration opportunities to expand COMSOL’s reach among relevant audiences, for print and digital outreach.

**Minimum Qualifications**

• B.Tech. or bachelor's degree in engineering is required with a strong technical background.

• Detail-oriented self-starter with strong organizational skills.

• Resourceful in solving problems with a passion to learn.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Postgraduate degree in Marketing or related experience of 1-2 years.

• Understanding of lead generation, lead nurturing, sales funnels, and pipeline management.

• Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

**Personal Growth**

Supporting your success in your role as a Marketing Executive will be other sales and marketing specialists, applications engineers, and software developers who occupy the top echelons of their areas of expertise. You will see and participate in the development and operation of many and varied cutting-edge new technologies.

As a marketing executive, you will work with some of the most preeminent engineers and scientists in their respective fields, who are simulating innovations and ideas for the future.

**About COMSOL**

COMSOL is the leading innovator of multiphysics software for research and development (R&D). Our products are continuously pushing the boundaries of computer-aided engineering (CAE), so that our customers can solve challenging science and engineering problems and develop better products, faster.

The COMSOL product family enables our end users to solve even the most sophisticated science and engineering problems, thanks to our intuitive and flexible graphical user interface. We create the tools that drive breakthroughs in physics and engineering — and we love what we do.

**Working at COMSOL**

The COMSOL Group is a fast-growing, high-tech engineering software company founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1986, with 16 offices and a distributor network worldwide.

The COMSOL office in Bangalore is spacious, bright, and comfortable. Our corporate culture is innovative, vibrant, and cutting-edge. We are committed to encouraging creativity through an exciting and challenging environment in which individuals excel and grow. Our talented employees and an active learning environment are the keys to our success.

title: Strategic Marketing & Market Development Lead — Defence AI
description:
**About Auric AI**

Auric AI helps the people who defend the country make faster, sharper decisions. We take the flood of data they collect across every source and turn it into answers they can act on. Behind it is a research-first team working on some of the hardest problems in AI, from intelligence fusion to computer vision to signals analysis, built in India for Indian needs. We are now building out the commercial side from the ground up. Our research and engineering teams work on some of the most challenging problems in AI, developing technologies designed to fundamentally transform how defence and intelligence organisations gather information, understand complex situations, and make decisions.

However, building extraordinary technology is only half the challenge. The other half is ensuring that the right people understand what is technologically possible, recognise its implications, and are inspired to adopt capabilities they may never have imagined. That is the challenge we want you to solve.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an exceptionally sharp, proactive, and unconventional thinker to lead marketing and market development at Auric AI. You will be responsible for building our marketing strategy and execution capabilities from the ground up, creating awareness and demand for highly advanced AI technology among India's defence, intelligence, and national security ecosystem.

*This is not a conventional marketing role.*

We are
*not*
looking for someone who simply manages social media, organises exhibitions, publishes content, or runs established marketing campaigns.

We want someone capable of inventing entirely new ways to make sophisticated technology visible, compelling, and relevant to a highly specialised audience. Our potential customers include organisations within India's armed forces, intelligence community, security establishment, and the broader defence technology ecosystem. Reaching these audiences requires an unusual combination of creativity, strategic intelligence, persistence, resourcefulness, and credibility. You will have significant autonomy, direct access to our technical teams, and the freedom to experiment with ambitious and unconventional approaches.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Build and Own Auric AI's Marketing Strategy**

* Develop and execute our end-to-end marketing and market-development strategy.
* Identify the most relevant audiences, decision-makers, influencers, and institutions across India's defence and national security ecosystem.
* Understand how sophisticated defence technologies gain awareness, credibility, trust, and adoption.
* Identify gaps between what defence and intelligence users currently believe is possible and what advanced AI can actually achieve.
* Develop creative and cost-effective strategies to close those gaps.
* Build marketing initiatives that translate into genuine customer interest, technical engagements, and opportunities for adoption.

**2. Develop Unconventional, High-Impact Marketing Initiatives**

We are particularly interested in strategies that go beyond conventional defence exhibitions, industry conferences, LinkedIn campaigns, and public relations.

You should be capable of independently conceiving and executing initiatives such as:

* Innovative demonstrations that show defence and intelligence professionals the art of what is possible with AI.
* Highly targeted campaigns around operational challenges facing national security organisations.
* Original research, technical narratives, and educational initiatives that reshape how potential users think about emerging technology.
* Creative ways of engaging influential stakeholders, institutions, technical communities, and relevant thought leaders.
* Unconventional partnerships, curated engagements, technical showcases, and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Entirely new approaches to reaching niche audiences that have not previously been explored.

These are examples, not instructions.

We expect you to challenge our assumptions, experiment independently, and discover opportunities that others may overlook.

**3. Make Complex AI Technology Compelling**

* Work closely with our researchers, engineers, and product teams to deeply understand our technology.
* Translate sophisticated AI capabilities into clear, credible, and compelling narratives.
* Develop content, demonstrations, presentations, technical explainers, and strategic communications for defence and national security audiences.
* Communicate effectively with both technical specialists and senior institutional decision-makers.
* Help potential users understand how emerging AI capabilities could transform intelligence analysis, situational awareness, and other national security workflows.

Your responsibility is not simply to explain what our technology does.

**It is to inspire customers to rethink what technology could make possible.**

**4. Create Awareness, Credibility, and Customer Engagement**

* Design strategies to reach relevant stakeholders within India's defence and intelligence ecosystem.
* Work with our leadership to identify and develop potential customer relationships.
* Create opportunities for substantive technical discussions, demonstrations, evaluations, and pilots.
* Build relationships with relevant research institutions, industry organisations, technology communities, and strategic partners.
* Develop an understanding of India's defence technology adoption environment and the institutional realities that shape it.
* Measure success through meaningful engagement, qualified opportunities, and long-term strategic impact rather than superficial publicity.

All outreach, demonstrations, and external communications must respect confidentiality, security requirements, and applicable laws and procurement processes.

**5. Build the Function From Scratch**

You will initially operate with a high degree of independence.

You must be equally comfortable developing an ambitious strategy and personally executing the work required to make it happen.

Over time, you may build a team, engage specialist partners, establish processes, and scale successful initiatives.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of outcomes rather than someone who requires an established team, a predefined playbook, or detailed instructions.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Lead Auric AI’s
  **go-to-market and strategic marketing**
  efforts, combining
  **market intelligence, customer discovery, technical storytelling, demand generation, and strategic partnerships**
  to build awareness and qualified engagement across India’s
  **defence technology, and national-security**
  ecosystem.
* **Exceptional proactivity and ownership**
  : You naturally identify opportunities, take initiative, overcome obstacles, and drive things forward without waiting to be told what to do.
* **Unconventional and original thinking**
  : You can develop genuinely creative approaches to difficult problems. You challenge assumptions, find non-obvious opportunities, and understand why an unusual strategy might succeed.
* **Exceptional intellectual ability**
  : You are an unusually sharp thinker who can understand unfamiliar industries, complex technology, institutional incentives, and difficult strategic problems. You reason from fundamental principles rather than relying exclusively on established playbooks.
* **A strong bias toward execution:**
  You can turn ambitious ideas into real initiatives. You are resourceful, persistent, experimental, and capable of delivering meaningful results with limited resources.
* **Deep intellectual curiosity**
  : You enjoy understanding difficult technical problems and sophisticated technology. You do not need to be an AI researcher, but you should be excited to engage closely with exceptional researchers and engineers.
* **Outstanding communication**
  : You can make complex ideas intuitive and compelling without resorting to exaggeration, superficial marketing language, or technical inaccuracies.
* **Professional judgment and discretion:**
  You understand the importance of credibility, confidentiality, ethical conduct, and responsible communication when working in sensitive national security domains.

**What We Do Not Require**

* Previous experience in defence, intelligence, or national security.
* A conventional marketing background.
* A particular educational qualification or university pedigree.
* An MBA.
* A minimum number of years of experience.
* Previous employment at a prestigious organisation.
* Experience managing large marketing teams or budgets.

Prior defence-sector experience can be useful, but it is not a substitute for exceptional thinking and initiative.

We welcome applicants from entrepreneurship, growth, business strategy, engineering, journalism, creative communications, research, and other unconventional backgrounds.

**We care far more about evidence of exceptional individual ability than about where you have worked or what your job title was.**

**Why Join Auric AI?**

* Work on advanced AI technologies with potentially significant implications for India's national security capabilities.
* Collaborate directly with an ambitious research, engineering, and leadership team.
* Build and shape a critical organisational function from the ground up.
* Enjoy substantial independence and ownership.
* Experiment with unconventional strategies rather than simply executing established marketing practices.
* Help introduce transformative technologies to institutions working on some of India's most consequential challenges.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your résumé.

We would also be interested in hearing about:

1. **The most unconventional idea or initiative you personally conceived and executed.**
   What made it different, why did you believe it would work, and what happened?
2. **An exceptional accomplishment achieved despite significant constraints.**
   What did you personally do, what obstacles did you face, and what were the results?

These examples can come from any field and do not need to involve marketing or defence.

We are not looking for someone who merely knows how marketing is typically done.

**We are looking for someone who can independently figure out how it should be done when no existing playbook is good enough.**

title: Creative Marketing Specialist
description:
We're looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and self-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team at Micromobility Industries!

We work at the intersection of mobility, technology, and innovation, bringing people and businesses together through international events, podcasts, webinars, and digital content and we’re one of the largest media platforms and our content should and does portray just that.

We're a growing startup with a lot happening, and we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys marketing, has a great creative eye, and can take ownership of things from start to finish.

This is a hands-on role where you'll have the freedom to experiment, bring your own ideas to the table, and shape how we communicate with our audience. We're always open to fresh perspectives, unconventional ideas, and innovative ways of getting things done. In fact, we'd love someone who can introduce us to new tools, creative approaches, and smarter ways of working.

**What you'll be doing**

* Planning and executing marketing campaigns for our international events, podcasts, webinars, and other initiatives.
* Creating and managing communications calendars to ensure our marketing activities are well planned, coordinated, and delivered on time.
* Developing engaging content for social media, newsletters, email campaigns, and other digital channels.
* Designing visually appealing creatives and marketing materials that are consistent with our brand.
* Editing videos, creating reels, podcast snippets, event highlights, and other promotional content.
* Managing content uploads, scheduling, publishing, and distribution across different platforms.
* Coming up with new campaign ideas and exploring creative ways to grow our audience and improve engagement.
* Tracking campaign performance and identifying opportunities to make our marketing more effective.

**What we're looking for**

We're looking for someone who is comfortable working independently and enjoys taking responsibility for their work. You'll have the support of the team, of course, but we're hoping to find someone who can manage their own priorities, make decisions, and keep things moving without needing constant supervision.

Ideally, you'll bring:

* Hands-on experience in digital marketing, content creation, and campaign management.
* A strong sense of design and aesthetics, along with experience using tools like Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.
* Good video-editing skills and familiarity with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, or equivalent software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* A proactive mindset, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new tools and experiment with new approaches.
* The ability to take a project from an initial idea through execution, without relying on detailed instructions at every stage.

Experience with event marketing, podcasts, or webinars would be a plus, but we're equally interested in someone who is resourceful, eager to learn, and genuinely enjoys the creative side of marketing.

**What's it like working with us?**

We're a small, international team with big ambitions, and being a startup means there's always something interesting happening. One week you might be working on a campaign for an event in San Francisco, and the next you could be promoting a podcast, launching a webinar, or experimenting with a completely new marketing idea.

We value people who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable sharing their opinions. Good ideas can come from anyone, and we're always happy to try something new if there's a better or more creative way to get things done.

You'll have plenty of opportunities to learn, take ownership of projects, work across different areas of marketing, and contribute to a business that's growing and evolving.

**Interested?**

Write to Riya@micromobility.io - We'd love to hear from you! Send us your resume along with a few examples of your work, whether that's a campaign you've managed, a video you've edited, a creative you've designed, or something you're particularly proud of.

We're especially interested in seeing work that you've independently conceptualized and executed.

title: Social Media Content Marketer - Intern
description:
**About Lokal**
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
  
  
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
  
  
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
  
  
Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  
  
Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  
  
Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)

Xoxoday is a global B2B SaaS and fintech platform for rewards, incentives, loyalty and payouts. Over 5,000 businesses across 100+ countries use Xoxoday products to engage employees, channel partners and customers.

Measurement and Optimisation
  
  

* Own funnel analytics, attribution, CAC, payback and MarTech stack performance.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the current marketing team across performance, content, product marketing, design and marketing operations, across different products and geographies.

What You Bring
  
  
Must have
  
  

* Hands-on AI skills. You use AI tools and agents yourself every day and can demonstrate real AI-driven marketing results.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**About the role**

As Head of Product, you own the Shopflo product and design organisation end to end. This is a builder's role with a founder's mandate. Your job is to make product quality the most, make merchants successful, find where Shopflo wins structurally and re-platform Shopflo for the agentic commerce era while leveraging the massive ecosystem of PineLabs across online and offline payments, EMI and issuer relationships.

**Roles and responsibilities**

**Own the core product and make quality the moat:**
Own the checkout product and the ancillary suite, and hold them to a standard that is demonstrably best in class. Treat performance, reliability, and correctness as competitive weapons rather than hygiene.

**Make merchants successful, and build with them:**
Shopflo succeeds only when its merchants do. Own the outcome metrics that matter to a D2C brand — conversion lift, RTO reduction, repeat rate, cost per order, marketing ROAS, etc — measured per merchant and reported honestly. Establish and run a design-partner cohort of leading brands to co-create products that genuinely matter to our merchants.

**Set the strategy: where to play, how to win:**
Define Shopflo's segment focus and differentiation in a shifting competitive landscape, and be equally clear about where you will not compete. Drive toward two goals: maximum share of each merchant's total commerce GMV, and maximum share of their growth spends.

**Re-platform Shopflo for the agentic era:**
Make Shopflo agent-transactable, building the mandate, consent, and authentication rails for agent-initiated payments, exposing catalogue and offer data machine-readably, and rethinking merchant operations as agentic rather than dashboard-driven.

**Connect the dots across Pine Labs:**
Build the cross-rail products only Pine Labs can build - find synergies across online payments, offline payments, and EMI transactions to create offers, underwriting, audience, and insight products that Shopflo competitors structurally cannot match. This is as much an organisational job as a product one: you will need to earn data access, engineering priority, and commercial alignment from teams you do not control.

**Build and lead the product and design organisation:**
Hire, develop, and set the bar for the Shopflo product and design team. Establish the operating rhythm — planning, prioritisation, shipping cadence — and protect the speed that made Shopflo worth acquiring.

**Experience**

* 12–17 years in product management; 6-7 years building b2b / SaaS products; 4+ years leading product managers and managers of PMs
* Experience in commerce / payments / martech is key
* Genuine depth on the agentic shift across marketing, commerce, payments, and operations
* Fluency in the Indian D2C or e-commerce context
* Experience with a CDP is plus — identity resolution, event infrastructure, or data products spanning multiple sources
* Experience dealing with Shopify or custom merchant stacks is a plus

* Strong external orientation — able to bring market trends, competitive intelligence, and forward-looking (Horizon-3) thinking into the team's strategic agenda
* High degree of judgment, maturity, and executive presence; acts as a trusted strategic thought partner to senior leaders on high-impact, ambiguous questions — framing choices, trade-offs, and implications rather than simply presenting analysis; this role engages regularly with Senior Stakeholders and handles confidential strategic and business information

**Education**

**Responsibilities**

title: Director - Product Management

**Job Profile: Director of Product Management

**About The Team & Role**
The Food Product team at Swiggy builds the products, platforms and capabilities that power growth across the three-sided marketplace - consumers, restaurant partners and Swiggy’s operating ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a broad portfolio of Food Product charters spanning across, Discounting, Pricing and Ads This is a senior leadership role for someone who can bring strategic clarity to a complex portfolio, build scalable products and develop a high-performing product organisation.

* Drive the next phase of monetization across Ads, discounting and adjacent products - going beyond short-term revenue to improve partner ROI, product quality and long-term marketplace health.
* Partner closely with Business, Operations, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Analytics and Finance to build integrated solutions across the three-sided marketplace.

* 10 years of solid product management experience in consumer tech with 3 to 5 years of product management experience, ideally in discounting, pricing in e-commerce.

title: Senior Director - Global Alliances
description:
**Collabera Overview:**

Collabera is a global technology and talent solutions company with more than 30 years of experience building and scaling businesses across technology, talent and enterprise transformation. Under the vision of Chairman Hiten Patel, Collabera has built a global ecosystem that includes Ascendion, Cognixia and Hyqoo, with capabilities across technology services, digital talent, workforce development and Global Capability Centers. As companies put frontier models to work, Collabera is building a focused business around enterprise adoption. Cognixia, a Collabera company, helps organizations prepare their workforce to use AI. Collabera adds specialized talent, delivery teams and global scale.

**Role: Senior Director - Global Alliances**

**Location: Bengaluru, KA**

**The Purpose, Role Definition, and Requirements:**

We are looking for a senior commercial leader who can build relationships with GTM, enterprise sales, and ecosystem teams at leading frontier model companies. You will identify where their customers need support, shape the right Collabera response, and turn those relationships into qualified opportunities and revenue.

**What You Will Own:**

* Build senior relationships with GTM, sales, and ecosystem leaders across the frontier model market and understand their priorities.
* Lead end-to-end alliance lifecycle from first conversation to signed partnership and joint go-to-market
* Structure commercial models such as referrals, joint selling, embedded solutions, and co-delivery that drive measurable revenue
* Design and activate joint GTM motions including co-sell, co-market, and solution bundling
* Identify enterprise accounts where Collabera can help, then create account plans and GTM motions that turn relationships into business.
* Bring Cognixia's workforce adoption capabilities into relevant enterprise conversations.
* Shape offerings around Forward Deployed Engineers, AI engineers, AI-enabled technology talent and specialized teams.
* Connect enterprise demand with Collabera's North American talent and GCC capabilities, working across internal teams from idea to close.
* Own pipeline and revenue results and bring market insight back into Collabera's strategy.

**What You Bring:**

* 10 to 15 years in strategic alliances, enterprise GTM, business development, technology partnerships or enterprise sales.
* A record of turning senior relationships into pipeline and revenue.
* Strong relationships across AI, cloud, enterprise software or technology platform companies.
* A clear understanding of enterprise technology sales and complex account environments.
* Credibility with senior executives and the judgment to handle strategic commercial discussions.
* The ability to work across technology, talent, learning and delivery teams with speed and ownership.
* Experience with workforce transformation, talent solutions, learning or GCC models is useful. Existing relationships in the frontier model ecosystem are highly valued.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Working relationships with priority frontier model GTM organizations.
* A focused set of enterprise accounts and clear account plans.
* Cognixia's workforce adoption offer included in relevant opportunities.
* Measurable qualified pipeline, initial wins, and repeatable GTM play.

**Why This Role Matters:**

Frontier AI models are fundamentally changing what enterprises can build, how they operate, and where they can create competitive advantage. The next significant opportunity is helping organizations develop the talent, capabilities, and delivery capacity required to adopt these technologies at scale.

Collabera is building a long-term growth business around this opportunity and is looking for a senior commercial leader to turn our existing Frontier AI ecosystem into a scalable revenue engine.

Collabera already has established relationships and partnerships across the technology ecosystem, including OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, and other leading technology companies. The foundation is in place. This role is about taking those relationships to the next level—deepening engagement with partner GTM, enterprise sales, and ecosystem teams, developing joint strategies, creating co-selling opportunities, and converting the ecosystem into qualified enterprise pipeline, client opportunities, and sustainable revenue growth.

This is not a traditional alliance management role focused primarily on maintaining relationships, coordinating QBRs, or managing partner programs. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the commercial opportunity—identify where Collabera can create differentiated value, build joint go-to-market motions, activate partner channels, develop enterprise pipeline, and ultimately drive partner-led revenue.

Most importantly, this is part of Collabera's long-term, multi-year growth vision. We are looking for a leader who wants to build something meaningful over the next several years: shaping the partnership strategy, establishing a scalable Frontier AI GTM model, developing strategic enterprise relationships, and building a durable, high-growth business around the ecosystem.

The role carries significant ownership, visibility, and long-term wealth-creation potential, including equity/stock option participation, and provides the opportunity to work closely with Collabera's Chairman and President. This leader will have a meaningful voice in defining the strategy, building the commercial model, and shaping how Collabera participates in the rapidly evolving Frontier AI market.

**What You'll Do At Pega**
Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI. Translate strategy into action with MVP definitions, outcome-based road maps, and prioritized backlogs tied to OKRs/KPIs. Negotiate scope and priorities to protect outcomes while managing constraints; facilitate governance and issue resolution with senior stakeholders. Tell the story of value through executive-ready narratives, data-driven visuals, and compelling demonstrations that accelerate decisions and adoption. Coach teams on journey-centric delivery and help mature practices, templates, and playbooks that scale success across accounts. Identify growth opportunities through realized outcomes, adoption signals, and stakeholder advocacy; contribute to proposals and SoWs. Drive account hygiene (timely and accurate contractual documentation, Project Status Reports (PSRs), Engagement Status Updates (ESUs), forecasts, and A/R collections) Step up to play Scrum Master or a Pega Business Architect role as required Advise on Pegasystems’ delivery methodology and how this can be harmonized with a client’s methodology; demonstrate a thorough understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum approaches to delivery.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a Designer for Customer Success—a confident facilitator, negotiator, and storyteller who can move seamlessly from the whiteboard to the boardroom. You make ambiguity actionable, connect ideas to outcomes, and inspire teams and executives alike. You balance creativity with pragmatism—and never lose sight of measurable value. You thrive on co‑creating client success journeys, blending design thinking with business acumen to deliver outcomes that matter. You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles. You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You've Accomplished**
12-15 years in consulting/technology/ GTM with 4+ years leading cross-functional engagements and/or product/program work; proven track record designing client journeys, conflict resolution, stakeholder mediation and landing measurable business outcomes. Experience in managing resources in Matrix or non-direct reporting structures Knowledge of cloud migration strategies and legacy modernization approaches Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships at multiple organizational levels. Executive-caliber written communication; storytelling; ability to simplify complex concepts into crisp narratives. Practical Agile experience (Scrum/Kanban); skilled in discovery-to-delivery orchestration and backlog management. Certifications (nice to have): PMP(preferred), PSM/CSM, PRINCE2, SAFe POPM/Lean Portfolio, Service Design (e.g., SDN) Travel Requirements: 25% domestic Travel – periodic travel for co-design workshops, executive playbacks, and key launches (may vary by client phase)
  
  
**Pega Offers You**

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

title: BC sector-TMT-Partner
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION-Strategic Transformation Partner**
**Objective and purpose:**
There is a strategic mandate to strengthen EY's Media & Entertainment sector leadership within GDS through the expansion of the Strategic Transformation Partner (STP) programme. This leader will serve as the sector leader for Media & Entertainment, driving market development, executive relationships, industry thought leadership, and large-scale transformation pursuits across Streaming & OTT platforms, Broadcasters, Publishers, Gaming organisations, Sports & Entertainment businesses, and Digital Media companies. The role will be accountable for originating and delivering complex transformation programmes spanning Growth, Content Monetisation, Audience and Subscriber Growth, Revenue and Advertising Operations, Operating Model Transformation, Cost Optimisation, Shared Services/GCC Strategy, Commercial Effectiveness, and Business Performance Improvement.
  
  
**Scope of the position:**

* Build and lead EY's Media & Entertainment market presence by originating strategic transformation programmes across major broadcasters, streaming platforms, publishers, gaming organisations, sports leagues, entertainment companies, and digital media businesses.
* Advise executive leadership teams on strategic growth priorities including audience acquisition and retention, subscriber economics, content portfolio optimisation, advertising monetisation, rights and royalties management, operating model effectiveness, and business performance improvement.
* Drive industry-led growth by developing executive relationships, shaping complex pursuits, creating market-leading thought leadership, fostering ecosystem partnerships, and positioning EY as a trusted transformation advisor within the global Media & Entertainment sector.

**Essential Functions Of The Job (Enter The Description)**

* Lead large, complex Media & Entertainment transformation pursuits across broadcasters, streaming platforms, publishers, gaming companies, sports organizations, advertising businesses, and digital media companies, driving growth, operating model transformation, commercial effectiveness, and enterprise-wide performance improvement.
* Design and deliver strategic transformation programmes spanning audience and subscriber growth, content monetization, rights and royalties management, content supply chain optimization, advertising operations, customer experience enhancement, organizational transformation, and shared services/GCC strategy.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with CEOs, Chief Content Officers, Chief Revenue Officers, Chief Digital Officers, Chief Marketing Officers, studio leadership teams, and business executives, positioning EY as the preferred advisor for industry transformation and growth.
* Lead cost transformation and profitability improvement programmes covering content operations, production and post-production workflows, rights and royalties management, media supply chains, streaming and platform operations, advertising operations, audience engagement, and global operating model design.
* Oversee the development and commercialization of Media & Entertainment sector assets, benchmarks, and industry solutions, including streaming economics frameworks, content profitability benchmarks, audience growth models, advertising monetization frameworks, rights management solutions, and operating model accelerators.
* Shape and articulate compelling, value-differentiated proposals that integrate capabilities across strategy, operations, finance, workforce transformation, customer experience, risk, and organizational change to address client priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Drive integrated go-to-market initiatives across Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, Tax, and Assurance, establishing EY as a leading advisor within the Media & Entertainment sector through industry thought leadership, executive engagement, strategic alliances, and sector-led growth initiatives.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities (Enter The Description)**

* Exercise strategic judgment in evaluating pursuit opportunities, including deal qualification, win probability assessment, competitive positioning, and required investment levels to secure large, complex transformation engagements.
* Make informed decisions on solution architecture and value propositions by analysing content and production economics, audience and subscriber insights, advertising performance, rights and royalty data, customer-experience metrics, digital-platform maturity, and industry benchmarks to shape differentiated proposals.
* Direct the development of pricing, commercial models, and deal shaping strategies for major pursuits, balancing risk, margin, delivery feasibility, regulatory constraints, and client value considerations.
* Analyze client industry trends, competitive dynamics, and financial performance to inform account strategy, go to market priorities, and investment in sector specific assets or accelerators
* Make decisions on solution architecture involving GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, analytics, and automation, grounded in technical, financial, and operational analysis.

**Education And Experience (Enter The Description)**

* 25+ Years in Consulting (Big 4, strategy consulting), AI and data leadership roles, or large scale digital transformation
* Advanced degree preferred (MBA, MS in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering)
* Experience in the Media and Entertainment sector, including content creation and production, broadcasting, publishing, streaming / OTT, gaming, digital media, advertising, and media-platform operations.

**Knowledge And Skill Requirements (Enter The Description)**

* Deep expertise in the Media & Entertainment industry, including streaming and OTT platforms, broadcasting, publishing, gaming, sports and entertainment, advertising, digital media, and evolving sector business models.
* Strong commercial and deal-shaping skills with proven experience originating, winning, and delivering large-scale transformation programmes focused on growth, profitability, operating model transformation, customer experience, content monetisation, and business performance improvement.
* Extensive understanding of Media & Entertainment value chains, including content creation, production, distribution, rights and royalties management, audience growth, subscriber economics, advertising operations, content monetisation, and media supply chain management.
* Ability to integrate cross-functional capabilities including strategy, finance, operations, workforce transformation, customer experience, risk, and organisational change into differentiated sector-led transformation solutions.
* Exceptional C-suite communication, executive presence, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence senior leadership teams and Boards.
* Proven experience leading complex enterprise transformation programmes, driving measurable business outcomes, managing senior stakeholder expectations, and delivering sustainable value realisation.

**Good to have (Differentiators)**

* Recognised industry thought leader with established relationships across Media & Entertainment organisations, industry bodies, strategic alliances, and ecosystem partners.
* Experience advising broadcasters, streaming platforms, publishers, gaming companies, sports organisations, advertising businesses, or digital media companies on strategic growth and transformation initiatives.
* Deep understanding of streaming economics, audience acquisition and retention strategies, content portfolio optimisation, advertising monetisation, rights and royalties management, and emerging digital business models.
* Experience leading large-scale, multi-market transformation programmes across APAC, Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas.
* Published thought leadership, keynote speaking experience, or participation in Media & Entertainment industry forums, conferences, and executive roundtables.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
