title: Head Branded Content and Education
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented marketer to head branded content and education for PhonePe. As the Head you will be the brand champion of PhonePe’s content channels across social media platforms (Youtube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms), responsible for shaping and executing strategies that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and overall business growth.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that requires a blend of strategic thinking, P&L understanding, creative flair, and analytical prowess to build and scale PhonePe’s content playbook. You will work cross-functionally, collaborating with teams across Product, Business, Finance, Analytics, and Marketing to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
**Craft & Taste Supremacy**
: You possess an uncompromising eye for design, copy, storytelling, and brand nuance. You know the difference between a high-converting, humanly crafted campaign and generic noise. You have the experience of running long form content strategy and channels on Youtube.
  
  
**Thoughtful Tool Integration**
: You embrace modern creative technology and AI, but you evaluate tools through the lens of human enablement. You champion productivity and efficiency through automation, without compromising the creative soul of the content.
  
  
**High Execution Rigour & Governance**
: You establish rigorous editorial and operational standards, brand content guardrails, and human-in-the loop review processes to ensure every piece of work meets the highest standards of brand safety and quality.
  
  
**Executive Influence:**
You confidently articulate content strategy to senior leadership. You frame creative and content choices around business impact, brand equity, and emotional connection rather than vanity metrics or technological trends.
  
  
**Culture & Mentorship:**
You mentor brand marketers, social media teams and creative talent both inhouse and external, to elevate the story-telling craft. You build a collaborative culture where human curiosity and creative experimentation thrive alongside operational speed and business impact.
  
  
**Cultural Relevance & Trend intelligence:**
You have a deep connection to Indian consumer behavior. You spot subtle cultural shifts and turn them into brand campaigns that genuinely connect with our diverse user base. You have strong experience in enabling rapid-response and real-time content workflows that keep the brand embedded in daily national and regional conversations.
  
  
**Content Distribution:**
You have a deep understanding and experience of partnering with or working on media planning and distribution from your past experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Story-telling on Social Media Platforms:**
You will define and maintain the overarching content and narrative standards across PhonePe’s social media platforms. Establish clear guidelines for human editorial oversight, brand safety, and content quality, ensuring that the content and its distribution is able to meet business objectives.
  
  
You will translate complex financial and consumer tech products into clear, emotionally compelling brand campaigns. Present creative strategies, campaign concepts, and brand performance updates to executive leadership.
  
  
**Business Impact through Content:**
You will define the impact of our content on the business P&L and long term brand building. You will build and deliver on annual operating plans working closely with Business and finance teams.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Craft Mentorship:**
You will lead, mentor, and grow a team of social media, content and brand marketers. You will foster a culture of craft excellence, encouraging the team and agencies to push creative boundaries on content creation and distribution while maintaining strategic discipline.
  
  
**Campaign Execution & Performance Balance**
You will oversee key brand launches and high-stakes campaigns to ensure speed does not compromise quality.
  
  
You will collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Brand teams to protect brand integrity while meeting aggressive timeline demands.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Creative Mastery & Craft**
Deep experience in brand storytelling, content strategy or creation, high stakes execution at scale. across multi-channel environments (digital, visual, social, video).
  
  
A strong, proven portfolio that reflects deep attention to detail, diversity, narratives and formats. Clear editorial judgment with a track record of upholding brand integrity against low-quality, generic asset production.
  
  
**Understanding of YouTube as the growth engine**
Deep experience and understanding of building YouTube playbook: formats, series, packaging (titles, thumbnails, hooks), retention, search and discovery, and the long-form and Shorts mix.
  
  
Understand how to grow subscribers, watch time and return viewership through programming, not one-off campaigns, that leads to business growth.
  
  
Build YouTube capability across your team and agencies.
  
  
**Marketing Domain & Leadership Depth**
10 to 12 or more years of experience in creative leadership, brand strategy, or advertising agencies / high-growth consumer brands.
  
  
Proven track record of managing and mentoring teams of marketers, or creative strategists.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to articulate creative decisions clearly to business leaders and technical teams.
  
  
Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer tech is highly preferred.
  
  
**Mindset to Succeed**
You believe that Brand marketing leads to revenue growth and enjoy it!
  
  
**Craft Ownership:**
You take personal pride in the visual and narrative quality of everything PhonePe puts into the market. You reject mediocrity and generic content.
  
  
**Human-First Technology Approach:**
You view new tools and automation as a way to elevate human talent, save time on repetitive tasks, and unlock deeper creative potential.
  
  
**Systems Thinking:**
You build repeatable frameworks, review mechanisms, and workflows that help large teams scale quality output consistently.
  
  
**Adaptability & Judgment:**
You make sound creative choices in fast-moving environments, knowing when to move fast and when to pause for craft refinement.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 10 to 12 or more years in creative direction, brand marketing, or digital advertising, with at least 2 to 3 years leading brand or creative teams.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft alongside business impact.
* Demonstrated experience establishing brand content guardrails and quality review systems across large teams (50+ to 100+ marketers).
* A strong builder’s mindset with experience in high-growth consumer technology or fintech.

**Why This Role Matters**
In an era where digital noise and automated content are everywhere, genuine creative craft and human strategy stand out more than ever. PhonePe believes that blending human creative vision, authentic story-telling with modern tools and platforms provides a true competitive advantage. The Head of Branded Content and Education will ensure our brand remains distinct, emotionally resonant, always present and visually exceptional while empowering our marketing team to work with unmatched speed and focus.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)**

* Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
* Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
* Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
* Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
* Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
* Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Canada Lead-Deal Manager-Assistant Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline**
Clients and Industries, Pursuits & Commercial Excellence
  
  
**Role Type**
Deal Manager - Assistant Director
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Deal Manager - Assistant Director partners with Engagement Teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits. They engage early and at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions, touchpoint campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development and orals preparation. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director provides support, advice and expertise to in all the stages of Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase
  
  
**Deal Manager - Assistant Directors are expected to**

* Manage execution of pursuit process, including critical path, timeline, and interdependencies
* Assess competitive situation and help develop differentiated win strategy focused on client priorities while protecting EY’s interests
* Develop power map and tactics to navigate client buying process
* Provide ‘glue’ to focus and guide extended pursuit team through structured sales approach and proposal development
* Collaborate with extended pursuit team define, package and articulate compelling client offer across scope, solution, price, and terms
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals.

Additionally, the Deal Manager - Assistant Director is required to identify, develop and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the Region.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management**

* Partner with Engagement Teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for Regional strategic, high-end opportunities
* Leads by example and advocates for gold standard pursuit practices
* In collaboration with other pursuit team members (e.g., Deal Leader, Engagement Partner, Client Partner), develops client-centric win themes that underpin the entire deal strategy. Ensures the win themes are reflected consistently throughout all client communications and deliverables.
* Suggests creative ideas that enhance our win strategy or ability to differentiate
* Manage and leads the development of opportunity value propositions
* Develop strategic messaging and lead conceptualization of all client-facing pursuit collateral
* Ensures all pursuit deliverables (e.g., meeting documents, proposals, presentations) are developed on schedule submitted on time and with the highest quality
* Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit
* Ensures deal infrastructure is established & maintained, including TEAMS site, calendar, action tracker, team roster, notebook, etc. with support from the Deal Coordinator as needed.
* Develops and maintains the pursuit plan/action tracker and calendar, making certain that all pursuit activities are assigned ownership, tracked and executed according to schedule.
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals
* Supports team strategic and/or operational initiatives to develop new or enhance existing best practices, tools, or enablers.
* Act as the central point of contact in managing the end-to-end process: evaluating requirements, organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines
* Serve as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions
* Shares lessons learned, best practices and innovation from pursuits and other experiences with teammates, the broader BD community, and the global firm as appropriate.
* Act as the knowledge steward for the pursuit
* Builds collaborative relationships with pursuit teams & senior client stakeholders,
* Lead post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement
* Maintain relationships with other Deal Activation teams and key interdependency groups across the organization Participate in relevant internal and external networks
* Facilitate internal deal governance process

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Champion CoE best-practice pursuit management tools and processes
* Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes
* Demonstrate versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles
* Influence / challenge the account team to optimize the chances of winning

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* Work with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others
* Provide coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other Deal Coordinators in P&CE.
* Support the onboarding and training of new hires in P&CE.
* Develop and coach Deal Coordinators, Client Executives and Client Servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training
* Oversee the work of the pursuit support team, including third-party resources (e.g. Deal Coordinator, external translation services, etc.)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines which are essential for a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Strong inter-personal skills
* Ability to analyze data and derive conclusions
* Excellent critical and strategic thinking
* Excellent project management and negotiation skills
* Self-motivated, resourceful & ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred)
* MBA (Marketing/International Business)

**Experience:**

* 12-15 years in Business Development of which minimum 5 years should be in Bid Management/Pre-Sales/Pursuit Management in professional services organizations
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Must have communications and proposal writing experience
* Experience in managing end to end managed services deals
* Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc.)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

Ideally, you’ll also have
  
  

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel - including occasional international travel - will be required

**Technologies and Tools**
**What We Offer**
Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required
  
  
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

title: GM - Business Transformation Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Business Transformation Lead to drive strategic transformation initiatives across Business service domains, translating enterprise transformation strategy into executable product and service roadmaps. Reporting to the Head of Transformation – Business, this role partners with business leaders, technology teams, markets, Finance, GTM teams and strategic partners to deliver measurable business outcomes, operational efficiency, service excellence and sustainable value realisation. The role combines transformation leadership, business architecture, programme delivery, AI-enabled innovation and stakeholder management to help VOIS achieve its long-term growth and performance ambitions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development and execution of transformation roadmaps aligned to business strategy and customer priorities
* Own end-to-end transformation planning, design and delivery across assigned products, services and business domains
* Translate complex and ambiguous business challenges into clear opportunities, hypotheses and actionable transformation plans
* Drive revenue growth, operational efficiency, service performance improvements and value realisation through transformation initiatives
* Manage programme governance, risks, dependencies, milestones and cross-functional delivery across multiple portfolios
* Design target-state business architectures aligned with strategic objectives, operating models, processes, data and technology capabilities
* Ensure alignment between business and technology architecture, identifying gaps and enabling scalable, sustainable solutions
* Partner with business leaders, local markets, Finance, GTM teams, Accenture and technology stakeholders to support adoption and business case delivery
* Utilise AI and GenAI tools to improve analysis, documentation, automation, decision-making and delivery effectiveness
* Establish measurement frameworks and governance mechanisms to track benefits realisation and transformation outcomes
* Influence senior stakeholders through insight-led communication, structured problem solving and strategic recommendations
* Support enterprise-wide transformation programmes while ensuring customer, employee and partner experience objectives are achieved

**Who You Are**

* Strong expertise in business transformation, programme leadership and operational improvement within complex environments
* Deep understanding of business service domains, operating models and the impact of transformational change on service performance
* Proven ability to build and execute strategic roadmaps while managing dependencies across multiple teams and functions
* Skilled in business architecture, future-state design, value realisation and performance measurement
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence senior leaders using structured, data-driven narratives
* Experience applying Agile, Lean and systems-thinking methodologies to transformation programmes
* Commercially aware with the ability to balance customer outcomes, operational effectiveness and business value
* Experience working with AI-enabled tools and supporting AI-led transformation initiatives
* Telecoms and/or cross-sector experience highly desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives with significant business impact
* Exposure to senior leaders across global markets, business functions and technology organisations
* Ability to shape future operating models, services and business architecture across a leading international organisation
* Opportunity to influence AI-enabled transformation strategies and emerging technology adoption
* Collaboration with diverse global teams and strategic partners on high-profile transformation programmes

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced enterprise transformation and strategic planning capabilities
* AI and GenAI application within business transformation and operational environments
* End-to-end business architecture and target operating model design
* Value realisation frameworks and benefits tracking methodologies
* Global stakeholder leadership, executive influencing and large-scale programme governance
* Data-driven decision-making and transformation performance measurement

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
  
  
**Alert**
Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  
  
#JDEnhancedByTARA

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: Marketing Manager, Brand, Content and Events (Aetos)
  
About Aetos

Aetos Design & Engineering is a Bangalore-based engineering and simulation company that has been solving hard design problems since 2004. Our 35+ engineers have delivered 100+ projects across six disciplines: systems engineering (1D and MBSE), CFD and thermal, structural and NVH, electromagnetics, wire harness and turbomachinery. We work with aerospace, defence, automotive, space, marine, energy and railway programmes.

The role

We are hiring a Marketing Manager to be the face and voice of Aetos. You will own our brand, content, campaigns, events and webinars from end to end, and turn deep engineering work into a story that customers in aerospace, defence and industry want to hear. This is a hands-on role: you will post, design, write, present and travel.

What you will do
  

You will run Aetos marketing across five areas.

**Brand and content**

•      Own the Aetos brand: voice, visual identity, templates and consistency across the website, decks and social channels.

•      Plan and publish LinkedIn content for the company page, several times a week, including carousels, case-study posts and technical explainers.

•      Turn engineering work from our simulation and design teams into clear stories, working with engineers to get the facts right and respecting client confidentiality.

•      Keep the website, case studies and insights pages current, with good SEO.

**Campaigns**

•      Plan, launch and manage B2B campaigns across LinkedIn, email and the website, with clear goals and reporting.

•      Run paid campaigns where they make sense and track what produces enquiries, not just impressions.

•      Build and maintain a lead list and nurture sequences in partnership with sales.

**Events and trade shows**

•      Plan and run our presence at trade shows and expos: stand, collateral, meetings, follow-up.

•      Represent Aetos at events, meet customers and partners, and capture leads and content on the floor.

**Webinars and thought leadership**

•      Plan, host and promote webinars and technical talks with our engineers.

•      Turn each webinar into follow-on content: clips, posts, summaries and an email to attendees.

**Sales support**

•      Create decks, leave-behinds and case-study PDFs for customer meetings.

•      Work with the sales team to feed back what customers ask about, and shape content around it.

What we are looking for

We want someone with [2–3] years of B2B marketing experience who is curious about engineering.

**Must have**

•      Proven B2B marketing experience, ideally in engineering, technology, manufacturing or industrial services.

•      Strong writing in English, with the judgement to explain technical work simply and accurately.

•      Hands-on LinkedIn experience: company page management, content planning, and paid campaigns.

•      Design skills in photoshop, Canva, Figma or Adobe tools, enough to produce clean graphics, carousels and decks yourself.

•      Experience planning and running campaigns, with a working knowledge of analytics such as LinkedIn analytics and Google Analytics.

•      Confidence presenting and hosting: you can speak on camera, host a webinar and represent the company at a stand.

•      Willingness to travel for trade shows and customer meetings, in India and abroad.

•      Organised and self-driven: you can run several things at once with little supervision.

**Nice to have**

•      Exposure to aerospace, defence, automotive, space or other engineering-led industries.

•      Experience organising or exhibiting at trade shows and expos.

•      Basic video editing for short clips and webinar highlights.

•      Experience with email marketing and a CRM such as HubSpot, and basic website CMS and SEO skills.

•      A degree in engineering, marketing, communications or a related field.

What you will get

•      Ownership: you shape how Aetos shows up, with direct access to leadership and the sales and engineering teams.

•      A real platform: an established engineering firm with 22 years of work to talk about.

•      Variety: aerospace, defence, space, automotive and industrial programmes to learn from and write about.

•      Location: Bangalore, on-site.

•      Employment type: full-time, permanent.

How to apply
  

Email [ aishwaryaj@aetos.co.in ] with the subject line "Marketing Manager, Aetos" and include:

1.     Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2.     Two or three samples of your work: B2B posts, campaigns, decks or event material, with a line on the result each produced.

3.     A short note (five lines at most) on how you would introduce Aetos to the market in your first 90 days.

We will review applications as they arrive and reply to shortlisted candidates.

title: Product Marketing & Content Manager
description:
**About ZOCA**
We are at $2.5Mn+ ARR, 1000+ beauty and wellness businesses on the platform, and a $6M Series A behind us. We are not starting out. But we are also nowhere close to where we want to be.
  
  
Zoca is building the growth infrastructure that small beauty and wellness businesses have never had access to. Online visibility, bookings, payments, customer retention, voice AI.
  
  
We want people who will think, challenge, ship, and own outcomes.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
There are roughly 8.5 million local service businesses in the United States. Almost every tool ever built for them helps run the business. Almost none of them brings anyone through the door.
  
  
Zoca is a growth system for those businesses, starting with beauty and wellness. More than 1,000 businesses use it today. We are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital, and GTM Fund. Our AI agents get a business found, answer its calls, book its clients, recover its drop-offs, and bring people back, all reading from one shared memory of that business.
  
  
Our customers are salon and med spa owners. They are busy, they have been sold to badly before, and they judge us on exactly one thing. Did more people walk in.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* The path from signup to first visible win, measured in days rather than impressions.
* Progression from the ramp plan to the full plan, and every lever that moves it.
* The monthly value report. Every account should receive an honest account of what we did for them, including how many of the clients we brought were genuinely new rather than people who were coming anyway. Being straight about that distinction is a competitive advantage in this category, not a risk.
* Product communication. Changelogs, in-app messaging, and release notes written for a salon owner rather than for an engineer.
* The knowledge base and the help content that both our AI front desk and our own team rely on.
* Positioning and enablement on the way in. Battlecards against the booking platforms, pricing communication, and launch messaging for new agents. This is a full product marketing seat, not only a retention one.

**Your first 90 days**
The order here matters more than usual, and we will hold you to it.
  
  

* Write the definition of a result, and get it instrumented

Our pricing depends on a number, and a customer has to be able to read how we calculate it and agree. Until that is true, nothing else you build can be trusted, and any communication on top of it makes disputes louder rather than quieter. Nothing else starts until this is done.
  
  

* Backtest the progression gate against real history

Run our criteria against accounts we already have and tell us honestly what it predicts. We would rather find out now that our own gate is wrong.
  
  

* Ship the first monthly value report to every account

Not a dashboard nobody opens. Something an owner reads in ninety seconds and believes.
  
  

* Rebuild the first 14 days after signup

So that a new customer has one measurable win inside two weeks, and knows it happened.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 - 6 years in product marketing, lifecycle, or customer marketing at a SaaS company. Small business customers strongly preferred, because enterprise instincts genuinely do not transfer to a salon owner with three staff.
* You have owned a retention or activation number rather than contributed to one.
* You can write clearly for a non-technical reader, with no marketing language anywhere near it.
* You are comfortable inside data. You should be able to pull a cohort yourself and tell us what it says without waiting on anyone.
* You will tell us when a number is not real. In this seat that matters more than being right.

**What This Is Not**
Not a campaign calendar role. Not a role where product tells you what to write and you write it. If the product experience is the reason customers are not getting value, we expect you to say so plainly and to push on it until it changes. You will have the access to do that.
  
  
*Zoca is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation is total CTC and includes a variable component tied to activation and retention outcomes. If you are excited by the role but unsure you meet every line, apply anyway and let the exercise speak.*
Skills: content marketing,customer marketing,product marketing,lifecycle marketing

**Marketing Executive**

**MishiPay - Global POS / Checkout / Retail Technology**

**Competitive Basic Salary and Bonus**

**About MishiPay**

**MishiPay**
is an international, leading checkout technology company that empowers shoppers to checkout in-store using either self-checkout via their own smartphones, or using MishiPay's industry leading, minimalist, low cap-ex kiosks. We are creating an enjoyable and convenient in-store shopping experience for leading retailers globally.

MishiPay now also runs Mobile POS, Click and Collect and Cash registers, so that merchants, who initially start with our self-checkout, can eventually run their whole store checkout process on MishiPay. With our technology, retailers have proven reductions in cost, due to requiring fewer cashiers, a marked increase in sales due to improved basket sizes, higher frequency of shopper visits and reduction in abandoned baskets, and in addition, all our retailers can access rich and priceless data about their customers. This enables a much better understanding of the customer journey in their bricks and mortar stores.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a highly creative, intuitive B2B SaaS/Retail Technology Marketing Executive to join our growing marketing team and support the execution of MishiPay’s global marketing activities. This is a multi-faceted design-led Marketing role, covering content and collateral design, video and creative production, events, digital marketing, social media, marketing operations and sales enablement.

You MUST have 2-3 years of highly creative B2B Marketing experience gained within a fast-paced business, ideally technology/SaaS. It’s essential that you have Canva/Adobe/Capcut and can create and edit B2B videos from scratch. title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
**Overview**
**ENERPAC – Who we are?**
Enerpac Tool Group is a premier industrial tools and services company serving a broad and diverse set of customers in more than 25 countries. The Company’s businesses are global leaders in high pressure hydraulic tools, controlled force products and solutions for precise positioning of heavy loads that help customers safely and reliably tackle some of the most challenging jobs around the world. The Company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin. Enerpac Tool Group trades on the NYSE under the symbol “EPAC”.
  
  
Our vision is to be our customer’s preferred partner through relentless innovation of industrial tools and services that help them safely and reliably tackle their toughest jobs around the world.
  
  
For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at
**https://www.enerpactoolgroup.com/**
.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Marketing Project Manager coordinates the day-to-day workflow of the Global Marketing COE creative project team. The role is the communication bridge between the onshore global marketing team and COE resources: receiving briefed work, scheduling it across the team, tracking progress, and keeping both sides informed. The role ensures work moves smoothly, deadlines are visible, and output reaches onshore review on time. The role supports the Design Manager, who leads the creative team and owns prioritisation and quality; the Marketing Project Manager ensures the Design Manager’s plan runs smoothly and both sides stay informed.
  
  
**Coordination**
**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Receive briefed work from the onshore global marketing team and log it into the project management system.
* Schedule tasks across the creative team (design, motion/3D, web, analytics) in line with the Design Manager’s assignments and priorities.
* Track progress of all live projects, keeping timelines, statuses and workloads up to date as the single source of truth.
* Coordinate handoffs between team members where projects span multiple skills.

**Communication**

* Run the daily rhythm with the onshore team across time zones, so overnight progress is visible each UK morning.
* Keep onshore stakeholders informed on status, timelines and any changes, proactively and without being chased.
* Route completed work to onshore creative review and track revisions through to sign-off.
* Flag delays, blockers and resource clashes to the Design Manager and onshore team early.
* Support the Design Manager with capacity visibility, timeline tracking and status reporting for planning decisions.
* Represent the India team's capacity in onshore planning conversations, advising the Design Manager and global marketing team on what the schedule can absorb.
* Hold onshore stakeholders to agreed brief standards, review turnaround and approval dates.

**Reporting**

* Maintain simple, regular reporting on delivery: what shipped, what is in progress, and what is at risk.
* Keep project documentation, templates and shared files organised and current.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong coordination and organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working daily with UK and US stakeholders across time zones.
* Proficiency with project management tooling (Trello or similar) and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to track many concurrent projects and keep information current, accurate and visible.
* Understanding of creative production workflows (design, video, web) preferred.
* Ability to work independently and exercise judgement on sequencing and trade offs, escalating with a recommendation rather than a question.

**Education And Experience**

* 4-5 years of experience in a project coordination, traffic or studio operations role.
* Experience in a creative agency, studio or shared-services environment preferred.
* Experience supporting distributed or onshore/offshore teams preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field preferred but not required.

**Enerpac Tool Group Values**
Be an ambassador for the businesses and ensure that Enerpac Tool Group Values always come first:
  
  

* SAFETY - Safety is our highest priority and is at the heart of everything we do.
* INTEGRITY - We will act with honesty and transparency and always do the right thing.
* OWNERSHIP - We will own our commitments, act with a sense of urgency, and deliver what is expected of us on time, or ask for help early enough.
* TEAMWORK - We will act as one Enerpac team, operate with an enterprise-wide mindset, and support each other to deliver for our stakeholders.
* AGILITY - We will act with purpose and speed, and we will adapt quickly to changing Circumstances

**What We Offer**
Our employee benefits including flexible workplace policies, employee resource groups, learning and development resources, career progression pathways, and community engagement initiatives are some of the reasons why we have had great success in bringing in new talent. In addition, our global employee wellness programs are crafted to support the physical, emotional, and financial well-being of our employees.
  
  

* Benefits & Perks vary by Country. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please reach out to us at: recruiter@enerpac.com

If you’re looking for a unique, exciting career with variety and potential for growth, Enerpac Tool Group offers challenges & extraordinary rewards for people on a global scale.
  
  
Never Compromise – choose ETG!

title: Marketing Excellence Manager
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the setting, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Lead the deployment, adoption and scaling of high-impact Marketing Excellence programs across APMEA countries and divisions. Translate regional and enterprise frameworks into repeatable playbooks, operating models and implementation plans that improve marketing effectiveness and commercial outcomes. Working across divisional marketing, country marketing, commercial teams and Centers of Excellence, scale priority programs such as KOL / Customer Advocacy, NPI launch excellence, lifecycle marketing and campaign excellence, ensuring successful approaches are standardized, adopted, measured and continuously improved.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Deployment & Scale**

* Lead regional rollout and scaling of priority Marketing Excellence programs across APMEA countries and divisions.
* Translate strategic frameworks into practical playbooks, processes, governance models, tools and implementation roadmaps.
* Manage cross-functional program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and stakeholder actions from pilot through proof of value to regional scale.

**Framework Adoption & Change Management**

* Drive adoption of frameworks including KOL / Customer Advocacy, NPI launch excellence, lifecycle marketing, campaign excellence and other priority programs.
* Partner with division and country marketing teams to adapt frameworks to business needs while maintaining common standards.
* Develop enablement materials, best-practice guides, communities of practice and training that embed new ways of working.

**Commercial Impact & Performance**

* Prioritize programs around measurable business and commercial outcomes, not activity alone.
* Define and track KPIs covering adoption, marketing effectiveness, customer engagement, demand generation, pipeline contribution and other program-specific outcomes.
* Use performance reviews to identify adoption gaps, improve execution and scale high-impact practices.

**Governance & Cross-functional Program Management**

* Build strong partnerships with divisional marketing, country marketing, commercial leadership, Digital Intelligence, COEs and other functional stakeholders.
* Support Marketing Leadership Council / Marketing Excellence governance, including prioritization, progress reviews and sharing of best practices.
* Serve as the central program-management point for Marketing Excellence deployment across APMEA.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate Marketing Excellence processes.
* Capture lessons learned from deployments and continuously improve frameworks, playbooks and adoption approaches.
* Partner with Digital Intelligence and AI / Automation teams where technology can improve program effectiveness or scalability.

**Success Measures**

* Adoption of priority frameworks across target divisions and countries.
* Pilot-to-scale cycle time and reuse of common playbooks / processes.
* Maturity improvement of participating businesses against defined Marketing Excellence benchmarks.
* Demonstrated commercial impact through relevant measures such as pipeline, revenue, NPI performance, customer engagement or productivity.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in marketing, program management, commercial excellence, product management, business development or transformation roles.
* Prior experience in life sciences, healthcare, applied markets, industrial, scientific instrumentation, diagnostics or related B2B industries.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex cross-functional programs across multiple businesses, geographies or stakeholder groups.
* Strong understanding of marketing strategy, NPI, customer engagement, demand generation, commercial processes and/or Marketing Excellence.
* Ability to translate strategic frameworks into practical operating models, playbooks and scalable programs.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a business-savvy, technically curious, and commercially minded engineer who enjoys turning market insights into business growth. Success in this role requires creativity, technical credibility, business acumen, and execution. The ideal candidate will help shape solution strategy, drive ecosystem engagement, create compelling content, and deliver measurable business impact. In addition to Go to Market strategy, the role includes multiple responsibilities within solutions, including block diagram analysis, performing teardowns, BOM analysis, and understanding and communicating conclusions to segment leads and management.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine their technical background with a strong work ethic, driving continuous learning toward understanding systems, business, market trends, marketing and partnerships. Success in this role includes:
  
  

* Driving awareness, ecosystem engagement and adoption of onsemi’s and our partners’ solutions.
* Identification of market opportunities that others have overlooked.
* Creation of innovative promotion and partnership programs.
* Development of content and campaigns that generate measurable business impact.
* Building relationships across internal and external ecosystems to accelerate solution adoption.

**Responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Go-to-Market Execution

Business & Market Analysis

Ecosystem Partnerships, Consortia & Reference Designs

Market Insight, Teardowns

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, MBA preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in semiconductors, electronics systems, product marketing, product management, applications engineering, design engineering, or related functions, or equivalent experience in system design at an original equipment manufacturer in data center, industrial/medical, automotive or aerospace and defense segments.

* Strong analytical skills with experience performing market analysis using tools such as Excel, Power BI and other data analysis and visualization tools.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and customer-facing skills.

**Preferred**

* Willingness to try new tasks, solicit regular feedback and pivot as needed

Why Join Us
  
  
You will play a critical role in shaping onsemi’s transformation into a customer- and system-aware company. You will work directly with senior business leaders and world-class engineering teams, influence investment and product decisions, and help create solutions that address some of the fastest growing opportunities across automotive, industrial, data center and aerospace & defense markets. This role offers growth opportunities and the ability to influence product strategy, technology direction, and business growth in multiple rapidly expanding markets.

(Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. title: Retention Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**

GOOD MONK (Superfoods Valley Pvt. Ltd.) is a food and nutrition tech startup dedicated to tackling nutritional challenges in India with innovative technology and products. With a vision to inspire healthy eating and living, GOOD MONK leverages modern science, deep consumer insights, and traditional wisdom. Our strategy revolves around four main platforms: transparency about food quality, disruptive food supplements, nutrition through snacking, and personalized nutrition tech.

**About the Role**

As the Retention Brand Manager at Good Monk, you will own the complete customer lifecycle, from first purchase to long-term loyalty. Your core mission is to drive repeat orders, improve LTV, and build meaningful, value-led communication across Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and App Push.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lifecycle & CRM Strategy**

● Build automated and personalized journeys across onboarding, education, replenishment, cross-sell, and win-back flows.

● Develop segmentation strategies using RFM, product usage patterns, family profiles, and nutrition needs.

● Own and drive KPIs: Repeat Purchase Rate, LTV, Active Subscribers, Monthly Retention Revenue.

**2. Campaign Planning & Execution**

● Build monthly CRM and retention calendars aligned with product launches and brand priorities.

● Execute high-performing campaigns focused on benefits, habit-building, and family health.

● Run targeted Email + WhatsApp campaigns for restock reminders, education, referrals, reviews, and festive events.

**3. Segmentation & Personalization**

● Build and manage cohorts based on user attributes, purchase behavior, and lifecycle stage.

● Deliver highly personalized, contextual communication to improve adoption, consistency, and retention.

**4. Analytics, Insights & Reporting**

● Track all retention KPIs through WebEngage/MoEngage dashboards.

● Analyze journey performance, drop-offs, content effectiveness, and cohort behavior.

● Study replenishment cycles across key SKUs (30-day, 45-day, etc.) to optimize nudges.

● Conduct A/B tests across content, offers, timing, creatives, and subject lines to improve conversion.

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

● Work with Creative teams to develop value-first communication around immunity, energy, protein, and family wellness.

● Collaborate with Performance Marketing for audience syncing, retargeting, and reactivation campaigns.

**6. Performance Marketing Integration**

● Partner with Performance Marketing to ensure a seamless experience from acquisition to retention.

● Build high-intent custom and lookalike audiences using CRM data for Meta & Google.

● Support remarketing, reactivation, and churn-winback initiatives based on CRM signals.

**Requirements**

● 3-4 years of hands-on CRM/Retention experience (D2C health/wellness preferred).

● Strong command of WebEngage, MoEngage, or Clevertap.

● Deep understanding of Shopify, GA, user analytics, and cohort analysis.

● Experience building lifecycle funnels, replenishment journeys, and subscription flows.

● Understanding of paid marketing fundamentals (Meta/Google) and audience strategy is a plus.

● Data-driven mindset with strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: B2B  Marketing & Partnerships Manager
description:

We replace fragmented, manual finance workflows with an intelligent operating system that helps finance teams automate collections, improve cash flow, and scale efficiently.

**Role:**

We are looking for a 
**Growth Marketing & Partnerships Manager**

This role will focus on reaching the right enterprise accounts and decision-makers, building relationships with ecosystem partners, establishing Valyx’s presence at relevant industry conferences, and strengthening our credibility across digital channels.

On the digital front, the focus will be on organic discoverability, high-quality content, customer testimonials, case studies, and third-party review and analyst platforms such as G2 and Gartner.

The ideal candidate has experience marketing a B2B SaaS product, understands enterprise buying journeys, and can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to build a repeatable demand-generation engine.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. **Account-Based marketing & Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute account-based marketing (ABM) strategies targeting high-value accounts, enterprise prospects, and relevant decision-makers.
* Work closely with Sales to identify target accounts, map buying committees, understand account priorities, and build targeted marketing programmes.
* Create account-specific campaigns, industry-focused messaging, and personalised outreach initiatives to engage prospective customers.
* Develop integrated campaigns across LinkedIn, email, content, and other relevant channels to support account engagement and pipeline creation.
* Build targeted campaigns around key industries, buyer personas, business challenges, and use cases relevant to Valyx’s solution.
* Track account engagement, marketing-qualified leads, sales meetings, and marketing-influenced pipeline.

**2. Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Marketing**

* Measure the effectiveness of partnership initiatives through engagement, qualified opportunities, and pipeline contribution.

**3. Events, Conferences & Industry Presence**

* Organise smaller, focused initiatives such as executive roundtables, customer meetups, partner events, and invite-only discussions.
* Coordinate pre-event outreach, meeting scheduling, on-ground engagement, and post-event follow-ups in collaboration with Sales.
* Build a structured event calendar aligned with target accounts, industry priorities, and business objectives.
* Track event performance based on target-account engagement, meetings generated, qualified leads, and pipeline impact.

**4. Content , SEO & Digital Thought Leadership**

* Develop and execute an SEO-led content strategy to improve Valyx’s organic visibility for relevant Accounts Receivable, collections, cash flow, and finance automation topics.
* Plan and manage high-quality content, including blogs, whitepapers, industry reports, solution pages, and thought leadership articles.
* Build content around customer pain points, industry trends, product use cases, and the business outcomes delivered by Valyx.
* Develop customer testimonials, case studies, customer success stories, and other proof points that strengthen trust and support the sales process.
* Improve Valyx’s visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms through relevant, credible, and well-structured content.
* Maintain a consistent presence across LinkedIn and other relevant professional channels to build brand awareness and engage target audiences.
* Work with internal subject matter experts, customers, and leadership to develop credible, insight-led content.

**5. Review Platforms, Analyst Relations & Brand Credibility**

* Build and manage Valyx’s presence across relevant third-party review platforms and industry directories, including G2 and Gartner-related platforms where applicable.
* Develop initiatives to encourage authentic customer reviews, testimonials, and feedback.
* Identify relevant analyst reports, industry listings, award programmes, and recognition opportunities that can strengthen Valyx’s market credibility.
* Ensure company profiles, product descriptions, and positioning are consistent across relevant platforms.
* Monitor brand mentions, customer sentiment, reviews, and competitor positioning to identify opportunities to improve visibility and reputation.

**6. Marketing Analytics & Sales Alignment**

* Work closely with Sales to align marketing programmes with target accounts, sales priorities, and pipeline goals.
* Establish clear tracking for campaign performance, account engagement, partner contribution, event outcomes, and inbound demand.
* Use tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, CRM, LinkedIn, and marketing analytics platforms to measure performance.
* Monitor lead quality, conversion rates, campaign effectiveness, and marketing-influenced pipeline.
* Continuously refine marketing programmes based on performance data, customer insights, and feedback from the Sales team.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs):**

* **Account-Based Marketing:**
   Engagement and demand generation across priority accounts.
* **Strategic Partnerships:**
   Partner ecosystem development and partner-led demand generation.

title: Category Lead — Car Commerce
description:
**Lane | Bengaluru |**

**Reports to the CEO/ Business Head**

**About Lane**

Lane is building India's most trusted, tech-enabled driving and mobility platform — transforming how first-time drivers learn to drive, and eventually buy their first car. We are India's first platform connecting certified driving instructors with learners.

In 18 months: 40,000+ hours of instruction, 4000+ learners, and a certified instructor network across Bengaluru. We recently closed a ₹8.5 crore pre-seed led by Kae Capital, with DeVC, Antler India, Panthera Peak, Titan Capital and angels participating 

Link:
https://lnkd.in/p/g4m9ubMx
,
https://businessreviewlive.com/lane-raises-%E2%82%B98-5-crore-to-fix-how-india-learns-driving/
, 

**The Vision**

Every Indian's relationship with a car starts the same way — with learning to drive. Almost nobody owns that moment. We do

Lane is building the full ownership journey: learn to drive → get licensed → buy the right first car → finance, insure and maintain it → upgrade. One platform, one relationship, one trusted source of advice across a decade of a customer's life. The driving school is the entry point, not the business

The ten-year goal:
**1 million Indians into the right first car — approximately ₹1,00,000 crore (~$12B) in vehicle GMV through the platform**

The near-term mandate for this role:
**5,000 vehicles and ₹500 crore GMV in 36 months**

, on repeatable unit economics

**Why This Moment Is Different**

Every existing player — marketplaces, dealer groups, classifieds, OEM channels — meets the customer at the
*same*

moment: when they are already searching. By then the buyer has a shortlist, a budget and four tabs open. It is a bottom-of-funnel fight won with discounts and ad spend.

Lane meets that customer very early — when they decide to learn to drive.

We know intent before the industry knows the buyer exists.

* A learning licence is the most reliable leading indicator of a first-car purchase in India. ~60% of Lane learners intend to buy their first car — and we capture that intent at onboarding: timeline, budget, fuel, financing route.
* We know not just
  *that*

  they'll buy, but
  *how they drive*

  . Instructors spend 10+ days one-on-one with every learner; our sensor platform will turn that into structured behavioural data feeding the recommendation engine. No one else has behavioural data on a buyer before the buyer buys.
* We earned trust before asking for a transaction. That is a distribution relationship no marketplace can buy.

Every incumbent's incentive is to sell you
*their*

car. Ours is to find you the
*right*

one — and stay through financing, insurance, RC transfer and service.

Everyone else competes for the buyer at the bottom of the funnel. Lane owns the top of it.

**The Role**

Complete ownership of Car Commerce, built from the ground up. Not a functional role — you own strategy, growth, revenue, operations, partnerships, customer experience and team. You report to the CEO

**You will own:**

* P&L — GMV, take rate, contribution margin, working capital. Decide and defend the operating model: brokered, full-stack, or hybrid by segment.
* Growth — convert Lane's learner base into transacting buyers; build seller-side supply across direct sellers, upgrade cohorts and dealer sourcing.
* Partnerships — OEM and dealer networks, NBFC and bank financing (including thin-file customers), insurance, warranty, inspection.
* Product & Ops — take buyer and seller journeys from manual process to product; own inspection and trust standards, inventory lifecycle, delivery, post-sale.
* Team — hire and lead across sales, ops, partnerships and category.

**What We're Looking For**

* 7–12 years, with meaningful time in automotive retail, auto-tech, marketplaces or high-growth consumer businesses
* Proven P&L or business-line ownership — you have carried a number, not just a function
* Deep understanding of the Indian automotive ecosystem: dealers, OEMs, financing, RTO, used-car pricing
* Strong operating instinct — comfortable in inventory, margin, inspection quality and delivery SLAs
* Founder-grade ownership. There is no playbook to inherit; you are writing it.

**Why This Role**

The thesis is proven, the capital is in the bank, and the category is still open. The next decade of Indian car retail belongs to whoever reaches the buyer first and earns their trust before the transaction. We already do — this role turns that into a business.

*Lane is the brand of Inlane Technologies Pvt Ltd, a DPIIT-recognised startup in Bengaluru.*

title: Founder’s Office (GTM+Growth)
description:
**About OLake**

OLake is an open-source CDC tool that replicates production databases into Apache Iceberg lakehouses and keeps those tables fast to query. It supports sources such as Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, MSSQL and DB2, and runs without Spark, Flink or Debezium in the path.

Our users are data engineers and data platform teams around the world.

**Why this role exists**

OLake has strong developer interest, but more people star the repo than run it. This role closes that gap. You will get OLake in front of the right engineers, wherever they spend time online, and make sure what they find is accurate enough to earn a try. They read benchmarks, check the repo, and can smell marketing fluff from a mile away. Everything we put out has to hold up to that reader.

This is a hands-on lead role. You set the strategy with the founders, and you also write, ship, measure and show up at events yourself. You work closely with product and engineering, because a claim that engineers can't verify does more harm than no claim at all.

**What you'll own**

1. Developer marketing and content. Own the content calendar, including technical blogs, comparison pages and SEO. Ship the blogs with engineering, and make each one useful to an engineer before it mentions OLake. Take part honestly on Reddit and data engineering forums, and build relationships with newsletter writers and creators in the space.
2. Video and YouTube. Run a weekly live series where internal teams demo features and reproduce benchmarks. Bring in guest speakers on lakehouse setups and migrations. Produce product videos and short-form clips.
3. Community and field. Grow the Apache Iceberg meetups in India and help start them in other APAC countries. Pick which conferences to attend, sponsor or speak at, and write the talks and CFPs.
4. Positioning and narrative. Own website and homepage copy, and the positioning for new features and products. Keep every performance claim consistent across the site and backed by a published benchmark. Build a story that works for a global audience, not just India.
5. Growth analytics and activation. Run the measurement stack: GA4, UTM conventions, Looker Studio reports, PostHog experiments and Mixpanel product telemetry. Use it to find which use cases and companies are active, and run the plan that turns stars into active users. Evaluate new tools against a clear decision scorecard.
6. Leadership and planning. Lead a team of 2 and help them grow. Set the team's OKRs and run them in 2-month cycles. Turn founder-level strategy into plans the team can execute.

**Your first 90 days**

You'll start with a running motion, so the first three months are about learning it and taking it over.

Days 1–30: Learn the product well enough to explain CDC, Iceberg delete formats and compaction to an engineer. Read the handover doc and meet the team, founders and key community contacts.

Days 31–60: Take over the content calendar and the weekly motions. Run the next Iceberg meetup.

Days 61–90: Lead your first OKR cycle review and set the next cycle's priorities with the founders.

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-haves**

* 2-4 years in product, developer or growth marketing at a B2B SaaS company, in a role where you owned outcomes, not just tasks
* Technical depth: you can read a benchmark, understand CDC, and explain why OLake differs from Debezium or Airbyte without looking it up
* Writing that engineers trust, whether it's a blog, a landing page, a Reddit comment or a cold email
* Comfort pulling your own numbers from analytics and product tools
* Experience leading or mentoring at least one person
* High agency: you move without tight briefs and are comfortable with ambiguity

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with developer tools, open source or data infrastructure
* You've spoken at, run or organised community events
* Comfort on camera or hosting live sessions
* A shipped project you can point to: a ranking comparison page, a community program, or a campaign that drove adoption

**Tools and what you'll get:**

*Tools you'll use:*

GA4, Looker Studio, PostHog, Mixpanel, the Docusaurus website, GitHub, Slack, Reddit and YouTube.

*What you'll get:*

* A budget and the freedom to run experiments
* A product engineers already like, in a category that is still being defined
* Cash, meaningful ESOPs and a performance-linked component, with exact numbers discussed with shortlisted candidates

title: Sales Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Innovative Print Works is a Bangalore-based commercial printing company specializing in high-quality offset printing and book manufacturing for clients across India. The company delivers complete print solutions for educational institutions, publishers, hospitals, corporate organizations, and businesses, covering textbooks, notebooks, brochures, catalogues, magazines, stationery, and customized products. Its services include a wide range of binding options, promotional materials, and specialty items such as paper bags and branded print collateral. With modern printing technology, strict quality control, competitive pricing, and reliable timelines, Innovative Print Works focuses on helping organizations turn their ideas into impactful printed communication.

**Role Description**
The Sales Marketing Executive role is a full-time position based in Bengaluru with a hybrid work model, allowing a mix of on-site client visits and some work from home. This role involves identifying and engaging prospective clients, presenting print solutions, and managing the sales cycle from lead generation to closing orders. The Sales Marketing Executive develops and executes marketing campaigns, coordinates with the production and design teams to ensure accurate job execution, and maintains strong relationships with existing clients through regular follow-ups. Daily responsibilities include conducting market research, preparing proposals and quotations, tracking sales performance, attending client meetings, and representing the company at industry events or networking opportunities. The role requires consistent reporting on sales and marketing activities and contributing ideas to improve market reach and customer experience.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Market Planning and Marketing skills to design and implement effective campaigns for print products and services.
* Candidates should possess solid Market Research skills to analyze customer segments, monitor competitors, and identify new business opportunities.
* Candidates should possess proven Sales skills to manage pipelines, negotiate pricing, and close deals with institutional and corporate clients.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to present solutions clearly, collaborate with internal teams, and maintain professional client relationships.
* Relevant experience in B2B sales or printing/packaging/advertising industries is beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, manage travel within Bengaluru, and meet sales targets in a hybrid work environment.
* Strong organizational skills, proficiency with CRM or sales tracking tools, and basic knowledge of MS Office or Google Workspace.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience is also considered.

title: Product Marketing Manager, II
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**About The Role**
International payments is complex, competitive, and evolving fast. At Razorpay, we’re building the infrastructure that enables Indian businesses to grow globally; and we’re doing it at speed.As Product Marketing Manager for International Payments, you will own the go-to-market strategy for Razorpay's cross-border payment products – including card acceptance, digital wallets, and global multi-currency accounts.
  
  
You will craft positioning that resonates with merchants, drive high-impact launches, arm the sales team with competitive assets, and more. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role where marketing, product, sales, and compliance intersect.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
This role sits at the heart of how our international payments products go to market.
  
  
You’ll work from problem definition to adoption: shaping ICP, value propositions, launch plans, and scaled programs to drive GMV and activation.
  
  
Our product team ships fast across new corridors, payment methods, and use cases, so you’ll constantly work on zero‑to‑one bets as well as scaling proven products.
  
  
If you enjoy ownership, commercial impact, and solving real merchant problems in a competitive space, this role gives you visibility with leadership and direct influence on revenue.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own GTM for key launches end‑to‑end – customer and market insight, positioning, launch strategy, and post‑launch adoption
* Work with the business and product team to scale up brand-building initiatives for the 1-10 journey for Razorpay International Payments Brand.
* Turn complex international payments capabilities (FX rates, settlement, methods, compliance, risk) into clear, differentiated narratives grounded in merchant insights
* Define ICPs and key segments (D2C exporters, SaaS founders, global marketplace sellers, design services, etc.) and build segment‑specific messaging, use cases, and proof points
* Drive multi‑channel GTM programs (email, webinars, roundtables, social, PR etc.) to deepen engagement and adoption
* Build social proof at scale – identify the right merchants, craft case studies and customer stories, and plug them into sales material and social campaigns
* Partner with Product and Growth to identify opportunities across merchant cohorts, payment methods, and use cases
* Enable sales with sharp narratives and assets – pitch decks, one‑pagers, battlecards, objection‑handling, and regular training

**What You Bring**

* 4-6 years of experience in product marketing, brand building or similar, with meaningful experience owning launches and GTMs for technical or fintech products
* You’ve owned multiple products or major feature launches end‑to‑end and can speak to their impact
* You are a strong storyteller – you can take complex products and make them resonate with founders, product, and finance leaders
* You thrive in fast‑paced environments and can juggle multiple priorities
* You work well cross‑functionally – you can bring product, sales, growth, design, and PR together around a clear GTM plan
* Experience in fintech/payments is a plus; exposure to cross‑border or international payments is an added advantage, but not mandatory

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter
