title: Growth Manager (3+ yrs exp)
description:
At MySivi, we're building India's first AI Tutor that's transforming how people learn spoken English. Our AI provides instant feedback on grammar, pronunciation, and fluency, helping users improve faster than ever before. Today, we've already helped
**2Cr+ users**
, and we're just getting started.

Our goal?
**Scale MySivi to ₹500Cr+ ARR in the next 6-8 months.**
We're looking for someone who wants to build, experiment, fail fast, learn faster, and drive massive growth alongside the founders.

We spend more than ₹20 lakhs per day on user acquisition. But growth isn't just about getting more installs, it's about converting those users into paying customers and building a profitable business.

We're looking for a
**Growth Manager who will own the entire funnel, from acquisition to purchase.**
You'll work closely with performance marketing, product, engineering, and creative teams to identify growth opportunities and turn them into measurable business results.

We've raised minimal funding, don't believe in burning money, and love to operate profitably.

**What will you do?**

🚀
**Own full-funnel growth:**
Take complete ownership of the user journey, from ad impressions and installs to activation, trial starts, purchases, and revenue.

📊
**Find growth opportunities:**
Analyse funnel data, cohort behaviour, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and retention to identify the biggest bottlenecks and opportunities.

🎯
**Drive acquisition:**
Work closely with performance marketers to scale Google and Meta campaigns, improve user acquisition efficiency, and attract high-quality users. Experiment on new channels.

🧪
**Run growth experiments:**
Form hypotheses, prioritise experiments, and test new ideas across creatives, onboarding, user activation, trial conversion, paywalls, pricing, and offers.

📱
**Improve product conversion:**
Work closely with product and engineering teams to ship experiments that improve activation, engagement, trial-to-purchase conversion, and revenue.

💰
**Own growth economics:**
Improve purchase revenue and ROAS while balancing acquisition costs, conversion rates, average order value, and retention.

🤝
**Break team silos:**
Bring marketing and product teams together around shared goals, clear metrics, and data-backed decisions. Take ownership of outcomes instead of passing problems between teams.

⚡
**Build a growth engine:**
Establish a systematic process for tracking metrics, running experiments, documenting learnings, and scaling successful initiatives.

**You will be a great fit if you:**

✔️ Have 3–7 years of experience in growth, growth marketing, product growth, or consumer internet businesses.

✔️ Have hands-on experience working across both paid acquisition and post-install conversion funnels.

✔️ Understand CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, activation, trial-to-purchase conversion, and subscription economics.

✔️ Can independently analyse data, identify bottlenecks, form hypotheses, and turn insights into experiments.

✔️ Have worked closely with product and engineering teams to improve user journeys and conversion rates.

✔️ Take complete ownership of outcomes instead of waiting for instructions or blaming other teams.

✔️ Are comfortable getting your hands dirty: analysing data, building reports, setting up experiments, and following through until results are measured.

✔️ Thrive in a fast-moving startup where speed, execution, and measurable impact matter more than presentations.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience scaling consumer mobile apps with subscription or in-app purchase models.
* Experience with Google UAC (App Campaigns), Meta Ads, and mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer.
* Experience with WebEngage, Amplitude, GA4, or other analytics and lifecycle marketing tools.
* Experience improving onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, and trial-to-paid conversion.
* Strong analytical skills, including SQL or the ability to independently investigate large datasets.
* Experience building growth processes or working across marketing and product teams.

**Why join MySivi?**

* Work directly with the founders on a high-impact business problem.
* Own a critical growth function with direct influence on revenue and profitability.
* Get the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and implement your ideas.
* Work with significant acquisition budgets and a team focused on measurable results.
* Help build a repeatable growth engine that can scale across multiple products.'

**This is not a traditional marketing role.**
We're looking for someone who can connect acquisition, product, and monetisation and take ownership of turning users into paying customers.

Please apply only if you enjoy solving growth problems hands-on, working with data, and taking ownership of business outcomes.

Feel free to send an email at hiring@mysivi.ai with the subject "Growth Manager at MySivi - NAME" if you think you would be an amazing fit. Do mention why you would be an amazing fit. This is the fastest way to get noticed :)

We are fast and will complete the process within few days.

  Has shipped AI/ML-powered features and not just managed roadmaps around them. Understands fundamentals related to model tradeoffs, latency, hallucination risk, evaluation pipelines, and what "AI-native" means in a security product context
* **Startup execution mindset:**
  Thrives in ambiguity with minimal process scaffolding. Leverages AI wherever applicable for the entire PDLC and can write their own PRDs, run customer discovery, define success metrics, and ship iteratively while collaborating with Engineering, GTM and Sales
* **Customer Obsession:**
  Understands the security buyer & user journey including SOC analysts, CTI leads, CISOs, and the procurement nuances. Can translate practitioner pain into product value props that close enterprise deals and retain customers long-term
* **Metrics & data driven mindset:**
  Is data & metrics driven and makes hard tradeoff decisions using usage data, NPS signals, win/loss patterns, etc. Comfortable with ambiguous data and uses frameworks to help guide
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* UX and/or User Interface Design skills will be a key plus
* A technical bachelor’s degree and MBA preferred

**Nice to Have:**

* ISAC / Threat Sharing Experience
* Deep AI & LLM knowledge
* Has been part of a team that has grown significantly quickly.

title: National Key Account Manager- ECom
description:

**Location:**
Bengaluru

title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Company:**

Blissclub is one of India’s fastest-growing apparel brands, built with a singular mission: to build comfortable and functional apparel for India. We are reimagining the apparel space not just designing products, but building a movement. What started as a community-first D2C brand has expanded into experience-led retail destinations where our Blissqueens don’t just shop, they connect, discover, and belong.

Founded in 2020 by ISB alum Minu Margeret, Blissclub raised its Series A of $15 million in May 2022, led by Eight Roads Ventures and Elevation Capital. This was followed by a Pre-Series B round of ₹33 crore and a Series B round of ₹160 crore, led by Singularity.

Featured on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list in 2022 and 2025, we’re one of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands redefining comfortable apparel for India.

**Job Location:**
HSR Layout, Bangalore (on-site).

**The role:**

You will own a key part of how BlissClub shows up wherever a customer meets it: in content, on social, and in our stores. All of that work points at one goal, which is growing the core of the brand.

You will write the plan and ship the work. This is a hands-on seat, not a role where you only direct agencies.

* **Reports to:**
  Chief Business Officer
* **Works with:**
  Category, Growth, Revenue teams (D2C, Marketplaces, Retail) and the in-house Creative team

**What you'll own**

**1. Grow the Core**

* Own the brand plan for our core franchises across Activewear and Citywear. These are the hero ranges the business is built on.
* Partner with Category to sharpen each franchise's story: who it is for, why it wins and what we say about it. Keep that story consistent across the website, marketplace listings and store shelves.
* Build always-on and seasonal plans for the core with Growth and the D2C, Marketplace and Retail teams.
* Turn sales, review, research and performance data into sharp creative briefs, then measure what they delivered.
* Keep the Core fresh, relevant and aspirational through content, community and collabs

**2. Content Excellence**

* Set the content strategy for key communication pillars: what we say, to whom, in which formats and how often.
* Work with the in-house creative team from brief to final cut. You are the quality bar on every asset, including copy, visuals and edits.
* Own execution across owned channels: the website, social and CRM (email, WhatsApp).
* Run a monthly test-and-learn loop. Double down on content that moves engagement, conversion and brand metrics, and cut what doesn't.

**3. Social Media**

* Own the social strategy for each platform - Instagram and LI being key.
* Run the content calendar, the brand voice and the community management standards.
* Plan creator and collaboration content that fits the brand and doesn't just borrow reach.
* Grow the quality of engagement (saves, shares, comments, follower quality), not only reach.

**4. Retail Marketing**

* Build the retail marketing playbook with the Retail team, covering store launches, local activations and catchment marketing that drives footfall.
* Own in-store and storefront assets that turn browsers into buyers: windows, facade screens, visual merchandising communication, POS and in-store content.
* Track footfall and conversion lift by store and by campaign, then roll out what works as new stores open.

**5. Community & Collabs**

Make the people who wear BlissClub the brand's most credible voice. You will build and run our community: run and workout meetups, store events, and a steady flow of customer content. You will also own collaborations, including co-created drops, partnerships with studios, run clubs and like-minded brands, and long-term creator relationships that build affinity rather than renting reach. The test is simple: a community that brings people back, and collaborations that open new audiences for the core.

**Who you are**

You combine taste with rigour. You can spot great content, and you can prove that it worked.

* 5–7 years in brand marketing, with at least 3 years at a digital-first consumer brand in D2C, fashion, beauty or lifestyle.
* A portfolio of campaigns and content you led yourself. Please bring it to the first conversation.
* Hands-on social experience: you have run brand handles and know what works on Instagram today.
* You can turn data into a creative brief, and then show the impact of the work that came from it.
* You have driven outcomes with Category, Growth and Sales or Retail teams without having direct authority over them.
* You are a strong writer, because copy is part of this job.
* You are comfortable with numbers: you set KPIs, read dashboards and report results honestly.

**Good to have**

* Omnichannel or retail marketing experience, such as store launches, visual merchandising or catchment activation.
* Experience managing PR or creative agencies.
* A background in apparel, activewear or another comfort-led category.

www.blissclub.com

title: Product Management Principal Specialist
description:
**Job Title**
Product Management Principal Specialist
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Principal Product Manager will lead priority Front Office / SECO transformation initiatives from problem definition and MVP development through launch, adoption and scale. The role translates customer needs into clear product decisions and outcome-driven roadmaps, selecting the right mix of product, enablement and commercial levers to accelerate adoption.
  
  
Working across product, engineering, UX, marketing and customer-facing teams, the role will align delivery with go-to-market readiness and own outcomes beyond feature release—including activation, sustained usage, workflow migration and customer value realization. Central to this mandate is evolving Selling Platform Connect to improve how travel sellers shop, book and service content across graphical, cryptic and hybrid workflows.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Own the Product Vision, Strategy and Roadmap
  
  

* Own the vision, strategy and outcome-driven roadmap for priority Front Office / SECO initiatives, translating customer needs, user behavior, market insights and business priorities into clear hypotheses, adoption goals and measurable milestones.
* Develop compelling value propositions, product narratives and investment cases that connect customer value with revenue, cost, adoption and strategic impact.
* Define the path from MVP to scale through target segments, phased rollouts, readiness criteria and adoption measures, balancing existing workflow continuity with graphical and AI-led modernization and clear decisions to continue, adapt, reposition or stop.

Lead Adoption from MVP to Scale
  
  

* Own the end-to-end adoption strategy from customer validation and pilots through launch, activation, usage growth, workflow migration and sustained value realization, aligned with product strategy.
* Develop segment-specific adoption playbooks combining in-product guidance, defaults, incentives, enablement, advocacy and targeted campaigns, with clear criteria for voluntary or firmer migration approaches based on customer impact, prerequisites, risks and expected outcomes.
* Define success measures and use product analytics, customer evidence and business indicators to assess performance, remove friction across the user journey and refine the proposition, experience or adoption approach.
* Partner with Product Marketing, launch and customer-facing teams on positioning, readiness and enablement, turning successful pilots into repeatable go-to-market and adoption approaches that scale across customers, segments and related workflows.

Define and Use Adoption Metrics
  
  

* Define an end-to-end adoption measurement framework covering eligibility, enablement, activation, usage depth and frequency, retention, workflow migration and value realization, with clear baselines, targets and leading indicators tied to product and business decisions.
* Combine quantitative analytics with customer research and frontline feedback to understand adoption drivers and barriers, embedding instrumentation and analytics requirements into the roadmap before launch.
* Establish regular performance reviews to diagnose gaps, prioritize interventions and communicate progress and trade-offs to leadership.

Drive Cross-Functional Programs
  
  

* Lead complex cross-functional programs, aligning related roadmaps, dependencies and product decisions while preserving individual product managers’ ownership of execution.
* Establish shared outcomes, accountabilities, decision points, risks and success measures, ensuring launch timing reflects product, commercial, operational and customer readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders, resolve misalignment and sustain momentum amid ambiguity and competing priorities, building reusable methods, governance and assets to scale adoption across markets, customer segments and related capabilities.

Engage Customers and Shape the Product
  
  

* Monitor competitors, technology trends and evolving travel seller needs to identify opportunities and inform product strategy and positioning.
* Build lasting customer and internal partnerships through discovery and co-creation, adapting product and adoption approaches to the workflows, constraints and operating models of TMCs, leisure agencies, online travel agencies and other seller segments.
* Represent the product in executive discussions, roadmap reviews, pilots and launches, translating feedback into scalable product decisions and clearly communicating workflow value and successful transition paths.

Strengthen Product Excellence
  
  

* Champion outcome-based planning, disciplined discovery, prioritization and post-launch learning across the product area.
* Coach product managers and cross-functional partners on adoption thinking, product analytics, experimentation and value realization.
* Make clear trade-offs between feature breadth, experience quality, operational readiness and adoption impact.
* Ensure accessibility, performance, reliability and usability are treated as adoption enablers within the product definition.

What You Bring
  
  

* Significant product management experience with evidence of leading complex B2B or enterprise initiatives from problem discovery and MVP definition to broad, sustained adoption across multiple teams, customer segments or product areas.
* A strong record of owning product strategy and roadmaps while making difficult trade-offs across customer value, business outcome, adoption potential, delivery complexity and long-term product direction.
* Deep practical knowledge of adoption levers, including segmentation, onboarding, enablement, in-product interventions, incentives, workflow defaults, experimentation and migration approaches.
* Experience defining adoption funnels and using product analytics, customer insight and operational data to guide decisions.
* Proven leadership of complex cross-functional programs without relying on direct authority.
* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous product problems into clear choices, decisions and next steps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed levels, from portfolio choices and senior alignment to user journeys, blockers and metric definitions.
* Experience in travel technology, travel selling, servicing, shopping, desktop workflows or large-scale workflow transformation is highly valuable; the stronger requirement is the ability to understand complex domains quickly and turn them into clear product choices, adoption paths and measurable outcomes.
* A collaborative, pragmatic and outcome-oriented leadership style with the courage to challenge assumptions and make difficult trade-offs.

**What We Can Offer You**
🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
  
🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
  
🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
  
🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
  
🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
  
📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
  
🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.
  
  
Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
**Be aware of recruitment scams**
Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Brand Lead
description:
**Medicine was never made for pets. It was adapted for them.**

Almost everything treating your dog or cat today started as a human formulation, repurposed and repackaged for animals as an afterthought. We want to change this: healthcare made for pets from the ground up, not borrowed.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Brand Lead to build our brand from the ground up. You'll define how we show up in the world: our positioning, identity, voice, creative direction and the experiences that make us distinctive.

This is a zero-to-one role with real autonomy. You'll turn customer and clinical insights into a brand people trust, remember and choose. You'll work across digital and offline touchpoints, partnering closely with founders, product and clinical teams to build a category-defining pet healthcare brand.

**Metrics you influence:**

Brand awareness, consideration, customer acquisition, retention and revenue.

What You'll Own

* Define and evolve our brand strategy, positioning and narrative.
* Own creative direction across campaigns, content, packaging, website and social.
* Build a distinctive visual and verbal identity that stays consistent as we scale.
* Turn customer, vet and market insights into compelling stories and creative concepts.
* Lead campaign development from brief to execution across online and offline channels.
* Build a content engine that educates pet parents and earns trust in pet healthcare.
* Work with growth to connect brand building with measurable business outcomes.
* Build relationships with agencies, freelancers, creators and creative partners.
* Establish brand guidelines and systems that help the team execute consistently.
* Identify cultural and category opportunities that can make us stand out.

What You Bring

* 5–8 years of experience in brand marketing, creative strategy or brand building.
* Proof that you've built or meaningfully shaped a brand, not just executed campaigns.
* Strong instincts for positioning, consumer insight, storytelling and creative direction.
* Experience building brands across digital and offline channels.
* An excellent eye for design, language and distinctive creative work.
* The ability to translate complex or technical subjects into simple, compelling stories.
* Experience in healthcare, pharma, D2C or another trust-led consumer category is a plus.
* An appetite for ownership. You'll be building the brand function, not inheriting one.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, moving quickly and making decisions without a playbook.

Why This Is Worth Your Next Few Years

* Build a brand from zero, with the autonomy to shape its direction.
* Help redefine how pet parents think about animal healthcare.
* Shape a global pet health brand at an early stage.
* Work directly with the founders, with real influence over strategy, creative and customer experience from day one.

title: Head of Strategy - Startup - 90 LPA
description:
We are looking for a strategic and commercially oriented Head of Strategy to work closely with the Founder/CEO in shaping the company's growth strategy, driving key business initiatives and translating strategic priorities into measurable business outcomes.

The role will involve identifying growth opportunities, evaluating new markets and business models, driving cross-functional initiatives, and supporting critical business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen, execution excellence and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Corporate Strategy & Business Planning**

* Partner with the Founder/CEO to evaluate business performance, identify growth opportunities and define strategic initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

title: Co-Founder & CEO
description:
Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Company:**
 Assessli

**Location:**
 Bengaluru, India | Hybrid / Flexible

**Experience:**
 10+ Years

**Compensation:**
 Equity-Based | Founder-Level Ownership | Performance-Linked Incentives

**Hiring Timeline:**
 4–6 Months

**Employment Type:**
 Full-Time

About Assessli

Assessli is an AI-powered EdTech company transforming personalized learning, student assessments, and educational intelligence.

With 
**200K+ users, an established technology platform, institutional partnerships, and ₹50 Cr+ in business opportunities nearing closure**
, Assessli is entering its next phase of growth.

As our existing founders shift their primary focus toward Dots-In and building Large Behavioural Model (LBM) infrastructure, we are looking for an experienced 
**Co-Founder & CEO**
 to take full ownership of Assessli's business operations, growth, and expansion.

**This is not a traditional CEO position. We're looking for an entrepreneurial leader who wants to build, own, and scale a company.**

What You'll Own

* **Business Leadership:**
   Lead Assessli's overall strategy, business operations, revenue, profitability, and P&L.
* **B2C Growth:**
   Scale our consumer EdTech platform through acquisition, retention, monetization, and subscription strategies.
* **B2B & B2G Expansion:**
   Drive partnerships and revenue through schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and government education initiatives.
* **GTM & Revenue:**
   Build and execute scalable go-to-market strategies and sustainable business models.
* **Team Building:**
   Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing sales, marketing, growth, operations, and business teams.
* **Fundraising & Partnerships:**
   Lead investor engagement, strategic alliances, and business expansion opportunities.
* **Product Commercialization:**
   Translate our AI-powered education technology into scalable, revenue-generating products.

Eligibility Criteria
  
Mandatory Requirements

**1. Prior EdTech Founding-Team or Leadership Experience**

Candidates 
**must have previously worked in a founding team or held a senior leadership position at an EdTech company.**

Relevant positions include:

* Founder / Co-Founder
* CEO / COO / CRO / CBO
* Business Head / Business Unit Head
* VP / Director – Growth, Sales, Business, or Operations
* Early founding-team member with significant commercial responsibility

**2. Proven EdTech Business Scaling Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience, with substantial leadership experience in EdTech.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling EdTech businesses, products, or revenue-generating business units.
* Strong understanding of both B2C and B2B EdTech business models.
* Direct experience managing revenue, P&L, growth, or major commercial operations.
* Proven capability in customer acquisition, sales, institutional partnerships, and business expansion.

**3. Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Ability to operate independently with a founder's ownership mindset.
* Experience building and managing cross-functional teams.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.
* Willingness to commit full-time to scaling Assessli over the long term.

Preferred Background

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in founding teams or senior leadership positions at companies such as:

**Physics Wallah, Unacademy, BYJU'S, Vedantu, upGrad, Simplilearn, LEAD Group, Classplus, Teachmint, Allen Digital**
, or other established or high-growth EdTech companies.

Experience in scaling a business to ₹25 Cr+ annual revenue, managing substantial P&L, or leading large-scale institutional distribution will be a strong advantage.

What We Offer

* **Meaningful Founder-Level Equity:**
   Negotiable ownership based on experience, commitment, and long-term contribution.
* **Operational Autonomy:**
   Freedom to build and execute Assessli's business strategy within agreed governance boundaries.
* **Established Foundation:**
   Existing technology, product capabilities, users, institutional relationships, and market opportunities.
* **Strategic Founder Support:**
   Continued guidance and support from the existing founders.
* **Long-Term Value Creation:**
   Opportunity to build a category-leading AI-powered education business.

*This is an equity-first opportunity. Cash compensation and performance-linked incentives will be discussed based on experience, mutual expectations, and the company's financial position.*

Who We're Looking For

Someone who has already experienced the journey of building and scaling an EdTech business and is ready for their next entrepreneurial chapter.

Someone who understands that 
**building a great company requires more than vision. It requires execution, revenue, leadership, resilience, and ownership.**

Most importantly, someone who doesn't just want to become the CEO of Assessli but wants to build its future as their own.

Application Process

We are conducting a selective 
**4–6 month leadership search**
 to identify the right long-term partner.

Interested candidates should share:

* LinkedIn profile or updated CV.
* Details of previous EdTech leadership or founding-team experience.
* Key business achievements, including revenue, growth, or P&L responsibilities.
* A brief note explaining their interest in joining Assessli as Co-Founder & CEO.

**Apply:**
 ceo@assessli.com

**Email Subject:**
 Co-Founder & CEO Application – Assessli

*We're not looking for someone to simply run Assessli. We're looking for someone to take it where it deserves to be.*

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.
  
  
Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
  
  
Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.
  
  
**About Team & Role**
Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.
  
  
Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.
  
  
As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.
  
  
The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.
  
  
Further the role will be responsible for
  
  

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description**
Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.
  
  
You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.
  
  
You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.
  
  
You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.
  
  
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
  
  
**About You**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

.

  and

  .

description:

The team is mandated to support pre-deal and origination activities, including pursuits/origination client meeting decks, capital agenda info packs, value creation opportunity packs, industry insight packs, RFP solutioning, deal economics, orals participation, thought leadership packs and idea generation support. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm and help drive revenue growth by working closely with EY stakeholders on new pursuits and support the practice in developing end-to-end proposals and proposal presentations to clients

* AI-Enabled Practitioner: skilled in activating AI use cases and CoEs, ensuring client transformations are future-proof

* Collaboration & inclusivity: Operate effectively across cultures and time zones, fostering a respectful and team-oriented environment.
* Leadership presence: Demonstrate sound judgment in risk management and escalation; show confidence and credibility in client-facing interactions.

**To qualify for this role:**
**Must Have:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Systems, Engineering, Economics, or Social/Organizational Science and other similar fields; a Master’s degree OR MBA OR Master’s in business administration is preferred.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience
* Past experience in Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals and MedTech) and Healthcare (Payers/Providers) sectors
* Strong understanding of Tech and AI-led solutions to address client problems
* Experience in Go to market documents, company and/or industry research and thought leadership documents
* Strategy Consulting Projects: The candidate should have experience in working on projects/workstreams such as strategy design, go-to market strategy, investment strategy and feasibility studies, transformation roadmap, competitive benchmarking, revenue and cost management, value creation, operating model strategy, AI-led digital strategy, digital transformation, pricing strategy and performance management framework (all or at least few)
* Business Acumen to drive actionable outcomes for clients with the latest industry trends, innovations & disruptions, metrics & value drivers
* Good Business sense and logical reasoning and should be able to conceptualize research storyboard along with strong PowerPoint and Excel skills
* Self-starter, proactive, comfortable working independently and taking on significant responsibility
* Experienced in presenting findings clearly in reports and other deliverables to clients
* Experience in mentoring, developing talent, and managing direct reports
* Able to simplify complex topics for senior stakeholders; strong written and presentation skills.

**What We Look For**
We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to do it. We look for people with an entrepreneurial spirit: innovative by nature, always creating new approaches, products, services, and technologies. Helping clients solve tough problems and implement solutions requires strong intellectual abilities and rigor as well as a practical sense of what works and what does not. We seek people who strive to lead themselves, their teams, and their communities, and who can foster effective teamwork to drive results. Is this you?

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.
  
  
Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* Freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead - Digital Marketing
description:
**About the company :-**

Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for high-net-worth and affluent Indians. Dezerv is co-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor. They have led successful wealth management businesses and managed over USD 7 billion in assets. The Dezerv team brings together decades of investing expertise from leading global financial institutions like JP Morgan, UBS, BNP Paribas, etc. Our team of experts monitors the performance of portfolios and rebalances them if required to ensure long-term success. We are backed by marquee firms like Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, Matrix, etc. Since inception, our clients have trusted us with over 18000+ Crs of their assets.

**Why are we building Dezerv?**

Investing is stressful and emotional. Building & growing wealth is difficult and time-consuming. Most individuals struggle with managing their investments and money. Our goal is to help individuals grow their wealth without the stress, time, and costs involved in a traditional investment. At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.

**What are we trying to solve/mission?**

We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long-term wealth across various market conditions.

**Role Overview :-**

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of data, growth, and product. As Lead– Digital Marketing, you will own all paid digital user acquisition for Dezerv — architecting, executing, and optimizing campaigns that bring high-intent investors onto the platform. You will work closely with the Product, Data, and Business teams to drive measurable growth while keeping customer acquisition costs (CAC) firmly in check.

**Why This Role at Dezerv?**

* Ownership from Day 1 — Lead and shape the entire performance marketing charter
* Category-defining product — Market a platform that genuinely changes how HNI Indians invest and manages their wealth.
* Data-first culture — Work with real-time dashboards, rigorous A/B testing, and sharp analytics
* Rapid growth — High learning curve, fast promotions, and significant market opportunity
* Collaborative leadership — Direct access to founders and leadership team

**Key Responsibilities :-**

**1 Strategy & Execution**

* Channels of Distribution: Plan and execute full-funnel performance marketing strategies across Meta, Google, YouTube, programmatic, and emerging digital/non-digital channels.
* Drive user acquisition for the Dezerv app with a sharp focus on investor onboarding and activation.
* Creative & Comms expertise – Need to have solid creative sensibilities who understand what kind of creative narrative will drive impactful growth in CAC & scale efficiencies for HNI.
* Deep consumer research & brand building: This role requires a very deep and psychographic understanding of the TG and being able to clearly identify unique insights & ability to put those into a sharp comm and brand strategy takes the pie.
* Hands-on expertise: Ideal for someone who likes to get their hands dirty from writing scripts, to conducting high-quality shoots, managing $ spends on distribution to working closely with the product team to build and launch new offerings.

**2 Optimization & ROI Management :-**

* Optimize all channels to deliver the best possible ROI while meeting user growth targets
* Continuously improve media and product performance funnels — from ad impression to first investment
* Monitor and manage Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), LTV, ROAS, and other performance KPIs.

**3 Experimentation & Analytics :-**

* Design and run rigorous A/B tests on creatives, messaging, targeting parameters, and landing experiences
* Analyze campaign data and consumer behavior to derive actionable insights and iterate quickly
* Identify high-impact user experience improvements and work with Product to implement them

**4 Stakeholder Management & Reporting :-**

* Report periodically to leadership on campaign performance, trends, and recommendations
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Data, and Business teams to plan and execute integrated campaigns
* Provide clear, data-driven, and actionable insights to business stakeholders
* Drive end-to-end cross-functional projects and ensure alignment across internal teams.

**5 Trends & Innovation :-**

* Stay ahead of digital marketing trends, platform updates, and new technologies
* Ensure Dezerv maintains a competitive edge and brand leadership in the performance marketing space

**Requirements :-**

* 5-7 years of relevant experience in growth & brand marketing or digital growth roles.
* Strong background in app performance marketing (UAC, Apple Search Ads, Meta App Campaigns, etc.)
* Proven experience at a product company or digital/growth agency
* Hands-on expertise with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, AppsFlyer/Adjust/Branch
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work with large datasets and draw meaningful conclusions
* Experience managing significant media budgets with demonstrable CAC optimization results.
* Experience working with creative teams/large production houses to develop high quality-performance ad assets.

**Good to Have :-**

* Prior experience in fintech, BFSI, or wealth management products
* Knowledge of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Clevertap,Snowflake,SQL)
* Exposure to programmatic advertising, DSPs, and audience segmentation strategies

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
## About the Role

Own utilisation of a distributed rental inventory network through performance and retention marketing. Every SKU is a depreciating asset — idle inventory is a cost, not a missed sale. ROAS and CAC are levers, not the goal.

The Weekly Loop: Read → Diagnose → Act → Review

Read the utilisation report every week (by SKU × city)

Diagnose: visibility, budget, catalogue, retention, or genuinely low demand?

Act: pull the right lever across Google, Meta, catalogue, or lifecycle

Review the following week; iterate

## Key Responsibilities

- Read the utilisation report every week (by SKU × city)

- Diagnose visibility, budget, catalogue, retention, or genuinely low demand

- Act by pulling the right lever across Google, Meta, catalogue, or lifecycle

- Review the following week and iterate

## Requirements

- 1–4 years hands-on running Google Ads and Meta Ads

- Comfortable reading data weekly and drawing own conclusions

- Real diagnostic instinct — knows which lever to pull and when

## Preferred Qualifications

- Not a fit if instinct is “spend more, ROAS good” without asking why

- Not a fit if SKU × city-level granularity sounds like too much detail

- Health insurance

- Direct mentorship from Demand Gen Lead

- Real autonomy from day one

- Bangalore, onsite

title: Senior Lead - Marketing and Growth
description:
**About the Role**

Think Design is looking for a Senior Lead - Marketing & Growth to strengthen the firm's visibility, thought leadership and business growth.

This role will shape how Think Design's expertise, work and perspectives are positioned, discovered and valued by clients, prospects and the broader design and business community. The role combines brand positioning, thought leadership, digital marketing, content strategy and growth initiatives to build market influence and generate opportunities for the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

Thought Leadership & Positioning

* Drive Think Design's thought leadership agenda and market positioning.
* Develop articles, reports, case studies, viewpoints and other content that showcases the firm's expertise.
* Build visibility for Think Design's leaders, work and perspectives across industry and business audiences.
* Strengthen the firm's differentiation within the experience design, digital transformation and innovation landscape.

**Website & Digital Presence**

* Own the strategy and evolution of Think Design's website.
* Ensure the website reflects the firm's capabilities, offerings and market positioning.
* Improve discoverability, engagement and conversion through content and experience improvements.

**Marketing Channels & Growth**

* Lead Think Design's presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Google Business Profile, newsletters and relevant industry directories.
* Drive SEO, GEO and digital marketing initiatives, including Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns.
* Develop campaigns that increase awareness, engagement and qualified inbound opportunities.
* Track performance and optimise marketing effectiveness across channels.

**Content & Business Development Assets**

* Oversee the creation and maintenance of case studies, capability decks, credentials presentations and other market-facing assets.
* Ensure consistency and quality across all external communications and marketing materials.

**Industry Visibility**

* Lead Think Design's awards and recognition programme.
* Identify opportunities across conferences, publications, partnerships and industry platforms.

**Who You'll Work With**

You will work closely with:

* Think Design's leadership team
* Business and growth teams
* Design and research leaders
* Content and marketing specialists
* SEO and digital marketing partners
* Designers supporting marketing initiatives

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stronger visibility and relevance for Think Design across key markets.
* Increased impact of thought leadership and content initiatives.
* Improved performance of the website and digital channels.
* Higher quality marketing assets and business development collateral.
* Greater industry recognition through awards, publications and external visibility.

title: Digital Marketing Manager- Paid Media
description:
**About the Company**

We are looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing & Paid Media Specialist to join our team in an on-site role at BHIVE Workspace, MG Road. * Ability to understand campaign data and make data-driven decisions.

**Preferred Skills**

Expected salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**

  

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
  
  
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
  
  
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  
  
About this Role
  

At Fam, we believe great marketing sits at the intersection of culture, creativity, and execution. Building for Gen-Z means staying deeply connected to how young people think, communicate, consume content, and engage with brands.

  

We're looking for a Marketing Manager who can turn ideas into high-impact campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and on-ground channels. You'll own execution end-to-end—bringing together cross-functional teams, creators, partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver campaigns that are timely, relevant, and memorable. We're also looking for someone who is AI-native - comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, campaign planning, content ideation, workflows, and execution.

  

This role is for someone who has a strong pulse on internet culture, loves bringing order to ambitious ideas, and can balance creative thinking with operational excellence. If you enjoy building campaigns that people don't just see, but genuinely engage with, you'll fit right in.

**Must Haves**
  

  
* Under-graduate degree in marketing, business, communication, or related field
  
* 3-5 years of experience in campaign management, brand marketing, growth marketing, or integrated marketing
  
* Strong execution capabilities across digital, on-ground, and influencer-led campaigns
  
* Experience managing end-to-end campaign timelines and cross-functional coordination
  
* Deep understanding of internet culture, social media trends, and Gen-Z consumer behaviour
  
* Ability to think creatively while maintaining strong operational rigor
  
* Experience working closely with creative, product, influencer, and partnerships teams
  
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  
  

  
**Good To Haves**
  

  
* Experience in fintech, consumer internet, D2C, or fast-paced startup environments
  
* Existing awareness of influencer ecosystem and creator partnerships
  
* Experience launching product GTM campaigns
  
* Familiarity with meme culture, creator economy, and pop-culture trends
  
* Ability to identify and capitalize on cultural moments quickly
  
* Understanding of campaign performance metrics and reporting
  
  

  
**Roles and Responsibilities**
  

  
* Lead end-to-end execution of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, influencer, social, and on-ground channels
  
* Own campaign project management - timelines, coordination, execution tracking, stakeholder alignment, and delivery
  
* Work closely with brand, product, design, growth, and partnerships teams to bring campaigns to life
  
* Drive product GTM campaigns with strong creative and cultural relevance
  
* Identify trending internet moments, social conversations, and creator opportunities relevant to Fam’s audience
  
* Coordinate influencer collaborations and external partnerships for campaigns and launches
  
* Ensure campaigns maintain consistency with Fam’s brand voice and resonate with Gen-Z audiences
  
* Balance creative thinking with operational excellence and execution speed
  
* Contribute campaign ideas rooted in social behaviour, youth culture, and internet-first storytelling
  
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize execution based on insights and learnings

  
  

**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck**

  

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

  

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

  

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

  

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

  

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

  

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

  

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

  

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

  

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

  
  

**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**

  

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.

  
  

**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech**

  

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.

  
  

**Trusted by leading investors**

  

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

  
  

**Join Our Dynamic Team**

  

At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.

  
  

Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
  
  
**PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.**

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are looking for a creative, proactive, and execution-focused Social Media & Content Strategist to build and grow Edit Lobby’s online presence across social media platforms.

The ideal candidate should understand what makes content perform, be strong at content ideation and scripting, and have the ability to turn ideas into engaging, high-performing content. * Develop and execute social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, audience growth, and inbound leads.

* Ability to manage multiple content initiatives and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly creative environment.
* Strong ownership mindset — someone who can take an idea and drive it through to execution without constant supervision.

You are curious, creative, proactive, and closely connected to what is happening in the content and social media space. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you - hr@editlobby.com

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**THE DATES THAT CANNOT MOVE:**

* **In-person interview:**
  20–30 November 2026, at our Bengaluru office. It cannot be done online.
* **Applications close:**
  15 November 2026. We interview on a rolling basis and may close early once the position is filled.
* **All online rounds complete by:**
  19 November 2026.
* **Joining date:**
  1 December 2026. Non-negotiable.

You must be free of notice period obligations by 1 December. If you are currently serving a 60 or 90-day notice, the timing will not work and we cannot make an exception. Please do not apply — it saves us both the time.

**Please read this advertisement all the way to the end before you apply. It is long on purpose. It tells you exactly what the job is, what it is not, how we assess you and what we will not budge on. Applications from people who clearly have not read it are easy to spot, and we do not take them forward.**

**WHO WE ARE:**

**Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers — imported and locally procured — and we are building Supply Chain as a Service, a subscription model that takes over procurement for our clients entirely.**

**We operate three companies: Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd (India), Jane Tech Labs Ltd (Hong Kong) and Jane Aero Tech Supply Chain FZCO (UAE). You would own the public face of all three.**

**We are bootstrapped. No outside funding, and none being sought. We are small, we move quickly, and people here own real things early.**

**THE ROLE:**

**Almost everything Jane sells today is sold by someone picking up a phone. That works, but it does not compound, and it means every conversation starts from nothing. Few have heard of us before we call.**

**Your job is to change that. You would be our first marketing hire, and the mandate is visibility — constant, credible, specific — so that when a buyer at an MRO or a defence manufacturer picks up the phone to one of our BD associates, the name is already familiar and already trusted.**

**What you would own -**

* **The social and content presence of all three companies.**
* **What we publish, where, and in what voice — the creative and channel decisions are yours to make and to defend.**
* **Visibility beyond our own channels: podcasts, interviews, independent digital outlets, creators in the aerospace, drone, supply chain and manufacturing space.**
* **The production line itself — the repeatable process that turns one piece of work into a fortnight of output.**

**One thing we want to be honest about -**

**Positioning sits with the founder. Which markets we farm, what we sell and to whom — those decisions are made by the Managing Director and will be for some time. What is genuinely yours is how we show up: the angle, the format, the channel, the voice, the calendar, and the judgement about what is worth publishing at all.**

**HOW THE CONTENT ACTUALLY WORKS:**

**One substantial piece of work per brand, broken down into everything else. We are not asking one person to invent nine separate content streams — we are asking for a production line.**

* **LinkedIn —**
  the core channel. Posts, articles, case notes, founder commentary. This is where aerospace and defence procurement buyers actually are.
* **YouTube —**
  long-form. Founder explainers, field reports, teardowns, customer problem walkthroughs, podcast and interview appearances. This is the source asset; everything else is cut from it.
* **Instagram —**
  short-form, derived from the long-form. Clips, stills, carousels. Reach and recognition rather than direct buying intent.
* **Cadence is tiered by company, because they are not equally busy:**
* **Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd (India) — long-form weekly, with derivatives across the week.**
* **Jane Tech Labs Ltd (Hong Kong) — long-form monthly, with derivatives across the month.**
* **Jane Aero Tech Supply Chain FZCO (UAE) — long-form monthly, with derivatives across the month.**

**Each company keeps its own identity and its own audience. They are not one brand with three logos, and the voice for a Hong Kong trading entity is not the voice for an Indian supply chain business.**

**WHERE THIS ROLE GOES:**

**Within about six months we expect to have AI agents doing the repetitive end of this work — cutting the derivatives, drafting the first version, scheduling, monitoring. We are telling you this in the advertisement for two reasons.**

**First, so you understand what we are optimising for: we do not need someone whose value is raw output volume, because that part is going away. We need someone who can define a process clearly enough to hand it over, judge what comes back, and hold a consistent voice across three brands without writing every word of it.**

**Second, because it is the interesting part of the job. You would be among the first marketers anywhere to run three brands with a team of agents rather than a team of juniors. If that is attractive to you, say so in your application.**

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

* **Own and publish to the content calendar across three companies and three platforms, consistently. Consistency beats brilliance here — a dead company page reads as a dying company.**
* **Write. Posts, articles, case notes, scripts, email campaigns, landing page copy — in an engineering-credible voice, for people who buy industrial components for a living.**
* **Run the founder’s content programme: shaping the narrative, drafting, and turning what happens inside the business into things worth reading and watching.**
* **Extract and sanitise stories from live work — interviewing the BD and sourcing teams, and making sure nothing published exposes a client, a supplier or a price.**
* **Pursue visibility beyond our channels: build the list, pitch the angle, chase the podcast, the interview and the independent outlet. Small and frequent beats big and never.**
* **Brief the designer properly, in writing, so their video and graphic work does not need three rounds of clarification.**
* **Build our employer brand. We are hiring seven people right now and will hire more.**
* **Report with numbers on what is working, and be willing to kill what is not.**
* **From roughly month four, define and supervise the AI agents that take over the repetitive production work.**

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT:**

* **It is not company positioning or pricing. Those sit with the Managing Director.**
* **It is not a design or video editing job. We have a designer for production — though being able to cut a rough clip yourself will make you faster.**
* **It is not performance marketing. We are not running paid acquisition at this stage, and if we do it will be a separate decision.**
* **It is not an agency-management role. You do the work; you do not brief it out and report on it.**

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

**Rs 40,000 to Rs 45,000 per month CTC (Rs 4.8–5.4 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on what you demonstrate in the assessment. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.**

* **Compensation reviewed formally at six months and at twelve months, against evidence.**
* **A real budget for the tools you need, including AI tools. We do not expect you to pay for your own software.**
* **PF and ESI as per statute.**

**The real compensation at this stage is the exposure: three brands, full ownership of the public face of the group, direct access to the founder every day, and a seat at the front of how marketing work is actually changing. At one to three years, very few roles offer that.**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* **MANDATORY —**
  writing samples with your name on them: published work, a portfolio, a newsletter, anything real. An application without them will not be reviewed.
* You can genuinely write: clear, specific, no filler. This remains the single most important requirement.
* 1 to 3 years in marketing, ideally B2B. This is not a fresher role.
* Evidence of a creative idea that was yours. Not a campaign you were on — an angle, a format or a hook you came up with and can explain the thinking behind.
* A working understanding of how reach actually behaves on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram, and of how the three differ.
* Comfort with AI tools, and the judgement to know when their output is not good enough. We use them here and we expect you to.
* You can brief a designer and judge creative work without needing to make it yourself.
* You publish something imperfect on schedule rather than something perfect late.

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**

**We mean this sincerely — it saves everyone time.**

* **You cannot attend an in-person interview in Bengaluru between 20 and 30 November 2026.**
* **You cannot join on 1 December 2026, for any reason, including notice period.**
* **You are not in Bengaluru and are not willing to relocate here at your own arrangement before joining.**
* **You are looking for a work-from-home or hybrid role. This is fully work from office.**
* **Your portfolio is follower counts and engagement rates with no link to reputation or pipeline.**
* **You have only worked in an agency, on accounts whose outcome you did not own.**
* **You need an established brand and a large budget to be effective.**
* **Writing is not your strength.**
* **You want to own positioning and strategy at company level from day one.**

**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

**Four rounds. We have deliberately kept the unpaid work small.**

1. **Application —**
   short questions, your CV, and your writing samples. The samples are mandatory.
2. **Assessment —**
   timed, online. Creative judgement, channel thinking, and one short practical brief — around 45 minutes of writing, not a weekend project.
3. **Video interview —**
   recorded, online. You talk us through your own assessment answers and the thinking behind them.
4. **In-person with the Managing Director —**
   at our Bengaluru office, 20–30 November.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

**One last time: if you have skipped to this section, go back and read the rest.**

**Apply through the link on this posting and answer the application questions in full. Attach your CV, your writing samples, and a short covering note in your own words. We read the notes, and the ones with a real voice get read twice.**

**Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd · Bengaluru, India**

**(We hire on evidence and demonstrated work, and we welcome applications from every background.)**

title: Product Marketing Senior Manager
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**Overview**

SonicWall is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market strategy and execution for our Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Threat Protection product lines, along with other assigned product lines across the SonicWall portfolio. This individual contributor role also drives the success of SonicWall's Technology Alliance Partner Program, ensuring partner value propositions and joint go-to-market plans translate into measurable pipeline and revenue impact. The role also maintains working knowledge of SonicWall SonicSentry, our Managed Security Services (MSS) business, to support consistent messaging and cross-functional alignment where the two offerings intersect.

You will develop positioning and messaging, lead product launches, build the sales and channel enablement tools that win deals, and serve as the subject-matter expert who translates complex security technology into clear, compelling, customer-facing value. This role requires deep hands-on execution rather than team management — you will drive results directly, in close partnership with product management, engineering, sales, and channel teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy & Positioning

* Own go-to-market strategy for EDR/Threat Protection and other assigned product lines, including value propositions and positioning tailored to target markets, buyer personas, and vertical/compliance requirements.
* Conduct ongoing competitive research and maintain subject-matter-expert-level understanding of competitors' strengths, weaknesses, and market moves across EDR/XDR, endpoint security, and other owned product lines.
* Partner with product management and engineering to translate technical capabilities into differentiated customer-facing messaging and business value propositions.
* Maintain working knowledge of SonicWall SonicSentry (MSS) sufficient to support cross-sell messaging, answer sales/partner questions, and keep positioning consistent across the endpoint and MSS portfolio

**Go-to-Market Execution**

* Plan and lead product launches end to end for endpoint and other owned product lines — coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, and support to execute the launch cycle and drive adoption.
* Build sales enablement assets, including pitch decks, battlecards, objection handlers, competitive comparisons, and training materials for direct and channel sales teams.
* Produce thought-leadership and demand-generation content — blogs, whitepapers, eBooks, videos, and web content — that positions SonicWall as a leader in endpoint security and the other product lines you own.

**Technology Alliance Partner Program**

* Own the marketing strategy and success metrics for the Technology Alliance Partner Program, ensuring partner value propositions, co-marketing assets, and joint go-to-market plans drive measurable partner and pipeline growth.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with alliance partners to support joint go-to-market execution and co-selling motions.

**Customer, Market & Partner Insight**

* Develop deep customer and partner knowledge through market research, segmentation and persona development, customer interviews, and internal business metrics.
* Identify and evaluate new market opportunities, industry compliance requirements, and emerging threats relevant to endpoint security and your other owned product lines, and recommend appropriate marketing activity.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track success metrics for launches, campaigns, and the partner program; report on performance against targets.
* Continuously test, measure, and refine messaging, campaigns, and enablement materials based on results and field feedback.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of product marketing experience, with meaningful time at a B2B security or technical software company; experience with EDR/endpoint security, threat protection, or network security strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of go-to-market strategy and execution for at least one product line or service offering, from launch through lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of the security market, including EDR/XDR, endpoint threat protection, and firewalls, plus emerging categories such as Zero Trust and SASE; working familiarity with managed security services (MSS) a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts into business-oriented value propositions for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to independently build sales enablement content — pitch decks, battlecards, training — that drives measurable sales results.
* Strong analytical and business skills; comfortable using data to prioritize initiatives and measure marketing effectiveness.
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects to completion across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Willingness to travel to visit customers, prospects, and partners as an essential part of the role.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience building or running technology alliance or channel partner marketing programs.
* Prior professional experience in product management or another strategic technical role.
* MBA or other advanced business degree.
* Strong grasp of current market trends and emerging technologies in cybersecurity.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree a plus.
* 6-8+ years of relevant product marketing experience. This is an individual contributor role
