title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
**Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!**

Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.

At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.

**Life @ Skillz**

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) & company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.

**Why Skillz?**

* Pioneers of Skill-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.

**The Future of Gaming Awaits!**

The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.

**About The Role**

Push notifications, email, and reactivation are Skillz's fastest available revenue levers. This role owns building the instrumentation, holdout-based measurement, and journey ownership needed to turn owned channels into an accountable, optimized growth engine.

**Responsibilities**

* Own email, push notification and in-app messaging as a single lifecycle function for Skillz Platform — strategy, calendar, execution and measurement.
* Own reactivation marketing end to end: cohort definition, offer design, ROI gating against held-out controls, step-downs and exclusion rules for perpetual reactivators.
* Own CleverTap journey design and execution once ownership transfers from Product, and drive onboarding of remaining titles as SDK 26 coverage expands.
* Make every campaign measurable: holdout-audited incremental NGR per campaign, CTR by channel and game, deliverability, and unsub/opt-out guardrails.
* Enforce messaging hygiene — one notification per campaign per player, mutually exclusive segments, contextual interstitial triggers, and segment→campaign attribution so no segment is orphaned.
* Design reactivation and win-back offers within the incentive rules: above-30% bonuses reserved for genuine reactivation, framed as rare and limited.
* Manage the Email Marketing Manager and build the lifecycle bench.
* Partner with Analytics for holdout design and reads, Game LiveOps for surface slates, Launch GTM for feature adoption campaigns, and Product (Rishabh) for messaging machinery and PN observability.
* Report weekly: what was sent, what it earned, what is being retired, and what needs unblocking.

**Key Competencies**

* Incrementality-first thinking — instinctively asks what the control group did; treats sends, opens and pMAU as inputs rather than results.
* Lifecycle craft — journey design, triggers, frequency capping, suppression logic and deliverability, across push, email and in-app together rather than channel by channel.
* Offer economics — understands that a reactivated user arriving on bonus cash can be NGR-negative, and can defend a step-down against a stakeholder whose reactivation number it depresses.
* Hands-on tooling — configures journeys and segments themselves; can pull their own data in SQL or a BI tool.
* Player respect — treats notification volume as a finite asset and argues for fewer, better sends.
* Builds from zero — the function, the DL, the runbook and the measurement all need creating; comfortable with that rather than expecting an established machine.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years in lifecycle / CRM / retention marketing for a consumer mobile product, including direct ownership of a reactivation or win-back programme.
* Deep hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform — CleverTap strongly preferred; Braze, MoEngage, Iterable or WebEngage acceptable — including journey building, segmentation and frequency management.
* Ran holdout-based incrementality measurement on messaging campaigns and can evidence a campaign they killed on the number.
* Real-money gaming industry experience required.
* Owned push notification deliverability and opt-in economics, including double-dialogue opt-in patterns and the constraints of iOS re-enablement.
* Comfortable partnering with Product on instrumentation gaps and with Analytics on independent scoring; experience taking over tooling ownership from another function is a plus.

**Location:**
Hybrid in Bangalore, India.

**Travel Requirement:**
Less than 10%

As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager (CRM & Reactivation)
description:
**Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!**
Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
  
  
**Life @ Skillz**

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) & company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.

**Why Skillz?**

* Pioneers of Skill-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.

**The Future of Gaming Awaits!**
The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
  
  
**About The Role**
Push notifications, email, and reactivation are Skillz's fastest available revenue levers. This role owns building the instrumentation, holdout-based measurement, and journey ownership needed to turn owned channels into an accountable, optimized growth engine.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own email, push notification and in-app messaging as a single lifecycle function for Skillz Platform — strategy, calendar, execution and measurement.
* Own reactivation marketing end to end: cohort definition, offer design, ROI gating against held-out controls, step-downs and exclusion rules for perpetual reactivators.
* Own CleverTap journey design and execution once ownership transfers from Product, and drive onboarding of remaining titles as SDK 26 coverage expands.
* Make every campaign measurable: holdout-audited incremental NGR per campaign, CTR by channel and game, deliverability, and unsub/opt-out guardrails.
* Enforce messaging hygiene — one notification per campaign per player, mutually exclusive segments, contextual interstitial triggers, and segment→campaign attribution so no segment is orphaned.
* Design reactivation and win-back offers within the incentive rules: above-30% bonuses reserved for genuine reactivation, framed as rare and limited.
* Manage the Email Marketing Manager and build the lifecycle bench.
* Partner with Analytics for holdout design and reads, Game LiveOps for surface slates, Launch GTM for feature adoption campaigns, and Product (Rishabh) for messaging machinery and PN observability.
* Report weekly: what was sent, what it earned, what is being retired, and what needs unblocking.

**Key Competencies**

* Incrementality-first thinking — instinctively asks what the control group did; treats sends, opens and pMAU as inputs rather than results.
* Lifecycle craft — journey design, triggers, frequency capping, suppression logic and deliverability, across push, email and in-app together rather than channel by channel.
* Offer economics — understands that a reactivated user arriving on bonus cash can be NGR-negative, and can defend a step-down against a stakeholder whose reactivation number it depresses.
* Hands-on tooling — configures journeys and segments themselves; can pull their own data in SQL or a BI tool.
* Player respect — treats notification volume as a finite asset and argues for fewer, better sends.
* Builds from zero — the function, the DL, the runbook and the measurement all need creating; comfortable with that rather than expecting an established machine.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years in lifecycle / CRM / retention marketing for a consumer mobile product, including direct ownership of a reactivation or win-back programme.
* Deep hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform — CleverTap strongly preferred; Braze, MoEngage, Iterable or WebEngage acceptable — including journey building, segmentation and frequency management.
* Ran holdout-based incrementality measurement on messaging campaigns and can evidence a campaign they killed on the number.
* Real-money gaming industry experience required.
* Owned push notification deliverability and opt-in economics, including double-dialogue opt-in patterns and the constraints of iOS re-enablement.
* Comfortable partnering with Product on instrumentation gaps and with Analytics on independent scoring; experience taking over tooling ownership from another function is a plus.

**Location:**
Hybrid in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Less than 10%

title: Principal Engineer, Product Marketing (Power)

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. You will engage in product definition as well as business planning activities. Your ability to work across functional groups through formal communication and direct interaction is critical to success. * Create & verify business case

* Drive internal and external resources to ensure readiness of all aspects of product release
* NPI demand estimation and supply management to transition to tactical marketing team

**Qualifications**

* Comfort and ability to collaborate and be effective in an entrepreneurial (fast-paced and ambiguous) environment
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills and comfort in presenting to a wide range of audiences. Capable to communicate issues in a concise and effective way.
* Desire and drive to interact with, as well as ability to build and maintain excellent relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Product ownership mentality

**To Make Our Lives Easier**

title: Partner Marketing Manager
description:

* Own and develop a go-to-market strategy with Datadog's key channel and cloud partners across India, tailored to the region's partner ecosystem and business priorities

* Partner with Channels & Alliances sales to identify the highest-impact partners and design joint marketing programs that drive pipeline generation and net-new customer acquisition
* Plan, execute, and measure integrated partner campaigns and marketing activities, including MDF-funded programs, events, and co-marketing initiatives
* Build strong stakeholder relationships across sales, partner, and marketing teams, creating channels for bi-directional feedback that shapes ongoing strategy, programs, and campaigns
* Communicate strategy, results, and recommendations clearly to both internal stakeholders and external partners
* Track and report on the performance of partner marketing programs, using data and insights to continuously refine the regional approach

* Experience working across cross-functional and cross-regional teams, with the ability to ensure alignment and drive shared outcomes
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build environments for open, bi-directional feedback
* Intellectually curious, with genuine excitement for building and shaping partner marketing strategy
* Good understanding of the India regional partner ecosystem; familiarity with the broader Rest of Asia (ROA) market is a plus
* Experience working at a cloud partner (AWS, GCP, Azure) or a leading channel partner is a plus

**Benefits and Growth:**

* Generous and competitive benefits package

* Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
* Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
* Best in breed onboarding
* Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
* Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*
**About Datadog:**
Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Manager, Product
description:
**Company Introduction**
Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
  
  
Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
  
  
**About Availity India**
Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India team’s partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
  
  
Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Role**
Availity is seeking a strategic and customer-focused
**Product Manager**
to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the
**Availity Essentials Portal**
, the industry's leading multi-payer provider portal.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with providers, healthcare organizations, engineering, UX, data, and business stakeholders to identify provider pain points, uncover new opportunities, and deliver innovative solutions that simplify healthcare administration and improve provider-payer interactions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the Availity Essentials Portal, ensuring alignment with customer needs, business goals, and provider engagement objectives.
* Conduct customer discovery with providers and healthcare stakeholders to identify workflow challenges, validate opportunities, and deliver impactful solutions.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, including requirements gathering, prioritization, development, launch, measurement, and continuous optimization.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX, Data, and business teams to build intuitive, scalable, and user-centric experiences that improve provider efficiency.
* Leverage data, analytics, and AI-powered tools to drive product decisions, accelerate innovation, measure outcomes, and continuously improve adoption and customer satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related product leadership roles, preferably within healthcare technology environments.
* Hands-on experience with provider portals, revenue cycle management workflows, payer-provider interactions, and healthcare administrative processes.
* Proven track record of leading products through discovery, roadmap development, delivery, launch, and ongoing optimization.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development practices and experience collaborating with Engineering, UX, Analytics, and cross-functional business teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions based on customer value and business impact.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or managing provider-facing healthcare applications, multi-payer portals, or provider engagement platforms.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare workflows including Eligibility, Claims, Claim Status, Prior Authorization, Remittance, and Provider Administration.
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or Figma AI for product discovery, research, and rapid prototyping.
* Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation frameworks, APIs, platform products, and SaaS business models.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Aha! Product board, Amplitude, Pendo, or Mixpanel; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

**Why Join Availity India?**

* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offering discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

title: Head of Growth (B2B- SaaS)
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore – Work From Office

**Experience:**
4–8 Years

**Qualification:**
Graduation is mandatory.

**About Zylu**

Zylu is a fast-growing SaaS company helping salons and beauty businesses manage appointments, customer engagement, marketing, and business operations. We are expanding across India and international markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Southeast Asia.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Head of Growth**
to own Zylu's growth across the complete funnel:

**Acquisition → Activation → Conversion → Retention → Expansion**

**Important: This is NOT a digital marketing role.**

This role is
**not limited to Google/Meta Ads, SEO, content, or lead generation**
.

You will own
**business growth and revenue outcomes**
, including conversion, activation, CAC, LTV, retention, ARR, and pipeline performance. The right candidate must identify and solve growth bottlenecks across
**marketing, sales, product, and customer success.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and optimise the complete customer growth funnel.
* Build and improve conversion across leads, demos, trials, and customers.
* Identify funnel gaps and implement high-impact growth initiatives.
* Run growth experiments across campaigns, landing pages, onboarding, product messaging, pricing, and sales processes.
* Drive customer acquisition through paid marketing, SEO, content, partnerships, referrals, webinars, and communities.
* Work with
  **Product & Engineering**
  to improve onboarding, activation, and product conversion.
* Work with
  **Sales**
  to improve lead quality, pipeline velocity, and lead-to-customer conversion.
* Work with
  **Customer Success**
  to improve retention, reduce churn, and drive expansion.
* Own key metrics, including
  **ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, conversion, activation, retention, churn, and NRR**
  .
* Build dashboards and provide actionable growth insights to leadership.
* Identify new market and GTM opportunities.
* Build scalable growth processes and support the hiring of the growth team.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4–8 years of experience in
  **growth, growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue marketing,**
  preferably in B2B SaaS.
* Proven experience driving
  **measurable business outcomes**
  , not just marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and growth funnels.
* Experience running growth experiments and conversion optimisation.
* Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and attribution tools.
* Startup experience with high ownership and fast execution is preferred.
* Vertical SaaS, SMB SaaS, or multi-location business experience is a plus.

**Ideal Candidate**

We want a
**growth operator, not a channel specialist**
.

A strong candidate should be able to demonstrate outcomes such as:

**“Improved conversion from X% to Y%” | “Reduced CAC by X%” | “Increased ARR by X%” | “Improved retention by X%”**

If your experience is primarily
**Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, content, or lead generation without ownership of revenue/business outcomes, this role may not be the right fit.**

**What you’ll actually do**

* Diagnose the funnel end-to-end — sign-ups, activation, trial conversion, sales cycle,

retention/churn — and find where the biggest leak or biggest lever is

* Run growth experiments across acquisition, onboarding, pricing/packaging, and

retention, not just ad creative

* Work directly with product/eng to influence onboarding flow, activation triggers, and

In-product prompts — you don’t need to write code, but you need to be comfortable

Telling engineering what to build and why

* Work directly with sales on lead quality, pipeline stage definitions, and conversion

bottlenecks (not just lead volume)

* Own the metrics stack — CAC, LTV, activation rate, trial-to-paid %, NRR/churn — and report on them without being asked
* Manage/direct specialist execution (paid ads, SEO, content, automation) either via

freelancers/agencies or a small internal team, rather than doing 100% of it yourself

* Operate across two markets (India self-serve motion, UAE more sales-assisted) and

Understand why the playbooks differ between them

**What success looks like (first 2 quarters)**

* Own and move the number: contribution to Zylu’s path to $3M ARR
* Close the gap between contacts at the opportunity stage and active deals in the pipeline
* Improve trial → paid conversion (self-serve India, paid trial US/Canada)
* Establish a working experimentation cadence — hypothesis, test, measure, kill or scale — across acquisition and activation
* Build the reporting Zylu currently lacks: deal-level conversion and retention visibility, not just top-of-funnel traffic/lead counts

**Hiring Process**

1. Initial discussion
2. Growth strategy / case study
3. Leadership interview
4. Founder / leadership discussion

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Company:**
 Assessli — AI-Powered Education & Personalized Learning

**Location:**
 Bengaluru, India (Preferred) | Hybrid / Flexible

**Position:**
 Chief Executive Officer

**Compensation:**
 Equity-Based | Founder-Level Ownership | Performance-Linked Incentives

**Experience:**
 10–18+ Years (Relevant Leadership Experience)

**Hiring Timeline:**
 4–6 Months | Rolling Applications

**Commitment:**
 Full-Time, Long-Term Leadership Role

About Assessli

Assessli is an AI-powered education technology company building the next generation of personalized assessment, learning intelligence, and adaptive educational experiences.

Our technology goes beyond conventional testing and learning management systems to understand individual learning gaps, academic performance, cognitive patterns, and behavioural challenges, enabling personalized recommendations and actionable insights for students, educators, institutions, and parents.

With an established technology foundation, institutional implementations, education partnerships, and experience across B2B, B2B2C, B2G, and B2C markets, Assessli is preparing for its next phase of commercial growth.

**We are now looking for an entrepreneurial CEO to take complete operational ownership of Assessli and build it into a category-defining AI EdTech company.**

As the original founders focus on advancing foundational AI research and building Dots-In, we are seeking a dedicated business leader to drive Assessli's next chapter of growth, expansion, and commercialization.

**This is not a conventional CEO job. It is an opportunity to join an established venture as an operating co-founder, earn meaningful equity ownership, and build a high-growth company.**

The Opportunity

We are looking for a proven EdTech leader who has worked closely with founders or leadership teams at leading B2C and B2B education technology companies.

The ideal candidate has firsthand experience building, launching, scaling, and monetizing education products across consumer and institutional segments.

You will inherit an existing product foundation, technology capabilities, brand assets, and market relationships rather than starting from zero.

Your responsibility will be to transform these assets into a scalable, commercially successful business.

You will have substantial autonomy over business strategy, revenue generation, institutional expansion, marketing, partnerships, hiring, and operational execution, within an agreed governance framework.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. Business Leadership & Strategic Growth

* Take complete ownership of Assessli's business operations, strategy, execution, and P&L.
* Develop and execute a three-to-five-year growth strategy.
* Establish predictable revenue streams, sustainable unit economics, and operational efficiency.
* Identify new commercial opportunities across India's education ecosystem and international markets.
* Build Assessli into an independently operating, scalable EdTech business.

2. B2C Growth & Monetization

* Lead the commercialization and growth of Assessli's B2C student learning and assessment platform.
* Build scalable customer acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies.
* Establish high-performing digital marketing, inside sales, conversion, and growth operations.
* Optimize CAC, LTV, ARPU, subscription conversions, retention, and engagement.
* Develop consumer pricing, subscription, and distribution models.

3. B2B, B2B2C & Institutional Expansion

* Scale partnerships with schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and education networks.
* Build strong enterprise and institutional sales pipelines.
* Develop long-term commercial relationships with education institutions and channel partners.
* Drive institutional onboarding, annual contracts, renewals, and account expansion.
* Expand opportunities across government education programs and large-scale institutional initiatives.

4. Revenue, Fundraising & Financial Ownership

* Own revenue targets, operating budgets, cash-flow planning, and profitability.
* Build a sustainable business model with strong financial discipline.
* Lead relevant fundraising discussions and investor relationships in coordination with the board.
* Develop strategic partnerships, distribution alliances, and new revenue opportunities.

5. Team Building & Organizational Leadership

* Build and lead a high-performance leadership team across sales, marketing, growth, operations, customer success, and product commercialization.
* Establish execution-oriented teams, performance metrics, and organizational processes.
* Create an ownership-driven culture focused on measurable business outcomes.
* Build the organizational capabilities required for national and international expansion.

6. Product Commercialization & Market Positioning

* Work with product and technology teams to translate Assessli's AI capabilities into commercially successful products.
* Drive product-market fit, pricing, positioning, market adoption, and customer feedback loops.
* Identify revenue-generating applications of AI assessment, personalized learning, student intelligence, and educational analytics.

Eligibility Criteria
  
Mandatory Qualifications

* **10+ years of relevant professional experience**
  , preferably including 5+ years in senior leadership, business ownership, or founding-team roles.
* Prior experience with a leading EdTech, online learning, test preparation, education SaaS, or education services company.
* Demonstrated experience in 
  **both B2C growth and B2B institutional or enterprise sales**
  .
* Proven responsibility for revenue generation, P&L, business expansion, or major commercial functions.
* Experience scaling a business, product, or business unit from an early stage to meaningful commercial scale.
* Strong understanding of the Indian education ecosystem, customer acquisition, monetization, and distribution channels.
* Ability to independently recruit, manage, and scale high-performing teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to commit full-time to a long-term, equity-oriented opportunity.

Highly Preferred Experience

Candidates with one or more of the following backgrounds are particularly encouraged to apply:

* Former Founder / Co-Founder of an EdTech startup.
* CEO / COO / CRO / Chief Business Officer at an education technology company.
* Business Unit Head / VP Growth / VP Sales / Country Head with significant P&L ownership.
* Founding-team or early leadership experience at companies such as BYJU'S, Unacademy, Vedantu, Physics Wallah, upGrad, Simplilearn, LEAD Group, Classplus, Teachmint, Allen Digital, or comparable education companies.
* Experience scaling a business unit to ₹25 Cr–₹100 Cr+ in annual revenue.
* Demonstrated expertise in consumer subscription models, school/institutional sales, or large-scale education partnerships.
* Experience raising capital, leading investor discussions, or managing an investor-backed startup.

*Experience at a specific company or revenue scale is preferred, not mandatory. Demonstrable execution and business ownership matter more than titles.*

Equity, Compensation & Ownership

**This is a founder-level, equity-first opportunity rather than a conventional fixed-salary executive appointment.**

The selected individual will have the opportunity to earn meaningful equity ownership in Assessli, structured around long-term commitment, business performance, and value creation.

The proposed compensation structure includes:

* **Meaningful equity participation:**
   Negotiable based on experience, leadership capability, commitment, and agreed milestones.
* **Performance-linked incentives:**
   Tied to revenue growth, customer acquisition, profitability, and strategic milestones.
* **Cash compensation:**
   Subject to mutual agreement and the company's financial position.
* **Equity vesting:**
   Structured through definitive agreements, with suitable vesting schedules and performance conditions.
* **Operating authority:**
   Substantial decision-making responsibility as CEO, subject to board oversight and reserved matters.

The successful candidate must be motivated by building long-term enterprise value and genuine business ownership, rather than seeking a traditional high-fixed-compensation executive role.

Selection & Hiring Process

**Expected hiring timeline: 4–6 months**

We are undertaking a structured, selective search to identify the right long-term operating partner.

The process will involve:

1. **Leadership Profile Screening:**
    Evaluation of EdTech experience, commercial achievements, and entrepreneurial background.
2. **Founder Discussion:**
    Strategic alignment, leadership philosophy, and long-term vision.
3. **Business Case Assessment:**
    Presentation of a proposed 90-day and 12-month growth plan for Assessli.
4. **Commercial & Operational Due Diligence:**
    Assessment of execution capabilities, leadership track record, references, and financial experience.
5. **Equity & Governance Discussion:**
    Finalization of ownership structure, performance expectations, operating authority, and contractual arrangements.
6. **Transition & Onboarding:**
    Structured handover with the existing founding team.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The selected candidate's joining date and transition arrangements will be mutually agreed.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is for someone who:

* Has already helped build or scale a significant education business.
* Wants to move beyond being an employee or corporate leader to becoming an owner.
* Understands the realities of building consumer and institutional education businesses.
* Can take responsibility for growth, team, revenue, profitability, and execution.
* Is ready to lead an existing technology venture into its next growth phase.
* Wants to dedicate the next several years to creating a meaningful and scalable company.

**We are not just hiring a CEO. We are looking for the next entrepreneur who will build Assessli's future.**

title: Senior Digital & eCommerce Localization Lead
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Your Role**
The Senior Digital & eCommerce Localization Lead is an expert practitioner responsible for the localization strategy, execution guidance, and cross-functional collaboration within one or more assigned pillars of the D&E Localization function. Pillars span Legal Compliance & Partnership, Digital Marketing, Customer Activation, Core Commerce, and Retention.
  
  
Operating as an embedded strategic advisor, this role ensures that localization investment is directed where it generates the greatest commercial return — prioritizing by impact rather than responding to individual market requests. Rather than owning every localization activity end-to-end, the Senior Lead guides, consults, and connects — ensuring the right accountability exists within the relevant functional teams while driving global consistency, quality, and measurable business impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Embedding & Planning**

* Actively participate in product roadmap, feature launch, and campaign planning cycles, representing localization requirements before decisions are finalized.
* Advocate for localization as a first-class input into D&E strategy, not a downstream production activity.
* Apply a commercial lens to localization decisions — prioritizing markets, channels, and features based on revenue impact, compliance risk, and strategic opportunity rather than volume of requests.
* Support the Head of Localization in maintaining and refining ROI-based prioritization criteria, ensuring localization investment is allocated to the highest-impact opportunities.

**Pillar Ownership & Delivery**

* Serve as the accountable lead for localization activity within assigned pillar(s), ensuring deliverables are clearly defined, prioritized, and executed to standard.
* Guide functional teams on how to implement localization requirements within their pillar — advising on approach, standards, and tooling rather than executing directly.
* Maintain a clear view of the localization backlog, pipeline, and in-flight activity within assigned pillars, surfacing risks or capacity issues proactively.
* Coordinate with other pillar leads to ensure cross-pillar dependencies are identified and managed effectively.

**Stakeholder & Market Partnership**

* Build and maintain effective working relationships with assigned Global D&E Stakeholders, Country Business Partners, and in-market commercial teams.
* Apply commercial and ROI judgement when translating market priorities into localization requirements — recommending investment where impact is evidenced, and deprioritizing where it is not.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, providing clear, evidence-based guidance on localization investment, scope, and sequencing.
* Manage stakeholder expectations across Commercial, Legal, RMTC, DDIT, and Customer functions as relevant to assigned pillar(s).

**Quality, Standards & Governance**

* Define and uphold localization quality standards, style guides, and terminology frameworks for assigned pillar(s).
* Advise on vendor selection, briefing, and review processes where third-party localization or translation services are engaged.
* Ensure that compliance, regulatory, and data privacy requirements are embedded in localization workflows within assigned pillar(s).
* Proactively escalate quality, capacity, or compliance risks to the Head of Localization before they impact the business.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track performance indicators for assigned pillar(s), contributing to the function’s overall KPI framework and reporting.
* Use customer feedback, market data, and performance insights to identify improvement opportunities and refine localization approaches.
* Contribute to the global Digital & eCommerce community, sharing expertise, market insights, and best practices across the teams.

**Required**
**Who You Are:**

* 7+ years of experience in localization, digital product management, eCommerce, digital marketing, or a closely related field within a global digital environment.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least one APAC or key commercial market language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bahasa Indonesia, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of digital and eCommerce ecosystems, including content management, search, transactional platforms, and/or digital marketing channels.
* Proven ability to operate as a senior advisor and influence stakeholders across commercial, product, legal, and technology functions without direct authority.
* Experience working in cross-functional, matrixed global organizations with multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities.
* Strong communication skills; able to translate complex localization topics into clear business language for senior stakeholders.
* Fluent English, written and spoken, to business standard.

**Preferred**

* Background in life sciences, B2B eCommerce, or a regulated industry; understanding of compliance and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Salesforce CRM (SFDC), or Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* Knowledge of SEO, GEO, and SEM principles in multilingual and multi-market contexts.
* Experience with agile product development and cross-functional pod or scrum team working.
* Knowledge of data privacy regulations applicable to key markets (e.g., GDPR, PIPL, PIPA, LGPD, CCPA).

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: Head of Partnerships - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**The Mission**
Instawork is building the data engine for the future of Physical AI.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Head of Partnerships**
to build and lead our India business partners. You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and onboarding thousands of small, medium and large businesses across India to help build the pipeline for Robotics data collection.
  
  
The opportunity is to connect Instawork's technology, labor marketplace, and operational scale with the world's leading robotics companies and turn real-world work into the high-quality data required to train and improve the next generation of physical AI.
  
  
This is a highly entrepreneurial role for a senior partnerships leader who wants to build something from the ground up and work directly with company leadership.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Build the Partnerships Engine for Small, Medium and Large businesses in India
  
  

* Own the partnerships strategy across hospitality, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, and other labor-intensive industries.
* Build and eventually lead the partnerships team, processes, systems, and operating cadence.
* Establish clear goals and metrics for pipeline generation and business acquisition
* Execute large business partnerships with industrial, co-operative and government bodies that work with multiple businesses
* Develop repeatable playbooks for partner identification, outreach, qualification, negotiation, and conversion.

**Work Directly with Leadership**

* Partner closely with the CEO and Head of Robotics on the company's partnership strategy.
* Bring market intelligence, partner feedback, and new opportunities directly to leadership.
* Move quickly from strategy to execution, with a strong bias toward action and measurable outcomes.

**Who You Are**

* 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, strategic alliances, or a similar commercial leadership role.
* Proven track record of managing fleet on street and also building and closing large B2B partnerships.
* Experience building a partnerships or business development function from the ground up is highly preferred.
* Strong network across hospitality, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, marketplaces, or other labor-intensive industries is a major plus.
* Entrepreneurial mindset—you enjoy building rather than inheriting an established playbook.
* Extremely strong bias for action and ownership. You see a problem and figure out how to solve it.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, limited structure, and rapidly changing priorities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Commercially sharp, highly driven, and comfortable being measured by outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Build a strong pipeline of businesses across India.
* Close and launch high-impact partnerships with multiple industrial, cooperative or government organizations
* Establish a repeatable partnership acquisition playbook.
* Create a scalable partnerships organization and operating model.
* Help position Instawork as a critical infrastructure partner for companies building the future of Physical AI.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Marketing Strategy & Operations
description:
**Role:**
Marketing Strategy & Operations

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India (on-site)

**Reports to:**
Marketing leadership

IIM / IIT (or equivalent top-tier) with a stint in consulting, brand or product marketing, growth, or a high-growth startup

This is a founder's-office-style seat on the marketing team. You will shape how the fuel and convenience retail industry sees PriceEasy and build the engine that turns that attention into pipeline.

**About PriceEasy**

PriceEasy is building AI and technology for fuel and convenience retail. We work with retailers around the world to help them make better decisions about pricing, operations and retail performance.

We are building an ambitious company and want someone who sees events and social media not as support functions, but as opportunities to create brand people in our industry remember.

**What You'll do**

**Marketing strategy**

• Define positioning, messaging and the brand story for each segment (fuel chains, c-store operators, oil majors, distributors).

• Build the annual marketing plan: priorities, channels, budget and targets tied to pipeline.

• Lead product marketing for launches: narrative, pricing pages, sales enablement and launch campaigns.

• Track competitors and industry trends and turn them into clear recommendations.

**Marketing operations**

• Own the marketing funnel: lead generation, attribution, conversion metrics and weekly reporting.

• Run the marketing tool stack (CRM, email, website, analytics); keep data clean and dashboards trusted.

• Design and automate campaigns, nurture flows and lead handoffs to sales.

• Measure ROI on every event, campaign and channel, and shift to what works.

• Produce customer case studies, reports and webinars with the sales and product teams.

**Social media**

• Run PriceEasy's LinkedIn and other social channels, with a content calendar that makes us the voice of AI in fuel retail.

• Create and ship posts, short videos and carousels every week, using AI tools to move fast.

• Build founder and team thought leadership on LinkedIn.

• Turn events, launches and customer wins into social moments, and track reach, engagement and inbound leads.

**How we work with AI**

PriceEasy is an AI company, and we expect this person to use AI extensively.

You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and AI creative tools to:

• Research markets, competitors, audiences and target accounts in hours, not weeks.

• Draft and repurpose content at speed: LinkedIn posts, blogs, emails, case studies and scripts.

• Create visuals, videos, event graphics and campaign assets without waiting on a designer.

• Analyze campaign and funnel data and turn it into crisp insights.

• Build lightweight automations and agents that remove manual marketing work.

**Who you are**

**Must-haves**

• MBA from an IIM (A/B/C/L/K/I or equivalent) and/or B.Tech/Dual Degree from an IIT, with a strong academic record.

• Sharp structured thinking: you can turn an ambiguous brief into a clear plan, budget and set of metrics.

• Comfortable with numbers: funnels, attribution, budgets and ROI in Excel/Sheets.

• Expert in HubSpot (must-have): hands-on experience setting up and running workflows, lead scoring, email campaigns, lists, reporting and dashboards.

• High ownership and bias to action. You ship, measure and iterate without waiting to be told.

• A daily AI user who is curious about what these tools can do next.

**Nice-to-have**

• 1–4 years in brand, product or growth marketing, consulting, or a founder's office at a B2B SaaS startup.

• Experience planning events or building a social media following.

• Exposure to HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva/Figma or similar tools.

• Interest in retail, energy, pricing or AI, and experience working with US or international teams.

**Why join us**

• 
**Real ownership early:**
work directly with leadership on decisions that shape the company.

• 
**Global exposure:**
sell to and work with retailers across multiple countries from Bengaluru.

• 
**AI at the core:**
learn how an AI-native company builds, sells and operates.

• 
**Fast growth path:**
a clear route into marketing leadership, Chief of Staff or business-unit roles as we scale.

We're looking for someone who lives on social media and wants to run it like a system. Every post you make starts in our own AI video platform: you'll generate short-form videos, carousels and posts in volume, build the pipeline that takes an idea from brief to published post across every channel, and measure what works so the next batch is better. One idea in. A week of posts out, made on our own platform.

**What You'll Do**

* **Make Content at Scale:**
  Generate Shorts, Reels, LinkedIn videos, carousels and quote cards in our platform, in volume and at each platform's size.
* **Build the Pipeline:**
  A repeatable flow from idea to script, generation, review and a scheduled post, with templates, prompts and checklists anyone can rerun.
* **Publish on a Cadence:**
  Run posting across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and X with a scheduling tool, on a steady rhythm.
* **Measure and Improve:**
  Track views, watch time, saves and clicks, keep what works, drop what doesn't, and report what you learned each week.
* **Show the Product:**
  Turn new features and sample videos into posts that show what interactive video can do.

**Who You Are**

* **Some Real Experience:**
  At least 6 months of hands-on social media work: a job, an internship, freelance clients or channels of your own.
* **You Live on Social:**
  You know what makes a Short, a Reel or a LinkedIn post land, and you can explain why.
* **AI-Native:**
  You use AI tools every day (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) and want to push them further.
* **A Systems Thinker:**
  You'd rather build a template, a spreadsheet or an automation than do the same task twice.
* **A Good Eye:**
  Hooks, pacing, captions and visuals matter to you.
* **Data-Curious:**
  You read the analytics and change course because of them.
* **Clear Writer:**
  A clear writer in English.
* **Bonus:**
  Video editing (CapCut, Premiere), design (Canva, Figma), automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n) or light scripting, and a social account you've grown yourself.

title: Senior Social Media Executive
description:
**Title**

Senior Social Media Executive (Creator-first)

Team

Brand, Content & Social

Works with

Creative, CX, CRM & Retention, Agencies & Creators

Experience

3+ years

Location

Bangalore, Indiranagar (In-office)

**About us.**

Supertails is a first-of-its-kind platform for India's pet parents — trustworthy veterinary care, training, and a one-stop shop for pet food and supplies. Online consults with our in-house vets, and doorstep delivery of an assortment sourced from India and across the globe

**Who we're looking for**

An enthu-cutlet who's on the internet all day, and you get there before the trend needs explaining.

You make the content yourself. Ideate, shoot, edit, ship. You don't wait for a brief to come up with the next cool idea for the brand.

You know exactly what to reply under someone else's post. The comment that gets screenshotted and gets on the feed post carousels.

You know how to actually use a creator. Not pay one and hope. Pick the right person according to the objective, brief them so they still sound like themselves for the brand.

A planned go-getter who always knows what they want to post the coming two weeks.

Your mission, should you choose to accept

Make the thing yourself — ideate, shoot, edit, ship. Same week, often same day

Catch the trend on the way up, not on the way out

Live in the comments. Ours, and every other one worth being in

Write the reply that gets screenshotted

Match the creator to the objective, then brief them so they still sound like themselves

Always know what's going out for the next two weeks

Build our presence off real pet-parenting insight, not off what worked for a snack brand

Turn events into content, not just a good afternoon

Read the numbers every week and kill what doesn't work

Pull the story out of the vets, CX and ops teams and put it on social

Push agencies and partners to make things people actually share

Spot and avoid thnigs lyk thise

Be around pets a lot

**What you'll own**

Making the content. You are the creator on this team, not the person who commissions one. Ideate, plan, shoot, edit, ship — phone-first and at trend speed. Nothing waits on an agency to go out today. The bigger brand pieces get made properly with the creative team, but the daily volume is yours.

Comments & community. Every reply, DM, mention and tag on our handles — and the conversations about pet parenting where we aren't tagged at all. Fast, funny where it earns it, useful always. Medical questions go to the vet team, order issues to CX. Know what an escalation looks like before it becomes one.

Creators & influencer programme. End to end: pick by objective, source, brief, negotiate, publish, measure. Get work out of creators that we couldn't have made ourselves, and keep it sounding like them. Build a roster you can call on, not a scramble every campaign.

The plan. A calendar that exists at least two weeks out, across every channel, and gets executed. Insight-based and built for every kind of pet parent — first dog, third cat, senior pet, foster. Room left in it for the thing that has to go out in four hours.

Partners, agencies & vendors. Brief, evaluate and push external creative partners. Evaluation, onboarding, and expense processes that come with them. Keep a clean log.

Measurement. Track content and channel performance on listening and analytics tools, report it clearly, act on it. Reach, engagement and follower growth are the scoreboard; response time and sentiment are the ones nobody watches and should.

**Requirements**

A portfolio with work you’ve created yourself, not just managed.

At least 3 years across social media agencies or in-house at brands

Hands-on shooting and editing: framing, cuts, sound, captions, and a feel for when a thing is 12 seconds too long

Chronically online, with a real grip on trends and how each platform's algorithm actually works

Community and ORM experience at volume: replying fast, in voice, without creating a problem

Creator management you've actually done: sourcing, briefing, negotiating, measuring

Planning discipline. A calendar that exists ahead of time, not one reconstructed on Friday

Hands-on experience scaling social for a new or young brand

Judgement on creative for different audiences, with a keen eye for detail

Stakeholder management with creative partners and internal teams, coordinated with clear communication that aligns all

Strong analytical skills: data and reports on Excel and listening tools

An independent worker who needs minimal intervention on daily tasks

**Application process:**
Please send your CV along with your portfolio, to careers@supertails.com

title: Digital Marketing Manager

As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. title: Assistant Manager – Supply (Performance Marketing, Delivery Partner Acquisition)
description:
Swish is building the next generation of food delivery by owning the entire value chain, from menu design and pricing to kitchen operations and customer experience. Backed by leading investors, we're building the future of food delivery by continuously launching new products, expanding into new markets, and creating innovative operating models.

You will own paid acquisition for delivery partners, managing budgets and campaigns across Meta, Google, and job platforms. You will optimise the funnel from lead to active partner while building scalable acquisition playbooks for city supply teams.

What You'll Do

Acquisition Strategy & Budget

* Own monthly and quarterly delivery partner acquisition plans by city, zone, and vehicle type.
* Translate supply gaps into hiring targets, channel strategies, and budgets.
* Manage acquisition budgets and optimise spend across cities and channels based on cost and partner quality.
* Plan surge campaigns around festivals, monsoons, peak meal times, and new kitchen or city launches.

Campaign Execution

* Run end-to-end campaigns across Meta, Google (Search, YouTube, Display, and App), and job platforms such as Apna, WorkIndia, Naukri, and Indeed.
* Build and test regional-language creatives in partnership with the Brand team.
* Run lead-generation, click-to-WhatsApp, and app-install campaigns based on city requirements.
* Manage agencies and affiliate/DSA partners, including briefs, payouts, performance, and lead quality.

Funnel Optimisation

* Own the complete partner funnel: lead → app install → sign-up → documentation → verification → training → first order → Day 7 and Day 30 activation.
* Identify funnel drop-offs and work with Product and Operations to improve conversion.
* Run structured A/B tests across audiences, creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies.

Measurement & Tracking

* Maintain attribution across AppsFlyer or similar MMPs, Meta Pixel/Conversions API, and Google conversion tracking.
* Track cost per lead, cost per onboarded partner, and cost per active partner.
* Build city, channel, and campaign dashboards with Analytics and conduct weekly performance reviews.
* Identify lead fraud and duplicate sign-ups and work with Trust & Safety to address them.

Playbooks & Stakeholder Management

* Build acquisition playbooks, creative libraries, and performance benchmarks for city supply teams.
* Balance paid acquisition with referrals, offline drives, and partner-to-partner programmes to optimise overall acquisition costs.
* Ensure campaigns comply with platform policies and relevant labour and earnings-claim guidelines.

How You'll Be Measured

* Cost per active partner
* Partners onboarded vs. plan by city and week
* Lead-to-active conversion rate
* Day 7 and Day 30 retention
* Spend vs. plan and channel-level cost efficiency
* Time taken to close identified supply gaps

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on performance marketing budget management.
* Proven experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including lead-generation and app-install campaigns.
* Working knowledge of MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust and conversion tracking through Pixel/Conversions API.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL knowledge is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, activation, retention, and cost efficiency.
* Ability to communicate effectively with city teams, agencies, cross-functional stakeholders, and senior leadership.

title: Marketing Manager, Attraction, Influence & Marketing (AIM)
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about connecting people to opportunity? Do you thrive using creative sourcing and marketing channels to deliver real hiring outcomes — at a pace and scale few organizations can match?
  
  
At Amazon, we are reinventing how to attract and hire exceptional talent at scale. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) organization is seeking a well-organized, data-driven, and self-motivated Marketing Manager to execute and scale Talent Marketing programs for India.
  
  
You are equal parts executor and analyst — comfortable building an integrated marketing plan with agency partners one day and presenting campaign results to leadership the next. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, take full ownership of your workstreams, and know how to coordinate across partner teams whose roadmaps don't report to you. You understand that recruitment marketing isn't just advertising — it's hiring infrastructure — and you're energized by delivering measurable, repeatable results at scale. This role requires operational rigor, creative problem-solving, and a bias for action on a team that works hard and has fun.
  
  
This role supports the Talent Marketing India leader in developing and executing India's sourcing and marketing strategy across all Amazon sites — profiling target candidates, identifying appropriate channel levers, and building top-of-funnel demand to efficiently attract hourly talent. You will develop and execute local and national community engagement strategies, operationalize plans against KPIs tied to growing the hourly talent pipeline, reducing reliance on paid advertising. Additionally, you will author candidate communications, hiring event content, onboarding collateral, offer templates, and other marketing materials.
  
  
You'll collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders on data-driven candidate attraction initiatives, track market shifts in hourly candidate behavior, and contribute to market mapping and intelligence efforts. To succeed, you'll need to see the big picture while executing rapidly on the ground.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work with internal and external agency teams to develop and execute integrated marketing programs tailored for local markets, messaging on the employee value proposition and branding at country and business line levels
* Use data to rigorously assess channel and media effectiveness, prioritize based on business requirements, and optimize to achieve marketing goals
* Maintain local staffing agency and marketing agencies including onboarding, project briefs, vendor management and payment processing
* Monitor channel analytics to measure effectiveness and forecast future spend and required activity by site/region
* Support multiple marketing programs end-to-end — from self-serve infrastructure to targeted activation for priority hiring domains
* Establish pre-pilot baselines in partnership with analytics teams, manage evaluation cycles, and present results to leadership
* Support tech integration requirements such as the transition from third-party tooling to Amazon-native infrastructure
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for assigned programs across analytics, PR, creative, and Central teams; contribute to cadenced reporting (WBR, MBR, HBR)
* Partner with analytics, performance marketing and other teams to validate attribution methodology, track baseline metrics, and translate data into actionable recommendations
* Maintain a thorough understanding of local employment trends and continually monitor competitor/industry developments
* Document processes, create playbooks, and maintain SOPs that enable programs to scale without proportional headcount growth

**About The Team**
Amazon's Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) organization is a dynamic team of marketing professionals dedicated to attracting and engaging talent across Amazon's diverse business segments. AIM achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences, engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.
  
  
**Description**
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's degree
* 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
* Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
* 3+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs
* Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

title: Assistant Manager - Product Marketing
description:
**About The Role**
The Product Marketing team at smallcase drives product-led growth by shaping user journeys, optimising conversion funnels, and scaling feature adoption across product lines. We sit at the intersection of Product, Analytics, and Business, turning complex financial instruments into intuitive, high-converting user experiences.
  
  
As an Assistant Product Marketing Manager, you will be the creative fuel behind top-of-funnel campaigns and on-product growth for global markets. This is a role for someone early in their PMM journey — or transitioning into it — who brings creativity, curiosity, and a genuine enthusiasm for the product. You’ll work on real campaigns and real launches from day one, with full support and structured learning along the way.
  
  
No prior PMM experience? That’s okay. If you’re coming from content or social, and want to transition to a growth role, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**About CASE Platforms**
CASE Platforms (formerly smallcase) is building the compounding layer for long-term wealth, helping every Indian design better financial futures with simple and transparent investment products.
  
  
Across its consumer brands (smallcase, Tickertape, Zerodha CASE Funds, creditcase), CASE serves 20+ million investors with model portfolios, index funds, ETFs and secured credit.
  
  
CASE also provides technology platforms & solutions to the largest and fastest-growing financial institutions to enable them to offer differentiated wealth experiences to their clientele.
  
  
**In this role, you will**
**Driving Top Of The Funnel**

* Plan and execute weekly top-of-funnel campaigns, working closely with the brand and paid marketing teams.
* Stay on top of market trends and quickly turn them into topical campaigns that drive awareness.

**Owning The Investment Lifecycle**

* Craft journeys both on-product (using marketing-owned product assets like Landing Pages, Collections, Banners, App Stories), off-product (comms: WhatsApp, Push Notifications, Emails, RCS via CPaaS tools), and automated journeys to help customers move ahead in their investment journey.
* Support A/B testing and copy experimentation on these assets in collaboration with the product team.

**Driving GTMs For New Launches**

* Own end-to-end Go-To-Market execution for new product and feature launches, contributing to awareness and early adoption goals.
* Craft user-facing messaging that translates product specs into clear, compelling value propositions.

**Learning The PMM Craft**

* Work alongside senior PMMs on lifecycle strategy, cohort thinking, and campaign attribution — building the skills to own full funnels independently over time.
* Bring ideas to the table proactively, and be willing to experiment, fail fast, and iterate.

**What We Look For In You**
Your background looks like one of these:
  
  

* You have 1–3 years of experience in social media, content marketing, or a related field, and you’re ready to move into growth.
* You’re a fresh post-graduate (MBA, Mass Comm, Journalism, or similar) looking to apply your learning as real growth tactics.
* You’re an early-career PMM or content-oriented marketer who values creativity and wants more growth responsibility.
* If you have prior investing experience in US market or experience in managing campaigns for US Stock Market, it’ll be a huge plus

**Nice to have**

* Highly creative — you generate ideas quickly and know how to shape them for different audiences.
* Self-starter — you notice what needs doing and take initiative without waiting to be asked.
* Product-curious — you’re interested in how smallcase works and want to invest time to understand and use the product.
* Strong writer — you can draft crisp, engaging copy across formats (short-form, long-form, in-app).
* Bias for action — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and are comfortable with quick turnarounds.
* Willing to learn — you embrace feedback, pick up new tools quickly, and don’t shy away from data.

**Workplace:**
This role is based in our Bangalore office and will require 3 days weekly in the office, with flexibility for 2 remote days each week.

title: Founding Product Marketing & Growth Lead
description:
