**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly creative, product-obsessed
**Product Marketing & Growth Lead**
to own how we shows up in the market.

This is not a traditional marketing role. We're looking for someone who can take a complex product, a customer insight, a technical breakthrough, or an interesting industry trend and turn it into content that people genuinely want to read, watch, and share.

You'll work directly with the founders, product, engineering, and design teams to build brand, shape our product narratives, and drive organic growth through compelling storytelling and creative marketing.

We don't want someone who just executes a content calendar. We want someone who figures out what the content calendar should be, challenges conventional B2B marketing, experiments with new formats, and consistently finds ways to make our products and ideas stand out.

**What You'll Own**

1. Content Strategy & Creative Storytelling

* Own content strategy end-to-end, from identifying interesting ideas to creating, publishing, and distributing content.
* Proactively uncover stories worth telling across our products, customers, research, engineering work, and industry.
* Turn complex AI concepts and technical breakthroughs into simple, engaging, and memorable narratives.
* Create high-quality content across LinkedIn, blogs, product videos, case studies, thought leadership, and other emerging formats.

2. Product Marketing & Positioning

* Develop a deep understanding of products, capabilities, users, and competitive landscape.
* Own product positioning, messaging, and value propositions across our product portfolio.
* Translate product features into compelling stories about the problems we solve and the value we deliver.

3. Brand, Design & Creative Direction

* Partner closely with our design team to translate ideas into high-quality visual content.
* Conceptualize and drive the creation of product videos, animations, carousels, infographics, launch assets, and other creative formats.

4. Organic Growth & Distribution

* Own and grow company's presence across relevant channels, particularly LinkedIn and other platforms where our target audiences engage.
* Think beyond publishing: develop distribution strategies that maximize reach, engagement, and qualified interest.
* Build founder-led and employee-led content programs that amplify our collective expertise.
* Experiment with new channels, communities, partnerships, and content formats.

5. Customer Stories & Market Presence

* Work with customer-facing teams to identify compelling use cases, customer outcomes, and success stories.
* Transform customer insights and measurable results into strong case studies, testimonials, and market-facing narratives.

**Requirements**

* **3–7 years of experience**
  in product marketing, growth marketing, content strategy, brand, or a related role, ideally at a high-growth
  **technology startup.**
* Have experience marketing technical
  **B2B SaaS or AI products.**
* Exceptional written communication and storytelling skills. You know how to make complex topics simple, interesting, and memorable.
* Genuine interest in AI, emerging technology, and how new products are changing industries.

title: DIRECTOR,DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGY & OPERATIONS
description:
**About Us**
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture.
  
  
**Digital Marketing Strategy & Operations**
Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. We’re in an exciting moment for Target’s digital business. Guest expectations keep evolving, and so do we — constantly reimagining the shopping journey across our platforms - including Target.com and the store network’s fulfilment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness.
  
  
The Site Merchandising team helps grow Target’s digital business by making it easier for guests to find, understand and buy products across Target.com and the Target app. Within Target India (TII), this role builds the operations Center of Excellence that helps teams deliver digital work with greater speed, quality and consistency.
  
  
As Director, Digital Marketing Strategy & Operations – Site Merchandising, you will set the direction for a strong digital operations COE that improves guest experience at scale. You will guide the leaders of Digital Operations, Product Content, Digital Marketing Strategy, Project Management and QA to work as one connected system, using guest signals, business priorities and operational data to shape better digital actions. Based in Bangalore, you will partner with the U.S. Site Experience leadership and global teams to remove barriers, improve speed-to-site, strengthen content and execution quality, and make the digital shopping experience simpler and more reliable for guests.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Digital Experience Operations & Scale Leadership**

* Partner across Global leadership team to set the vision and operating principles for the digital operations COE, ensuring the work is simple, scalable and focused on guest experience outcomes.
* Build the COE model across Digital Operations, Product Content, Digital Marketing Strategy, Project Management and QA, with clear standards, intake, prioritization, SLAs, decision rights and escalation paths.
* Use operating measures such as speed-to-site, content readiness, campaign readiness, quality, defects and capacity to guide trade-offs and leadership decisions.
* Create leadership routines that give teams visibility to priorities, risks, ownership, launch readiness and opportunities to improve guest experience.
* Own the COE transformation roadmap, using standardization, automation, tooling and process redesign to improve speed, quality, consistency and scale across operations, QA and content workflows.
* Build maturity across the COE by improving partnership between capability leaders, strengthening repeatable ways of working and scaling practices that make digital execution more consistent.
* Pilot AI and automation opportunities that improve content creation, QA validation, intake, workflow visibility and repeatable execution across the COE.

**Guest Experience, Digital Marketing & Content Strategy**

* Translate key events, promotions, category priorities and guest signals into clear actions across marketing placements, product content, purchasability and post-launch improvements.
* Use guest experience inputs — including behavioral data, OSAT, Contacts CPO, returns, guest reviews and post-purchase signals — to identify friction, prioritize fixes and improve product and site experiences.
* Strengthen Product Content as a strategic Site Merchandising capability, improving PDP completeness, item readiness, attribution, taxonomy, imagery, copy and decision-useful information for guests.
* Strengthen QA, operational readiness and issue resolution so teams can protect guest experience and improve execution across all five pyramids.

**Team Development & Leadership**

* Lead through capability leaders, building a connected team that can make clear decisions, solve problems quickly and improve guest outcomes.
* Set clear expectations, coaching routines and growth opportunities that help leaders build strong operating judgment, guest focus and cross-functional influence.
* Build a COE culture focused on ownership, simple ways of working, continuous improvement and accountability for better guest experience outcomes.

**Cross-Functional & Global Engagement**

* Align Item, Product, UX, T+, Marketing, Merchandising Operations and TII teams on the priorities and decisions needed to scale digital work and improve guest experience.
* Serve as a senior connection point between Bangalore and the U.S. Site Experience leadership, ensuring priorities, risks, escalations and decisions are clear and connected.
* Remove systemic barriers by securing partner commitments, clarifying ownership and keeping teams focused on speed, quality and scale to elevate guest experience.

*Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.*
**About You**

* 12+ years of experience in digital retail, e-commerce, site merchandising or digital operations, with experience building scalable operating models or Centres of Excellence.
* 8+ years of people leadership experience, including leading through managers, developing leaders and building strong team capability.
* Strong understanding of digital experience operations, product content, digital marketing execution, QA, launch readiness and performance measures that improve guest experience.
* Proven ability to lead in a global, matrixed environment, align senior partners, remove barriers and drive decisions across business, product, technology, marketing and operations teams.
* Track record of leading transformation, automation and process improvement that increases speed, quality, consistency and operational scale.
* Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to simplify complexity, lead through ambiguity and build trust around a shared COE vision.

title: Growth Marketing Lead (AI-First)
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore-based, remote — working core hours that overlap the US day (our team and customers are US-based)
  
  
**Engagement:**
Contract to start, with potential to expand
  
  
**Reports to:**
Founder / CEO
  
  
**About MarcoPolo Learning**
MarcoPolo Learning builds award-winning learning experiences for young children. Since 2013, we've reached hundreds of thousands of families and thousands of classrooms across North America, with our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bringing STEM and global discovery to life for early learners.
  
  
We're now an AI-first company. Our newest product, Miss Audrey AI, puts a proactive AI coach and teaching assistant in the hands of early-childhood educators, supporting teachers in the moment with guidance, resources and family engagement. It opens up a new category in early learning, and we're building the growth engine to bring it to every teacher, centre and early-learning organisation that needs it. This is the role that leads it.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors and running lean, we're looking for a senior, hands-on growth leader who wants to build that engine with AI at its core.
  
  
**The role in one line**
Lead MarcoPolo's growth. Define the story that makes educators and early-learning leaders see Miss Audrey AI as essential, build an AI-powered engine to reach them at scale, and turn that interest into sign-ups, paid subscribers and sales conversations.
  
  
**This is not a general marketing role**
This is not a single-channel role. It isn't only SEO, paid social, content calendars or app installs. Miss Audrey AI is creating a new category, so growth here comes from sharp positioning, smart outreach and constant experimentation rather than capturing existing search demand. We're looking for a strategic generalist who can set the direction, do much of the work hands-on, and bring the team along.
  
  
You'll work in a fast-moving, AI-first startup where AI is built into how marketing gets done, from research and outreach to creative, testing and reporting. You'll be the person who knows which tools are worth using, puts them to work, and keeps raising the bar on what our growth engine can do.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Positioning and messaging.**
Shape how we talk to teachers, centre directors and early-learning leaders. Test messaging angles quickly, learn from the results and sharpen the story until it consistently converts.
  
  
**An AI-powered growth engine.**
Design and run AI-driven workflows for audience research, prospect enrichment, personalised outreach across email, LinkedIn and other channels, creative, landing pages and reporting. Review the output, refine it and keep improving it.
  
  
**The Miss Audrey AI funnel.**
Take educators from free sign-up to first value to paid subscription, working with engineering on onboarding, upgrade moments and lifecycle messaging.
  
  
**Pipeline for our sales team.**
Turn campaigns and product usage into qualified conversations with centre directors and organisation leaders, and equip our US sales team with the messaging and evidence to close.
  
  
**The experiment loop.**
Decide what to test across audiences, messages, channels and offers; read the results; and double down on what works.
  
  
**Tools and innovation.**
Stay ahead of the AI marketing landscape. Evaluate new tools, adopt the ones that move the needle, and help the wider team use them.
  
  
**Leadership and communication.**
Present plans and results to leadership, explain the approach clearly to the team, direct freelancers and partners, and help build the function as it grows.
  
  
**Report the numbers that matter.**
Pipeline, sign-ups, activation, paid conversion and cost to acquire, with a clear point of view on what to do next.
  
  
**Expected outcomes**
**You'll Be Measured On Results, Not Activity**

* Messaging: a clear, tested value proposition that resonates with teachers, centre directors and early-learning leaders.
* Growth engine: a live, AI-powered acquisition and outreach engine producing a steady flow of qualified sign-ups and conversations.
* Conversion: a measurable and improving free-to-paid conversion rate for Miss Audrey AI.
* Sales pipeline: a reliable flow of qualified opportunities handed to the US sales team.
* Experimentation: a regular testing cadence across messaging, channels and offers, with results that compound.
* Capability: new AI tools and workflows adopted across marketing, and a clear plan for how the function scales.

**What You'll Need (essential)**

* 7+ years in growth or marketing across strategy, positioning and messaging, demand generation, lifecycle and experimentation. You're a generalist with real breadth, not a single-channel specialist.
* Leadership experience. You've owned a growth or marketing function, or a major part of one: setting strategy, directing people, agencies or freelancers, and working closely with founders or senior leadership.
* AI-first in practice. You use AI tools daily in your marketing work and can show workflows you've built and deployed. You keep up with the AI marketing landscape and know which tools are worth using.
* Experience building demand for a new or differentiated product, where you shaped the story and made the case rather than capturing existing demand.
* A confident, clear communicator, with excellent spoken and written English. You're comfortable presenting to leadership, working with a US-based team and customers, and explaining strategy simply.
* Data and experimentation fluency. Comfortable setting up measurement, reading funnel and campaign data, and running clean experiments.
* Startup pace and self-direction. You ask the right questions, propose a plan and execute with minimal oversight in a fast-changing environment.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience marketing to educators, schools, childcare or early-learning organisations, or to individual users within larger organisations.
* Freemium or product-led growth experience, converting free users into paying subscribers.
* Experience working with or for a US-based company while based in India; you understand US customers, US working styles and collaborating across time zones.
* Prior startup experience: you know what it's like to build with limited resources and moving goalposts.

**Nice to have**

* EdTech, or any product sold to educators, parents or consumers.
* Familiarity with tools already in use here, including HubSpot, Customer.io, n8n, ClickUp and Webflow, and with AI-driven prospecting and outreach tools.
* Enough design sense to shape clean, conversion-focused web and email flows (you don't need to be a visual designer).

**Engagement details**

* Type: Contract to start, with potential to expand as the growth engine proves out.
* Location & hours: Bangalore-based and remote, with daily working overlap with our US team.
* Works closely with: The US sales team and AI-automation partners who support the technical build.
* Start: Immediate start preferred.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!
  
  
Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
  
  
Life @ Skillz
  
  

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) & company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.

Why Skillz?
  
  

* Pioneers of Skill-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.

The Future of Gaming Awaits!
  
  
The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Own the Blackout Bingo LiveOps calendar end to end — events, tournaments, promotions and the limited-time-offer slate — as the single accountable operator for the game.
* Be accountable for the three ratified KPIs on the surface: incremental NGR per campaign (holdout-audited), event margin (collection vs prizes), and the count of events running at negative margin.
* Lead the Blackout Bingo LiveOps line — the Senior Associate today and the Associate bench as it lands — setting standards, developing the team and hiring into it.
* Design and configure campaigns directly: segments, entry-fee tiers, prize curves, schedules, eligibility and guardrails, in the admin portal and in CleverTap.
* Tune the slate to Blackout Bingo's own economy — entry-fee distribution, session profile, tail composition and marquee rhythm — rather than inheriting a shared calendar.
* Hold offer discipline on the surface: 30% standard bonus cap, same-day bonus decay, wallet-balance gating and net-winner exclusions; prevent LTO stacking across Daily, Weekend and Filler offers.
* Reserve holdouts at send time and run experiments end to end — hypothesis, segment, control, read — retiring what does not earn its incentive cost.
* Deliver the tail live-event tier, zonal identity events and month-long merch events on Blackout Bingo as the economy rebalance rolls out.
* Own the Blackout Bingo line in the weekly LiveOps Review and the per-venue scorecard commentary: what moved, why, and what happens next.
* Partner with Product on capability and roadmap, Analytics on measurement and independent scoring, Lifecycle CRM on messaging, and Launch GTM on feature adoption.
* Contribute to the Game LiveOps operating model alongside Indrani G as the function scales.

**Key Competencies**

* Owns a number, not a calendar — reasons in event margin and incremental NGR, and can tell the difference between a campaign that worked and one that ran during a good week.
* Economy sense — understands that an offer is a cost, and reasons about prize curves, collection versus prizes and net deposits rather than participation counts.
* Hands-on operating detail — comfortable in campaign tooling and configuration, and precise about eligibility rules and guardrails. A build-and-run role, not a briefing role.
* People leadership — has managed or closely mentored operators, sets standards rather than approving individual campaigns, and can hire and develop a small bench.
* Experiment discipline — reserves the holdout before the send, defines the read before launch, and accepts a null result.
* Willing to kill a popular event — can retire a well-liked but negative-margin event and explain why to players, Product and their own team.
* Peer-level presence — can hold a position against Product and Analytics without a reporting line, and be the accountable voice for the surface in a room of senior stakeholders.
* Clear written communication — weekly commentary that says what moved, why, and what happens next.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years in LiveOps, game operations, product marketing, promotions or growth operations for a consumer mobile product, including full ownership of an events and offers calendar for a live title at scale.
* People leadership — has managed at least one or two operators directly, or has a clear and evidenced step-up into a management line (setting standards, reviewing work, developing others).
* Real-money gaming, online gambling, fantasy sports, fintech or a mid-core F2P title with a deep in-game economy strongly preferred. Bingo, casual or social-casino category experience is a plus but not required.
* Evidence of running a title's economy, not just its calendar: prize curves, entry-fee tiering, bonus rules, and a documented decision to change or retire something on margin grounds.
* Ran a measured experimentation practice — control groups or holdouts with a defined read — and can show a result that changed what was shipped, including a null result.
* Hands-on with campaign and segmentation tooling (CleverTap, Braze, MoEngage, WebEngage or an internal admin portal) and comfortable pulling their own data in SQL or a BI tool.
* Comfortable with a fast weekly cycle, with a function being built around them, and with having their results independently scored by an analytics function.

Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance

with global enterprises and fast-growth technology companies. We blend creativity,

digital, advisory, and storytelling to help brands build relevance, reputation, and

recall in complex B2B environments.

position, differentiate, and solve business problems for clients.

for a portfolio of enterprise B2B accounts.

solutions, and create work that is sharp, relevant, and strategically grounded.

campaigns

and ideas

- Strong understanding of narrative structure, messaging, positioning, and

audience context

- Comfortable collaborating with designers, strategists, digital teams, and

account managers

- Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage multiple priorities

simultaneously

- Curious, thoughtful, and commercially aware

- Prior experience working on enterprise or B2B brands

- Strong portfolio demonstrating both strategic thinking and writing craft

- Ability to manage writers and maintain quality across multiple accounts

- Strong research and contextual thinking capability

stakeholders and deadlines

At Zensciences, content shapes strategy, influences perception, and drives business

conversations.

This role offers the opportunity to work across some of the world’s leading B2B and

technology brands — building narratives, campaigns, thought leadership, and

storytelling systems that genuinely matter.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About the role**

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to turn compelling narratives and hypotheses into measurable go-to-market activities: attracting technical professionals and buyers, and driving adoption of Computer across self-serve and enterprise audiences.

You'll define how a product area is positioned and brought to market, own the go-to-market strategy, and execute it across segments. We expect you to build the engine while staying deeply in the work, writing the messaging, running the launch, and reading the results yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for launches and feature releases, owning the launch plan, ICP, value drivers, and coordination with product, design, sales, and demand gen.
* Define positioning, messaging, and differentiation across segments, from solo sign-ups to enterprise buyers.
* Build a measurement framework that gives clear visibility into expected outcomes and lets you track traction continuously: pipeline, sign-ups, activation, adoption, win rate.
* Own the competitive narrative for your area (against horizontal AI, legacy CX/EX tools, and build-it-yourself alternatives), translated into battlecards and objection handling the field can use.
* Partner with product and engineering to shape roadmap priorities through customer and competitive insight, and close the loop by feeding named asks from win/loss and customer calls back to leadership.
* Support sales enablement with pitch narratives, competitive messaging, demos with objection handling, and case studies.
* A clear, sharp writer. You can explain a complex feature in a subject line and hold a room with the strategy behind it.
* Strong at positioning: you look at a segment and a product moment and know which story will land, and you bring a point of view, not just execution against a brief.
* An experimenter. You develop and test hypotheses on channels, messaging, and value propositions, treat every launch as a test with a clear outcome you can read, and iterate fast.
* Someone who dives deep on the numbers. You track the KPIs that matter, understand what's moving and why, and turn the insight into the next action, not a deck that sits in a drive.
* Biased toward shipping and iterating quickly over long planning cycles.
* Able to build cross-functional trust and manage senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* You get energy from building from scratch, and have a hacker mentality.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years in product marketing, growth, or developer marketing for a technical or enterprise audience.
* A track record of customer-facing content, campaigns, or messaging you can speak to in detail and tie to measurable outcomes.
* Experience owning end-to-end product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Comfort with analytics, CRM, and marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot) to drive decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration, prioritization, and program management.
* Background in, or strong interest in, AI-powered products.

**What sets you apart**

* You use gen AI tools daily and ship content with them. You're in every new model the week it drops.
* Experience with A/B testing and customer research methodologies.
* A track record of leading successful product launches across multiple markets or segments.
* Experience working in matrixed, cross-functional organizations.
* Familiarity with product analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms.

title: Category Manager
description:
**About Ownly**

At OWNLY (Backed by Rapido) we’re on a mission to make food delivery simple, fair, and exactly what you ordered and nothing extra. Our team is built of problem-solvers, innovators, and doers, all working to make OWNLY the most trusted way to get your food without hidden charges or inflated prices and we’re just getting started. We connect customers to their favourite restaurants through our reliable delivery network, while helping restaurant partners keep more of what they earn. As we grow, our focus remains the same: fair pricing, honest service, and a platform that respects everyone involved in the journey from kitchen to doorstep.

**About the Role**

Ownly is looking for a driven, analytical, and entrepreneurial Category Manager to lead the growth and business performance of a category across two cities. In this role, you will own category-level strategy and execution, working at the intersection of supply, demand, customer experience, and business operations. You will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, developing city-specific strategies, improving marketplace performance, and driving sustainable revenue growth. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and hands-on execution capabilities to build a scalable and profitable marketplace.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Category Strategy and Business Ownership

* Own the end-to-end growth strategy and business performance of the assigned category across two cities.
* Develop city-level business plans, growth targets, and strategic initiatives aligned with overall marketplace objectives.
* Identify opportunities to expand category penetration, improve market share, increase transactions, and drive revenue growth.
* Track category performance against business targets and proactively address gaps.

2. Marketplace Supply and Assortment

* Build and strengthen the supply ecosystem by identifying, onboarding, and activating relevant sellers, partners, brands, or service providers, as applicable.
* Improve supply availability, assortment quality, pricing competitiveness, and fulfilment reliability.
* Identify supply gaps across cities and develop strategies to address them.
* Build strong partner relationships to improve engagement, productivity, and long-term retention.

3. Demand Generation and Conversion

* Partner with marketing and growth teams to develop initiatives that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and repeat transactions.
* Improve marketplace conversion through better assortment, pricing, promotions, and customer experience.
* Identify customer behaviour trends and local market opportunities to develop targeted growth initiatives.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and optimise investments based on business outcomes.

4. City-Level Business Management

* Drive category performance across both cities while accounting for local customer behaviour, competition, and market dynamics.
* Develop city-specific growth plans and prioritise initiatives based on business potential.
* Monitor city-level performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue, order volumes, conversion, and customer retention.
* Work closely with city operations and local teams to ensure effective execution of category initiatives.

5. Analytics and Performance Management

* Establish and monitor key performance indicators across revenue, transactions, conversion, supply availability, customer retention, and profitability.
* Use data and business insights to identify performance gaps, root causes, and growth opportunities.
* Build regular business reviews and performance dashboards to track progress against targets.
* Conduct experiments, evaluate outcomes, and scale successful initiatives across cities.

**Must Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.
* 4 + years Experience in category management.
* Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, including supply-demand management, customer acquisition, conversion, and unit economics.
* Demonstrated ability to own business metrics, solve ambiguous problems, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL or BI tools is an advantage.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and execution skills.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and manage multiple priorities.

title: Head of Gift Cards & Processing
description:

We operate across shopping, travel, food, grocery, and other commerce categories, with a vision to build a consumer AI agent that simplifies how people discover, compare, and purchase products and services.

As part of our growing offerings, Buyhatke also provides
**Gift Cards that can be redeemed across multiple online marketplaces and brands**

. We are now looking for an experienced professional to take ownership of and build Buyhatke’s gift-card business into the largest and most trusted gift-card processing platform in India, then expand globally over the next three years.

**About the Role:**

This role owns the full business outcome: supply, partnerships, product, distribution, transaction processing, risk, customer experience, economics, and international expansion. The successful candidate will turn gift cards from a catalogue or discount product into a high-scale payments and commerce infrastructure business.

**What You'll do:**

* Define and execute Buyhatke’s three-year gift-card strategy across consumer, corporate, rewards, affiliate, and embedded distribution channels.
* Build a differentiated processing platform covering catalogue management, pricing, inventory, issuance, delivery, redemption status, refunds, reconciliation, settlement, and reporting.
* Sign and grow relationships with brands, retailers, aggregators, issuers, payment partners, banks, fintechs, loyalty platforms, employers, and global distributors.
* Create a reliable supply and fulfilment network with high availability, competitive commercials, clear SLAs, and scalable operational controls.
* Make Buyhatke the preferred distribution layer for gift cards through its own products and third-party channels, including APIs and white-label integrations.
* Establish the operating model for fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, KYC/KYB, chargebacks, customer support, compliance, and partner risk.
* Own the P&L, contribution margin, working capital, partner economics, pricing, and investment decisions for the business.
* Build a high-performing team across business development, product, engineering, operations, risk, finance, and customer experience.
* Lead international expansion market by market, beginning with the most attractive corridors, use cases, and regulatory environments.

**Three-Year Outcomes**

The exact targets will be finalised with the CEO during the first 30 days. The role will be measured against a balanced scorecard such as:

* **Market position**

  - Become a category leader in India and a credible global processing platform
* **Scale**

  - Reach a large, repeatable annual processed value with strong month-on-month growth
* **Network -**

  Build deep coverage across priority brands, categories, channels, and geographies
* **Reliability -**

  Deliver industry-leading authorization, fulfilment, delivery, reconciliation, and support SLAs
* **Economics -**

  Build durable contribution margins with disciplined partner and channel economics
* **Distribution -**

  Power Buyhatke, enterprise clients, rewards programs, affiliates, and embedded partners
* **Trust -**

  Maintain strong fraud loss, chargeback, compliance, and customer-resolution metrics
* **Team -**

  Build the leadership bench and operating cadence required for global scale

**First Year Plan**

* **First 30 days: Diagnose and Choose**
* Audit current gift-card revenue, margins, suppliers, product flows, technology, contracts, risks, and customer pain points.
* Map the market, competitors, white spaces, priority categories, and highest-value distribution channels.
* Produce a board-ready strategy with a clear wedge, target customer segments, business model, investment needs, and quarterly milestones.

* **Days 31–90: Build the Foundation**
* Close the highest-value supply and distribution partnerships.
* Define the target processing architecture, partner APIs, operational controls, and data model.
* Launch a single operating dashboard for processed value, revenue, margin, fulfilment, fraud, refunds, support, and partner performance.
* Hire the first critical team members and establish weekly business reviews.

* **Months 4–12: Prove Repeatable Scale**
* Deliver a materially stronger gift-card product and partner experience.
* Launch repeatable B2B and embedded distribution motions.
* Improve availability, fulfilment speed, reconciliation accuracy, and resolution times.
* Prove healthy unit economics in the initial segments before committing to international expansion.
* Present a validated Year 2 and Year 3 expansion plan with quantified market and investment priorities.

**Requirements:**

* 10+ years of experience in
  **gift cards, payments, fintech, ecommerce, loyalty, rewards, marketplaces, or a closely related business.**
* Demonstrated
  **ownership of a scaled P&L, transaction business, platform, or major revenue line.**
* Strong record of
  **building partnerships**

  with brands, issuers, aggregators, banks, fintechs, enterprises, or distribution platforms.
* Comfortable operating across strategy and execution: negotiating a contract in the morning, reviewing a product funnel in the afternoon, and resolving an operational incident when required.
* **Deep understanding**

  of transaction economics, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, chargebacks, refunds, compliance, and working capital.
* Experience
  **launching or scaling**

  APIs, platform products, B2B2C distribution, or embedded commerce is highly valuable.
* **International experience or a strong understanding of cross-border payments**

  and market entry is preferred.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, structured thinking, commercial judgement, and bias for action.
* **Entrepreneurial energy:**

  willing to build the function, recruit the team, and create operating processes from first principles.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 12 months, Buyhatke should have a clear category strategy, a reliable processing and operations backbone, a strong supply network, repeatable distribution channels, measurable unit economics, and a team capable of scaling the business.

After three years, Buyhatke should be recognised by brands and distribution partners as one of the most trusted and commercially valuable gift-card processing platforms serving India and global markets.

**Why This Role**

This is a
**zero-to-one and scale-up leadership opportunity**

with direct access to the founders. You will shape a new business at the intersection of commerce, payments, rewards, and infrastructure and have the mandate to build the category rather than manage an existing playbook.

title: Technical Partner Manager
description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

**Job Description**

**About the Role**

To support Nexthink’s continued growth, we are hiring a Technical Partner Manager (TPM) to drive pre-sales engagement with global Managed Service Provider (MSP) partners, with a particular focus on partners operating from India.

The TPM will support the MSP Sales team by acting as the trusted technical advisor, helping to expand Nexthink’s footprint through technical leadership, enablement, and value-driven selling across global MSP ecosystems

**Key Responsibilities**

**Partner Enablement & Strategy**

* Define and execute the Global MSP technical enablement strategy, equipping partner teams to independently position, demonstrate, and sell Nexthink solutions
* Enable MSP partners to integrate Nexthink into their service portfolios and go-to-market offerings
* Build long-term technical relationships with partner stakeholders and drive continuous capability uplift

**Pre-Sales Execution**

* Act as the primary technical pre-sales lead for MSP-aligned opportunities
* Support the full sales cycle, including solution positioning, demonstrations, proof-of-value (POV) engagements, and technical validation
* Lead value-based workshops to articulate how Nexthink delivers measurable business outcomes
* Support large, complex enterprise opportunities and help drive deals to successful closure

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with MSP account teams on pipeline development, account planning, and QBRs
* Act as a technical liaison between MSP partners and Nexthink product teams, providing feedback on requirements, roadmap, and market needs
* Engage with cross-functional stakeholders (IT Operations, ITSM, Security, Digital Workplace) to build strong solution alignment

**Thought Leadership & Advocacy**

* Act as a Nexthink subject matter expert (SME) internally and externally
* Contribute to partner-facing content, including case studies, proposals, and RFP/RFI responses
* Deliver presentations at customer events, partner sessions, and industry forums
* Help shape innovative, partner-led services built on the Nexthink platform

**Success in this role will deliver:**

* MSP partners confidently and independently positioning Nexthink in their offerings
* Growth in partner-led pipeline, deal size, and technical win rates
* Strong technical credibility with senior stakeholders across partner and customer organisations
* Successful enablement programs that scale across global MSP teams

**Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 3 years of extensive experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales within SaaS or cloud environments
* Proven experience working with and enabling global MSP partners
* Track record of supporting revenue growth and contributing to complex sales cycles
* Experience in value selling and engaging with senior business and technical stakeholders

**Technical & Domain Expertise (one or more areas)**

* Digital Employee Experience (DEX) / End-User Computing / Workplace services
* IT Service Management (ITSM) and ITIL frameworks
* Cloud and workplace transformation (e.g., Microsoft 365, Windows 11, migrations)
* Security, governance, risk, and compliance
* Experience in designing or operating enterprise IT services or service desks

**Skills & Attributes**

* Strong business and commercial acumen with a value-driven mindset
* Excellent presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, including executive-level engagement
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, global environment
* Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence across partner and internal teams
* Technically curious and able to rapidly learn and articulate Nexthink’s platform and value

**Additional Information**

* Language: Fluent English required
* Travel: Domestic travel within India and occasional international travel

**Additional Information**

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!
**Check what we offer:**

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.

* 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with Bajaj, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.

* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.

* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering.

* 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.

* 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.

* 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.

* 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.

* 📣  Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

*Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.*

title: Group Head - Strategy
description:
The purpose of this role is to partner with communications planning teams and clients to create strategic outputs including insight generation, cultural narrative, media briefs, creative media solutions and go-to market activations.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**About The Role**
Group Head, Strategy (Media and Comms) for Automotive account. You will lead the thinking on how Client's motorcycles, scooters and EVs get advertised across India, and be the senior person the client turns to on media and communications.
  
  

* Account: Automotive (two-wheelers, scooters and EVs)
* Function: Strategy, Media and Communications
* Reports to: Business Head / VP Strategy
* Location: Bangalore
* Employment: Full time

What this role is for
  
  
The Automotive Client spends a lot on advertising, and that spend should rest on a proper understanding of buyers, the category and competitors. The Group Head makes sure it does. You own how media and communications strategy comes together for the account's brands, from national launches to regional and dealer level activity, and you represent the agency's strategic view with the client.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Strategy and planning**

* Build and own the yearly media and communications strategy for Client's brands, from commuter motorcycles to premium bikes, scooters and EVs.
* Turn consumer, category and competitor insight into clear choices on audience, channel and message, including regional and language specific plans.
* Lead strategy for launches, festive season campaigns and always-on brand work.
* Agree with the client's analytics and sales teams how effectiveness will be measured: reach, consideration, leads, test rides and sales.
* Guide the media mix across TV, digital, social, influencers, OOH, print, radio, retail and dealer activation, along with partnerships and sponsorships.

**Working with the client**

* Be the senior strategic contact for Client's marketing leadership. Present strategy, reviews and recommendations.
* Keep an eye on changes in the business and the category, and bring the client ideas before they ask.
* Work with creative, digital, data and production teams so the strategy shows up in the final work.

**Leading the team**

* Lead and mentor the strategy and media planning team, from senior planners to executives.
* Set the standard for plans, decks and reports, and review work before it goes to the client.
* Encourage testing and learning, and make sure good results get shared within the team.

**Business side**

* Work with the planning across media functions, buying and trading teams.
* Help grow the account and contribute to new business generation in the group.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* 9 to 12 years in media, communications or brand strategy, with at least 5 years leading teams, in an agency or on the marketing side of a large advertiser.
* Work on automotive, two-wheeler or similar high spend, high involvement categories. EV experience is a plus.
* Hands-on experience building integrated plans across traditional and digital media for national brands with strong regional reach.
* Comfortable presenting to CMO level and senior marketing stakeholders.
* Graduate degree needed. MBA or a postgraduate degree in marketing, communications or business is preferred.

Skills we are looking for
  
  

* Strategic thinking: can take messy data and consumer insight and turn it into a clear point of view and a plan people can act on.
* Strong command of TV, digital, OOH, print, radio and retail media, and how they work together in an automotive purchase journey.
* Good understanding of India's two-wheeler market, including differences between regions, and between rural and urban buyers.
* Comfortable with budgets, media economics and measuring effectiveness.
* Persuasive in the room, with clear writing and good storytelling.
* A people leader who develops talent, gives honest feedback and keeps a high bar.
* Works well with creative, digital, data and client teams without slowing things down.

What the first year should look like
  
  

* The yearly media and comms strategy is agreed with the client before the next planning cycle starts, with a measurement framework attached.
* At least two major launches or campaigns planned and run on a strategy the client credits for the results.
* A stable team, with a development plan for each senior member.
* Client feedback that shows the agency is involved early in their decisions.
* Media efficiency and effectiveness measures improved against the agreed baseline.

**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Brand:**
Carat
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

title: Director, Brand and Creative
description:
**About us**

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 76 operational centres spanning 8.2 million square feet (as of December 2025). WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our
website

**About the role**

The Brand Director is responsible for defining, building, and safeguarding the WeWork India and Rivet (Design and Build brand under WeWork India umbrella) across all markets, member touchpoints, and communication channels. This role owns brand strategy, identity, positioning, and voice, ensuring consistency and distinctiveness across a fast-growing flexible workspace portfolio. Reporting to the CMO, the Brand Director translates the company's business strategy into a compelling brand narrative that strengthens member acquisition, loyalty, and WeWork India's position as the leading flexible workspace provider in the country.

**Roles and responsibilities**

**Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Own and evolve WeWork India's brand strategy, architecture, and positioning in alignment with global brand guidelines and local market context.
* Translate business and growth objectives into a clear, differentiated brand narrative for enterprise, SME, and individual member segments.
* Conduct and act on brand health tracking, competitive benchmarking, and market/consumer research to guide brand decisions.
* Define and evolve brand guidelines, tone of voice, and visual identity standards, ensuring alignment with WeWork's global brand while reflecting local market nuances.

**Brand Building & Campaigns**

* Lead end-to-end development and execution of brand campaigns across digital, print, out-of-home, experiential, and partnership channels.
* Partner with performance marketing, PR/communications, and growth teams to ensure brand campaigns support pipeline, occupancy, and revenue goals.
* Champion integrated marketing communications that build brand salience, consideration, and preference in target markets.
* Oversee brand elements across physical locations (space design, signage, member collateral) in partnership with the Design and Community teams.

**Creative & Content Leadership**

* Set the creative vision and quality bar for all brand-led content, campaigns, and creative assets, working closely with in-house creative teams and external agencies.
* Guide storytelling across member testimonials, thought leadership, sponsorships, and flagship brand moments/events.
* Ensure brand consistency across owned, earned, and paid channels, including website, social media, sales collateral, and community touchpoints.
* Build Social media strategy for LinkedIn, Instagram and Youtube

**Stakeholder & Agency Management**

* Manage relationships with creative, media, PR, and research agencies, ensuring high-quality output, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Community, Product, Design, and Communications teams to embed brand thinking across the member journey.
* Act as a key brand advisor to the CMO and leadership team, presenting brand performance, insights, and recommendations.
* Partner with WeWork Global brand teams to ensure India market activity is aligned with and contributes to global brand strategy.

**Team Leadership & Governance**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing brand team, fostering a culture of creativity, rigor, and accountability.
* Own the brand marketing budget, ensuring efficient allocation and measurable return on brand investment.
* Establish brand governance processes and approval workflows to protect brand integrity across a distributed, multi-city organization.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Brand health metrics: awareness, consideration, favorability, and Net Promoter Score (NPS) among target audiences.
* Share of voice and share of market versus key competitors in the flexible workspace category.
* Contribution of brand campaigns to lead generation, funnel velocity, and member retention.
* Brand consistency and compliance scores across markets, channels, and physical locations.
* Marketing ROI and efficient management of the brand and creative budget.
* Successful delivery of flagship brand campaigns, partnerships, and sponsorships within timeline and budget.

**Experience and qualifications**

* MBA or Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Brand Management, or a related field from a recognized institute; Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline required.
* 12–16 years of progressive experience in brand management, marketing, or brand strategy roles, including at least 4–5 years in a senior/leadership capacity.
* Prior experience in hospitality , retail, or other high-touch consumer and B2B/ B2C brands is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling brands across multiple markets or geographies.
* Track record of managing large creative and media agency relationships and multi-crore brand marketing budgets.
* Experience partnering with global or matrixed marketing organizations is an advantage.
* Strategic thinking: ability to connect brand strategy to business outcomes and translate it into actionable plans.
* Creative judgment: strong eye for design, storytelling, and content quality, with the ability to give clear, constructive creative direction.
* Data and insight orientation: comfort using brand tracking, market research, and analytics to inform decisions.
* Stakeholder management: ability to influence and align senior leaders, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
* People leadership: experience building and developing high-performing marketing/brand teams.
* Communication: excellent written and verbal communication skills, with executive presence to represent the brand internally and externally.
* Agility: comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.
* Maintain key relations with the Internal and external teams:
* Internal: Chief Marketing Officer, Sales & Growth leadership, Community teams, Design & Real Estate, Communications & PR, Global WeWork Brand team, Finance. External: Creative, media, and research agencies; PR partners; brand and event sponsors; media outlets.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing competitive compensation, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

title: F&B Brand Manager
description:
**Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**

**About Viwidh Foodcraft**

Viwidh Foodcraft is building modern food brands focused on great food, memorable customer experiences, and sustainable growth. Our flagship brand, Roti Kulcha Naan, is a North Indian vegetarian dining brand built around a breads-first philosophy.

description:

title: Area Manager - EVPV
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
The Peripheral Vascular Health portfolio focuses on minimally invasive therapies that help physicians treat complex peripheral vascular disease through advanced endovascular and catheter-based technologies. This business partners closely with vascular surgeons, interventional radiologists, and other specialists to expand access to innovative treatment options and support clinical adoption across healthcare systems.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, market development, and customer engagement across the assigned territory for the Peripheral Vascular Health portfolio. This role partners with physicians, hospitals, distributors, and key stakeholders to grow market share, expand therapy adoption, and support the effective use of Medtronic therapies and solutions
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Achieve territory sales, revenue, and market share objectives for the Peripheral Vascular Health portfolio.
* Develop and execute territory business plans to drive therapy adoption and expand customer reach.
* Build and strengthen relationships with vascular surgeons, interventional radiologists, hospital stakeholders, and key opinion leaders.
* Provide clinical and technical support during procedures, product evaluations, and customer training programs.
* Identify new business opportunities and increase market penetration across assigned accounts and customer segments.
* Partner with distributors to ensure product availability, optimize secondary sales, and support business growth.
* Conduct customer engagement activities, educational programs, and therapy awareness initiatives in compliance with company policies.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity and provide timely business insights to leadership.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience\*
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Science or Pharmacy with 4+ years of medical device, healthcare, or related commercial experience.
* Experience in Peripheral Vascular, Endovascular, Vascular Surgery, Interventional Radiology, or related therapy areas.
* Experience supporting clinical cases, product demonstrations, or procedure-based medical technologies.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, healthcare market dynamics, and distributor management.
* Experience planning and executing physician education programs, workshops, or Continuing Medical Education activities.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using market insights to develop territory growth strategies.

title: Chief of Staff – MD’s Office
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore, India

**Experience:**
7–10 years

**Industry:**
Industrial Automation, Manufacturing, Automotive, Engineering or Technology

About KUKA India

KUKA India is part of the global KUKA Group, a leading provider of intelligent automation solutions, robotics, and digital manufacturing technologies. KUKA Group operates across multiple business areas, including industrial robotics, automation solutions, systems engineering, logistics automation, and healthcare automation through its group companies and businesses, including Swisslog and Swisslog Healthcare.

With a strong global presence and a commitment to innovation, digital transformation, and operational excellence, KUKA Group enables businesses across industries to enhance productivity, efficiency, and competitiveness.

At KUKA India, we work across our businesses and group companies to drive strategic growth, strengthen cross-functional collaboration, and translate business priorities into measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, commercially minded, and execution-oriented
**Strategy & Business Execution Manager**
to support strategic initiatives and cross-functional priorities across KUKA India and its group companies.

The role will work closely with senior leadership, business heads, and global stakeholders to translate strategic discussions into actionable plans, drive business reviews, coordinate transformation initiatives, and ensure effective execution of key priorities.

The ideal candidate will combine strong strategic judgement, project and people management capabilities, commercial understanding, and hands-on expertise in modern technology, marketing technology (MarTech), CRM platforms, Salesforce, and Generative AI tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Planning & Business Execution

* Drive strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives across KUKA India businesses and group companies.
* Translate leadership discussions and strategic priorities into clear action plans, ownership, milestones, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Track progress against business objectives, identify execution gaps, and drive timely resolution of issues.
* Support business planning, strategic reviews, performance tracking, and leadership decision-making.

2. Business Performance & Commercial Support

* Support business heads in analysing business performance, identifying growth opportunities, and evaluating strategic priorities.
* Contribute to the preparation of business cases, partnership proposals, investment proposals, and transformation initiatives.
* Develop management presentations, dashboards, reports, and executive summaries to support informed decision-making.
* Coordinate follow-up actions from management meetings and business reviews to ensure accountability and timely closure.

3. Cross-Functional & Global Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with business leaders, functional teams, and global stakeholders to align priorities and deliver strategic initiatives.
* Facilitate collaboration across business units and group companies, ensuring effective communication and information flow.
* Manage competing priorities in a complex, matrix-based organizational environment.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, resolve coordination challenges, and bridge gaps between strategy and execution.

4. Digital Transformation, MarTech & CRM

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Marketing Technology (MarTech), CRM platforms, and Salesforce.
* Support the effective use of CRM and digital tools to improve business visibility, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes through automation, digital solutions, and data-driven decision-making.
* Apply Generative AI and the latest technology tools to improve productivity, research, analysis, reporting, and project delivery.

5. Project & People Management

* Lead strategic projects from planning through implementation, monitoring, and closure.
* Manage small teams, shared resources, and cross-functional project contributors to achieve agreed objectives.
* Establish clear accountability, timelines, deliverables, and performance measures.
* Support change management and ensure consistent execution of business priorities across teams.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* 7–10 years of relevant professional experience in strategy execution, business operations, transformation, program management, or project management.
* Experience in industrial automation, manufacturing, automotive, engineering, technology, or related industries is preferred.
* Proven experience managing strategic projects, cross-functional initiatives, and senior stakeholder relationships.
* Experience supporting business planning, management reviews, commercial initiatives, or investment proposals.
* Hands-on understanding of MarTech tools, CRM platforms, and Salesforce is essential.
* Practical experience using Generative AI tools and modern digital technologies to improve business productivity and execution.
* Experience managing teams, shared resources, or multiple stakeholders in a complex organizational environment.

Must-Have Competencies

* **Strategic judgement:**
  Ability to assess complex business situations, evaluate alternatives, and recommend practical solutions.
* **Commercial acumen:**
  Understanding of business performance, growth opportunities, business cases, and investment decisions.
* **Execution excellence:**
  Ability to convert strategic priorities into actionable plans and deliver measurable results.
* **Project and stakeholder management:**
  Strong coordination, prioritization, and influencing skills across functions and seniority levels.
* **Digital and technology orientation:**
  Hands-on proficiency with modern technology, Generative AI tools, CRM, Salesforce, and MarTech applications.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear, concise leadership presentations.
* **Problem-solving:**
  A proactive, structured approach to resolving challenges and closing execution gaps.
* **Adaptability:**
  Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrix-driven environment.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely execution and closure of strategic initiatives.
* Improved accountability and visibility of cross-functional priorities.
* Quality and effectiveness of business reviews, planning, and management reporting.
* Successful coordination across KUKA India businesses, group companies, and global stakeholders.
* Effective adoption of digital, CRM, MarTech, and Generative AI tools.
* Measurable improvements in execution efficiency, collaboration, and business outcomes.

Work Location

**Bangalore, India**

This is an excellent opportunity for a strategic thinker and hands-on execution leader who enjoys working closely with senior leadership, driving business priorities, and creating measurable impact across a global industrial technology group.

title: Business Head
description:
**Business Head – Talent Transformation**

HCLTech is seeking a high-impact Business Head to drive the commercial growth and market expansion of its Talent Transformation practice.

This is a revenue-owning, client-facing leadership role — responsible for building a strong enterprise pipeline, closing large-scale deals, and shaping the product portfolio that backs every sale.

You will operate at the intersection of enterprise sales, workforce strategy, and product commercialization — partnering with CHROs, CLOs, and business leaders to position HCLTech as the preferred partner for large-scale talent and capability transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and deliver the revenue target for the Talent Transformation practice, with full P&L accountability across bookings, margin, and pipeline health.
* Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end — from prospecting and solution positioning through commercial negotiation and contract closure.
* Hunt and develop new logos across priority verticals (Manufacturing).
* Build and maintain a qualified, multi-quarter pipeline; drive forecast accuracy and deal velocity through disciplined CRM practice.
* Develop and execute the GTM strategy for HCLTech's talent transformation portfolio across enterprise, mid-market clients.
* Identify whitespace opportunities and new market segments to expand the practice's commercial footprint.
* Build and leverage a high-value network of CXO, CHRO, and CLO relationships to generate demand and shape procurement decisions.
* Lead responses to strategic RFPs and RFIs; own the win strategy, executive storyboarding, and commercial construct.
* Forge partnerships with technology vendors, learning platforms, and ecosystem players that open new channels and co-sell opportunities.
* Serve as executive sponsor for strategic accounts — driving satisfaction, renewal, and year-on-year expansion.
* Translate client workforce challenges into tailored solution narratives that resonate at board and C-suite level.
* Partner with product and delivery teams to shape the portfolio — ensuring offerings are market-differentiated, competitively priced, and scalable.
* Provide market intelligence to inform product roadmaps, packaging decisions, and new offering development.
* Lead commercialization of new offerings: define value propositions, build sales plays, and enable the broader sales team.
* Build and coach a high-performing BD and solutioning team; set targets, instill sales methodology, and create a winning culture.
* Represent HCLTech at industry forums, analyst briefings, and thought leadership events to elevate the practice's market presence.

**What You Bring**

**Experience**

* 10–18 years of progressive experience, with at least 6–8 years in enterprise sales, business development, or practice leadership.
* Demonstrated success closing large, complex deals (multi-million dollar TCV) in talent, learning, HR tech, or IT services.
* Track record of building and scaling a practice or business unit with P&L ownership.
* Experience selling to CHROs, CLOs, and HR leaders at Fortune 500 / Global 2000 organizations.
* Exposure to workforce transformation, enterprise learning, or talent strategy consulting is strongly preferred.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Exceptional executive presence — able to command a boardroom and navigate complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial acumen: deal structuring, pricing strategy, negotiation, and margin management.
* Strategic thinker who connects macro workforce trends to specific client problems and HCLTech solutions.
* Product-savvy: understands how to commercialize a portfolio and enable a field sales team.
* Data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecast accuracy, and market sizing.
* Familiarity with the learning technology landscape — LMS, LXP, AI-driven skilling platforms, and workforce analytics.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA strongly preferred.
* Certifications in Product Management is a plus.
