title: Manager – Revenue (Bangalore)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: GEN AI- SM- AIA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
Assistant Director – AI / GenAI (Go-To-Market)
  
  
The Data and Analytics team is a multidisciplinary technology team that delivers client projects and solutions across data mining and management, visualization, business analytics, automation, statistical insights, and AI/GenAI. Assignments span a wide range of countries and industry sectors.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We are looking for an Assistant Director - AI/GenAI - with a strong Go-To-Market (GTM) focus. The candidate in the role will define and drive the AI GTM strategy, build differentiated solution narratives and value propositions, and develop industry-specific solutions and use cases across Financial Services; Consumer, Products and Retail; Healthcare and Wellness; Manufacturing; Supply Chain; Telecom; Real Estate; and other sectors. A central part of the role is scaling AI/GenAI capabilities through business development, thought leadership, and talent development.
  
  
Your key responsibilities
  
  

* Define and execute the AI/GenAI Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy in alignment with business priorities and identify high-value AI transformation opportunities across functions and industries.
* Drive business development by originating new client opportunities, leading proposal development, and actively participating in pitches for existing and prospective accounts.
* Own executive-level client relationships by serving as a trusted advisor, ensuring delivery excellence, and identifying opportunities to expand client impact.
* Build AI solution narratives, value propositions, and differentiated messaging, and develop industry-specific AI use cases and business cases.
* Develop and commercialize thought leadership on emerging trends, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, autonomous workflows, and AI-powered analytics.
* Build reusable AI/GenAI intellectual property (IP), including proprietary frameworks, accelerators, and new offerings that differentiate EY's capabilities in the market.
* Develop, review, and implement solutions using AI, machine learning, and deep learning, and develop APIs using Python.
* Lead the development and implementation of Generative AI applications using open-source models (Llama, BERT, Mistral, etc.) and closed-source models (OpenAI GPT models, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, Claude, Cohere, etc.).
* Design and optimize solutions that leverage vector databases for efficient storage and retrieval of contextual data for LLMs.
* Understand business priorities and sector dynamics, and identify white spaces and opportunities for analytics and AI applications.
* Manage large and mid-sized projects, ensure smooth service delivery across assigned products, engagements and/or geographies, and work with project managers to address resource needs and gaps.
* Coach and mentor managers and junior colleagues, investing in the growth of EY's AI/GenAI talent and team culture.
* Collaborate across D&A and adjacent practices to bring integrated, high-impact AI solutions to clients' most complex challenges, and provide expert review across projects.

Skills and attributes for success
  
  

* AI & Data fluent: Strong understanding of AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and data and analytics, with the ability to integrate data, AI/GenAI platforms, and analytics into large-scale enterprise transformations and articulate a clear point of view on the evolving agentic AI landscape.
* A proven business developer: Experienced in consulting, solutioning, pre-sales, product strategy, or technology GTM, including managing proposal processes, leading client pitches, growing accounts, and identifying and pursuing new opportunities.
* A leader and collaborator: Energized by managing high-performing cross-functional teams and building trusted, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders.
* A structured thinker: Able to navigate ambiguity, decompose complex business and technology challenges, and deliver clear, actionable solutions with executive-level communication.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Ability to work creatively and systematically in a time-limited, problem-solving environment.
* Reliable and ethical, with high professional standards.
* Flexible, curious, and creative, with openness to new ideas and the ability to propose innovative solutions.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a positive, collaborative working style.
* Intercultural intelligence and experience working across multicultural, distributed-delivery teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision.

To qualify for the role, you must have
  
  

* MBA or master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 11-14 years of relevant work experience in developing and implementing AI and machine learning solutions; deployment experience in Azure is preferred.
* Proven experience in AI transformation programs, with a track record of pipeline generation, proposal development, and deal support.
* Experience building and commercializing AI/GenAI offerings, assets, or IP.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture, data governance, and automation platforms.
* Experience guiding teams on AI/Data Science projects and communicating results to clients.
* Familiarity with implementing solutions in the Azure cloud framework.
* Experience applying statistical techniques such as linear and non-linear regression, classification, optimization, forecasting, and text analytics.
* Familiarity with deep learning and machine learning algorithms and popular AI/ML frameworks.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience working with NLG, LLM, and deep learning techniques, including neural network approaches.
* Expertise in implementing applications using open-source and proprietary LLM models, and proficiency with LangChain-type orchestrators or similar Generative AI workflow management tools.
* Minimum of 6-9 years of programming experience in Python.
* Experience with the software development life cycle (SDLC) and principles of product development.
* Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to mentor team members, with strong technical and problem-solving skills.

Ideally, you’ll also have
  
  

* Ability to think strategically and end-to-end, with a result-oriented mindset.
* Ability to build rapport within the firm and earn client trust.
* Willingness to travel extensively and work from client sites and/or practice office locations.

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn in this fast-moving environment.
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multidisciplinary team of 3,000+ professionals in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Parthenon practices globally and with leading businesses across a range of industries.

What we offer
  
  
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in delivering EY's growth strategy. From accountants and coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities across business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from around the world. We will introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

title: Product Operations Lead
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Lead Product Operations Manager to oversee the operational aspects of our product portfolio. In this role, you will lead a team responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of our products, optimizing processes, and driving successful product launches. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in operations management, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for driving excellence in product operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product and NPI execution**

* Lead and coordinate Product Operations activities across ideation, discovery, development, launch readiness, commercialization, and post-launch reviews.
* Improve the quality and consistency of NPI deliverables, including discovery outputs, Voice of Customer evidence, value propositions, business cases, launch plans, and readiness reviews.
* Establish and maintain milestone, risk, dependency, and action tracking for priority NPI programs.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, clearly documenting decisions, owners, due dates, and escalations.
* Monitor NPI performance and generate actionable insights to improve launch quality, predictability, adoption, and commercial execution.
* Support root-cause and corrective-action activities for delayed, underperforming, or at-risk offerings.

**Process governance and operational excellence**

* Deploy and sustain Honeywell Accelerator Global Design Models and associated governance routines.
* Drive adherence to standard work while identifying opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate duplication, and reduce administrative burden for Offering and Portfolio Managers.
* Build repeatable intake, prioritization, governance, documentation, and escalation mechanisms.
* Partner with process owners and subject-matter experts to resolve gaps across tools, workflows, roles, and decision rights.
* Identify and implement practical automation, AI, reporting, and workflow improvements that increase team productivity and data quality.
* Create reusable job aids, templates, training materials, and best-practice resources.

**Portfolio and lifecycle operations**

* Support portfolio-review cadences by consolidating data, validating inputs, preparing decision materials, and tracking agreed actions.
* Enable portfolio roadmap execution and maintain the operational data needed for product and offering decisions.
* Translate product, market, customer, financial, and operational data into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Maintain decision logs and action registers that improve transparency and follow-through.

**Customer, market, and commercial evidence**

* Support Voice of Customer planning, evidence collection, data management, and analytical synthesis.
* Develop or coordinate centralized customer, market, and competitive insights for product and portfolio teams.
* Support ideation events, discovery workshops, segmentation, market assessment, and value-proposition activities.
* Connect customer evidence and market insights to portfolio, investment, roadmap, launch, and commercialization decisions.
* Support sales enablement and commercial readiness activities for priority launches.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Serve as the operating connector among OLering Management, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance, PMO, and business leadership.
* Influence teams without direct authority and create clarity across complex, multistakeholder initiatives.
* Facilitate productive governance forums and ensure issues reach the appropriate decision-makers.
* Communicate risks, choices, recommendations, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Coach stakeholders on Product Operations processes, tools, data expectations, and standard work.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, marketing, operations, data analytics, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, Portfolio Management, Business Operations, or a related cross functional role.
* Experience coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and milestones.
* Strong analytical skills and experience transforming data into decision-ready reporting and recommendations.
* Proficiency in business reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI.
* Strong written communication, executive presentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to establish structure, improve processes, and drive accountability in an ambiguous environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or an advanced degree in business, product management, engineering management, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience supporting new product introduction, product development, launch readiness, or commercialization.
* Familiarity with Voice of Customer, discovery, segmentation, competitive analysis, and value-proposition development.
* Experience creating management operating systems, dashboards, governance routines, training content, or standard work.
* Experience applying automation, AI, or workflow tools to improve operational productivity.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global industrial technology, automation, software, or engineering organization.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Operates with a customer-value and growth mindset.
* Converts ambiguity into structured plans and clear decisions.
* Demonstrates sound judgment and knows when to resolve, influence, or escalate.
* Builds trust across functions and organizational levels.
* Balances governance discipline with speed and practical execution.
* Uses evidence and data to challenge constructively.
* Takes ownership for closure, not simply coordination.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Deputy Director - Marketplace
description:
**Who are we?**

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit. Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. title: Director, Customer Excellence
description:
**Company Description**
**About AbbVie**
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB SUMMARY**
Develops, recommends and delivers initiatives to maximize the impact and efficiency of sales resources. This role will be a key member of the Affiliate Management Team and is responsible for mentoring and managing the staff working in SFE, Training, CRM, BI, Trade Channel to deliver an effective service across the business.
  
  
Works closely with General Manager to ensure effective communication and adoption of best practice and processes to enable optimal deployment of sales resources. Ensures direct reports are trained and capable to execute country tasks and can deliver effectively on initiatives. The role will also liaise with Regional and International commercial excellence.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Customer Segmentation/Targeting and Territory Optimization**

* Research, develop and define the strategy to profile, segment and target Abbvie’s customers managing the implementation of projects, identifying and communicating best practice and measuring success of approaches.
* Work with BUDs to set direction for sales management that will ensure salesforce effort is targeted to highest value customers aligned with business strategy and that KPIs are identified to track sales team performance.
* Run projects to identify optimal and code compliant coverage of key business accounts and target customer groups and collaborate with sales management to ensure resources are deployed across the BU/Product Line/Country effectively to maximize the impact of the sales teams.
* Lead re design of territory structures as required to ensure optimal coverage of key customers.
* Assess impact of new sales processes and the value of deploying sales team in different ways.
* Develop the key metrics that are used to track sales team performance across the business units working with BI and CRM teams to ensure systems and reports are in place to track metrics
* Maintain familiarity with current trends in salesforce deployment for the Pharmaceutical/Healthcare industry including understanding of how different models can deliver key business objectives.

**Salesforce Bonus/Incentive Design**

* Work with the Region to shape and develop annual incentive schemes ensuring schemes are aligned to regional strategy and policy and are fair and motivational. Test and implement.
* Ensure local bonus policies are understood and paid correctly in country, providing support as needed to ensure correct management of sales bonus for accurate calculations and payments to be made.

**Country Sales Operations**

* Lead and develop CRM and BI roles to ensure they support delivery of business strategy. Provide input to the structure and requirements of these roles/teams ensuring suitable training is provided and Abbvie systems are understood and fully utilized.
* Lead the implementation of significant CRM, BI and digital initiatives, working with relevant team members to ensure strong adoption, sustained effectiveness and clear local ownership of plans and deliverables.
* Drive digital adoption by the IFT by embedding tools, dashboards and field processes into day-to-day commercial routines, enabling data-led decision making and stronger execution discipline across sales teams.
* Drive accurate and timely reporting by CRM/BI ensuring effective working processes are in place to meet requirements of all business units.
* Ensure the sales operations organization has the right skills, capabilities and future-focused mindset to anticipate evolving business needs, adopt new ways of working and continuously raise the standard of sales operations and excellence.
* Represent the country on regional meets and lead/participate in workstreams. Inform lead team about regional and international commercial excellence initiatives and relevance to the business.

**Training**

* Lead the Sales Training team in defining and executing a strategic capability-building agenda that strengthens sales effectiveness, customer engagement and account management excellence across the organization.
* Ensure sales training interventions are continuously aligned in real time with global scientific, behavioural and commercial excellence frameworks, translating global standards into locally relevant and actionable learning priorities.
* Drive effective coaching of sales managers to embed desired field behaviours, improve quality of in-field execution and build leadership capability to sustain performance improvement.
* Ensure timely upskilling of sales teams by identifying emerging capability gaps, prioritising interventions with commercial leadership and measuring impact against business and customer excellence outcomes.

**Market and sales planning & analysis**

* Provide quantitative and qualitative commercial insights to the financial planning, S&OP and LRP processes.
* Propose commercial strategies which cover discount policy development and implementation, supply optimisation practices, routes to market analysis, pricing and promotional activities, targeted wholesaler and pharmacy relationships and any other commercial initiatives that drive domestic revenues.
* Analyze the performance of above-mentioned initiatives.

**Leadership & Collaboration Requirements**

* Proven experience partnering with commercial teams to co-develop and execute local innovation and capability-building initiatives
* Strong discipline in reviewing SFE metrics and using data to course-correct campaigns
* Executive presence to influence stakeholders across regional, global, and local affiliate levels
* Leadership capability to drive accountability and results

**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in business, management or commercial excellence would be an advantage.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry, preferably in multinational organisations, with significant exposure to customer excellence, sales force effectiveness, commercial operations, training, analytics, CRM and digital capability building.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional customer excellence or commercial excellence agendas, including segmentation and targeting, territory optimisation, incentive design, sales operations, market planning and performance management.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including talent development, coaching, performance management and building high-performing teams across sales training, CRM, analytics, BI and digital functions.
* Experience in sales training, coaching, compliance programmes, budget management, forecasting and governance of sales and commercial excellence processes.
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders in a matrix, multicultural environment.

**Essential Skills, Experience And Competencies**

* Senior-level gravitas with a hands-on approach, able to shape strategy while driving disciplined execution across customer excellence priorities.
* Excellent understanding of ethical sales and marketing practices, compliance expectations and customer-focused engagement models in the healthcare industry.
* Strong strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting and business acumen, with the ability to connect market insights, customer needs, commercial priorities and operational execution.
* Deep knowledge of sales force effectiveness, CRM, BI, digital adoption, distribution channels, forecasting and performance management systems.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal, motivational and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust, align stakeholders and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced, matrix environment.
* Strong analytical, numerical, creative and conceptual thinking skills, with a proven ability to translate data and insights into clear strategic choices and measurable business actions.
* High personal effectiveness, including prioritisation, responsiveness, flexibility, resilience and the ability to operate with limited supervision while knowing when to consult, escalate or inform.
* Proven track record of success in setting high professional standards, driving change, fostering innovation and delivering customer and business impact.
* Seizes market opportunities through insight-led decision making, identifying customer and commercial priorities and choosing effective approaches to deliver sustainable impact.

**BEHAVIOURS/VALUES**

* Collaborates broadly across local, regional and global teams, prioritising and leveraging resources to ensure customer excellence goals are met.
* Builds trusting relationships with internal and external stakeholders, understands customer needs and embeds customer-focused practices across sales operations, training and analytics.
* Cultivates strategic networks and partnerships to achieve business goals, engages people with energy and clarity, and creates commitment to shared success.
* Adapts effectively in uncertain and changing environments, remains comfortable with ambiguity and brings future-focused thinking to evolving business and customer needs.
* Acts with integrity and authenticity, promotes trust, is receptive to the ideas of others and demonstrates self-motivation, creativity and innovation.

title: Growth Manager - Admissions
description:
**About Mesa**

Mesa School of Business is India's first VC-backed business school focused on 0-to-1 venture building. It was founded by Harvard, IIT and Kellogg alumni and recently closed a ₹110 Cr Series A.

The undergraduate program trains students to build real companies, not just study them. Each cohort is small, selective and outcome-driven.

**The role in brief**

This role owns the UG admissions engine end to end. It runs from the first ad impression to the final interview, and it builds the systems that let a cohort of 200–400 students scale without breaking.

It sits where sales, marketing, growth and people meet. Half the job is running the funnel. The other half is redesigning it while it runs: new SOPs, new automation, a rebuilt interview process and a growing team.

Think of it as building Mesa's go-to-market function for admissions, not just executing a cycle.

**What you'll own**

**Funnel strategy and growth analytics**

The goal is not more students. It is better ones: high-quality, high-intent students who are a real fit for Mesa. Every number you track should serve that.

* Own the full admissions funnel, top to mid: lead → Info Session → MSAT → application → interview → offer.
* Run a daily lead-quality review across region, campaign and creative. Flag what drives intent, not just volume.
* Build and track unit economics: CPL, CSQL, CAC, LTV:CAC and ARPU for the cycle.
* Analyse past cohorts to find real conversion drivers, such as parent alignment and session attendance, and feed them back into targeting.

**What you'll bring**

* 3–5 years in fast-moving startups, across growth, brand, marketing or community-led businesses.
* A track record of walking into ambiguity and leaving behind systems others can run.
* Comfort with numbers: funnel math, unit economics, and spreadsheets you build yourself.
* Sharp, plain writing for students, parents, investors and internal teams.
* Experience leading and hiring small, cross-functional teams.
* Ease switching between strategy, analysis, copy and on-ground execution in the same week.
* Bonus: event production, cold outreach and partnerships, or EdTech experience.

title: Manager, Marketing Operations
description:

Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud-first, AI-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. **Manager, Marketing Operations — Bangalore, India**
**About The Role**
Marketing Operations at Calix is where strategy becomes execution. We're rebuilding the engine — a new marketing automation platform, an AI-assisted intent and enrichment layer, and an analytics foundation that ties every campaign to pipeline. We're looking for a Manager of Marketing Operations to lead that work from our Bangalore CIDC hub.
  
  
You'll lead and grow a team responsible for the day-to-day health of our martech stack — Salesforce Marketing Cloud, 6sense, Salesforce CRM — while owning the strategic projects that expand what the stack can do, and the operating model that lets the work scale. You'll be hands-on enough to unblock your team on a segmentation build or a data quality issue, and senior enough to make sure that problem doesn't recur. If you want a role where you can shape a global marketing operations function rather than maintain one, this is it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead and develop the team**

**Build the operating model that scales production**

* Establish naming conventions, QA checklists, approval workflows, and documentation that make campaign production repeatable and low-risk
* Create enablement materials and training paths that upskill the team and reduce dependency on senior technical resources
* Continuously identify manual, high-touch work and convert it into templated or automated processes

**Own the platforms**

* Serve as senior SME for Salesforce Marketing Cloud — journeys, data extensions, audience segmentation, deliverability, governance, and integration with Salesforce CRM
* Own 6sense administration and strategy: intent keyword planning, audience/segment design, account and contact enrichment, and ABM activation

**Drive data quality and execution rigor**

* Own marketing data integrity — list imports, normalization, enrichment, deduplication, and pre-activation QA
* Build repeatable, documented processes that reduce manual effort and downstream reporting errors
* Establish governance for consent, data standards, and campaign taxonomy

**Deliver strategic projects**

* Lead multi-system, multi-stakeholder projects from requirements through launch and adoption
* Identify and implement automation and AI opportunities that improve speed, accuracy, and capacity
* Triage and prioritize incoming work through project management tooling, balancing operational demand against strategic initiatives

**Required**

* 8+ years in marketing operations, with demonstrated progression into leadership or team lead responsibility

20 days a quarter in office.

title: Marketing Content Manager
description:
**About PRED**

PRED is a sports prediction market. Instead of betting against a house, fans trade on outcomes against each other. That means better odds, instant cashout, and winners are welcome. We're backed by Accel and Coinbase Ventures, and we're a small team that ships fast.

**The role**

You'll be the voice of PRED wherever sports fans spend their time. You'll turn live games, odds moves and big moments into content that makes people want to trade, on X, short-form video, community channels and our own site. You'll be in the conversation as games happen, not reacting the next morning. You'll be creating for a global audience across Europe, LATAM and Rest of world.

**What you'll do**

-
**Own PRED's social presence**
, starting with X. Post daily during NBA, NFL and football (soccer) seasons: match-moment takes, odds swings, market callouts and memes that actually land.

-
**Cover games live**
. Post in real time during big games, tied to what's moving on PRED.

-
**Make short-form video**
(Reels, TikTok, Shorts, X video) explaining how PRED works, showing trades and cashouts, and covering the stories behind the markets.

-
**Write ad and campaign copy**
with performance marketing. Test hooks, angles and offers, then learn from the results.

-
**Work with creators and KOLs**
in sports, betting and crypto. Write briefs, review drafts and keep the brand consistent.

-
**Build a content calendar**
around the sports calendar: season openers, playoffs, derbies, drafts and transfer windows.

-
**Track what works**
Report on reach, engagement, sign-ups and trades driven by content, and drop what doesn't perform.

**Who you are**

-
**You live and breathe sports**
. You watch the games, follow the storylines and argue about them with friends.

-
**You love making content.**
You'd be making it even if nobody paid you, and you probably already are.

-
**You're bold and experimental.**
You'll try a weird format, a hot take or a new platform before anyone else does, and you're fine killing an idea that doesn't work.

**What you bring**

- 2–5 years in sports content, social media or growth marketing. Experience at a sportsbook, fantasy, prediction market, sports media or crypto company is a big plus.

- You're deeply into sports. You know the NBA, NFL and European football well enough to have an opinion on a Tuesday night game.

- You understand odds and probability and can explain them simply.

- Native X fluency. You know what makes a post travel, and you have accounts or posts you've grown that you can point to.

- You write sharp, fast and funny without being cringe.

- You can shoot and edit short-form video yourself (CapCut, Premiere or similar).

- You're comfortable with numbers and test and iterate instead of guessing.

- You're responsible: you know the rules around gambling-adjacent and financial marketing, and you don't cut corners on compliance.

**Nice to have**

- Experience with Polymarket, Kalshi or crypto-native products

- Spanish or Portuguese (we grow across LATAM)

- An existing network of sports or betting creators

- Basic design skills (Figma, Canva)

**What we offer**

-
**Best pay in the industry**
, plus ESOPs

- On-site in Bangalore with a small, fast team (game time is work time)

- Real ownership: your content ships the same day and its results are visible

- Develop and execute structured tests for creatives, messaging, audience segments, landing pages, bidding strategies and campaign formats.

- Optimize Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display and Demand Gen campaigns, along with relevant Meta and LinkedIn campaign formats.

**3. Marketing Technology, Tracking & Attribution:**

- Demonstrate strong working knowledge of the modern marketing technology ecosystem, including conversion tracking, automation, audience management, attribution and CRM integrations.

- Manage and troubleshoot campaign tracking using Google Tag Manager, GA4, platform pixels, conversion APIs and relevant tracking tools.

- Ensure accurate implementation and validation of conversion events across advertising platforms, websites and landing pages.

- Work with CRM and technology teams to support lead tracking, campaign attribution, offline conversion imports and the transmission of relevant conversion signals to advertising platforms.

**4. Analytics, Reporting & Insights:**

- Evaluate campaign performance across geographies, channels, audiences, creatives and funnel stages.

- Prepare accurate and timely daily, weekly and monthly campaign performance reports.

- Use GA4, advertising platform dashboards, CRM data and Excel to investigate performance trends and identify actionable optimization opportunities.

- Ensure adherence to campaign briefs, launch timelines, optimization schedules and reporting requirements.

- Review campaign setups, tracking implementations, reports and optimization recommendations prepared by team members.

- Support team members in troubleshooting campaign issues and resolving platform-level execution challenges.

- Coordinate with creative, content, web development, CRM and admissions teams for campaign assets, landing page changes, tracking requirements and campaign-related inputs.

**3. Success Metrics (KRAs):**

The following KRAs will be used to evaluate performance. Final targets and weightages can be agreed upon based on the assigned market, campaign mix and business priorities.

**KRA 1: Campaign Delivery & Acquisition Performance:**

- Achievement of assigned lead generation targets.

- CPL and cost-per-qualified-lead performance against approved targets, where applicable.

- Campaign delivery against assigned budgets.

- Reach, impressions and frequency performance for awareness campaigns.

**KRA 2: Campaign Optimization & Efficiency:**

- Timeliness and effectiveness of optimization actions.

- Creative, audience, keyword and landing page testing execution.

- Identification and resolution of campaign performance issues.

- Retargeting and remarketing campaign effectiveness.

**KRA 3: Martech, Analytics & Execution Excellence:**

- Accuracy and reliability of campaign tracking and conversion events.

- Timely identification and resolution of tracking discrepancies.

- Accuracy and timeliness of performance reports.

- Quality of campaign analysis and optimization recommendations.

**Experience:**

- Demonstrated experience managing campaigns across multiple markets, including international geographies.

- Prior experience handling lead generation as well as brand awareness and engagement campaigns.

- Previous experience supervising performance marketing executives and Assistant Managers, with responsibility for reviewing execution and campaign performance.

**LinkedIn Ads:**

**Other Advertising Platforms:**

- Ability to evaluate new advertising channels and formats based on their relevance to assigned campaign objectives.

**B. Analytics & Data:**

- Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Meta Events Manager and LinkedIn Insight Tag.

- Conversion tracking, attribution and offline conversion measurement.

**C. Martech & Emerging Technologies:**

title: Social Media Manager | LinkedIn Strategy, Content & Brand Growth
description:
The Role

LinkedIn is more than a place to publish posts. It is where ideas compete for attention, brands earn credibility, and the right conversations can change how a business is perceived.

At CareerXperts, we work at the intersection of talent, technology and business. We are looking for a
**Social Media Manager with a strong LinkedIn focus**
who understands the platform, has a sharp content instinct and knows how to build a consistent brand presence without resorting to generic corporate content.

This role calls for someone who can think strategically, write creatively, understand audience behaviour, experiment with content formats and take ownership of organic growth.

What You’ll Own

**LinkedIn Strategy & Growth**

* Develop and execute a LinkedIn-first social media strategy aligned with brand positioning and business priorities.
* Build content calendars covering thought leadership, industry insights, recruitment trends, leadership perspectives, company updates and employer branding.
* Drive organic reach, audience growth, meaningful engagement, profile visits and brand visibility.
* Study LinkedIn distribution patterns, content performance and audience behaviour to identify what deserves more attention.
* Experiment with formats, publishing frequency, hooks, polls, carousels, newsletters and founder-led content.

**Content Creation & Storytelling**

* Write sharp, original LinkedIn posts that sound human, informed and distinctive.
* Turn ideas from recruitment, DeepTech, startups, leadership and talent markets into compelling content.
* Develop scroll-stopping hooks, strong headlines, captions, polls and newsletter editions.
* Work with designers to create effective visual content, carousels, campaign creatives and branded assets.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice across company pages and leadership profiles.
* Identify relevant industry conversations and timely topics that the brand can contribute to meaningfully.

**Analytics & Performance**

* Track impressions, engagement rates, follower growth, clicks, reach and other relevant performance metrics.
* Analyse content performance to understand what resonates, what falls flat and why.
* Run structured experiments on content formats, hooks, topics and publishing schedules.
* Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights and actionable recommendations.
* Translate analytics into better content decisions rather than reporting numbers alone.

**Brand & Campaign Management**

* Plan and execute LinkedIn campaigns for brand awareness, employer branding, service visibility and recruitment marketing.
* Coordinate with internal teams to gather insights, stories and subject-matter inputs.
* Maintain a strong publishing cadence and ensure timely execution.
* Monitor relevant industry discussions, competitors and emerging content trends.
* Explore appropriate LinkedIn features and marketing capabilities to expand brand visibility.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in social media management, digital content or LinkedIn marketing.
* Demonstrable experience managing LinkedIn company pages and growing organic audiences.
* Excellent writing, editing, headline development and storytelling skills.
* A strong understanding of LinkedIn content formats, analytics and distribution dynamics.
* Experience creating content calendars and managing multiple content streams.
* Ability to interpret performance data and make informed content decisions.
* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, LinkedIn Analytics and social media scheduling or reporting tools.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to maintain consistency without compromising content quality.
* A proactive mindset, sound creative judgement and a willingness to test new approaches.

**What Will Give You an Edge?**

* Experience growing a LinkedIn company page through organic content.
* A portfolio of LinkedIn posts, campaigns, newsletters or content experiments with measurable outcomes.
* Experience with B2B marketing, recruitment, HRTech, startups or technology brands.
* An understanding of founder branding, executive thought leadership and employer branding.
* The ability to combine creative instincts with analytical thinking.

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Sustained growth in relevant followers and organic reach.
* Improved engagement quality and audience interaction.
* Stronger consistency and distinctiveness in brand communication.
* Better-performing content backed by analytics and experimentation.
* Meaningful contributions to brand visibility and business objectives.

**Why CareerXperts?**

We work across talent, technology and the businesses shaping what comes next. That gives us plenty to say - but saying it well takes thought, originality and a clear understanding of the audience.

You will have the opportunity to shape how CareerXperts shows up on LinkedIn, experiment with ideas, build a recognisable brand voice and connect content performance with business impact.

**If you know how to make a brand worth paying attention to on LinkedIn, we should talk.**

**Application:**
Share your resume along with links to LinkedIn pages you have managed and examples of content or campaigns you have worked on.

title: Assistant Manager SEO
description:
**Welcome to GO Asia**

GrowthOps is a marketing transformation agency, consistently awarded the top Customer Engagement agency in APAC. For over 15 years, we’ve been helping brands go to market in Asia by integrating strategy, design, technology and AI. Trusted by enterprises and high-growth innovators, we specialise in supporting media, MarTech and creative operations across financial services, telecommunications, transportation, ecommerce, energy and more. GrowthOps is part of The Applied AI Company.

***Based in India. Bangalore preferred (hybrid). You’ll need hands-on experience with hreflang, technical troubleshooting (JS rendering, crawl and indexing issues), and tools like Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Google Search Console.***

**Overview**

We're looking for a hands-on
**technical SEO specialist**
to own the technical search strategy and execution across a portfolio of regional clients. You will partner with engineers, product managers, content leads and account teams to improve crawlability, indexing, site performance and organic growth. This role is scoped as an expert individual contributor (Senior Specialist), with or without direct interaction with the client.

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy**

* Define a pragmatic technical SEO roadmap per client, aligned to business goals and market realities (Singapore, Malaysia and wider APAC).
* Translate SEO requirements into clear, prioritised tasks and delivery plans for product and engineering.
* Champion an experimentation mindset and communicate impact to stakeholders in plain language.

**Technical SEO**

* Run comprehensive technical audits covering crawl diagnostics, indexation, internal linking, schema, canonicals, robots directives, sitemaps, pagination/faceted navigation and duplicate handling.
* Diagnose and resolve JavaScript SEO challenges across common rendering approaches (SSR/SSG/CSR) and ensure scalable solutions.
* Design for large, multilingual and multi-market sites (hreflang, regional content logic, URL design, parameter governance).
* Implement structured data at scale (JSON-LD) with robust validation processes.
* Lead low-risk site migrations and re-platforming (domain/HTTPS, CMS/e-commerce) with clear mitigation and recovery plans.

**Performance, UX & Core Web Vitals**

* Partner with engineering to improve LCP, INP and CLS using data-driven diagnostics (resource hints, critical CSS, image optimisation, lazy-loading strategies, JS budget, server timing, CDN tuning).
* Establish performance guardrails and monitor regressions.

**Analytics, Measurement & Reporting**

* Design measurement frameworks that map SEO initiatives to GA4/GSC metrics and revenue proxies.
* Build concise dashboards and exec readouts linking technical changes to traffic, index coverage and conversions.
* Set up monitoring and alerting for crawl errors, index anomalies, page speed regressions and ranking volatility.

**Automation & Tooling**

* Use and extend industry tools (GSC, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, log parsers).
* Streamline repetitive checks using preferred workflows (e.g., XML sitemap diffs, hreflang validation, orphan detection, templated schema).

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Work closely with developers to scope acceptance criteria and validate releases; provide clear reproduction steps and solutions.
* Partner with content and digital PR teams to align technical foundations with content velocity and link acquisition.
* Contribute to playbooks and standards; mentor junior SEOs informally.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Define robots and crawl-rate policies; manage indexation at scale.
* Ensure SEO-friendly security and infrastructure decisions (HTTPS/HSTS, redirect hygiene, canonical strategy, cache headers).
* Maintain documentation for change logs, release notes and rollback procedures.

**Requirements**

* 5 to 8+ years in SEO with a strong technical focus; agency or product-side experience with large/complex sites.
* Expertise with crawling tools (Screaming Frog) and strong proficiency with GA4, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.
* Working knowledge of web fundamentals (HTML/CSS/HTTP), JavaScript frameworks (React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt) and common rendering modes.
* Familiarity with CDNs and edge platforms and how to leverage them for SEO (redirects, caching, image optimisation).
* Practical experience improving Core Web Vitals and setting performance guardrails.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to defend a point of view with data and empathy.
* Excellent attention to detail, documentation discipline and project management.
* Client-facing confidence: run workshops, present findings, and participate in roadmap discussions.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with A/B testing platforms (Optimizely, VWO), and server log analysis at scale.
* Knowledge of international SEO nuances in APAC.
* Experience with programmatic SEO and templated content architectures.

**Tools you'll likely use here**

GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools, Ahrefs, SEMrush, SIMILARWEB.

***We appreciate your application and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates regarding next steps***

**Social Media Associate**

Manager who can turn random internet rabbit holes into actual content ideas.

Someone who can write a killer script, build a social media strategy, plan a content calendar, use AI tools to speed up execution, and pick up a phone to shoot content themselves.

You should understand why a reel works, what makes people stop scrolling, and how to turn a half-baked idea into something worth publishing.

* Scripts & Storytelling: Write engaging reels, short-form video scripts, hooks, captions, and concepts that grab attention in the first few seconds.

* Strong writing skills and an instinct for storytelling.
* A solid understanding of Instagram, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and current social media formats.

* Comfort with creator outreach, communication, negotiation, and follow-ups.

* A portfolio, personal page, or examples of content you’ve worked on that demonstrate your thinking and execution.

Bonus Points If…

* You’re already a content creator with a personal page or an active audience.
* You’ve built a page, grown an account, or created content that has performed well organically.
* You understand creator culture and know how to approach creators without sounding like a copy-pasted brand email.
* You can show us a reel and explain why it worked, not just that it went viral.
* The Creator Bonus
* Already creating content? There’s an opportunity to earn an additional ₹15,000–₹30,000 per month!
* If you’re an active creator who can bring your own content creation skills and audience understanding to the table, you could earn additional compensation based on the scope of creator work and agreed deliverables.

Who Should Apply?

We care more about your ideas, instincts, and ability to execute than a long list of certificates.

If you’re the person sending friends reels with “we should do something like this,” spotting trends before they peak, writing scripts in your Notes app, and figuring out how to make things happen without being told every step, we’d like to meet you.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Convin**

Convin is building AI that turns customer conversations into measurable business outcomes. Founded by IIT Delhi alumni, Convin develops proprietary AI products that help B2C businesses engage customers across phone calls, WhatsApp, SMS, and website voice widgets. Convin’s AI products understand customer intent and determine the right channel, timing, message, and next action for every interaction.

Convin helps businesses turn customer interest into qualified leads, booked appointments, renewals, and completed payments. Convin is building for two demanding B2C markets, India and the United States. In India, we serve leading EdTech, retail, and BFSI businesses. In the United States, we help home service businesses turn more inquiries into booked jobs.

At Convin, every team contributes to solving real business problems. Whether you are building our products, taking them to market, growing customer relationships, or strengthening the organization behind them, your work will directly influence Convin’s growth and customer outcomes.

As Convin scales, you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work across India and US markets, and help shape the products, teams, and systems behind our growth. Convin is trusted by leading brands including Physics Wallah, SBI Life, Shaadi.com, Bajaj, Niva Bupa, Aditya Birla & RBL.

**Highlights:**

* Raised $6.5 million in Series A funding in 2024
* Ranked No. 6 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups 2025 list in India
* Ranked the 19th Best Software Company in India by G2

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and execution-oriented
**Brand Marketing Specialist**
to strengthen Convin’s brand presence across India and the US.

You will own initiatives that shape how Convin is perceived in the market, build awareness among target audiences, strengthen brand credibility, and establish Convin as a recognizable voice in AI, Customer Experience, Contact Center Technology, and B2B SaaS.

The role will combine brand strategy, storytelling, integrated campaigns, industry events, partnerships, digital presence, and thought leadership. You will work closely with leadership, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and external partners to develop compelling brand narratives and execute initiatives that create measurable business impact.

We are looking for someone who can take an idea from concept to execution, build memorable brand experiences, and connect brand-building efforts with audience engagement, market visibility, and business growth.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Develop and execute brand marketing strategies aligned with Convin’s business objectives and target markets.
* Strengthen Convin’s brand positioning, messaging, identity, and differentiation in the AI and B2B SaaS ecosystem.
* Build a consistent brand narrative across customer segments, industries, channels, and markets.
* Translate Convin’s technology, customer outcomes, and business value into compelling brand stories.
* Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, credibility, recall, and differentiation.
* Maintain consistency in brand messaging and visual identity across marketing materials, campaigns, events, and customer touchpoints.
* Work with leadership to communicate Convin’s vision, milestones, innovation, and market impact.

**2. Integrated Brand Campaigns**

* Plan and execute integrated brand campaigns across digital, social, email, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.
* Develop campaign concepts, messaging, creative briefs, and execution plans aligned with brand objectives.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external agencies, designers, and content partners to deliver high-quality campaigns.
* Build campaigns around company milestones, product innovations, customer outcomes, industry trends, and key business initiatives.
* Identify relevant moments, conversations, and platforms where Convin can strengthen its visibility.
* Track campaign reach, engagement, audience growth, brand visibility, and other relevant performance metrics.
* Experiment with new campaign formats and distribution channels to improve brand engagement.

**3. Events, Conferences & Industry Presence**

* Own the planning and execution of industry conferences, trade shows, roundtables, executive forums, webinars, and customer events.
* Identify relevant events across AI, SaaS, Customer Experience, Contact Centers, BFSI, Retail, and EdTech.
* Develop event concepts and brand experiences that strengthen Convin’s market presence.
* Coordinate event participation, sponsorships, speaker opportunities, presentations, booth experiences, branded collateral, and product showcases.
* Work with Sales and leadership to identify relevant audiences, customers, prospects, and industry stakeholders.
* Plan pre-event, on-ground, and post-event activities to maximize visibility, engagement, and business opportunities.
* Measure event performance through attendance, engagement, meetings, brand exposure, and pipeline contribution.

**4. Brand Storytelling & Thought Leadership**

* Build compelling narratives around Convin’s vision, technology, customer impact, and industry expertise.
* Collaborate with leadership and subject matter experts to develop thought leadership initiatives.
* Drive brand storytelling through LinkedIn, blogs, newsletters, interviews, customer stories, industry publications, and other relevant formats.
* Develop content themes and campaigns that establish Convin’s credibility in AI-powered customer conversations and customer experience technology.
* Identify opportunities for media coverage, industry recognition, awards, speaking engagements, and expert commentary.
* Build customer-led narratives, case studies, and success stories that demonstrate real business outcomes.
* Explore founder-led content and executive visibility initiatives to strengthen Convin’s brand authority.

**5. Digital Brand Presence & Social Media**

* Strengthen Convin’s digital brand presence across LinkedIn, the company website, newsletters, and other relevant platforms.
* Work with internal content and design teams to ensure consistent brand communication across channels.
* Plan brand-focused social media campaigns, creative assets, and content calendars.
* Collaborate on website messaging, brand pages, company announcements, and visual storytelling.
* Monitor audience engagement, brand mentions, content performance, and industry conversations.
* Identify opportunities to improve brand discoverability through SEO, industry platforms, communities, and emerging AI-driven discovery channels.
* Ensure that all brand communication reflects Convin’s positioning, tone, and visual identity.

**6. Partnerships & Community Marketing**

* Identify strategic partnerships, industry associations, communities, and platforms that can increase Convin’s brand visibility.
* Build relationships with event organizers, industry influencers, media platforms, and relevant ecosystem partners.
* Explore co-marketing opportunities, joint webinars, partner campaigns, and industry collaborations.
* Identify opportunities to position Convin alongside relevant technology and business communities.
* Coordinate partnership initiatives from planning and execution to performance measurement.

**7. Brand Research & Performance Measurement**

* Research competitor brands, market positioning, industry trends, and emerging brand-building opportunities.
* Track competitor campaigns, event participation, messaging, digital presence, and thought leadership.
* Gather insights from customers, Sales, Customer Success, leadership, and industry stakeholders.
* Establish and monitor relevant brand marketing metrics, including reach, engagement, audience growth, share of voice, media mentions, and event visibility.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of campaigns and brand initiatives and recommend improvements.
* Connect brand marketing activities with relevant business outcomes, including qualified engagement, target-account awareness, and pipeline influence.
* Maintain campaign calendars, budgets, performance reports, and execution plans.

**8. AI, Creativity & Marketing Innovation**

* Use AI tools to improve research, ideation, content development, campaign planning, and performance analysis.
* Experiment with new creative formats, campaign concepts, and marketing workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve the speed, quality, and efficiency of brand marketing execution.
* Stay informed about emerging trends in AI, marketing, digital storytelling, and audience engagement.
* Use automation and data insights to make brand initiatives more efficient and measurable.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of experience in Brand Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Corporate Marketing, or a related function.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing brand campaigns, events, or integrated marketing initiatives.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning, messaging, storytelling, and audience engagement.
* Experience managing industry events, conferences, webinars, sponsorships, or brand partnerships.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling brand narratives.
* Experience working with design, content, digital marketing, leadership, and external agencies.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Ability to take ownership from strategy and ideation through execution and performance measurement.
* Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.
* Familiarity with marketing analytics, campaign reporting, and brand performance metrics.
* Willingness to work from Convin’s Bengaluru office five days a week.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, AI, enterprise technology, Customer Experience, Contact Center Technology, or Sales Tech.
* Experience building a brand or establishing brand marketing processes in a growing startup.
* Experience with US or international markets.
* Experience with PR, media relations, analyst relations, industry awards, or executive communications.
* Experience in employer branding or founder-led brand initiatives.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn marketing, SEO, content distribution, and digital campaigns.
* Experience managing agency relationships, event budgets, and sponsorships.
* Experience using AI tools for marketing research, content creation, and campaign execution.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stronger brand awareness, recognition, and differentiation for Convin.
* Clear and consistent positioning across marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
* High-quality brand campaigns that generate meaningful audience engagement.
* Greater visibility across relevant industry events, communities, and media platforms.
* A strong presence for Convin’s leadership and subject matter experts through thought leadership.
* Compelling customer stories that strengthen brand credibility and trust.
* Successful partnerships and event initiatives that improve market visibility and target-audience engagement.
* Measurable improvements in relevant brand metrics, including reach, engagement, audience growth, and share of voice.
* Clear reporting on campaign performance, budgets, and business contribution.

**Why Join Convin?**

* Build the brand of a growing AI-first B2B SaaS company.
* Work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to shape Convin’s market presence.
* Own brand strategy, campaigns, industry events, partnerships, and thought leadership.
* Work across India and US markets and engage with leading businesses.
* Experiment with creative ideas, emerging technologies, and new marketing approaches.
* Enjoy a high-ownership environment with the opportunity to build and scale brand marketing initiatives from the ground up.

title: Marketing Operations & AI Manager
description:
**Job Description**
As Marketing Operations & AI Manager for Asia and Emerging Markets, you run the region's marketing technology, data, automation, and reporting. You own the platforms, integrations, data, dashboards, and AI workflows that the whole marketing team depends on, and you keep them working. This is the systems and data layer underneath marketing, distinct from campaign operations, who build and ship the campaigns themselves. Your job is to keep the demand engine running reliably, the data clean, and marketing's contribution to pipeline measurable and trusted. TR is investing in AEM marketing so it runs on better systems and practical automation. Done well, this role takes manual, repetitive work off the team, gives everyone reporting they can rely on, and makes AI an everyday tool rather than a project.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run the marketing technology stack: administer, configure, and maintain the regional marketing technology platforms and their integrations day to day, including Eloqua (or the regional marketing automation platform) and Salesforce, covering system configuration, user management, data flows, and platform migrations.
* Own the lead lifecycle and routing: build and maintain lead capture, scoring, and lifecycle management, the routing rules, and the MQL to SQL definitions and handoff into business development and sales, so leads move cleanly and fast.
* Own reporting, analysis, and insight: own the KPI and reporting framework and the data behind it, including tracking and attribution; analyse marketing and pipeline performance; and turn the numbers into clear insight and recommendations for marketing and commercial leaders, what they mean and what to do. Build and maintain reporting in Power BI and SQL, and guide the more junior analyst who produces routine reporting.
* Build AI and automation into the work: design, build, and run AI and agent workflows for repetitive operations tasks such as data hygiene, lead routing, segmentation, reporting, and localisation, turning manual effort into fast, reliable automation.
* Keep data clean and compliant: maintain data quality, enrichment and the integrity of records, and keep marketing activity compliant with data regulation across AEM markets.
* Keep marketing organised: maintain campaign taxonomy, naming, and the standard processes and templates that keep marketing consistent across markets, and support budget tracking and reporting.
* Document, train, and work with vendors: create clear documentation and run onboarding and training so marketers across the region use the tools and processes consistently, and work with external vendors and platform partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Five or more years hands-on in marketing operations, marketing technology, or go-to-market operations in a B2B technology environment.
* Strong hands-on experience administering a marketing automation platform such as Eloqua or Marketo, and Salesforce, including automation, integrations, lead scoring, and lifecycle management.
* A strong data and analytics background: you query and join data with SQL, build reporting in Power BI, and turn marketing and pipeline data into clear analysis, insight, and recommendations.
* A foundation in business analytics or data science, comfortable working with larger datasets to find and explain what is happening.
* Hands-on experience building AI and automation, including agentic AI workflows, to remove repetitive work and speed up marketing operations.
* Practical command of the lead lifecycle and a sales and marketing reporting background, including lead scoring, routing, the MQL to SQL handoff, and funnel reporting.
* Experience working across a matrixed, multi-region organisation, ideally across Asia or emerging markets.
* A self-starter who spots and fixes problems before they reach the wider team, experienced enough to set the reporting standard and guide a more junior analyst, and a clear communicator who can explain technical work to non-technical colleagues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Any relevant certifications will be added advantage

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
