title: Growth Manager – Content & Local Brand
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

description:
**Alike.io**



is a passionate bunch of people, working hard to make it easy for everyone to travel like the people they like. We are the world’s first unified AI social travel platform: travel content creators share their travel stories from their personal travel studios, and Eia, our AI travel companion, turns that social content into trip ideas, then plans and books the entire holiday – from hotels, experiences, visas and commute to eSIMs – all in one place, supporting travellers before, during and after their trip with real human experts.

We are looking for enthusiastic folks with a get-it-done mindset to join us in this mission. For us, hard work is important, but even more important is keeping our promises, delivering on our commitments. Being a hero is good at Alike but being a team player is priceless. And finally, making the right choice usually means going the difficult path, and that is the Alike way.

**The role**

As a Growth Manager, Experiences (Middle East), you will own the customer-facing side of our Experiences business in the Middle East, with a key focus on UAE. You will be the revenue owner for the geography, responsible for the user journey, website conversion, pricing, promotions and propositions that turn demand into bookings. You will report to the Director, Experiences and work in close partnership with the Supply Manager, Middle East, who owns supplier sourcing and contracting, as well as with the marketing, digital commerce, product, operations and finance teams.

You will take a data led approach to test and improve the customer journey and propositions across channels and customer segments and will be the in-market expert on what travelers want to do and experience in the region.

.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the revenue and margin targets for Experiences in the Middle East, with a focus on UAE – plan, forecast and deliver against them.
* Develop and execute the category strategy and roadmap for the Middle East, aligned with the global Experiences strategy and informed by customer insights, market research and competitor analysis.
* Own the end-to-end user journey for Middle East experiences, from discovery and search through to booking and post-booking, identifying and removing friction at every step.
* Drive conversion rate optimisation (CRO) on the website – define and run A/B tests, and optimise listing pages, content and checkout in collaboration with the product, digital and design teams.
* Manage the end-to-end proposition lifecycle, from ideation and validation to launch and optimisation, ensuring that propositions across attractions, tours, activities and curated experiences are customer-focused, differentiated and profitable.
* Develop and implement pricing strategies, aware of the seasonality, events and festivals, booking window, demand fluctuations and competitor pricing.
* Plan and run promotions, offers and campaigns with the marketing team, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and margin.
* Partner with the Supply Manager, Middle East and cross-functional stakeholders, including marketing, digital commerce, product, operations, finance and customer support, translating customer demand and performance data into supply priorities and delivering propositions that meet customer expectations and business goals.
* Monitor and report on funnel and commercial performance using data and customer feedback and contribute to the global Experiences playbook by sharing learnings with the other geographies.

.

**Key requirements for the role**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* A deep understanding of the UAE market dynamics and trends is a must.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering successful and innovative propositions that meet customer needs and drive revenue and margin growth.
* Use AI-powered dashboards, analytics and experimentation tools to monitor funnel and commercial performance in near real time, and to inform pricing, promotions and conversion decisions.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Creative and customer-oriented mindset, with a passion for travel and creating memorable experiences.
* Highly motivated, self-driven and results-oriented, able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

 

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Private medical insurance
* Family friendly work environment, we understand what’s important in people’s lives
* A supportive and ambitious team to help you grow

description:

**Role Purpose**

The
**Category Growth Lead (K–5)**
will act as the business owner for the K–5 category, covering learners from Kindergarten to Grade 5.

This role is responsible for driving category revenue, learner acquisition, parent conversion, engagement, retention and profitability. It combines business strategy, growth marketing, product thinking, customer insights and operational execution.

The ideal candidate will understand how to build and scale a learning business for young children, with a strong focus on parent decision-making, learning outcomes and long-term customer value.

1. Category Revenue Ownership

2. Growth Strategy

3. Funnel Optimisation

6. Campaign Planning & Go-to-Market

7. Analytics & Business Reviews

* Enrolment growth.
* Revenue achievement.
* Growth across relevant K–5 grades and customer segments.
* New customer acquisition.

**Conversion**

* Lead-to-enrolment conversion.
* Trial/demo-to-paid conversion.
* Enquiry-to-enrolment conversion.
* Campaign and channel conversion efficiency.

**Engagement & Retention**

* Learner activation and active learner rate.
* Class attendance and learning activity participation.
* Parent engagement and satisfaction.
* Retention, renewal and course completion rates.
* Referral and repeat-purchase rates.

**Business Performance**

* LTV/CAC.
* Customer acquisition cost.
* Revenue per learner.
* Contribution margin.
* Customer lifetime value and overall category profitability.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

**6–10 years**
of relevant experience across category management, business growth, growth marketing, product growth or business ownership.

Preferred backgrounds:

* EdTech, particularly K–12, early learning or primary education.
* Category management and P&L ownership.
* Growth strategy, acquisition and conversion optimisation.
* Product-led growth and customer lifecycle management.
* Experience in a parent-led purchase journey, subscription business or consumer product serving children would be an advantage.

* Strong business ownership and revenue orientation.
* Ability to develop and execute growth strategies.
* Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making.
* Understanding of acquisition funnels, conversion optimisation and retention.
* Customer-centric thinking, with an understanding of parent expectations and learner needs.
* Go-to-market planning and campaign effectiveness.
* Cross-functional stakeholder management.
* Proficiency in analytics and BI tools.
* Ability to translate insights into clear action plans and measurable outcomes.

* Thinks like the CEO of the category and takes end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.
* Drives enrolment and revenue growth while maintaining healthy unit economics.
* Understands both the parent’s purchase decision and the child’s learning experience.

title: Business Unit Head – Oleochemicals
description:
**About US**
Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences.
  
  
We scale process development and manufacturing as one continuous system, supported by world-class R&D infrastructure and executed across a global network of 500+ manufacturing partners and thousands of scientists and technical partners. The result: new materials go from molecule to commercial scale in months, not years. Scimplify operates offices and teams across 5 countries with 1,000+ innovator customers in 40+ countries.
  
  
We are backed by investors such as Accel, Bertelsmann, Omnivore, Hitachi Ventures and 3one4 Capital, having raised over $80M.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Scimplify is looking for an entrepreneurial Business Head – Oleochemicals to build the business from the ground up, with end-to-end ownership of strategy, product portfolio development, sourcing, manufacturing partnerships, and sales across domestic and international markets.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong technical and commercial expertise in oleochemicals, along with the ability to identify market opportunities, establish supply chains, acquire customers, and build a profitable business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Building: Develop the go-to-market strategy, identify target segments, define product portfolios, and establish the oleochemicals business from inception.
* Technical & Product Expertise: Drive product selection and portfolio development across fatty acids, fatty alcohols, glycerine, methyl esters, oleochemical derivatives, and specialty oleochemicals.
* Domestic & International Sales: Build customer relationships, develop distribution channels, acquire strategic accounts, and drive exports and global market expansion.
* Sourcing & Manufacturing: Establish supplier networks, identify manufacturing and contract manufacturing partners, evaluate production capabilities, and develop cost-competitive supply chains.
* Commercial & P&L Ownership: Lead pricing, cost modelling, margin management, business planning, revenue generation, and overall profitability.
* Strategic Partnerships: Build relationships with manufacturers, raw material suppliers, distributors, and global customers to establish a scalable business.
* Team Building: Develop the business team, processes, and operating model required to scale the vertical.

**Desired candidate profile**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in oleochemicals, fatty acids, fatty alcohols, or oleochemical derivatives.
* Strong technical understanding of product chemistry, manufacturing processes, applications, specifications, and market dynamics.
* Proven track record in business development, customer acquisition, sourcing, and commercial negotiations.
* Experience in both domestic and international markets, including exports and global customer development.
* Demonstrated ability to establish new business lines, develop supplier ecosystems, and scale revenue from an early stage.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in P&L ownership, pricing, and margin management.

**Ideal candidate**
A technically strong, commercially driven leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who can
**build Scimplify’s oleochemicals business from zero to scale**
, establishing a competitive product portfolio, manufacturing and sourcing network, and customer base across India and international markets.

title: Business Manager / Business Head – Essential & Natural Oils
description:
**About US**
Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences.
  
  
We scale process development and manufacturing as one continuous system, supported by world-class R&D infrastructure and executed across a global network of 500+ manufacturing partners and thousands of scientists and technical partners. The result: new materials go from molecule to commercial scale in months, not years. Scimplify operates offices and teams across 5 countries with 1,000+ innovator customers in 40+ countries.
  
  
We are backed by investors such as Accel, Bertelsmann, Omnivore, Hitachi Ventures and 3one4 Capital, having raised over $80M.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Business Manager / Business Head – Essential & Natural Oils will be responsible for developing and expanding Scimplify's business across essential oils, natural oils, aromatic ingredients, and related natural-origin products.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of commercial leadership, market understanding, sourcing expertise, supplier development, and customer relationship management. The individual will identify growth opportunities, build a robust supplier and manufacturing network, lead commercial negotiations, and develop long-term relationships with domestic and international customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience in the essential oils, aroma ingredients, fragrance and flavour, natural extracts or related industries, with a proven ability to build business and deliver profitable growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Strategy & Growth
* Develop and execute the business strategy for Scimplify's Essential & Natural Oils vertical.
* Identify attractive product categories, target markets, customer segments, and new business opportunities.
* Develop a growth roadmap covering sourcing, manufacturing partnerships, customer acquisition, and market expansion.
* Evaluate industry trends, pricing dynamics, competitive positioning, and evolving customer requirements.
* Build a strong business pipeline and establish measurable revenue and profitability targets.
* Sales & Business Development
* Drive customer acquisition, business development, and strategic account management across domestic and international markets.
* Develop relationships with fragrance and flavour companies, FMCG businesses, personal care and cosmetics manufacturers, wellness brands, ingredient distributors, and other relevant customers.
* Identify customer requirements and develop commercially viable product and sourcing solutions.
* Lead commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, quotations, contract closures, and long-term supply agreements.
* Build a strong pipeline of new accounts while expanding business with existing customers.
* Identify opportunities to introduce new products, expand product portfolios, and increase customer wallet share.
* Sourcing & Supplier Development
* Build and manage a reliable supplier ecosystem covering essential oils, natural oils, botanical oils, and related natural-origin ingredients.
* Develop relationships with growers, distillers, processors, extract manufacturers, aggregators, and sourcing partners.
* Evaluate suppliers on product quality, pricing, traceability, reliability, capacity, and sustainability practices.
* Develop sourcing strategies to ensure competitive procurement costs, consistent availability, and dependable supply.
* Identify opportunities to establish long-term sourcing partnerships and improve supply chain resilience.
* Build an understanding of seasonality, crop availability, geographical sourcing advantages, and raw material price fluctuations.
* Product & Technical Understanding
* Develop a strong understanding of essential oils and natural oils, their applications, processing methods, and customer specifications.
* Understand product characteristics such as aroma profile, purity, composition, quality parameters, and consistency.
* Work with technical, quality, R&D, and manufacturing teams to ensure products meet customer requirements and applicable standards.
* Support product evaluation, sampling, customer approvals, and commercialisation of new ingredients.
* Identify opportunities across natural extracts, botanical ingredients, aroma chemicals, and value-added ingredient categories, where aligned with business priorities.
* Manufacturing & Strategic Partnerships
* Identify and develop relationships with essential oil distillers, processors, extraction facilities, and contract manufacturing partners.
* Assess manufacturing capabilities, production capacity, processing expertise, quality systems, and cost competitiveness.
* Explore opportunities for custom processing, contract manufacturing, product development, and value-added solutions.
* Work with manufacturing and technical partners to improve product consistency, yields, quality, and commercial viability.
* Develop strategic partnerships that support business expansion, differentiated offerings, and long-term customer commitments.

title: Lead Risk Manager & Portfolio Owner
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.
**FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities. This multicultural team drives the company's mission of reshaping financial services for underserved communities.**
To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch informative video.

**The role**

We are hiring a
**Lead Risk Manager & Portfolio Owner**
to run FairMoney's Android Quick Loans portfolio in Nigeria. Android is a mature, high-volume and strategically important lending portfolio. This is a
**mini-CEO role for the portfolio**
: you will be the delegated day-to-day owner of its commercial, economic, risk and people outcomes.
  
  
**Please note this role is remote for talents in South Africa and other countries but hybrid for talents in Nigeria and India.**

**Job Description**

**Portfolio economics and business planning**

* Own Android revenue, sustainable Gross Loan Book growth, risk-adjusted Gross Profit, economic profit and credit-risk performance
* Build and own the annual Android business plan and strategic roadmap
* Produce the monthly portfolio forecast and maintain a clear bridge between actual performance, budget and prior forecast
* Diagnose material variances and drive corrective actions with clear owners and deadlines
* Manage Expected Credit Loss, ECL/Revenue, approval and disbursal rates, Average Loan Size, tenure, exposure, FPD, roll rates, PAR, NPL, repeat value and CAC payback
* Partner with Finance and Portfolio Economics on loan-level and customer-level NPV, funding efficiency and performance attribution

**End-to-end Android credit strategy**

Own and continuously improve strategy across:

* **New-to-Bank:**
  low-and-grow origination, first-loan ticket, tenure, pricing and risk controls
* **Returning:**
  repeat eligibility, behavioural strategy, offer construction and exposure growth
* **Top-Ups and Internal Consolidation:**
  eligibility, incremental exposure, pricing, conversion and post-event risk
* **High-risk segments:**
  risk-box clean-up, pricing, short-tenure treatment and exposure caps
* **Rejected-customer re-entry:**
  controlled requalification using risk, affordability and alternative data

You will own the commercial application of PD cut-offs and calibration, pricing, offers, tenure, exposure limits, affordability, income-source treatment, fraud overlays, MBS treatments and customer-routing logic.

**Affordability, experimentation and production delivery**

* Help formalise and operationalise Android affordability using bank-statement/MBS signals, transaction behaviour, SMS-derived estimates, declared income and repayment history
* Translate affordability into amount, tenure, price, exposure, Top-Up and Consolidation decisions
* Design controlled A/B, multivariate and champion/challenger tests with explicit hypotheses, maturity windows, success measures and rollback triggers
* Measure full unit economics rather than only early risk metrics
* Translate strategy into decision-engine rules, parameters and implementation requirements
* Own replay, back-testing, validation, staged rollout, monitoring and post-implementation review
* Drive cross-functional dependencies through to production rather than stopping at analysis

**Delegated decision rights**

Within agreed appetite, budgets and authority, you will be empowered to:

* Prioritise and sequence the Android portfolio roadmap
* Approve and launch controlled experiments within agreed thresholds
* Scale, pause, modify or roll back strategies against predefined evidence and guardrails
* Reallocate team capacity across Android workstreams
* Escalate and resolve delivery blockers

You will escalate decisions that exceed delegated financial or risk thresholds, change company-level risk appetite, create material legal or customer-conduct implications, or materially affect another portfolio.

**Team and cross-functional leadership**

* Build and lead a senior Android credit-strategy team with clear workstream ownership
* Establish strong weekly and monthly portfolio rhythms
* Develop credible workstream owners and at least one portfolio deputy
* Reduce key-person dependency through documentation, controls and repeatable processes
* Work closely with Decision Science, Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, Portfolio Economics, Collections, Fraud, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Customer Service
* Mobilise these partners around clear briefs, owners, timelines and expected economic impact

**Requirements**

* 6+ years in consumer credit risk, credit strategy or lending portfolio management
* Proven ownership of a material lending portfolio or product line, including revenue, GLB, risk and profitability
* Experience building annual business plans, monthly forecasts and corrective action plans
* Strong digital unsecured-lending experience; Nigerian or broader African-market experience is strongly preferred
* Advanced understanding of PD, LGD, EAD, vintages, roll rates, IFRS 9/ECL, pricing, offers, tenure, exposure, affordability and NPV
* Strong SQL capability and comfort with Python or equivalent analytical tooling
* Experience translating credit strategy into decision-engine rules and controlled production changes
* Evidence of building senior teams, developing successors and leading complex cross-functional delivery
* Strong executive communication and the confidence to challenge decisions with evidence

**Benefits**

* 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors
* Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET)
* Training & Development budget
* Paid company business trips

**Recruitment Process**

* A screening interview with one of the members of the Talent Acquisition team
* Business Case Study
* Technical interview with Global Head of Android Lending
* Final Interview with Chief Credit Officer

title: App Monetization Manager
description:
Company: Oogway Apps (oogwaysapps.com)

Function: Growth / Monetisation

Location:[City / Remote / Hybrid]

Reports to:[Head of Growth / Head of Product / COO]

Employment type: Full-time

**About Oogway Apps**

Oogway Apps builds and operates a portfolio of mobile apps across gaming and non-gaming categories. We are looking for a monetisation owner who can grow revenue across the portfolio while protecting user experience and retention.

**Role Overview**

You will own the monetisation strategy and execution for a set of apps in the Oogway portfolio, covering both ad revenue (IAA) and in-app purchases and subscriptions (IAP). You will work with product, engineering, UA/marketing, design, and analytics to design monetisation systems, run experiments, optimise yield, and improve LTV and ARPDAU, while keeping ROAS and retention healthy.

**Key ResponsibilitiesAd monetisation**

* Own ad revenue for assigned apps across rewarded, interstitial, banner, native, app-open, and MREC formats.
* Manage mediation platforms (e.g., AppLovin MAX, Google AdMob/AdMob Mediation, IronSource/LevelPlay, Unity LevelPlay) and ad network integrations (e.g., Meta Audience Network, Unity Ads, Mintegral, Pangle, Liftoff/Vungle, InMobi, Moloco).
* Optimise waterfalls and bidding setups, floor prices, placements, frequency caps, pacing, and ad-unit configurations by geo, user cohort, and app version.
* Run A/B tests on ad placements, formats, timing, and session-level ad load to maximise ARPDAU without hurting retention or session length.
* Monitor fill rates, eCPMs, show rates, latency, and ad quality, and work with partner account managers to resolve issues and unlock better demand.
* Ensure ad quality and compliance through creative filtering, category blocking, and malicious or misleading ad monitoring.

**IAP and subscription monetisation**

* Own IAP and subscription revenue, including pricing, packaging, offers, paywalls, trials, and promotions.
* Design and test store catalogues, price points, regional pricing, bundles, starter packs, and limited-time offers (gaming), and paywall designs, trial structures, and annual-vs-monthly mix (non-gaming).
* Work on conversion, payer penetration, ARPPU, renewal rate, churn, and win-back strategies.
* Manage subscription tooling and billing infrastructure (e.g., RevenueCat, Adapty, native Google Play Billing / StoreKit).

**Hybrid monetisation and LTV**

* Build the right mix of ads and IAP for each app based on genre, audience, and geography.
* Model LTV by cohort, channel, and geo, and partner with the UA team to set bidding targets and payback windows.
* Identify new revenue levers such as offerwalls, rewarded video economies, sponsorships, or premium tiers.

**Analytics and reporting**

* Build and maintain dashboards for revenue, ARPDAU, eCPM, impressions per DAU, conversion, ARPPU, LTV, and ROAS.
* Run cohort, funnel, and segmentation analysis to find opportunities and diagnose revenue drops.
* Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights, forecasts, and recommendations.

**Cross-functional collaboration**

* Work with product and design to integrate monetisation into game economies and app flows without harming the experience.
* Work with engineering on SDK integrations, updates, QA, and release management for ad and billing SDKs.
* Work with UA/marketing to align monetisation with acquisition strategy and ensure positive unit economics.
* Keep apps compliant with Google Play and App Store policies, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), consent frameworks (CMP/UMP), ATT, and COPPA where relevant.

**Requirements:**

**Must have**

* 3–6 years of experience in mobile app monetisation, ad ops, or product growth, with hands-on ownership of ad revenue and/or IAP.
* Strong working knowledge of mediation platforms, programmatic and bidding concepts, and ad network ecosystems.
* Proven track record of improving ARPDAU, eCPM, conversion, or LTV through structured experimentation.
* Solid understanding of mobile metrics: retention, ARPDAU, LTV, ROAS, payer conversion, eCPM, fill rate.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort in spreadsheets and SQL, and in BI tools (Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase, or similar).
* Experience with A/B testing tools (Firebase Remote Config, Google Optimize alternatives, Unity Remote Config, or in-house frameworks).
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence product and engineering decisions.

**Good to have**

* Experience across both gaming (hyper-casual, casual, hybrid-casual, midcore) and non-gaming (utility, productivity, lifestyle, edtech, photo/video) apps.
* Experience with subscription apps and paywall optimisation.
* Familiarity with attribution and analytics tools (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Firebase, GameAnalytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel).
* Understanding of Python or scripting for automation and reporting.
* Knowledge of privacy, consent, and platform policy requirements.
* Experience working with publisher or ad network account managers to negotiate better terms.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Total monetisation revenue (ads + IAP) for assigned apps
* ARPDAU and ARPU/LTV growth
* Ad eCPM, fill rate, and impressions per DAU
* IAP and subscription conversion, ARPPU, and renewal rate
* ROAS and LTV-to-CAC payback
* Number and win-rate of monetisation experiments
* Retention and session-length guardrails (no negative impact from monetisation changes)

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: Learn the portfolio, audit current monetisation setups, and identify quick wins.
* First 90 days: Launch a prioritised experiment roadmap and show measurable ARPDAU or conversion gains on key apps.
* First 6–12 months: Establish a scalable monetisation playbook for the portfolio, with improved LTV and ROAS across assigned apps.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of monetisation across a diverse app portfolio
* Direct impact on revenue and a seat at the table for product decisions
* A fast-moving environment with room to experiment
* Competitive compensation: [Salary range / performance incentives]

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a short note on a monetisation win you drove (what you changed, how you tested it, and the impact) to [email / application link].

title: Delivery Lead - RGM
description:

**Domain Expertise (Highly Preferred)**

Additional Preference:
  
  

* Experience working with global or regional RGM teams is a strong plus.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

* Business Impact & Value Realization (RGM Outcomes)
* Client Trust & Stakeholder Satisfaction

**Note:**
*By submitting your application, you consent to being contacted by our Talent Acquisition team via phone call, email, SMS, WhatsApp, or other communication channels regarding your application and relevant career opportunities.*

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:

* Prepare job descriptions, project briefs, and scope requirements for freelance assignments.

* Evaluate freelancers based on expertise, reliability, work quality, and ability to meet deadlines.

* Strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, account management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, lead conversion, and revenue generation.
* Experience managing CRM systems, sales pipelines, client relationships, and prospect follow-ups.

title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

Business Line Manager

Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

The SBU Connectivity Product Management Lead is the portfolio-level owner for product management, product evolution, go-to-market orchestration, and lifecycle value realization across SBU Connectivity. The role consolidates the former product-specific Business Lead responsibilities into one Product Management organization while maintaining distinct product lines for telematics and connectivity offerings and clear interfaces with the Global Business Lead for overall commercial/business ownership.
  
  
You will translate market, customer, technology, and RFQ signals into a coherent portfolio roadmap, investment priorities, differentiated product propositions, and executable business cases. You will lead a globally distributed team of product managers and regional GTM product managers and influences a broad matrix spanning engineering, architecture, delivery, finance, sales, marketing, and customer teams. Success requires enterprise-level judgment across multiple product lines, regions, customers, investment horizons, and technology generations.
  
  
Manage the global Product Management organization spanning telematics/connectivity product lines and regional GTM product management in the Americas, Europe, Japan, India/APAC and other priority markets. You

* Lead GTM & Regional Product Management: Convert market and Voice-of-Customer signals into product priorities, positioning, value propositions, sales enablement and launch readiness.
* Partner for Growth: Work with Global Business Lead, Sales and RFQ/Early Engagement to shape opportunities around scalable products and derivatives rather than bespoke solutions.
* Own Product Business Cases & Value Realization: Establish product investment logic across market potential, pricing, revenue, margin, R&D, lifecycle cost, reuse and ROI in partnership with Finance.
* Manage Product Performance: Track adoption, pipeline fit, reuse, financial contribution, roadmap execution and customer feedback, taking corrective action when expected value is not realized.
* Connect NPI to Product Ownership: Partner with NPI to mature new concepts and technology opportunities into validated product propositions with disciplined transition into portfolio ownership.
* Drive Cross-Functional Product Realization: Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Global Delivery to translate market needs into scalable platforms, executable roadmaps and reusable production-ready releases.
* Establish Product Management Excellence: Standardize MRD/PRD, roadmap, business case, launch, lifecycle and decision frameworks while resolving cross-product priorities at portfolio level.
* Build Global Product Leadership: Develop a high-performing global Product Management and GTM organization with strong accountability, a customer-centric, data-driven, product-first culture.

**What You Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred.
* 20+ years of progressive experience in automotive, connectivity, technology or adjacent industries, including significant leadership responsibility across product management, business development, GTM and product commercialization.
* 10+ years leading senior, globally distributed teams and complex matrix organizations across multiple regions, customers and product lines.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-product roadmaps, product lifecycle decisions, business cases, pricing/value propositions, investment prioritization and go-to-market execution.
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to balance revenue, margin, R&D investment, product reuse, time-to-market and long-term portfolio value.
* Broad understanding of automotive connectivity and telematics technologies including cellular/5G, V2X, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/GNSS, cloud/edge services, cybersecurity, OTA and automotive-grade hardware/software platforms.
* Proven ability to convert customer and market needs into differentiated, scalable product propositions while resisting unnecessary bespoke complexity.
* Executive communication and influencing skills with credibility across customers, senior leadership, engineering, sales, finance, partners and globally distributed teams.
* Ability to make high-quality decisions under ambiguity and lead transformation across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct authority.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* MBA or advanced degree paired with a technical undergraduate degree.
* Experience leading telematics/connectivity portfolios spanning mobility segments.
* Experience with ecosystem partnerships, new business models, software/services monetization and global OEM commercialization.

**What Makes You Eligible**

title: Strategic Partner Manager, Pixel for Business, Devices and Services
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, sales operations, channel partner management, and enterprise technology consulting.
* Experience in a consultative sales role providing business solutions, and developing B2B channel partner growth strategies for enterprise customers.
* Experience in enterprise sales, and in negotiating and facilitating agreements.
* Experience working on the sales lifecycle, including lead generation, qualification, negotiation, and facilitating agreements.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or other advanced degree.
* Knowledge to deliver credible, strategic recommendations to senior executive decision-makers.
* Ability to manage multi-stakeholder, complex business cycles effectively.
* Strong analytical capabilities to evaluate market trends, customer needs, and competitive intelligence.
* Excellent communication, and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build trust with C-level executives. Demonstrated leadership skills to guide, motivate, and collaborate with cross-functional sales teams.

**About the job**
The Devices and Services Business organization focuses on Google-branded hardware such as Google Pixel, Google Fitbit Air and others and key subscription services such as Google One. Our team is the business arm for Devices and Services, responsible for delivering the P&L results and for leading partnerships with our carriers, retailers, distributors, and enterprise verticals, including developing channel strategy, negotiating commercial terms, marketing and merchandising, and overall market share goals. Our team is also responsible for driving our direct to consumer sales via the Google Store, by driving retail rate recommendations in stores and by ensuring that the presence in-store and online is top notch. We partner cross-functionally with marketing, operations, Product and Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams internally, and with our retail and carrier counterparts across these disciplines.
  
  
As the Pixel for Business Strategic Partner Manager (SPM), you will drive and scale the Pixel and hardware business across Enterprise, Small and Medium Businesses (SMB), Government, Education, and Secure Devices procurement opportunities, with a primary focus on India.
  
  
In this role, you will seed and shape strategic opportunities, innovate business models around emerging trends (e.g., On-Device AI, SMB, Device Services), and build market-specific solutions. You will collaborate with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders to develop and execute a cohesive growth plan for Pixel Business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and qualify new enterprise-level business opportunities across refresh and new accounts. Deliver effective customer engagements alongside strategic partners, resellers, and mobility partners.
* Collaborate with channel partner leadership to build and execute business development plans, providing enabling programs, training, and tools. Advise enterprise clients and partners on business, digital, and workplace transformation solutions aligned with modern market demands.
* Develop strategic account plans, expanding the adoption of the Google Pixel platform and ecosystem. Execute joint account plans cross-functionally with to drive device refresh, expansion, and net-new business growth.
* Establish scalable, lighthouse reference stories that demonstrate impact and can be replicated across industry verticals. Leverage solution-selling and IT enterprise architecture expertise to transform workflows and strategic operations.
* Innovate commercial models with cross-functional teams to cultivate sustainable, long-term business growth.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

description:

* Craft and deliver key communications and presentations, including speaking engagements and leadership updates, that support internal and external alignment.
* Run point on cross-functional projects and establish a standardized change management approach for transformation initiatives.

**Data Analytics & Insights**

* Build financial models and growth models to guide investment decisions.
* Diagnose marketing and sales funnel conversion issues and make the right recommendations
* Analyze customer behavior to shape product prioritization
* Define the key metrics and build the right dashboards

**YOU HAVE**

* 8+ years in strategy, operations experience in a SaaS business; management consulting or equivalent required, MBA preferred.
* A proven track record building, scaling, and refining strategy and programs for complex businesses.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all organizational levels.
* Experience with organizational design, organizational behavior, and leadership or team development.
* Strong data analysis skills — using metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement — with meticulous attention to detail across multiple concurrent projects.

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. * Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
* Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

* Minimum 3 years of experience leading and managing sales or commercial teams.
* Proven Commercial Director experience in luxury hotels.

* Proven experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
* Strong background in cross-functional collaboration within matrixed environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze financial data to inform strategic and tactical decisions.
* Track record of identifying and evaluating new business opportunities.
* Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel industry operations.

With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Senior Manager (Strategic PR, Branding & Communications)
description:
**🚀 About Joveo**

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are looking for someone who can help make Joveo a company people turn to for a clear, informed view on AI and the future of hiring.

You will help bring the ideas, expertise and work inside the company into the conversations that matter to our business.

**🌟 About the role**

We are hiring a communications professional with an editor’s instinct for a story and the initiative to make it happen. You can spot an angle in a customer conversation, draw a compelling point of view out of a founder, and earn attention for work that deserves it.

Reporting directly to the
**Chief of Strategic Initiatives & Global Supply Officer**
, you will lead strategic PR and leadership visibility. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to shape Joveo’s corporate narrative and advise on where we should speak, what we can credibly say and which opportunities deserve our attention.

**Strategic PR is the primary mandate.**
Creative brand campaigns are an important extension of it. We want someone who brings original ideas, understands how different channels work and can turn a strong story into a campaign people remember.

**🧠 What you’ll do**

* Develop Joveo’s corporate narrative. Get close to our leaders, customers and subject experts. Find the evidence behind the story and turn it into compelling pitches, commentary, contributed articles and briefing material.
* Build a sustained earned-media program across relevant business, technology, startup and industry publications. Develop relationships with journalists, editors, newsletters and podcasts by understanding their audiences and bringing them useful ideas.
* Strengthen leadership visibility. Develop distinctive points of view, prepare executives for interviews and identify relevant speaking opportunities. Make the message sharper while preserving the person’s voice.
* Lead communications around approved company milestones, product developments and funding announcements when relevant. Prepare FAQs, manage media enquiries and advise leadership when an issue requires a careful response.
* Originate creative campaigns that support our PR priorities. Turn customer insights, company expertise or a timely point of view into an editorial series, collaboration, event or other relevant format. Own the brief and channel choices, coordinating specialists where needed.
* Use paid PR selectively and make the budget work harder. Assess sponsored content, distribution, events and agencies against a clear audience, objective and cost. Find resourceful ways to build visibility through earned and owned channels.
* Measure whether the work is making a difference. Track coverage relevance, message accuracy, audience engagement and attributable inbound interest. Keep paid exposure distinct from earned coverage and use the results to improve the next campaign.

**🎯 What we’re looking for**

* You have personally earned relevant coverage for a technology business, startup or agency client. You can explain how you found the story, pitched it and adapted when the first approach did not work.
* You know India’s business and technology media and have relevant working relationships.
* You write and edit exceptionally well. You can understand a complex product and explain why it matters in language people want to read.
* You are comfortable advising senior leaders, questioning a weak angle and recommending a stronger one.
* You have originated a campaign, collaboration or channel idea that made an impact. You can show your contribution and explain the audience insight behind it.
* You are resourceful with a focused budget and can take an idea through execution. Experience in AI, enterprise technology, corporate milestone communications or international media is useful.

**✨ Why join Joveo**

You will help shape the story while it is being formed, with direct access to senior leadership and responsibility for how it reaches the public.

There is room to bring your own editorial judgment and pursue original ideas. Your work will influence how customers, prospective hires and the wider business community understand Joveo, with PR at the centre and creative thinking throughout.

title: Pricing Lead
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Pricing Lead will serve as the strategic pricing business partner to the India Managing Director and leadership team, owning and running the in-market pricing operating system. The role converts cost, market, customer, portfolio and value signals into disciplined pricing decisions that improve sustainable margin per metric ton and total material margin.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Act as strategic pricing partner and constructive challenger to the Managing Director, commercial leadership and cross-functional leaders, translating analysis into clear recommendations and navigating difficult pricing, margin and volume trade-offs.
* Own and continuously improve the India pricing operating system, including pricing committee routines, Price Build, pricing governance, decision records, escalation paths, action tracking and cross-functional cost-into-pricing updates.
* Define and govern price-realization, discount, rebate, promotion and exception frameworks, ensuring differentiated pricing is intentional, linked to customer value and segmentation, and not hidden in discretionary concessions.
* Drive local adoption and business use of enterprise pricing capabilities, including Price Build, Customer Profitability, PriceFX and scalable analytics, while identifying data-quality gaps, adoption blockers and market requirements.
* Lead the execution of multiple profitability optimization projects and deploy strategic pricing capabilities for the various business groups aligned with their strategies, market dynamics and needs.
* Define roadmaps and execute initiatives by leading new approaches for large deal negotiations.
* Develop execution strategies for the deployment of pricing as an end to end process from strategic considerations to actual price setting techniques, governance and supporting technology.
* Review business need assessments with regard to data and technological requirements and make realistic return on investment recommendations.
* Monitor trends and pricing developments and trends and ensure new thought leadership and new capabilities are introduced across business groups.
* Evaluate hypotheses for profit improvement opportunities, validate with data and facts and execute the strategy for deployment projects to capitalize on the opportunities.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
* Analytical proficiency to derive insights from large and complex sets of business data
* Financial knowledge for profit and loss, margin and price decision making
* Experienced in project and change management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in a strategic role with proven experience leading pricing initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer, market, value, and cost insights into pricing decisions.
* Proven track record of leading in-market pricing strategies that drive profitable growth.Experience establishing and optimizing pricing governance, processes, and decision frameworks.
* Strong influencing skills with the ability to drive alignment across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams.
* Ability to embed pricing into business planning and commercial decision-making.Strong commercial acumen with a focus on revenue growth, margin expansion, and customer value realization.
* Background in any one of the following areas: Costing & Finance, Business, Marketing, or Supply Chain.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership capabilities.

Program Management

Go-to-Market Planning & Brand Launches

* Manage upward communication effectively, providing leadership with timely updates on program progress, performance, and risk
* Cultivate strong working relationships with internal teams and external vendors to ensure seamless, high-quality execution

Data, Reporting & Customer Engagement
  
  

* Leverage Excel and BI tools to monitor campaign performance, analyse return on investment, and deliver weekly and monthly category performance reports

marketing, program management, others

3. Creative Production & Organic Social Media — 20%

* Write engaging ad copy, headlines, captions, and calls to action.

* Test creative variations and use campaign performance data to improve future assets.

**Organic social media**

* Plan and execute a practical content calendar for Instagram and LinkedIn.
* Schedule and publish approved content consistently.
* Develop content around education choices, career decisions, industry developments, and relevant learner concerns.
* Monitor engagement, reach, saves, shares, profile visits, and relevant enquiries.
* Maintain consistency in MegaRyse's brand identity, messaging, and tone.
* Align organic content with wider marketing objectives and paid advertising campaigns.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 1–3 years of practical experience in performance marketing or digital marketing.
* Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.
* Practical experience with Google Ads, including search campaigns and conversion optimisation.
* Understanding of lead generation funnels, audience targeting, retargeting, and conversion tracking.
* Working knowledge of SEO, keyword research, on-page optimisation, and organic search performance.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and Meta Pixel.
* Ability to create and edit short-form videos and digital marketing creatives.
* Good copywriting skills for advertisements, scripts, captions, and landing pages.

* Strong analytical, communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in education, edtech, higher education, professional courses, or other lead-generation businesses.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against business outcomes, execution quality, and continuous improvement.

**Performance marketing**

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Cost per qualified lead.
* Lead-to-counselling booking and attendance rates.
* Campaign conversion rates and efficient use of the advertising budget.

**Creative production and social media**

Targets will be set based on the initial performance baseline, available budget, and business objectives. SEO will be evaluated over an appropriate period rather than solely on immediate lead generation.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to:

title: Marketing Director
description:
**About Us**
Fermi AI is building an AI tutor for students preparing for NEET and JEE. It teaches concepts, solves doubts step by step, adapts practice to each student's weak areas, and tracks readiness for the exam like a personal coach available any time, at a fraction of coaching fees.
  
  
**The role**
You will build Fermi AI's growth engine from scratch: positioning, go-to-market, acquisition, activation and conversion to paid. Your north star is paying learners who stay and improve, at a cost per paid user that scales.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will run experiments yourself in the first months, find the two or three channels that work, then hire and scale. You will work daily with founders, product and academics to shape what we launch and how we talk about it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Positioning and go-to-market**

* Define Fermi AI's positioning against coaching institutes, online players and why an AI tutor built for NEET/JEE wins.
* Own pricing and packaging inputs with founders: free tier, trials, subscriptions, test-series add-ons.
* Plan launches and growth pushes around the exam calendar: new-session starts, board-exam season, JEE Main/Advanced and NEET results, and the dropper window.

**Growth and funnel**

* Own the full funnel: awareness → install/sign-up → activation (first doubt solved, first practice set) → habit → paid → renewal.
* Run performance marketing on Google, Meta, YouTube and app stores (UAC, ASO), with clear CAC and payback targets.
* Design referral loops, freemium hooks and lifecycle journeys (WhatsApp, push, email) with product.
* Set up attribution and analytics (MMP, product analytics, CRM) from day one.

**Partnerships and offline channels**

* Build B2B2C channels: schools, small coaching institutes and teachers who adopt Fermi AI for their students.
* Run scholarship tests, seminars and campus activations in coaching hubs
* Shape marketing for any offline or hybrid presence we add later (open question: confirm plans).

**Brand, content and community**

* Build trust with students and parents: accuracy of the AI, alignment with NCERT and exam patterns, measurable score gains.
* Turn learning outcomes into proof — improvement data, student stories and results — strictly within our verified-claims policy.
* Grow owned channels (YouTube, Instagram, Telegram/WhatsApp communities, PYQ and mock-test content) as top-of-funnel and showcases of the tutor in action.
* Work with educators and student creators; manage PR and reputation on app stores and parent forums.

**Team, data and compliance**

* Hire the first marketing team (performance, content, community, design) and manage agencies.
* Run a weekly growth review: channel CAC, activation, conversion to paid, retention and payback.
* Keep all advertising compliant with CCPA guidelines on misleading coaching ads and app-store policies (no unverified ranks, no guaranteed-selection claims, honest AI claims).

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 90 days**

* Ship positioning, messaging and a brand foundation the founders sign off on.
* Stand up tracking: attribution, funnel dashboards and a baseline for CAC, activation and conversion to paid.
* Run tests across at least 5 acquisition channels and identify the 2–3 worth scaling.
* Hire or line up the first performance and content hires.

**First 12 months**

* Reach [N] active learners and [N] paying subscribers (open question: set targets).
* Bring blended CAC to ≤ ₹[X] with payback within [X] months.
* Lift activation and free-to-paid conversion by [X] points with product.
* Make ≥ [X]% of sign-ups organic or referral-led.
* Build a recognised brand among NEET/JEE aspirants and parents, backed by published learning-outcome data.

**Must-haves**

* 8–14 years in marketing, with at least 4 years in Indian test-prep EdTech (NEET/JEE strongly preferred).
* Has driven consumer app or subscription growth and can speak to the CAC, activation, conversion and retention numbers they owned.
* Has done 0 → 1 or early scale-up work: built a channel, brand or team from nothing, not only run a mature machine.
* Strong performance-marketing command (Google, Meta, YouTube, app-store campaigns), hands-on, not only via agencies.
* Understands how Indian students and parents choose prep: results, trust, price, peer and teacher recommendations.
* Fluent in English and Hindi; one more regional language is a plus.

**Good to have**

* Has marketed an AI or adaptive-learning product and handled questions on its accuracy and trust.
* Built a YouTube channel or student community that became a major acquisition source.
* Has run B2B2C partnerships with schools or coaching institutes.
* Has worked with educator-creators and student influencers.

**What we offer**

* A founding leadership seat at a Meraki Labs venture, shaping a new category: AI-first exam prep.
* Competitive CTC with meaningful ESOPs.
* Budget and freedom to test, then build the team and stack you need.
* Close work with founders, product and AI teams where your insight shapes the product, not just the ads.

qualified leads. While SEO will be the primary focus, the role also contributes across the wider digital marketing

mix, including content, social media, paid campaigns, email marketing and analytics.

Search Engine Optimization (Primary – approx. 70%)

rankings.

title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst - India
description:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
  
  
**About The Role**
Kong's Marketing Operations team is the operational backbone of the go-to-market engine. This role is built around execution, but it doesn't stop there. You'll own the day-to-day intake queue, turning marketer requests into clean, accurate, on-time programs in Marketo. And you'll bring enough curiosity and systems thinking to spot what's inefficient, broken, or worth automating, and say something about it.
  
  
You'll work closely with a globally distributed team supporting the systems, processes, and data infrastructure that connect marketing activity to pipeline.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build, QA, and send emails in Marketo from intake requests: template setup, token population, smart list configuration, scheduling, and send confirmation
* Process list imports end-to-end: field normalization, deduplication checks, schema mapping, and load validation against Salesforce
* Build audience segments and smart lists for campaign targeting based on marketer-provided criteria; validate logic before use and flag coverage gaps
* Maintain lead flow integrity for records touching your work: lifecycle stage accuracy, routing correctness, and Marketo-SFDC sync health
* Handle operational workflows including suppression list updates, unsubscribe management, and compliance record corrections
* Identify recurring patterns in the intake queue and propose process improvements or automation before someone has to ask twice
* Document execution workflows and build repeatable checklists so output quality stays consistent at volume
* Stay current on marketing automation capabilities and adjacent GTM tooling; bring ideas back and pressure-test them against real use cases

**What You'll Bring**

* 4-6+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a GTM systems role
* Strong hands-on Marketo experience: email execution, smart lists, tokens, program architecture, and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of Salesforce: enough to validate sync behavior, catch attribution gaps, and escalate when something doesn't land correctly
* Comfort with data: list hygiene, field normalization, deduplication logic, and compliance requirements (GDPR, CAN-SPAM)
* A process improvement instinct: you see how something works and immediately think about how it could work better
* High accuracy and attention to detail; you QA your own work before it goes live and own the fix when it doesn't
* Ability to manage a queue of concurrent requests, prioritize effectively, and communicate proactively when something is blocked
* Comfortable working autonomously and asynchronously with a globally distributed team

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with HTML email editing
* Hands-on experience with GTM orchestration or workflow automation tools such as Clay, Zapier, or similar
* Familiarity with data platforms like Snowflake or BI tools like Tableau
* Exposure to lead scoring models and attribution methodology
* Background in B2B SaaS or a technical product environment

**What We're Looking For Beyond The Resume**
Someone who takes pride in execution quality and doesn't let a request go out the door with a broken link or the wrong segment. Who also notices when the same type of request comes in for the tenth time and asks whether it should be automated instead. The work is high-volume and detail-intensive, and the best person in this role will do it well while quietly making it easier for everyone around them.
  
  
**About Kong**
Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

title: Growth Marketing Manager

**What you will own**

Pipeline from target health systems, the

●Share account intelligence, website visitor data, and content performance with sales.

●Create other enablement resources as sales needs them.

●Manage communications for Jeeves feature releases.

●Plan and structure customer story interviews with customers.

●Gather and share competitive intelligence.

**Must-haves**

●At least 3 years (ideally 3 to 5) of hands-on growth, demand generation, or outbound

marketing experience, preferably in B2B SaaS.

●A track record of generating qualified pipeline

●Strong hands-on experience with Clay, Apollo, and Seamless.AI, or similar tools, for list

building, enrichment, and verification.

●Experience using signal data to prioritize accounts and to time and personalize outreach.

●Hands-on experience with Smartlead.ai or similar sending tools, including setting up

sequences, sending, and tracking, and monitoring deliverability and fixing problems when they appear.

●Daily, practical use of AI in your work, and at least one thing you have automated end to

end, such as a Clay table, a Grok Bot or Claude-based agent or automation, or a similar build.

●Experience running and optimizing LinkedIn Ads.

●Experience reporting on campaign and website performance in GA4.

●Clear, persuasive writing across outreach, email, landing pages, and social.

●Comfort with numbers: you can read a funnel, set a baseline, run a test, and make a call.

●The judgment to own a plan, set priorities, and work with sales, product, and subject matter experts without close supervision.

**Nice-to-haves**

●Experience marketing to hospitals, health systems, or other healthcare IT buyers.

●Experience selling into enterprise buying committees with long sales cycles.

●Experience running and optimizing Meta Ads and Google Ads.

●Experience writing long-form content, such as blog posts and guides.

●Hands-on experience with a CRM.

●Experience owning website page structure, messaging, and copy updates.

●Event, webinar, or conference marketing experience, including speaking submissions.

●Experience with account-based marketing and using engagement signals to prioritize accounts for sales.

Clay, Apollo, Seamless.AI

Smartlead.ai (sequencing, sending, deliverability monitoring)
