* Draft proposals, sponsorship decks, one-pagers, and follow-up communications
* Support partnership and sponsorship conversations from first contact through to closure
* Maintain a clean CRM or tracker with lead status, next steps, and pipeline value
* Prepare a weekly pipeline report for the founder

2. Event Marketing and Promotion

* Plan and run promotion campaigns for upcoming events across LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and social media
* Write event copy, invitations, newsletters, speaker announcements, and post-event recaps
* Create simple creatives and posts (Canva or similar)
* Track campaign performance: reach, responses, registrations, and conversions
* Coordinate with partners and speakers for co-promotion

3. Guest and Delegate Acquisition

* Identify and invite prospective guests, speakers, and VIP attendees
* Reach out to target professionals, explain the event’s value, and drive delegate registrations
* Follow up persistently until attendance is confirmed
* Maintain guest and delegate lists, confirmations, and attendance records

4. Event Operations Support

* Coordinate with the events team on logistics, guest lists, schedules, and vendor communication
* Be present on the ground at events for guest check-in, hospitality, and attendee engagement
* Collect feedback and contact details, and handle post-event follow-ups

5. Founder’s Office Support

* Assist the founder with research, presentations, reports, and meeting preparation
* Prepare market, competitor, and industry research briefs
* Draft emails, notes, and documents on the founder’s behalf
* Take on special projects and cross-functional tasks as they come up

A Typical Week

* **Monday:**
  Pipeline review with the founder, weekly target setting, outreach planning
* **Tuesday to Thursday:**
  Lead research, outreach, calls, and follow-ups; event content and promotional material
* **Friday:**
  Campaign performance review, tracker updates, drafts and proposals
* **Saturday:**
  Follow-ups, event coordination, and weekly report to the founder
* **Event days:**
  On-ground support (timings may extend as needed)

Targets & Performance Metrics

**Weekly targets**

* Research and build
  **50 to 75 qualified leads**
  (sponsors, partners, speakers, delegates) with verified contact details
* Make
  **40 to 60 outreach touchpoints**
  (calls, emails, LinkedIn, WhatsApp)
* Send
  **15 to 20 personalised pitches or proposals**
  to sponsors and partners
* Secure
  **3 to 5 meetings or calls**
  for the founder and team
* Update the CRM or tracker daily and submit a
  **weekly pipeline report**
  every Saturday

**Monthly targets**

* **Guest acquisition:**
  Invite and confirm
  **15 to 25 guests, speakers, or VIP attendees**
* **Delegate acquisition:**
  Drive
  **10 to 20 confirmed delegate registrations**
  per event cycle
* **Business development:**
  Advance
  **2 to 3 sponsor or partner leads**
  to proposal stage and support closure of
  **at least 1**
* **Event marketing:**
  Publish and manage
  **8 to 12 pieces of promotional content**
  (posts, newsletters, invitations, creatives)
* **Conversion:**
  Lead-to-meeting of
  **at least 10%**
  and meeting-to-registration or deal of
  **at least 25%**

**Event-wise targets (per event)**

* Complete post-event follow-ups within
  **48 hours**
  (thank-you notes, feedback collection, next-step outreach)

**Quality standards**

* Tracker accuracy of 95% or higher, with no duplicate or outdated entries
* Every outbound email and proposal free of spelling and grammar errors
* All follow-ups completed within agreed timelines

**How performance is reviewed**

* Weekly review with the founder (Monday)
* Monthly scorecard against the targets above
* Mid-point review at month 3 and final review at month 6, which feeds into the certificate, letter of recommendation, and any conversion opportunity

Requirements

**Must have**

* Excellent written and spoken English (you’ll be writing and speaking to senior professionals daily)
* Strong research, communication, and organisation skills
* Comfort with cold outreach, phone calls, and follow-ups
* Proficiency in Google Workspace or MS Office
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree (BBA, MBA, Marketing, Communications, Business, or similar)
* Ability to commit to the full 6 months and the Monday to Saturday office schedule

**Good to have**

* Hindi fluency
* Canva or basic design skills
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, or CRM tools
* Prior internship, event, sales, or marketing experience
* Interest in startups, networking, or the events industry

Skills You’ll Develop

* B2B outreach, lead generation, and pipeline management
* Sponsorship and partnership selling
* Event marketing, promotion, and community building
* Professional business writing and pitching
* Working with founders and senior leaders
* Project management and execution under deadlines

What You’ll Gain

* Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row view of how a company is built
* Real ownership of work that affects revenue and event outcomes
* Networking with founders, executives, and industry leaders
* A strong portfolio of real projects
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation on successful completion
* Performance incentives on delegates and sponsorships closed
* Opportunity for a full-time role based on performance
  *(remove if not offered)*

Who Will Thrive Here

You’re curious and hungry to learn, you write well, you’re not afraid to pick up the phone, and you follow through without being chased. You enjoy variety, handle a fast-moving environment well, and want real responsibility.

Who This May Not Suit

This isn’t a good fit if you want a part-time or remote role, can’t commit to the full 6 months, or prefer a narrow, fixed set of tasks.

title: SEO and ORM Executive
description:
**OBJECTIVE OF THE POSITION**

As part of the ORM team, the SEO Specialist will lead Karma Group's organic search strategy, ensuring the brand is highly visible, discoverable and trusted across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search platforms. The role will be responsible for auditing and improving the technical health of Karma Group's global websites; driving sustainable organic growth; enhancing brand discoverability through SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO); and implementing best practices to strengthen the Group's digital presence. Working closely with the GEO & ORM Executive, Content Marketing, Web Development, AI and Digital teams, the SEO Specialist will develop scalable search strategies while supporting the ORM function through reputation-focused SEO initiatives, optimisation of business profiles, and guidance on online review management. By combining technical SEO expertise with AI search optimisation and online reputation best practices, this role will help ensure Karma Group maintains a strong, authoritative and future-ready presence across both search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Strong expertise in Technical, On-Page and Off-Page SEO.
* Ability to conduct comprehensive SEO audits and develop actionable optimisation strategies.
* Experience with keyword research, search intent analysis and content optimisation.
* Understanding of website architecture, crawlability, indexation and Core Web Vitals.
* Knowledge of AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Experience with Local SEO, International SEO (hreflang) and structured data (Schema Markup).
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret SEO performance and recommend improvements.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to work collaboratively with technical, content and marketing teams.
* Support in monitoring and responding to online reviews and customer feedback, helping maintain a strong brand reputation while enhancing visibility across search and AI platforms.
* Assist in managing reputation during high-priority or sensitive issues, working closely with internal stakeholders where required.
* Identify recurring customer feedback and collaborate with relevant teams to recommend improvements.
* Ensure online review content and business profiles contribute positively to the brand's visibility in both traditional and AI-powered search.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 2–5 years of proven experience in SEO, with a strong focus on technical SEO and organic search growth.
* Experience managing SEO for medium to large websites or multi-site environments.
* Experience in hospitality, travel or lifestyle brands is advantageous.
* Experience developing SEO strategies for multi-brand or international websites.
* Familiarity with Google AI Overviews, LLM optimisation and emerging AI search trends.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS or JavaScript to support technical SEO implementation.
* Experience using Python or automation tools for SEO analysis is a plus.
* Strong project management, communication and presentation skills.

**TOOLS**

Experience with:

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Ahrefs or Semrush
* Screaming Frog SEO Spider
* Google Tag Manager
* Looker Studio
* AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity
* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

title: Senior Manager - Commercial Digital Partner (RGM)
description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more
  
  
  
  
**About The Function**
Digital & Technology (D&T) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.
  
  
This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it’s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.
  
  
You’ll be part of a team that’s constantly learning, experimenting and pushing boundaries, with the freedom to explore new ideas and the support to turn them into reality.
  
  
**Experience/skills required:**
  
  
 BE/B.Tech preferably in Computer Science or related discipline.
  
  
 MBA from a reputed institute (preferred).
  
  
 PMP, ITIL or Agile/Scrum certification preferred.

 Strong Product Management/Product Ownership experience for enterprise business applications.
  
  
 Deep understanding of Revenue Growth Management (RGM), Trade Promotion Management (TPM), Pricing, Spend management and other Commercial processes.
  
  
 Experience with CRM/Sales/Commercial applications and SaaS products, preferably within FMCG/CPG, preferably on Salesforce platform
  
  
 Experience delivering end-to-end digital products from strategy and roadmap through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
 Strong understanding of enterprise platforms (SAP preferred), integrations and software development lifecycle.
  
  
 Experience working in Agile delivery models and managing cross-functional teams.
  
  
 Proven experience managing implementation partners, AMS vendors and delivery governance.
  
  
 Strong analytical, problem-solving and solution design capabilities.
  
  
**Key Criteria For The Role**
 Own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for commercial products including TPM and eCostcard.
  
  
 Act as the Digital Product Owner and SME for Commercial and Revenue Growth business capabilities.
  
  
 Partner with Commercial, Finance and Global Product teams to identify opportunities and define technology solutions.
  
  
 Lead demand management, roadmap prioritisation and solution design aligned to business outcomes.
  
  
 Drive end-to-end delivery through internal teams and implementation partners.
  
  
 Own product adoption, governance, business value realisation and continuous improvement.
  
  
 Influence stakeholders and vendors to deliver high-quality solutions that meet business objectives.
  
  
 8–12 years of experience in Product Management, Business Technology or Digital Transformation.
  
  
 Experience delivering Sales, Commercial, CRM or Revenue Growth applications within FMCG/Consumer Goods.
  
  
 Strong understanding of Trade Promotion Management, Pricing, Commercial Finance or Revenue Growth business processes.
  
  
 Proven experience owning enterprise applications across the complete product lifecycle.
  
  
 Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence senior business leaders.
  
  
 Experience managing implementation partners and application support vendors.
  
  
 Ability to translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
  
  
 Strong planning, organisational and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  
  
 Self-driven individual who can work independently and lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  
  
**Success In This Role Will Be Demonstrated Through**

* Being recognised as the trusted Digital partner for Revenue Growth Management or commercial processes.
* Driving product strategy and business outcomes rather than simply delivering projects.
* Building strong relationships with Commercial, finance and Global stakeholders.
* Influencing business decisions through product expertise and data-driven recommendations.
* Driving high standards of execution and accountability across vendor partners.
* Demonstrating ownership, resilience and proactive decision-making.
* Delivering measurable improvements in business adoption, user experience and operational efficiency.
* Bringing external best practices and innovation into the product roadmap.

Best suited for someone who
  
  

* Leads the initiative and drives change
* Has ability to inspire confidence among the Business Users
* Can build & maintain relationship with internal & external stakeholders
* Is technically savvy
* Is analytically oriented and great at problem solving
* Will require travel upto 10% in a month"

  
  
**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

title: Manager - Card Portfolio Optimization Consulting, VCA X
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Summary
  
  
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates as one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery.
  
  
**Purpose**

* Primary focus: Own and drive portfolio strategy — lifting acquisition, activation, engagement, and incremental spend across credit and debit card portfolios.
* Core expertise: Cards portfolio optimization strategy, customer lifecycle management (CLM), and campaign management (design, targeting), with strong familiarity with payments industry rules and card-network/regulatory guidelines.

**Responsibilities**
Portfolio Strategy and Performance
  
  

* Develop and refine end-to-end strategies to improve KPIs: acquisition, activation, usage, spend per active, retention, cross-/up-sell, attrition reduction, credit losses, and ROI.
* Diagnose performance drivers and recommend segment-level interventions by lifecycle stage.

Customer Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Design journeys for onboarding, early engagement, habituation, maturation, retention/win-back; define treatments and test plans (A/B and multivariate).
* Identify friction points and opportunities to accelerate first-use, repeat use, and long-term engagement across digital and partner/merchant channels.

Campaign Strategy, Design, and Execution
  
  

* Translate portfolio objectives into campaign strategies: offer constructs, eligibility, targeting rules, suppression logic, and measurement frameworks.

Insights, Analytics, and Forecasting
  
  

* Drive analytics that size opportunities and forecast impact (propensity, uplift, CLV, attrition, spend elasticities); own a disciplined test-and-learn roadmap.
* Craft clear documentation and executive-ready presentations that turn findings into decisions for senior stakeholders.

Thought Leadership and Team Contribution
  
  

* Track market trends (rewards, interchange, merchant offers, embedded finance, tokenization, BNPL, digital wallets) and turn them into portfolio interventions.
* Build the playbooks, benchmarks, and frameworks that become the reference standard for portfolio optimization across every market — not a one-off deliverable, but the thing other markets build on.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 6-8 years in cards/payments, banking, or consulting with hands-on ownership of cards portfolio optimization, lifecycle programs, and campaign management.
* Experience with offer optimization, rewards strategy, merchant-funded offers, and partnerships.
* Familiarity with credit risk fundamentals (underwriting policy, line management) and their interaction with spend growth strategies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, banking, financial services, consulting, or another data-intensive industry.
* Experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, prompt-based systems, or AI-assisted analytics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to craft executive-ready presentations and translate complex analytics into clear business decisions.
* Strong project management; ability to run multiple initiatives, set priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with disciplined documentation.
* Define the methodology, don't just execute one — thrive in a delivery model where the standard for this capability area is still being built, and where your judgment sets it.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Quick Commerce Manager
description:
We are looking for a Quick Commerce Manager to own and scale our presence on quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BB Now, etc.).

This role sits at the intersection of growth, operations, and execution, driving GMV, availability, visibility, and profitability across Q-commerce channels while ensuring

seamless coordination with platform teams, HM supply teams, and channel partners for operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Platform s Account Management**

·       Own end-to-end performance across quick commerce platforms

·       Manage platform accounts, business planning, and overall account health

·       Act as the primary point of contact with platform category, ops, and growth teams

·       Manage onboarding, expansion, and day-to-day execution across dark stores

·       Ensure appointments and review meetings with HM teams and channel teams are scheduled and completed on time

·       Coordinate closely with HM supply teams to ensure appointment dates are planned and executed on an ASAP basis

·       Prepare and maintain account-wise business reports and PCL reports for management review

2. Growth s Revenue

·       Drive GMV growth through assortment expansion, pricing, and visibility levers

·       Plan and execute platform-led campaigns, app placements, and promos

·       Optimize ROAS and contribution margin for Q-commerce channels

·       Monitor account-level profitability and performance metrics

3. Assortment s Availability

·       Decide ideal Q-commerce assortment by city / dark store

·       Ensure high fill rates, in-stock %, and low cancellation rates

·       Work closely with supply chain and warehouse teams to forecast demand

·       Ensure GRN (Goods Receipt Note) processes happen on time to avoid operational delays

·       Monitor stock levels proactively and maintain healthy inventory availability across all dark stores

·       Ensure minimal to zero RTV (Return to Vendor) through efficient stock planning and execution

4. Pricing s Promotions

·       Manage platform pricing, discounts, and funding negotiations

·       Track promo performance and optimize for scale vs profitability

·       Monitor competitor pricing and platform benchmarks

5. Operations s Execution

·       Solve operational issues impacting SLA, delivery time, or customer experience

·       Track and improve key metrics: fill rate, OSA, cancellation %, refund %, ratings

·       Ensure compliance with platform SOPs and service levels

·       Drive strong coordination between operations, warehouse, supply chain, and platform teams for smooth execution

6. Data s Reporting

·       Own weekly/monthly business reviews with platforms

·       Analyze cohort-level and city-level performance

·       Identify insights and growth opportunities from platform data

·       Prepare MIS, account performance dashboards, and monthly PCL reports

·       Track revenue, margins, investments, claims, and profitability across accounts

Key Metrics You’ll Own

·       GMV C Revenue

·       Contribution Margin / ROAS

·       Fill Rate C In-Stock %

·       Cancellation C Refund Rates

·       App Visibility C Share of Shelf

·       GRN Timeliness

·       RTV Reduction C Inventory Health

·       Account-wise PCL Performance

title: Associate Director, Projects Pursuits
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Build and expand Emerson’s preferred or exclusive specification status across assigned GECs and product lines.
* Lead early engagement with engineering teams and stakeholders to influence specifications and project outcomes.
* Develop and execute structured account strategies, including playbooks, pipeline visibility, and opportunity mapping.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams to align pursuit strategies, share insights, and ensure consistent customer engagement.
* Guide commercial awareness by supporting frame agreements and tracking specification-to-order conversion performance.
* Design and deliver technical training programs to enhance customer engagement and support specification adoption.
* Lead, coach, and develop a geographically distributed team, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Maintain accurate CRM data, provide regular reporting, and use insights to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with stakeholders across multiple engineering and project functions.
* Develop and maintain a multi-level training plan per assigned Global Engineering Center, including awareness sessions, product application training, and advanced technical workshops; position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Review equivalent plans developed and maintained by the Project Pursuit Senior Managers.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account Managers and Global Strategic Accounts & Specification Managers to align pursuit strategies and deliver consistent stakeholder messaging for Global Engineering Centers.
* Share account intelligence, specification activity, and project pipeline updates with Global Strategic Account counterparts; support and oversee approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the Global Engineering Center level, serving as the in-country leadership interface between global programs and the national field team.

**Who You Are:**
You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives, while balancing multiple priorities to achieve results aligned with organizational goals. You proactively identify opportunities and take action to address challenges, using data and insights to guide decisions and continuously improve outcomes. You communicate effectively across diverse audiences, adapting your approach to influence and build trust, and you develop people through coaching, feedback, and creating opportunities that enable growth and performance.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 10 years of related experience required; 12+ years preferred.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams, EPC contractors, or owner-operators in industrial automation, instrumentation, or related fields.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical specifications, vendor qualification processes, or project outcomes.
* Experience leading or mentoring individuals or teams, with a focus on collaboration and development.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle from early design through procurement and execution.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and projects in a dynamic environment.
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) systems and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with global or strategic account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed to support customers and team collaboration (approximately 25–30%).

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience working with global or strategic accounts and collaborating across regions or functions.
* Background in managing distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to industries such as energy, oil and gas, chemicals, power, data centers, or similar sectors.
* Familiarity with engineering design or specification tools and platforms.
* Advanced education or professional development in business, engineering, or leadership (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience supervising team members located in diverse locations.
* Experience supporting or executing global Approved Vendor List qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Deal Manager - Assistant Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline - Clients and Industries, Pursuits & Commercial Excellence**
**Role Type - Deal Manager - Assistant Director**
**The opportunity**
The Deal Manager - Assistant Director partners with Engagement Teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits. They engage early and at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions, touchpoint campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development and orals preparation. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director provides support, advice and expertise to in all the stages of Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase
  
  
Deal Manager - Assistant Directors are expected to
  
  

* Manage execution of pursuit process, including critical path, timeline, and interdependencies
* Assess competitive situation and help develop differentiated win strategy focused on client priorities while protecting EY’s interests
* Develop power map and tactics to navigate client buying process
* Provide ‘glue’ to focus and guide extended pursuit team through structured sales approach and proposal development
* Collaborate with extended pursuit team define, package and articulate compelling client offer across scope, solution, price, and terms
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals.

Additionally, the Deal Manager - Assistant Director is required to identify, develop and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the Region.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management**

* Partner with Engagement Teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for Regional strategic, high-end opportunities
* Leads by example and advocates for gold standard pursuit practices
* In collaboration with other pursuit team members (e.g., Deal Leader, Engagement Partner, Client Partner), develops client-centric win themes that underpin the entire deal strategy. Ensures the win themes are reflected consistently throughout all client communications and deliverables.
* Suggests creative ideas that enhance our win strategy or ability to differentiate
* Manage and leads the development of opportunity value propositions
* Develop strategic messaging and lead conceptualization of all client-facing pursuit collateral
* Ensures all pursuit deliverables (e.g., meeting documents, proposals, presentations) are developed on schedule submitted on time and with the highest quality
* Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit
* Ensures deal infrastructure is established & maintained, including TEAMS site, calendar, action tracker, team roster, notebook, etc. with support from the Deal Coordinator as needed.
* Develops and maintains the pursuit plan/action tracker and calendar, making certain that all pursuit activities are assigned ownership, tracked and executed according to schedule.
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals
* Supports team strategic and/or operational initiatives to develop new or enhance existing best practices, tools, or enablers.
* Act as the central point of contact in managing the end-to-end process: evaluating requirements, organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines
* Serve as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions
* Shares lessons learned, best practices and innovation from pursuits and other experiences with teammates, the broader BD community, and the global firm as appropriate.
* Act as the knowledge steward for the pursuit
* Builds collaborative relationships with pursuit teams & senior client stakeholders,
* Lead post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement
* Maintain relationships with other Deal Activation teams and key interdependency groups across the organization Participate in relevant internal and external networks
* Facilitate internal deal governance process

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Champion CoE best-practice pursuit management tools and processes
* Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes
* Demonstrate versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles
* Influence / challenge the account team to optimize the chances of winning

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* Work with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others
* Provide coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other Deal Coordinators in P&CE.
* Support the onboarding and training of new hires in P&CE.
* Develop and coach Deal Coordinators, Client Executives and Client Servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training
* Oversee the work of the pursuit support team, including third-party resources (e.g. Deal Coordinator, external translation services, etc.)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines which are essential for a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Strong inter-personal skills
* Ability to analyze data and derive conclusions
* Excellent critical and strategic thinking
* Excellent project management and negotiation skills
* Self-motivated, resourceful & ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred)
* MBA (Marketing/International Business)

**Experience:**

* 12-15 years in Business Development of which minimum 5 years should be in Bid Management/Pre-Sales/Pursuit Management in professional services organizations
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Must have communications and proposal writing experience
* Experience in managing end to end managed services deals
* Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc.)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel - including occasional international travel - will be required

**Technologies and Tools**

* Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Partner seamlessly with Anaplan’s GTM Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain Enterprise Planning Applications into Anaplan’s GTM motion by:

Key Metrics

Qualifications

* **More than a decade of experience in Supply Chain Planning space**
* Demonstrable understanding of Anaplan’s platform and its applications to solve complex business challenges (Or similar EPM / Enterprise Planning / Supply & Demand Planning solutions in the market)
* **Deep domain knowledge of Supply & demand planning**
  , at strategic, operational and headcount levels, the market of Supply Chain focused - Enterprise performance management, planning and reporting solutions, required processes and best practices, and the key stakeholders and decision-makers.
* **Understanding of product management, enablement and GTM operations.**
* Proven experience in consultative selling or strategic advisory roles, preferably within SaaS or enterprise software, with the ability to ask the right questions, manage objections, and guide the sales journey from start to implementation and expansion.
* **Have background working in Manufacturing industry – preferable to have worked directly in a manufacturing company in the past before transitioning to SaaS or Enterprise Software organizations.**
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge-sharing skills, with a demonstrated exceptional ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.

title: Director - Product
description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rapacious growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 5% of India’s households shop with us.
  
  
As a Director in our team, you will collaborate with Developers, Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and Engineers. We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our PMs are driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigor to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for the right person to lead our talented bunch of Product Managers, Senior Product Managers and Product Analysts. As our Director, you will further act as a cross-functional leader. You will influence senior stakeholders across teams such as Engineering, Design, Category Management, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Own complex and impact product charters for Meesho
* Define a compelling product vision and strategy for your Org, and influence other functional leaders/teams
* Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved first and break them down into smaller chunks
* Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems
* Experiment with multiple ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximise product success
* Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously
* Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction
* Create a product roadmap that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of solutions to key customer/business problems
* Lead, mentor and coach a direct team of Product Managers and Product Analysts

**What You Will Need**

* 14+ years of work experience
* At least 10+ years experience in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet experience preferred)
* Experience in building and leading high performing teams
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on ‘first principles’ thinking
* Good understanding of technology
* Familiarity with product management processes such as A/B experimentation
* Experience of having managed a direct reporting team of product managers

title: Sr.Regional Business Manager (South) - Indian Region
description:
**SUMMARY**

The role as a Sr. Regional Business Manager is to manage the development of the region’s sales & distribution network and coordinate the sales efforts of the regional sales channels. The main responsibility is to ensure that the forecast is on target, the individual will be responsible for managing and owning to but not limited to order, revenue & margin aspects of the business for Accuray products and solutions. This includes the development of regional sales strategies adapted to the specific market situations and needs based on detailed market analysis. Leading cross functional team building efforts within the Region, in particular the coordination with the Service and Marketing Teams. The Regional Business Manager will work with the Senior Regional Business Director to develop specific sales plans to effectively win orders with new customers and new orders with existing customers and lead the sales process to successful customer acceptance and margin turnovers. The Individual must have a strong sales/commercial track record as individual contributor in medical devices & life Sciences domains.

The work location is in Remote-India preferably in Bangalore, Hyderabad & Chennai.

The role reports into the Senior Regional Business Director – India & Subcontinent.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for managing commercial and sales targets for the region mainly but not limited to new orders, revenue, margins, upgrades sales & market share aspects of the business. Contribute to timely renewal of service contracts in the assigned territory.
* The individual has to carry out business by accurately positioning Accuray’s products and portfolios in Private market, Strategic Accounts & Govt. accounts while maintaining high visibility in assigned geography to ultimately gain the market share.
* Assess individual markets and develop together with the Marketing, Service teams and Senior Regional Business Director, sales and marketing plans and strategies to achieve business goals with prospects and existing customers for new system sales.
* Develop relationships and build Accuray advocacy within the respective territory.
* Coordinate all regional sales activities to achieve the quarterly and yearly goals. Ability to forecast the business imperatives and maintain linearity of business on Quarter-to-Quarter basis.
* Develop reference centers for the region.
* Assist the sales channels in the preparation of high-level proposals and product/clinical features, advantages, and benefits (FAB) to medical physicists, oncologists, and key administrators.
* Participate in customer training programs, industry symposia and trade shows.
* Build and keep the funnel in SalesForce.com (Customer Relationship Management System) up to date in order to deliver a reliable forecast to the management.
* Ensure safety and quality considerations and requirements are proactively addressed and implemented in marketing & customer requirements.
* Follow the timeline for internal QA-related tasks, like Accuray University.
* Address and report in a timely fashion safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff.
* Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety & Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others
* Inform the Regional Business Director about the competitive landscape and advice for pricing strategies for the respective territory.
* Managing accolated quarterly budget for Travel, lodging & business expenses and accurately reporting of same.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor/Master’s degree in biomedical engineering or related field is required.
* Minimum 10 years professional sales experience of medical equipment with specific knowledge of the assigned territory is highly desired. Other related experience may also be considered.
* Familiarity and experience with oncology, radiotherapy, IMRT, Radiosurgery, Medical Physics, and other hospital/healthcare practices.
* Excellent level of English (read, written, spoken). Local language, Tamil, Telegu and Kannada will be an added advantage.
* Experience demonstrating strong written and verbal skills including an ability to present.
* Excellent customer relation skills, problem solving and stakeholder management in a matrixed organization.
* Experience with the use of standard office software programs including spreadsheet, word-processing, email applications and Power Point.
* Ability to be self-motivated and to work independently.
* Capability to work home based while keeping a high standard of motivation, professionalism, and ethic.
* Team worker and loyal team member
* Dynamic, proactive, and driven to high levels of accomplishment.
* Willingness to travel at least 60% of the time.

We offer attractive benefits package to the right candidates. Please send your resume with current and expected salary details and a cover letter quoting the job reference to jobs-asia@accuray.com

All information received will be kept strictly confidential and used for recruitment purposes only.

title: Business Head
description:
Technocitta IT Solutions is looking for an
**experienced and highly driven Business Head – Sales**
who can take complete ownership of our sales function and build the next phase of our revenue growth.

We are looking for someone who is not just a
**sales manager**
, but a
**business builder**
—someone who can create sales strategies, lead and develop the sales team, acquire new customers, grow existing accounts through
**cross-selling and upselling**
, build strong OEM relationships and consistently drive revenue and profitability.

The ideal candidate should come from the
**IT Infrastructure / System Integration / IT Hardware industry**
and have strong knowledge of enterprise technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales Strategy & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the company's overall sales and business development strategy.
* Create annual, quarterly and monthly revenue plans.
* Identify new markets, industries, customers and business opportunities.
* Build strategies to increase revenue, profitability and market share.
* Develop go-to-market strategies for different IT infrastructure solutions.
* Monitor competitors, market trends and emerging technologies.

**2. Lead & Manage the Sales Team**

* Lead, mentor and motivate the complete sales team.
* Set individual and team-wise targets.
* Monitor sales performance, pipeline and conversions.
* Conduct regular sales reviews and performance meetings.
* Build a performance-driven sales culture.
* Train the team on consultative and solution-based selling.
* Help salespeople convert opportunities into high-value deals.

**3. New Business Development**

* Drive acquisition of new enterprise and corporate customers.
* Develop relationships with CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, IT Heads, Procurement Heads and decision-makers.
* Personally participate in strategic customer meetings and large opportunities.
* Develop large enterprise accounts and strategic relationships.
* Build a strong and predictable sales pipeline.

**4. Cross-Selling & Upselling**

* Develop strategies to increase revenue from existing customers.
* Identify opportunities to sell multiple solutions to existing accounts.
* Build account-wise cross-sell and upsell plans.
* Convert transactional customers into long-term strategic accounts.
* Ensure customers are exposed to Technocitta's complete portfolio.

**5. IT Infrastructure Solution Sales**

The candidate should have good commercial and solution knowledge of:

* IT Hardware – Laptops, Desktops, Workstations & Peripherals
* Servers
* Storage Solutions
* Networking & Switching
* Wi-Fi / Wireless Solutions
* Firewall & Network Security
* Data Centre Solutions
* Audio & Video Solutions
* Backup & Disaster Recovery
* Cloud / SaaS solutions

The candidate does not need to be a deep technical engineer, but must be able to
**understand customer requirements, identify the right solution and lead the commercial sales process**
.

**6. OEM & Partner Management**

* Build strong relationships with OEMs, distributors and technology partners.
* Develop joint business plans with strategic OEMs.
* Explore OEM schemes, incentives, deal registrations and special pricing.
* Work with partners to generate new business opportunities.
* Ensure the sales team effectively utilises the company's OEM ecosystem.

**7. Sales Pipeline & Forecasting**

* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Establish proper opportunity qualification and sales processes.
* Review pipeline quality, ageing and conversion probability.
* Prepare accurate weekly/monthly/quarterly sales forecasts.
* Ensure CRM discipline across the sales team.
* Track opportunities from lead generation to closure.

**8. Large Deal & Commercial Management**

* Lead strategic and high-value opportunities.
* Participate in commercial negotiations.
* Ensure healthy margins while closing deals.
* Develop pricing and negotiation strategies.
* Work closely with pre-sales, procurement, finance and operations teams for successful deal closure.

**9. Customer & Account Management**

* Build long-term relationships with key customers.
* Develop strategic account plans for major customers.
* Increase customer retention and repeat business.
* Identify upcoming infrastructure requirements within existing accounts.
* Ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for expanding the relationship.

What We Are Looking For

**Mandatory:**

* Minimum
  **6 years of experience in IT Infrastructure / IT Hardware / System Integration Sales**
  .
* Strong experience in B2B / Enterprise Sales.
* Experience managing and leading a sales team.
* Strong understanding of IT Hardware and Infrastructure solutions.
* Proven track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Experience in new customer acquisition.
* Experience in cross-selling and upselling.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to interact with CXO-level and senior IT decision-makers.
* Strong commercial understanding and business acumen.

Candidates from
**IT Infrastructure companies, System Integrators, IT Solution Providers, OEMs, distributors or technology companies**
will be preferred. Current market roles similarly emphasize enterprise infrastructure knowledge, complete sales-cycle ownership, OEM/channel relationships and pipeline management.

Key Skills

**IT Infrastructure Sales | Enterprise Sales | B2B Sales | Sales Leadership | Business Development | Account Management | Cross-Selling | Upselling | IT Hardware | Networking | Servers | Storage | Data Centre | Audio Visual | Solution Selling | OEM Management | Channel Management | Negotiation | Pipeline Management | Revenue Growth**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Business Head will be directly responsible for:

* **Revenue Growth**
* **Gross Margin / Profitability**
* New Customer Acquisition
* Existing Account Growth
* Cross-Selling & Upselling
* Sales Team Performance
* Sales Pipeline Growth
* Conversion Ratio
* Forecast Accuracy
* Large Deal Closures
* Customer Retention
* OEM Business Growth

The Person We Are Looking For

We are
**not looking for someone who only manages sales reports**
.

We are looking for a person who can say:

**"Give me the sales team, portfolio and targets—I will build the strategy, create the pipeline, develop the team, win new customers, grow existing customers and take ownership of the revenue."**

The ideal candidate should be a
**hands-on sales leader, strategist and business developer**
who is comfortable personally getting involved in important deals while simultaneously building a high-performing sales team.

Why Join Technocitta?

* Opportunity to lead the complete sales function of a growing IT Infrastructure company.
* Exposure to multiple IT infrastructure technologies and OEMs.
* Opportunity to build and execute your own sales strategy.
* Direct visibility with the company's leadership.
* Significant opportunity to grow the business and your career.
* Performance-linked growth and incentives.
* Opportunity to build a strong enterprise customer portfolio.

Location

**Bengaluru, Karnataka**

Experience

**6+ Years in IT Infrastructure / IT Hardware / System Integration Sales**

Position

**Business Head – Sales**

**If you are passionate about building businesses, leading people and creating revenue—not just managing a sales pipeline—we would like to hear from you.**

title: Senior Manager Product Strategy - Footwear
description:
**About Us**
: Founded in 2016, is India’s largest fitness company and wellness platform. Cult, from the

house of Curefit, was established with a mission to make fitness easy, fun and accessible to everyone, and has emerged as a

community celebrating the joy of fitness. The brand today offers a range of fitness services ranging from group workouts, gyms

and personalized fitness solutions, as well as an expansive selection of quality fitness products for the everyday athlete. The

company’s vision is to empower everyone towards an active and healthier lifestyle through innovative fitness solutions,

enabled by technology.

**Job Summary**
: The Senior Manager – Product Strategy & Experience will lead product strategy and experience across the

footwear product lifecycle, from initial ideation and technical development to athlete testing, commercialization, and

post-launch optimization. The role requires deep expertise in technical footwear, consumer insights, market trends, and

product marketing to develop high-performing products that meet sales, sell-through, quality, and consumer expectations. The

position will serve as a key bridge between R&D, Design, Marketing, Sales, Creative, and other cross-functional teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

● Partner with R&D and Design teams during early-stage product creation to provide technical footwear expertise and

market-driven inputs for future product concepts.

● Drive fit, product, and elite athlete testing programs to gather performance feedback and identify opportunities for

product improvement.

● Lead sample reviews and internal buy sessions, providing structured and timely feedback aligned with product and

commercial objectives.

● Develop and execute Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies to support brand positioning, product launches, conversion, and

sell-through.

● Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, and Sales/Channel teams to translate technical footwear features into

compelling consumer-facing product stories.

● Develop accurate product copy, technical content, and story briefs to support launch campaigns.

● Monitor and analyze product ratings, consumer reviews, and post-launch field performance.

● Establish structured feedback loops with R&D and Design teams to drive continuous improvements in product quality,

fit, performance, and design.

● Support product lifecycle and program management activities to ensure successful execution across seasons.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

● Strong passion and expertise in sports/athletic footwear.

● Deep understanding of footwear construction, materials, fit, manufacturing processes, and technical product development.

● Proven experience in product strategy, program/project management, and product marketing within athletic, lifestyle,

or specialized footwear brands.

● Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams across R&D, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Creative

functions.

● Strong understanding of consumer insights, athlete feedback, market trends, and their application to product strategy.

● Advanced proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

● Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to provide precise technical feedback and present

product strategies to senior leadership.

● Strong analytical, strategic, and problem-solving capabilities with a commercial and consumer-focused mindset.
