A Senior Category Manager plays a crucial role by overseeing the strategic management and optimization of product categories. This D2C-focused role requires deep internal collaboration. You will partner with our internal Country Sport Teams, supply chain, and retail operations to bring our exclusive brands to life. This position requires a deep understanding of consumer behavior, market trends, and the competitive landscape to drive revenue growth and enhance customer experience within assigned product categories.You will also be a key driver of the 3P and Marketplace business through the category management overtime as the project and individual evolves subject to growth of both business and individual capacity.
  
  
**Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)**
As the business pilot for your category, your success will be measured by the following targets:
  
  

* Objective 1: Accelerate Category Growth & Profitability

○ Key Result: Achieve target E-Commerce Turnover & Turnover growth.
  
  
○ Key Result: Maintain strictly piloted P&L responsibility and Profitability margins.
  
  

* Objective 2: Drive Omni-Channel Customer Experience

○ Key Result: Increase the Conversion Rate on the mobile app and web platforms.
  
  
○ Key Result: Elevate overall category experience to meet target Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  
  

* Objective 3: Content & CX management & Assortment Metrics

○ Key Result: Improve CX and PDP experience for your customers/users for the category
  
  
○ Key Result: Successfully launch and scale new internal product lines with target sell-through rates.
  
  
**Job Location:**
Decathlon Anubhava, Bengaluru.
  
  
**Way Of Working:**
4 days a week form office and 1 day from home
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Business Piloting**

* Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies aligned with overall business goals, considering market trends, customer preferences, and competitive analysis.
* Lead proactive business planning and own the category online business case along with business finance and program teams.
* Execute PNL + Business Piloting to ensure sustainable category growth.

**Assortment & Product Lifecycle Management**

* Curate and manage product assortments within assigned categories, ensuring a balanced mix of products that meets customer demands and aligns with brand positioning closely working the sport teams.
* Monitor and optimize the entire product lifecycle, from pricing and promotions to inventory management.
* Set competitive commercial strategies, monitor commercial trends, and optimize margins to achieve revenue and profitability targets.

**Cross-Functional Leadership (D2C Focus)**

* Work closely with Country Sport Teams to optimize the offer, develop the commercial policy to address user needs, and successfully launch new products and promotions.
* Collaborate with the Sales Side and Marketing Team to plan and implement effective online marketing campaigns, search engine optimization (SEO), and SEM detailing.
* Work closely with the Country Customer Service Team to understand customer sentiments and address customer journey grievances.
* Work closely with the ecosystems of Logistics , Lastmile , Retail , Tech and Product to federate your sport growth vs the Platform growth.

**Performance Analysis & Market Research**

* Monitor and analyze website traffic, sales data, and customer behavior to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular market research and competitive analysis to understand industry trends, benchmark against competitors, and identify gaps or opportunities within the category.

**Qualifications**

* Cultural Fit : Be a sportsman at heart aligned to contributing to the purpose of the company and living the values and culture of the company on a daily basis. (NON NEGOTIABLE CRITERIA)
* Experience: 5 to 10 years of experience in category management, strictly within the D2C or ecommerce sector.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field; a Master's degree is preferred.
* Analytical Skills: Proficient analytical skills, with a strong ability in data analysis and market research to make data-driven decisions.
* Communication: Outstanding communication is essential to effectively manage stakeholder communication and articulate category strategies to senior management.
* D2C Acumen: In-depth knowledge of ecommerce platforms, Omni-retail operations, and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**Company Description**
BEACON AI is the world’s first Agent Engine Optimization (AEO) platform, built for a world where AI answers, rather than search results, drive brand discovery. The platform measures brand visibility across six major AI systems, providing a composite AI Visibility Score™ that shows how and where a brand appears in AI-driven recommendations. Each audit generates an agent.json file, a structured, machine-readable brand identity that helps AI platforms understand what a brand does and why it is a relevant answer. BEACON AI focuses on mention rate, rank position, sentiment, and cross-platform visibility gaps to help brands become the trusted signal that AI systems navigate toward. The company is positioned at the intersection of AI, marketing, and analytics for brands that want to lead the next decade of discovery.

**Role Description**
As a Co-Founder at Beacon AI, you will help define the company’s vision, strategy, and execution across product, go-to-market, and operations. You will work closely on customer discovery, refining the AEO value proposition, and shaping product features based on feedback from brands and agencies. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and managing key relationships, leading sales conversations with early customers, driving marketing experiments, and creating narratives that explain Agent Engine Optimization to the market. You will collaborate with technical and non-technical partners to prioritize the roadmap, analyze platform data, and identify growth opportunities. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area, requiring active presence with the founding team and local ecosystem.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills, including comfort with data, metrics, and experimentation to guide product and go-to-market decisions.
* Excellent communication skills for storytelling, stakeholder alignment, customer conversations, and clear internal collaboration.
* Demonstrated sales abilities, including prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing early-stage B2B or SaaS deals.
* Marketing experience in positioning, messaging, demand generation, or growth strategies, ideally in tech or AI-driven products.
* Research skills to explore market trends, customer needs, competitive landscapes, and evolving AI platforms.
* Experience in startups or early-stage companies, with a track record of building from zero-to-one and operating in ambiguous environments.
* Understanding of AI, data, or digital marketing ecosystems; familiarity with SEO or related fields is a strong plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical teams; prior experience partnering with product and engineering is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, marketing, or related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is valued.
* High ownership mindset, resilience, and readiness to contribute across multiple functions

Important Note: The role is equity ownership of 50:50 without salary. Product is pre-revenue. Once revenue starts we will start with salary. At this moment we are looking for partner ownership.

title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
  
  
  
  
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.

This is a high-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.

You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.

The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.

**What You'll Do**

• Own high-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
  
  
• Tackle ambiguous company-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.
  
  
• Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments.
  
  
• Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions.
  
  
• Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment.
  
  
• Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust.
  
  
• Develop executive and Board-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations.
  
  
• Bring an outside-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next.

**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

• 4-6+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in-house strategy experience;
**experience from a top-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred**
  
• Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems
  
  
• Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred
  
  
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations
  
  
• Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority
  
  
• Comfortable moving between high-level strategy and hands-on analysis
  
  
• Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity
  
  
• Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation

**Why This Role**

Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.

For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.

You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Director, Product
description:
**Company Introduction**
Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
  
  
Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a visionary, entrepreneurial product leader to identify, incubate, and scale new growth opportunities. The Director, Product - Emerging Solutions & Innovation will operate at the intersection of customer needs, data, artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, and platform innovation to create differentiated products and new sources of value.
  
  
This role is accountable for taking products from 0-to-1: discovering high-value problems, forming investment hypotheses, rapidly prototyping solutions, launching pilots, validating product-market fit, and transitioning successful concepts into scalable products and sustainable business lines.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership with a hands-on builder mindset. They must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making evidence-based investment decisions, and mobilizing cross-functional teams to convert emerging technologies and white-space opportunities into measurable customer and business outcomes.
  
  
**SUCCESS PROFILE**
A product innovator who has repeatedly transformed unproven ideas into validated, market-ready products through disciplined experimentation, rapid learning, and commercial execution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Innovation & Opportunity Development
* Identify and prioritize emerging customer needs, market shifts, technology trends, and white-space opportunities that align with enterprise strategy and growth objectives.
* Define compelling opportunity narratives, product theses, and value propositions grounded in customer evidence, market attractiveness, strategic fit, and differentiated advantage.
* Build investment cases that clearly articulate the problem, target customer, addressable opportunity, solution hypothesis, expected value, key assumptions, risks, and funding requirements.
* Maintain an innovation portfolio that balances near-term experiments with longer-term strategic bets, using clear criteria to start, continue, pivot, scale, or stop initiatives.
* Product Incubation and 0-to-1 Execution
* Own the complete incubation lifecycle from concept and discovery through prototype, MVP, pilot, product-market fit validation, commercialization, and scale transition.
* Translate ambiguous opportunities into structured discovery plans, testable hypotheses, learning agendas, and sequenced experiments.
* Apply Lean Startup, Design Thinking, and outcome-based product practices to accelerate learning while reducing investment and delivery risk.
* Establish stage-gate governance with evidence-based decisions, explicit exit criteria, and transparent recommendations for continued investment.
* Remain close to the work by shaping product concepts, reviewing prototypes, engaging design partners, interpreting pilot results, and resolving critical product trade-offs.
* AI, Data and Emerging Technology Products
* Define product strategies for AI-enabled, data-driven, analytics, automation, and platform capabilities that solve meaningful customer and business problems.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance teams to assess technical feasibility, data readiness, model performance, operational needs, and enterprise risk.
* Design data products with clear data sourcing, quality, interoperability, governance, insight delivery, and monetization considerations.
* Define AI product requirements beyond model accuracy, including workflow integration, explainability, human oversight, reliability, monitoring, adoption, and measurable business impact.
* Promote responsible AI practices by incorporating privacy, security, fairness, transparency, accountability, regulatory, and customer trust considerations throughout the product lifecycle.
* Rapid Prototyping, Experimentation and Pilots
* Champion rapid prototyping using modern design, low-code, AI-assisted, and engineering approaches to make ideas tangible and test assumptions quickly.
* Lead design sprints, customer co-creation sessions, proof-of-concepts, concierge tests, MVPs, and controlled pilots with clear learning objectives.
* Define success measures before each experiment, including customer desirability, usability, technical feasibility, operational viability, commercial potential, and strategic value.
* Build strong design-partner relationships and establish mechanisms to gather, synthesize, and act on qualitative and quantitative feedback.
* Create a high-learning-velocity environment where teams test critical assumptions early, share evidence transparently, and adapt direction rapidly.
* Commercialization and Scale
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, and Legal to define market positioning, target segments, pricing, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market plans.
* Develop adoption and growth models that connect product usage to customer outcomes, revenue potential, retention, efficiency, or strategic differentiation.
* Lead pilot-to-production decisions and create practical scale plans covering technology, operations, support, enablement, compliance, and financial sustainability.
* Guide successful incubated products through a disciplined transition to a scaled product organization while preserving strategic intent, customer insight, and outcome accountability.
* Monitor post-launch performance and continuously improve the product, proposition, and operating model based on evidence.
* Product Strategy, Portfolio and Outcome Management
* Set the vision, strategic narrative, objectives, and multi-quarter roadmap for the emerging product portfolio.
* Define north-star outcomes, leading indicators, guardrail metrics, and learning metrics for each initiative.
* Use customer data, product analytics, market intelligence, and financial evidence to prioritize opportunities and guide portfolio investment.
* Balance speed with quality and risk, making explicit trade-offs among customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, technical feasibility, and time to learning.
* Communicate portfolio health, evidence, risks, decisions, and recommended actions to executive stakeholders with clarity and candor.
* Cross-Functional and Executive Leadership
* Create shared direction across Product, Engineering, UX, Data, Architecture, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.
* Influence without relying on authority, resolve competing priorities, and secure the sponsorship, funding, talent, and operating support needed to advance promising opportunities.
* Act as the single-threaded product leader for incubation decisions and ensure accountability for outcomes across participating teams.
* Build trusted relationships with customers, partners, industry experts, and ecosystem participants to strengthen discovery and accelerate validation.
* Team Leadership and Product Craft
* Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for emerging products, fostering strategic thinking, customer obsession, commercial acumen, experimentation, and ownership.
* Build reusable incubation playbooks, templates, metrics, decision forums, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve innovation effectiveness across the organization.
* Create a culture that values evidence over opinion, progress over perfection, and learning over activity while maintaining high standards for product quality and ethical decision-making.
* Attract and retain diverse, high-performing talent capable of operating across strategy, discovery, technology, and commercialization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of progressive product management experience, including significant leadership responsibility for product strategy, discovery, delivery, and business outcomes.
* Demonstrated success creating and launching one or more 0-to-1 products, with direct ownership from opportunity identification through validation and commercialization.
* Experience developing data products, AI-enabled products, analytics solutions, intelligent automation, or technology platforms.
* Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, MVP development, customer pilots, design-partner programs, and iterative validation.
* Ability to translate uncertain opportunities into structured hypotheses, experiments, product decisions, and investment recommendations.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including business-case development, market sizing, pricing, packaging, monetization, and go-to-market planning.
* Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence senior executives, technical leaders, customers, and commercial stakeholders.
* Excellent written, verbal, storytelling, and executive communication skills, with the ability to make complex concepts clear and actionable.
* Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product management talent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical discipline; an MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification is strongly preferred.
* Experience in healthcare technology, enterprise SaaS, platform products, payer-provider workflows, interoperability, or regulated data environments.
* Experience working in a startup, corporate innovation lab, venture studio, emerging-products group, or another environment where teams created new products under uncertainty.
* Working knowledge of generative AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, data platforms, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and modern product development practices.
* Experience establishing governance and operating models for AI and data products, including privacy, security, model risk, and responsible AI considerations.
* Evidence of successfully stopping or pivoting low-potential initiatives based on learning, as well as scaling validated opportunities.

**Measures of Success**

* Quality and strategic relevance of the innovation pipeline and clarity of portfolio investment decisions.
* Speed from opportunity identification to prototype, pilot, validated learning, and market launch.
* Percentage of critical assumptions tested before significant investment and quality of stage-gate evidence.
* Pilot conversion, product adoption, customer value realization, revenue or efficiency impact, and progress toward product-market fit.
* Effectiveness of cross-functional alignment, executive decision-making, and transition of successful products into scalable ownership.
* Growth, engagement, and innovation capability of the product team.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**

* Establish a clear emerging-products strategy, opportunity thesis, prioritization model, and incubation operating cadence.
* Build a qualified portfolio of high-value AI, data, and platform opportunities supported by customer and market evidence.
* Advance priority concepts through rapid prototypes and design-partner validation, with explicit decisions to scale, pivot, or stop.
* Launch one or more pilots with defined learning goals, operational readiness, success metrics, and commercialization pathways.
* Create strong executive visibility into portfolio health, investment needs, risks, learning, and expected business value.
* Raise organizational capability in 0-to-1 product development through coaching, reusable practices, and disciplined experimentation.

**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

title: Director, Cardiac Market Development, Asia
description:
**Company Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
Intuitive Surgical is widely considered the most exciting medical device company in the world today. Surgeons worldwide are changing the way surgery is performed by utilizing our robotic surgical device, the
***da Vinci®***
Surgical System, to enhance their surgical precision and greatly improve patient benefits. The Clinical Sales Representative will help maximize the utilization of installed
***da Vinci®***
Surgical Systems.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director, Cardiac Market Development, Asia is an individual contributor role that supports the Cardiac Sales Directors in China, India, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan by translating global cardiac procedure and product strategies into market-ready plans, programs, and tools. This role also serves as the Asia-based implementation partner to the Vice President, Global Cardiac, helping bring key global programs, training processes, and global KOL development initiatives to life across Markets with different customer needs, operating models, and development stages.
  
  
Working closely with the Cardiac Sales Directors in each Market and the VP, Global Cardiac, this role localizes global programs and content, supports training and KOL development execution, tracks performance metrics, and improves quality and matrix efficiency. Commercial priorities and Market-level decisions remain with the Cardiac Sales Directors and Asia Market General Managers; this role is accountable for enabling and accelerating their execution.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
***Regional Procedure and Product Lifecycle Strategy***

* Support the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Global Cardiac in developing and executing cardiac procedure strategies using Market insights, customer needs, competitive dynamics, clinical pathways, and commercial priorities.
* Translate global portfolio, product launch, lifecycle, and procedure strategies into focused roadmaps, priorities, and activation plans.
* Coordinate with sales, clinical, capital, key accounts, customer training, marketing, market access, regulatory, and enabling functions to support readiness, sequencing, and execution.
* Identify adoption barriers, unmet needs, and growth opportunities and convert them into recommendations and action plans for the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Global Cardiac.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on Asia Market requirements, customer needs, evidence gaps, positioning, and future portfolio opportunities.

***Market Development and Marketing Localization***

* Localize cardiac marketing programs, value propositions, messaging, content, media, and field tools while maintaining brand, clinical, regulatory, and legal requirements.
* Develop integrated market development plans spanning segmentation, account activation, peer education, society engagement, digital channels, and stakeholder awareness.
* Enable teams to build sustainable programs with surgeons, care teams, hospital leaders, key opinion leaders, training centers, and reference sites.
* Ensure content and media plans are insight-led, audience-specific, reusable, and aligned to the customer journey and sales execution needs.
* Capture, codify, and scale effective practices and share Asia Market learnings with the VP, Global Cardiac, and other Global partners.

***Program Support, Metrics, and Operating Cadence***

* Support the operating rhythm for cardiac Market development and marketing, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, initiative tracking, and performance reporting.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for program effectiveness, adoption progress, launch readiness, content utilization, and return on investment.
* Create dashboards and decision forums that help leaders assess progress, resolve barriers, redirect low-value work, and scale successful programs.
* Support initiative portfolio tracking by clarifying owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Support budget planning, tracking, and forecasting for cardiac Market development and marketing programs, in partnership with the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Global Cardiac.

* Design scalable processes, standards, and ways of working that increase execution quality, speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Clarify interfaces and handoffs across Global, Regional, and local Market teams to reduce duplication, close gaps, and improve matrix efficiency.
* Establish quality controls for plans, programs, content, metrics, and launch deliverables, so work is compliant, decision-ready, and fit for use.
* Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving and remove barriers that limit field execution or customer impact.
* Contribute to a culture of disciplined experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement using data and field feedback.

***Partnership and Collaboration***

* Serve as a close working partner to the Cardiac Sales Directors in each Market on execution of growth priorities, programs, and training, with Market commercial decisions remaining with the Sales Directors and Asia Market General Managers.
* Partner with Market and Regional teams across China, India, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan to drive alignment through influence and collaboration rather than direct authority.
* Build regional learning loops that allow Market teams to adapt programs locally while scaling effective practices across Asia.

* Communicate progress, insights, and performance clearly to the Cardiac Sales Directors, VP, Global Cardiac, and Asia leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in medical devices, healthcare, or another complex regulated industry, including experience in sales, marketing, market development, or commercial operations.
* Demonstrated success translating global strategies into Market-specific commercial plans and measurable execution.
* Experience with procedure development, product launch and lifecycle management, customer segmentation, integrated marketing, and commercial planning.

* Proven ability to lead through influence across countries, functions, and organizational levels in a complex matrix.
* Advanced analytical capability, including defining metrics, leading operating reviews, interpreting results, and turning insights into decisions.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
We are specifically looking for a marketing professional with
**proven, hands-on experience in building and strengthening a brand**
—including
**brand positioning, brand messaging, brand identity, brand credibility, awareness, and market perception**
, preferably within a
**B2B / SaaS / Software Product environment**
.

The ideal candidate should have experience in
**taking ownership of how a company is perceived in the market and building a strong, credible, and differentiated brand presence.**

About the Company

We are a leading
**SaaS-based company specializing in Quality Management Software**
, empowering businesses globally to ensure compliance, streamline operations, and enhance food safety standards.

Our mission is to make a meaningful difference in the world by providing innovative solutions that drive
**safety, efficiency, compliance, and trust**
.

As we continue to expand globally, we are looking for a passionate Brand Marketing professional who can help shape how our company and products are
**positioned, perceived, and recognized in the market**
.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**dynamic and results-driven Brand Marketing Manager**
to join our team in Bangalore.

The primary objective of this role is to
**build, strengthen, and establish our brand in global markets**
—from defining how we communicate our value to building brand awareness, credibility, trust, and differentiation within our target markets.

You will work directly with the
**CEO based in Canada**
and collaborate with a team of marketing professionals to develop and execute initiatives aligned with the company's vision, positioning, and business objectives. This is a hands-on role for someone who can
**think strategically about the brand while also getting things done**
.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy & Brand Building

* Develop and execute brand marketing strategies to strengthen our brand presence across global markets.
* Build and continuously refine the company's
  **brand positioning, messaging, narrative, and value proposition**
  .
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the brand and establish a strong position within the market.
* Develop strategies to increase
  **brand awareness, recognition, credibility, and trust**
  among target audiences.
* Ensure consistent brand representation across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
* Translate the company's vision, mission, and product strengths into compelling brand stories and market-facing communication.
* Identify gaps in our current brand presence and take ownership of initiatives to strengthen them.

2. Market Research & Brand Insights

Required Skills & Qualifications

title: Manager - Branding
description:
**About The Team**
The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:
  
  

* User Growth: Scales the full lifecycle funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention. The User Growth team also houses Meesho’s branding pods, which shape how Bharat sees, trusts and keeps coming back to Meesho.
* Marketplace: Focuses on strengthening the seller ecosystem and improving selection quality to create a robust and reliable marketplace experience.
* Category: Identifies high-potential segments, launches and scales new categories, and drives assortment expansion to meet evolving customer demand.
* Mall: Builds a trusted branded destination for quality-conscious users, enhancing the platform’s premium and branded shopping experience.
* Pricing: Ensures competitiveness and affordability, enabling the platform to deliver strong value for customers while maintaining marketplace health.
* Content Commerce: Powers content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven shopping journeys that drive engagement, trust, and conversion.

Together, these verticals identify whitespace opportunities, launch and scale new initiatives, and continuously optimize the user lifecycle through data-backed decisions. Operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, the team combines structured problem-solving with rapid execution to deliver meaningful impact.
  
  
If you’re excited about building a brand that millions across Bharat love and return to, this role offers both strategic depth and hands-on impact.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Manager – Programs (Branding), you will anchor the branding pods within User Growth. You will own Meesho’s brand strategy end to end: understanding what holds users back and what brings them back, turning those insights into sharp brand briefs, and leading the campaigns that land them across TV, digital and influencers.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for a brand builder, not a documentation role. You will spend time with users first-hand, shape communication for India’s many consumer cohorts, and lead a team that delivers large, high-impact campaigns that move user growth and retention.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Consumer Understanding: Interact with users to understand the barriers that stop them from using Meesho and the triggers that bring them back, and synthesize these first-hand insights into clear, actionable direction.

* Brand Strategy & Briefs: Develop Meesho’s brand strategy and write brand briefs that translate consumer insight into a sharp proposition for creative and media partners.
* Communication Strategy: Define the communication strategy and channel mix across TV and mass media, digital, and influencers.
* Cohort-Led Messaging: Tailor communication and messaging for distinct user cohorts (South/North, urban/rural, female/male, etc.) so the brand resonates across Bharat.
* Campaign Ownership: Own large-scale campaigns end to end, from brief to launch to measurement, and track their impact on brand and business metrics.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with Product, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, and external creative, media and influencer agencies to deliver campaigns and secure buy-in from senior leadership.
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop the branding pod, set priorities, raise the creative and strategic bar, and remove roadblocks to execution.

**What You Will Need**

* Education: MBA from a top-tier institute (IIM, ISB or similar) with a subsequent move into branding, or a specialist branding background (e.g., MICA). Other strong MBA or brand profiles are welcome.

* Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in brand management or consumer marketing, preferably in FMCG or e-commerce.
* Hands-on Branding: Prior, direct branding experience is essential, including building brand strategy and briefs yourself.
* First-hand Consumer Understanding: Demonstrated experience of personally interacting with consumers, synthesizing insights, and translating them into a brand brief or campaign.
* Campaign Ownership: Direct ownership of significant campaigns across TV, digital and/or influencers, with at least one major career highlight and measurable impact.
* Communication: Excellent storytelling, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to generate buy-in from senior stakeholders and external partners.
* Leadership: Team management experience and the ability to advocate for user-driven decisions while thinking critically and executing tactically.

title: Growth & Revenue
description:
**Revenue and Growth Manager**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, commercially minded critical thinker to own the evolution of Kapiva’s digital store. This role is about understanding what the customer and business need today, what the ideal store should look like, and what needs to change to get there. You will work across Product, Tech, Marketing, Analytics, Creative and Business teams to identify opportunities, prioritise them and drive them to impact.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can connect customer behaviour, business

performance and digital experience — and turn insights into action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Store Ownership — #1 Priority**

● Own the overall quality, effectiveness and evolution of the D2C store experience.

● Ensure the customer journey is seamless, intuitive and commercially effective.

● Stay close to customer behaviour, funnel performance and store experience to identify gaps and friction.

● Proactively identify what is broken, what needs to improve and what the ideal store experience should look like.

● Balance immediate business needs with building a better long-term store experience.

**2. Growth Opportunities**

● Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve Conversion, AOV, Revenue and LTV.

● Use data, customer behaviour and business context to understand where the biggest opportunities lie and why.

● Develop and evaluate new ideas, experiments and experience improvements based on potential business impact.

● Ensure initiatives move from insight → prioritisation → execution → measurement → learning.

● Continuously challenge the status quo and look for ways to make the store more effective.

**3. Cross-functional Leadership**

● Work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, Analytics, Creative and Business teams to

turn priorities into outcomes.

● Create clarity on what needs to happen, why it matters and who needs to deliver it.

● Proactively identify dependencies, risks and gaps and ensure they are addressed.

● Drive initiatives through to closure and measurable impact, without things falling through the cracks.

**What We’re Looking For**

● Exceptional critical thinking and structured problem-solving.

● Strong commercial understanding of digital commerce and customer journeys.

● High ownership and a strong bias for action.

● Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.

● Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring clarity to complex problems.

● Strong customer-first mindset combined with business thinking.

● Data-driven, with the ability to translate insights into actions.

● Experience in D2C, e-commerce, digital product, growth or CRO is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

The person in this role should consistently be able to answer:

What is happening? Why is it happening? What matters most? What should

we do now? And what should the ideal state look like?

**Success means:**

● A seamless and continuously improving store experience.

● Clear identification and prioritization of the highest-impact growth opportunities.

● Faster conversion of insights into meaningful improvements.

● Strong cross-functional execution with clear ownership and closure.

● Measurable improvement in Conversion, AOV, Revenue and LTV.

title: Director, Business Growth & Strategy Leader
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
In this position, you will lead the Software Products Business Growth & Strategy organization, enabling HARMAN to compete in the pure software market. This is a global, multi-function leadership role with direct accountability across Business Strategy & Portfolio Management, Business Growth OPDM [Outbound Product Management] / Pre-Sales, Solution Management, Customer Success, Pursuit & Account Management, and Partner Strategy. This role will manage a team of senior functional leaders and a distributed organization responsible for influencing where HARMAN plays, how Software Products wins, and how revenue is created, protected, realized, and governed. Success requires a strategic, results-driven, and change-oriented leader with a strong industry perspective, disciplined decision-making governance, and the ability to connect across all levels of the company to drive outcomes.
  
  
This role is central to HARMAN’s transition from a hardware-led and hardware-plus-software model toward a software-first business capable of winning SDV, platform, lifecycle revenue, and recurring software opportunities. Success requires executive-level judgment, strong commercial and financial ownership, deep customer orientation, and the ability to influence Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Legal, CAMs, Automotive Strategy, and senior leadership around a single growth agenda.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Set the vision, operating agenda, and performance expectations for the Software Products Business Growth & Strategy organization, ensuring the function operates as one accountable growth engine rather than a collection of support activities.
* Lead senior functional leaders across Business Strategy & Portfolio Management, Business Growth OPDM [Outbound Product Management] / Pre-Sales, Technical Solution Management, Customer Success/Program Management, Pursuit & Account Management (from Discovery to Cash), and Strategic Partner Strategy.
* Set the software-first commercial agenda, translating the Software Products strategy into 5YP revenue, EBIT, pipeline, GTM, portfolio, partner, and investment plans.
* Foster a collaborative, values-led environment where depth of leadership enables teams to own the outcome, move as one, and apply collective intelligence to deliver exceptional customer and business outcomes.
* Own the business translation of Software Products strategy into multi-year revenue, EBIT, pipeline, portfolio, account, and GTM plans aligned with Intelligent Cockpit and Automotive priorities.
* Drive market intelligence, customer voice, competitive insight, segment prioritization, and go-to-market readiness, so product and investment decisions are anchored in where customers are moving and where HARMAN can win.
* Lead portfolio and investment steering with Product Management, Engineering, Finance, and Strategy, ensuring budget allocation, and resource decisions are tied to revenue potential, margin impact, market differentiation, and execution feasibility with KPI-driven dashboards that highlight value, risk, and actions needed to accelerate profitable growth.
* Responsible to deliver revenue realization according to growth trajectory targets across regions, through pursuit strategy, business development, battle plans, bid management, pipeline coverage, forecast quality, and executive-level deal escalation.
* Oversee solution management and pre-sales execution to ensure customer requirements, technical solutioning, drive high-quality RFX responses, pricing inputs, SOW scope, and solution commitments are commercially sound, technically credible, and aligned to product direction.
* Protect and expand existing revenues through account management and customer success discipline, including renewals, extensions, follow-on programs, account health, escalation management, customer feedback loops, and continuity of awarded business to ensure customer retention.
* Chair the decision-making KPI-oriented governance model for your organization, including executive business reviews, pipeline and pursuits governance, account continuity, strategy and portfolio investment forums, market insights, sales operations governance, and business case approval discipline.
* Represent Software Products voice in cross-BU executive forums and influence enterprise stakeholders to resolve structural barriers, secure resources, and ensure Software Products is set up for success.
* Collaborate with Sales Excellence, Global Customer Groups, Finance, and Business Development to embed Software Products into account planning, commercial governance, customer strategy, and growth execution across regions.
* Build an external and internal narrative that makes HARMAN credible as a software partner to OEMs, Tier 1s, technology partners, and internal business units, to enable alternate channels of revenue generation.
* Own business operations and sales operations rigor across forecasting, contract lifecycle, booking, invoicing, PO tracking, revenue support, business case quality, quote-to-cash transparency, and leadership reporting.
* Represent Software Products across Business Units and with strategic customers, partners, and executive stakeholders, aligning resources and removing barriers to accelerate credibility driving toward defined goals.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* 18+ years of progressive hands-on leadership experience across automotive software, connected vehicle, SDV, product strategy, business development, commercial operations, portfolio management, or enterprise software growth; experience with OEMs, Tier 1s, or major technology players strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior functional leaders and multi-disciplinary global teams, through transformation, ambiguity, organizational change, and high-stakes executive decision making.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Sales, CAMs, Business Development, SBU leadership, Sales Excellence, and enterprise strategy functions.
* Deep understanding of software business models, recurring revenue, licensing, services, platform economics, solution selling, commercial governance, and the shift from product-centric lifecycle value models.
* Strong financial acumen across revenue planning, EBIT, business cases, pricing, budget allocation, margin improvement, portfolio trade-offs, and investment governance.
* Experience leading complex customer-facing software pursuits, RFQ/RFX strategy, executive customer engagement, account expansion, renewals, contract continuity, and cross-functional deal governance.
* Ability to establish operating models, governance forums, KPI systems, dashboards, and management routines that improve decision quality, transparency, accountability, and execution speed.
* Strategic communication capability, including the ability to distill complex software, commercial, technical, and financial topics into crisp executive recommendations and decision papers.
* Bachelor's and/or master’s degree in engineering, Business, Strategy, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree is strongly preferred.

**Things To Know**

* Be willing to travel up to 50%, domestic/international travel and occasional trips into the Novi office location required.
* This role is based in Bengaluru, India and follows a hybrid schedule, with regular in-office collaboration alongside engineering, product, and customer program teams.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
  
  
**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
  
  
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

title: Associate Director - Field Marketing
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Some of our most valuable customer conversations begin in a room: a CISO dinner, a founder meetup, a practitioner roundtable. Your mission is to turn those conversations into a predictable, growing source of pipeline for Sprinto.
  
  
You’ll own our global field marketing strategy across the
**US, EMEA, and APAC**
, reaching startup and SMB founders as well as mid-market security, GRC, and IT leaders. You’ll decide where we show up, whom we bring together, and where every field dollar goes.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
Reporting to the
**Head of Marketing**
, you’ll sit on the Marketing leadership team and lead
**three regional field marketers**
covering US Mid-Market, APAC/EMEA Mid-Market, and Startup/SMB programs. You’ll also own
**GRC Hub**
and
**Secure Circle**
, our CISO peer group, and bring field programs into our broader ABM motion.
  
  
This is a
**player-coach role**
. You’ll build the strategy, systems, and team while staying close to execution, whether that means hosting an executive dinner, testing a new market, or working with Sales on an account-specific experience.
  
  
  

* Own the global field strategy and pipeline. Build annual and quarterly plans across the US, EMEA, and APAC, aligned with regional sales priorities. Own sourced and influenced pipeline, budgets, and ROI, using program reviews within 30 days to decide what to scale, improve, or stop.
* Build programs that move buyers forward. Run conferences, executive dinners, roundtables, and partner-led experiences. Align with Sales and SDRs on target accounts, meeting goals, outreach, follow-up, and nurture, and embed account-specific field plays into our ABM motion.
* Grow communities and executive relationships. Own GRC Hub and Secure Circle, creating programming that builds membership, engagement, and pipeline. Bring the right buyers into the room and turn members into speakers, hosts, and advocates.
* Lead the team and build repeatable systems. Coach three regional field marketers, own hiring and headcount planning, and build reusable playbooks for execution and reporting. Manage vendors and agencies, and partner with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Finance to keep programs consistent and well-run.
* Experiment and turn learning into action. Test new markets, formats, gifting, and activations with clear hypotheses and budget caps. Use AI to improve research, targeting, content, and reporting, and turn successful experiments into programs the team can repeat.

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* You’ve built and led field marketing teams. You bring 8–12 years in B2B marketing, including 5+ in SaaS field or regional marketing and 3+ managing field marketers, ideally across regions.
* You can connect programs to commercial outcomes. You’ve owned multi-region budgets and pipeline targets, can demonstrate program ROI, and are comfortable building your own analysis in HubSpot.
* You understand different markets and buyers. You’ve run programs in at least two of the US, UK/Europe, Middle East, or India/APAC, reaching startup/SMB buyers and mid-market or enterprise security, IT, or GRC leaders.
* You bring people together around execution. You build strong partnerships with Sales, SDRs, and Partners, and are equally comfortable hosting senior executives, presenting to leadership, and getting into event details.
* You build, learn, and adapt. You move quickly through ambiguity, use evidence to prioritise, and turn lessons into practical playbooks. You stay close to execution while helping your team grow.

**You’ll bring additional perspective if**
you’ve worked in cybersecurity, compliance, or GRC; built a practitioner community or executive peer group; designed account-level field programs; or helped a Series B+ company turn founder-led initiatives into a repeatable field motion.
  
  
*If you’ve built field programs that created meaningful buyer relationships, measurable pipeline, and a stronger playbook for the next round, we’d love to hear how you did it.*
**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**

YadaSutra Ayurveda is a doctor-led Indian Ayurvedic mother and baby care D2C brand of Neerozhukkil Vaidyasala Pvt. Ltd. (NVPL), built on over 100 years of traditional Ayurvedic legacy. The company focuses on pregnancy care, postpartum wellness, baby care, and Ayurvedic personal care products that combine authentic formulations with modern quality standards. Built for contemporary mothers, YadaSutra blends clinical Ayurvedic expertise, trusted ingredients, and community-led care to support women and babies through every stage of motherhood. Products are available through www.yadasutra.com and leading marketplaces. YadaSutra's vision is to become India's most trusted Ayurveda brand for mother and baby care.

**Role Description**

The E-commerce Marketing Manager – D2C Growth & Team Leadership is a full-time, permanent role based in Bangalore, with an initial 3-month allocation at the Cochin head office. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will run YadaSutra's online store as a business, lead the marketing team behind it, and take ownership of marketing-led revenue.

The role covers the full e-commerce growth engine, from catalogue and conversion to campaigns and customer retention. You will manage the Shopify store (products, collections, landing pages, offers, apps and analytics), keep the catalogue accurate and high quality, and plan inventory with the operations team so bestsellers stay available and slow movers are cleared with the right offers. You will track margins by product and category and guide pricing, discounts and bundles to protect profitability.

You will improve conversion rate, average order value and the full customer journey through A/B tests on landing pages, product pages, offers and checkout, and work with CRM and retention channels such as WhatsApp, email and SMS to drive repeat purchase and lifetime value. You will build marketing strategies and campaign calendars, plan launches and seasonal campaigns, and coordinate performance marketers or agencies, content creators, scriptwriters, video editors and UGC contributors so that media, creative and the store work together. You will guide UGC concepts, ad scripts and creative direction, and build a library of tested creatives and learnings.

As a team leader, you will set targets, delegate responsibilities, run weekly planning and review meetings, coach team members, support hiring, and define KRAs and KPIs with HR. You will track CAC, ROAS, conversion rates and revenue, prepare weekly and monthly reports with clear insights and next actions, and work with finance and management on budgets and the profit impact of marketing decisions. You will also protect the YadaSutra brand voice and visual identity, and make sure all product pages, ads and content follow applicable regulations for Ayurvedic, baby and personal care products and platform policies, avoiding unverifiable health claims and getting messaging approved by the medical team where needed.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience working directly in D2C brands, ideally in beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness, or mother and baby care.
* Strong hands-on Shopify skills, including products, collections, landing pages, offers, apps and analytics.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a marketing team, including setting targets, delegating, reviewing quality and managing deadlines.
* Strong understanding of D2C e-commerce, including catalogue development, category management, inventory planning and margins.
* Working knowledge of Meta and Google ads, GA4 and D2C unit economics (CAC, LTV, AOV).
* Good understanding of UGC, short-form video, scripting and campaign storytelling.
* Experience with CRM and retention tools (WhatsApp, email, SMS) and with managing agencies or freelancers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ownership of results and clear communication.
* Fluency in English; knowledge of Malayalam is an advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA preferred).

title: Marketing Executive
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Marketing Executive to join our Bengaluru team. The ideal candidate will assist the marketing team in developing and executing marketing campaigns, performing day-to-day administrative tasks, and conducting essential research to support the company’s growth initiatives. This fast-paced role is perfect for someone who is passionate about marketing, enjoys multitasking, and can seamlessly blend traditional lead generation with advanced IT-focused strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

-Conduct in-depth market research to identify trends, competitor activities, and potential market opportunities.

-Stay informed about industry trends and market conditions to identify new lead generation opportunities.

-Assist in the coordination and execution of marketing projects, multi-channel campaigns, demand generation and enterprise events.

-Execute Account-Based Marketing (ABM), email marketing and social media campaigns.

-Assist in driving Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies and partner engagement.

-Track and report on lead generation activities, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvements.

-Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to align lead generation strategies with company goals and ongoing campaigns.

**Requirements**

-Master's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

-2-3 years of experience in marketing or a related role, preferably within the IT industry.

-Familiarity with modern marketing tools and software, including social media platforms, CRM systems, and productivity softwares.

-Proficient in tracking lead generation metrics and reporting.

-Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build relationships with potential stakeholders.

-Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.

-Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**Description**
**About This Role**
We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help define how our products are positioned, launched, and adopted in the market. This role sits at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing, with a clear focus on translating customer and market insights into effective go-to-market execution.You'll work closely with cross-functional partners to shape messaging, enable sales teams, and support revenue growth across the product lifecycle. This is an execution-heavy role suited for someone who is comfortable working with data, customers, and internal stakeholders in a fast-moving SaaS environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Customer & Market Insights**

* Engage with customers and prospects to gather qualitative and quantitative insights.
* Translate customer needs and feedback into clear positioning and messaging inputs.
* Analyze the competitive landscape to identify gaps, opportunities, and differentiation.

**Go-to-Market & Positioning**

* Define and execute go-to-market strategies aligned with business priorities.
* Shape product positioning and narratives that support adoption and growth.
* Partner with product and marketing teams to support product launches and feature rollouts.

**Sales Enablement**

* Build sales playbooks, enablement materials, and core marketing assets.
* Partner with sales teams to refine messaging, positioning, and outreach approaches.
* Support sales teams with clear, usable materials that improve effectiveness in-market.

**Demand & Growth Support**

* Collaborate with marketing teams on demand generation and growth initiatives.
* Support optimization of conversion funnels and lead acquisition efforts.
* Ensure messaging consistency across campaigns and channels.

**Measurement & Optimization**

* Use analytics tools to measure the impact of marketing and GTM initiatives.
* Monitor performance and identify areas to improve effectiveness and efficiency.
* Apply insights to refine strategies and execution over time.

title: Marketing Analyst
description:
We are looking for a hands-on and data-driven Marketing / Product Analyst who can convert marketing, product, and customer data into actionable business insights.
  
  
You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Business teams to analyse acquisition channels, campaign performance, user behaviour, conversion funnels, engagement, retention, and revenue. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, solving ambiguous problems, and taking ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyse the complete customer journey, from lead generation and acquisition to engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue.
* Track and analyse marketing performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, organic, social, referral, and other acquisition channels.
* Monitor key marketing metrics, including impressions, clicks, CPL, CAC, conversion rates, ROAS, ROI, and lead quality.
* Use Google Analytics to understand website traffic, user behaviour, traffic sources, landing-page performance, and conversion events.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Looker Studio and Metabase.
* Analyse product and marketing funnels to identify drop-offs, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct customer segmentation, cohort, retention, and behavioural analyses.
* Partner with Marketing and Product teams to define metrics and measure the impact of campaigns, product changes, and experiments.
* Support A/B testing by defining success metrics, analysing results, and recommending next steps.
* Extract, organise, and analyse data from AWS-based data sources and internal systems.
* Create trackers, reports, and lightweight analytical models using Google Sheets.
* Automate recurring reports and reduce dependency on manual data extraction.
* Validate data accuracy and investigate inconsistencies across dashboards, advertising platforms, and internal reports.
* Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations for business stakeholders.
* Proactively identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing analytics, product analytics, growth analytics, business analytics, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports using Looker Studio and Metabase.
* Experience working with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Analytics data.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning, and reporting.
* Exposure to extracting or analysing data hosted on AWS.
* Good understanding of marketing funnels, product funnels, customer journeys, and conversion metrics.
* Understanding of metrics such as CPL, CAC, ROAS, ROI, conversion rate, retention, engagement, and lifetime value.
* Ability to work with large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities and ambiguous business problems.
* High ownership, agility, curiosity, and bias for action.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with product analytics or engagement tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, MoEngage, or CleverTap.
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data analysis and automation.
* Experience with campaign attribution, cohort analysis, experimentation, and A/B testing.
* Familiarity with AWS services such as Redshift, Athena, S3, or QuickSight.
* Prior experience in an EdTech, consumer internet, SaaS, e-commerce, or high-growth startup.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Marketing and Product teams have reliable visibility into their key metrics.
* Campaign, channel, and product decisions are supported by data rather than assumptions.
* Funnel leakages and growth opportunities are identified proactively.
* Dashboards and reports are accurate, automated, and easy for stakeholders to use.
* Insights lead to measurable improvements in acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, or revenue.

title: Lead Analyst, Database Marketing
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Marketing Database Management professional to own and evolve the organization's marketing data foundation. The role will be responsible for ensuring that Marketing has access to a trusted, accurate, complete, compliant and business-ready database that can support demand generation, account-based marketing, personalization, campaign execution, lead management, analytics and AI-driven marketing.
  
  
The ideal candidate would own the quality, governance, growth, enrichment and usability of the marketing database, while partnering closely with MarTech, Campaigns, Sales/SDR, Analytics, IT and Enterprise Systems. The person will be expected to establish a scalable data management framework, identify and eliminate data quality issues, improve the marketable database, automate repetitive data processes and help build the data foundation required for advanced analytics and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Marketing Database Strategy
* Own the Marketing database strategy, health and roadmap
* Define and maintain standards for account, contact, lead and prospect data
* Drive database growth, coverage and marketable database development
* Establish database health and quality scorecards
* Data Quality & Enrichment
* Own data cleansing, deduplication, normalization and validation
* Develop data enrichment and augmentation strategies
* Improve accuracy, completeness, freshness and usability of Marketing data
* Establish processes to prevent bad data from entering the database
* Data Governance & Compliance
* Define data ownership, governance, taxonomy and data standards
* Manage consent, suppression and data retention requirements
* Partner with Enterprise Systems, Security and Legal on data governance and compliance
* Segmentation & Data Activation
* Develop audience segmentation frameworks for campaigns, ABM, personalization and nurture
* Partner with Campaign, Email and Lead Management teams to ensure audiences are accurate and activation-ready
* Improve target-account and persona coverage
* MarTech & Data Integration
* Partner with the MarTech team to ensure reliable data flows across CRM, Marketing Automation, enrichment, web, SDR and analytics platforms
* Identify data integration gaps, synchronization issues and data leakage
* Support requirements for the future Marketing Data Lake / data foundation
* Automation & AI
* Identify opportunities to automate data cleansing, enrichment, validation, segmentation and quality monitoring
* Explore AI-enabled approaches for entity matching, classification, enrichment and anomaly detection
* Continuously reduce manual database management effort

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Database Management, Marketing Operations, CRM Data, Revenue Operations or a related field
* Strong experience managing complex B2B databases
* Excellent understanding of CRM and Marketing Automation data models
* Experience with platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, ZoomInfo or equivalent data/enrichment platforms
* Knowledge of data governance, segmentation, enrichment, deduplication and consent management
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data warehouses/lakes and BI tools is desirable
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Marketing, Sales, IT/Data and Enterprise Systems
* Analytical, process-oriented and highly detail-oriented
