* Optimize content to rank on Google and appear in AI search results. Own inbound and AEO, including schema, website structure, and making content accessible to search engines and AI crawlers
* Build and maintain a backlink and digital PR strategy to strengthen domain authority
* Run experiments on content performance, headlines, CTAs, and formats, and iterate based on conversion data rather than traffic alone
* Set up and maintain dashboards (Looker Studio, GA4, GSC) that give a single view of content performance across the full funnel

**2. Trial Lifecycle and Activation**

* Define what trial success looks like: set activation milestones, instrument the funnel, and report on conversion performance weekly
* Map the trial journey from signup through first pipeline to the aha moment and conversion, and identify where intent drops
* Design and run lifecycle communications: onboarding email sequences, in-app nudges, and re-engagement flows tied to behavioral triggers
* Act as the internal voice of the trial user in product, GTM, and leadership conversations

**3. Conversion Rate Optimization**

* Synthesize behavioral data (session recordings, funnel drop-off, in-app events) into structured conversion hypotheses with clear success metrics
* Design and execute CRO across onboarding flows, high-intent landing pages, and trial touchpoints, with documented methodology and learnings
* Partner with Design on landing page variants for use-case pages, competitor comparison pages, and ICP-segment pages. You define the hypothesis and copy, Design executes
* Maintain a rigorous experiment log: hypothesis, variant rationale, statistical methodology, results, and learnings

**4. Product and GTM Partnership**

* Surface structured, prioritized insights from organic visitors and trial users into the roadmap process weekly
* Build technically credible collateral: setup walkthroughs, migration guides, and competitive comparison assets written for data practitioners, not buyers
* Create and maintain a weekly product-to-GTM feedback brief synthesizing signals from content performance, trials, support tickets, and deal reviews
* Support competitive displacement motions with content and push customers toward a switch decision

**What You Need to Bring**

**Non-Negotiable**

* 5–8 years across Inbound, or PLG at a B2B SaaS company, preferably selling to technical buyers, with direct ownership of organic performance or a self-serve conversion program and measurable outcomes
* Strong writing and editing skills. Comfortable across thought leadership, technical content, and competitor comparison pages
* Hands-on data background, or close enough experience alongside a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist to write for that audience without translation
* Working understanding of PLG mechanics: activation frameworks, aha-moment design, in-product lifecycle marketing, and trial funnel instrumentation
* Behavioral analytics skills: Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog for funnel and activation tracking, plus Hotjar or FullStory for session analysis
* Experimentation discipline across both content and product surfaces: A/B tests run with proper statistical methodology, not just a headline swap
* Experience building dashboards or reports that connect content, SEO, and lifecycle metrics to pipeline and business outcomes

**Strong Advantage**

* Experience improving visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, and Gemini
* Familiarity with ELT, data pipelines, or other technical products in a fast-growing startup environment
* Familiarity with PLG tools: in-app messaging (Appcues, Pendo, or equivalent), lifecycle email (Customer.io, Braze), and interactive demos (Arcade, Navattic, Storylane)
* Experience with competitive displacement content at the trial stage
* Basic HTML/CSS comfort to push copy or CTA edits without filing a ticket

**What Good Looks Like at 6 Months**

**Milestone**

**30 Days**

* Organic content audit and trial funnel audit both complete. Activation milestones defined. Editorial calendar live. First lifecycle experiment shipped.

**90 Days**

* Organic traffic and AI visibility trending up against baseline. 5+ CRO or lifecycle experiments shipped with documented outcomes. Onboarding email sequence live and instrumented.

**180 Days**

* Measurable improvement in organic pipeline contribution and trial-to-paid conversion.
* Competitive trial-stage and comparison content covering top displacement scenarios.
* Lifecycle and content experimentation embedded in sprint cycles.

**This Role Is Not for You If**

* You have only done content marketing or demand gen and have never owned a self-serve conversion funnel with measurable outcomes
* You need a separate analyst to tell you where the funnel is breaking before you can act
* You have never written for a technical audience and are relying on learning it on the job
* You treat content and lifecycle marketing as calendars to fill rather than systems that respond to data

title: General Manager / Category Lead_Bambinos.live
description:
We’re Hiring: General Manager / Category Lead | Bambinos.live

**Build a $10M Business. Own a Category. Think Like a Founder.**

At
**Bambinos.live**
, we’re looking for high-ownership, AI-first leaders to build and scale our business verticals into category-leading, profitable businesses.

This isn’t a traditional management role. You’ll own an entire business vertical end to end — from P&L and growth to product, customer experience, sales and educator operations — with a bold mission:
**scale your vertical to $10 million ARR within 24 months.**

If you’re a builder who loves solving problems, working with data, moving fast and using AI to multiply your impact, this could be your next big opportunity.

**About Bambinos.live**

Bambinos.live is a Shark Tank India Season 4-backed live learning platform for children 4–15.

We serve 8,000+ students across India, the Middle East, and the US, with approximately 40% of our buyers being NRI families.

Our vision is to become the
**“Disney of Education”**
by building story-driven, gamified and immersive learning experiences delivered live by expert educators.

The Opportunity

**Role:**
General Manager / Category Lead

**Openings:**
4 — one for each business vertical

**Location:**
Bengaluru, HSR Layout | Work from Office

**Experience:**
2–5 years

**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. from IIT or BITS, or MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore or Calcutta, or ISB

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Competitive salary + ESOPs

Choose Your Vertical

We’re hiring one business owner for each of the following categories:

* **Languages:**
  Unbox English, Unbox Kannada, Hindi for NRI Kids
* **Spirituality:**
  Little Yogi, Bhagavad Geeta
* **Academics:**
  Unbox Math, Unbox Science, Olympiad Preparation
* **Extra-curricular:**
  Unbox Chess, AI for Kids

Each Category Lead will own the roadmap, economics and growth of their vertical, including launching new programs that address evolving customer needs.

What You’ll Own

**1. Business Strategy & P&L**

* Own revenue, gross margin and contribution margin for your vertical.
* Build annual and quarterly business plans covering targets, budgets, pricing and program mix.
* Track unit economics, including CAC, LTV, payback periods and educator cost per class.
* Make data-backed decisions on where to scale, optimise or discontinue initiatives.

**2. Growth & Revenue**

* Drive enrolments across India, the Middle East, the US and other international markets.
* Own the complete funnel: leads → demos → conversions → renewals.
* Partner with marketing on campaigns, content, channels and strategic partnerships.
* Build new revenue streams through schools, B2B partnerships, camps, workshops and program bundles.

**3. Product & Curriculum**

* Own the product roadmap across your vertical's programs.
* Translate parent and child insights into better learning experiences, formats and pricing.
* Take new programs from concept to launch, targeting the first 100 paying students.
* Partner with curriculum and product teams to improve learning outcomes and make progress measurable.

**4. Customer Experience & Retention**

* Own the complete parent and child journey, from demo and onboarding to learning progress and renewal.
* Improve parent NPS, attendance, completion and renewal rates.
* Identify churn drivers and close the loop on escalations, refunds and customer feedback.

**5. Sales & Conversion**

* Work closely with inside sales to sharpen pitches, scripts, objection handling and pricing.
* Establish and review conversion targets for your vertical.
* Equip counsellors with strong program knowledge and effective sales enablement.

**6. Educator Operations & Team Building**

* Build a high-quality educator pipeline ahead of business demand.
* Own educator onboarding, training, quality standards and performance management.
* Optimise capacity, scheduling and utilisation to ensure a consistent learning experience.
* Build and lead a lean, high-performing core team as the vertical scales.

AI-First Is How We Work

At Bambinos.live, AI is not an add-on. It is our default operating system.

We expect our Category Leads to build lean, efficient businesses where AI handles repetitive work and people focus on judgement, creativity and execution.

You will be expected to:

* Use ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools daily for research, analysis, planning and decision-making.
* Build AI-powered workflows for curriculum drafts, assessments, presentations and content quality checks.
* Automate reporting and dashboards, using tools such as Metabase, SQL and BI platforms.
* Apply AI to sales enablement, lead scoring, parent communication and churn prediction.
* Use AI to improve educator screening, training, feedback and quality assurance at scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to introduce AI learning experiences.

**Our default question: “Can AI do 80% of this?”**

We’re looking for people who demonstrate AI leverage through their work, not just those who list AI tools on their resumes.

How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be reviewed monthly, with quarterly goals aligned directly with the Founder & CEO.

Key measures include:

* **Business:**
  Progress towards $10M ARR, contribution margin and path to profitability.
* **Growth:**
  New enrolments, conversion rates and customer acquisition cost.
* **Retention:**
  Renewal rates, customer lifetime value and churn.
* **Customer experience:**
  Parent NPS, attendance and program completion.
* **Product:**
  New program launches and measurable learning outcomes.
* **Educator operations:**
  Quality, retention and utilisation.
* **AI leverage:**
  Revenue per team member, productivity and meaningful automation.

Your First 90 Days

In your first three months, you will:

* Develop a deep understanding of your vertical's customers, business metrics and unit economics.
* Present a clear 24-month roadmap towards $10M ARR.
* Deliver two measurable quick wins in conversion, retention or operational efficiency.
* Establish an AI-driven weekly business review and performance dashboard.

Who Should Apply?

**Must-have qualifications:**

* 2–5 years of experience in a high-ownership role, such as a founder's office, category or business management, growth, strategy or consulting.
* B.Tech/B.E. from IIT or BITS, or an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore or Calcutta, or ISB.
* Demonstrated ownership of business outcomes such as revenue, growth, conversion or margins.
* Strong analytical skills, including Excel/Google Sheets modelling, funnel analysis and familiarity with SQL or BI tools.
* Practical, demonstrable experience using AI tools to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work across customers, educators and cross-functional teams.
* A strong bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, accountability and fast-paced execution.

**Good to have:**

* Experience in consumer internet, EdTech, D2C or subscription businesses.
* Exposure to international customers, particularly NRI markets.
* Personal interest or expertise in languages, spirituality, mathematics, chess or related learning categories.
* Experience managing freelancers, educators or other distributed workforces.

What You’ll Get

* **Real business ownership:**
  Take responsibility for a complete business vertical early in your career.
* **Founder access:**
  Work directly with the Founder & CEO on strategy and execution.
* **Meaningful upside:**
  Competitive compensation with ESOPs.
* **Career acceleration:**
  A potential pathway to Business Head or CXO roles as your vertical grows.
* **AI-first environment:**
  Access to AI tools and the opportunity to build AI-powered business operations.
* **A meaningful mission:**
  Help shape how children learn, grow and discover their potential.

Our Hiring Process

1. Application review — CV and a short note on your preferred vertical.
2. Introductory conversation with the CEO's office.
3. Take-home case — develop a 90-day plan for one vertical using AI.
4. Case presentation and deep dive with the Founder & CEO.
5. Culture and reference conversations.
6. Offer.

Ready to Build Something Big?

If you want to move beyond managing tasks and start owning business outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Enterprise GTM Lead

**About Us:**

Trail is the context layer AI agents run on. We're building the missing layer between your company's rules, exceptions, and institutional knowledge and the agents trying to act on them. It's a governed graph that lets any agent or platform, including Trail agents, make the right call on your most complex business processes. Agents today fail not because models are weak, but because they're never given the judgment a business builds up over years. We're fixing that.

Visit our Website and Youtube to learn more!

This is a builder's role. You'll work closely with the leadership and sales teams to identify high-potential opportunities, run GTM experiments and unlock new channels for growth. From testing a new customer segment to experimenting with account-based marketing or exploring an untapped channel, you'll own initiatives end-to-end and turn what works into repeatable growth engines.

We're looking for someone smart, driven, and entrepreneurial — someone who takes initiative, moves fast, and is comfortable figuring things out without a playbook. Founder experience is a strong plus.

* 5+ years with an undergraduate degree from a Tier 1 institute

title: Category Manager
description:
**About the company**

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising

the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market — economy to

mid-market — to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel

over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price

point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.

We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:

● Itsy (₹1000–1500)

● Treebo and Treebo Premium (₹1500–3000)

● Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (₹3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10

across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

**About the Role**

The Category Commercial Manager – Hills is the category's chief strategist: the person who

figures out what actually makes a hill-station hotel perform, codifies it into a playbook, and

builds the knowledge base that lets the rest of the organization act on it consistently. This role is

less about running any single lever day-to-day and more about answering the "why" behind

performance — which factors separate a top-performing hill hotel from a struggling one — and

turning that answer into a repeatable, scalable set of actions.

Pricing execution sits with the central Revenue Management pricing team. Everything else that

drives hill-hotel performance — demand patterns, inventory strategy, positioning, marketing,

and policy — is this role's to understand, document, and turn into playbook guidance, working

closely with the teams who execute against it.

This is a high-visibility, senior individual-contributor role reporting into commercial leadership,

with regular exposure to QBR and senior management reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy & Playbook Creation (core mandate)

● Diagnose what drives performance in the hills category — pull apart top-performing vs.

underperforming hotels within each cluster (Chikmagalur, Coorg, Ooty, Shimla, Manali,

etc.) and identify the specific, repeatable factors behind the gap

● Translate those findings into a living Hills Category Playbook: a structured, prioritized set

of "what to do" actions — by cluster, by season, by hotel maturity — covering everything

from listing content to demand planning to promotions

● Continuously test and refine the playbook: treat each intervention (a pricing change, a

new cancellation policy, a promotion) as an experiment, and feed results back into the

playbook rather than treating it as one-off

● Own the category's knowledge base — a single source of truth documenting what

works, what doesn't, and why, so that the logic doesn't live only in one person's head

and can be handed off, audited, and built on

● Build decision frameworks (e.g., "when a hotel's occupancy drops below X in season Y, do

Z") that let revenue management, marketing, and ops teams act on the playbook

without needing this role in every conversation

● Benchmark the hills category against comp sets and against Treebo's other categories

(city, business) to pressure-test which "hills-specific" factors are truly unique to the

category

Revenue Management (beyond pricing) — as playbook inputs

● Study demand seasonality by destination (long weekends, festival calendars, school

holidays, wedding/honeymoon seasons) and turn it into a demand-planning framework

the category can reuse year over year

● Define the category's point of view on inventory and availability strategy —

length-of-stay controls, minimum-stay/blackout dates, stop-sells, and overbooking

approach at high-demand properties — and document it in the playbook

● Define the category's channel mix and distribution strategy, and the market/segment

strategy (corporate vs. leisure vs. drive-in) by cluster and season

● Partner with the central pricing team on rate-uplift opportunities (e.g., properties priced

below comp set despite equal or better review scores), feeding them the category insight

behind each opportunity

● Investigate root causes behind Critical No-Show % and other NBV-leakage patterns at

sold-out properties, and codify the intervention playbook (ACQ or otherwise)

Marketing — as playbook inputs

● Determine what marketing actually moves the needle for hill destinations — content

quality, listing photography, promotions, campaigns — and document what works by

cluster and season

● Build the playbook for OTA visibility and content marketing (listing standards,

ranking/boost programs) in coordination with the Listing Intelligence workstream

● Design and run promotion/campaign experiments tied to seasonality, and record which

formats and offers actually lift occupancy and RevPAR

● Track marketing-driven demand signals (e.g., hotel detail view traffic by platform) to

figure out where marketing effort pays off, and build that into the knowledge base

Policy — as playbook inputs

● Determine the right cancellation, refund, and no-show policy stance for the category,

and document the reasoning and trade-offs (guest flexibility vs. NBV protection)

● Define the category's position on rate parity, minimum-stay, blackout, and

booking-window policy for peak-season dates

● Ensure category-level policy recommendations account for OTA platform requirements

and Treebo's broader commercial policy framework

Competitive & Market Intelligence

● Track ARI (Average Rate Index) and Review Index against comp sets for each cluster

● Turn competitive patterns into playbook guidance — e.g., what a competitor is doing

that consistently correlates with better performance, and whether it's worth adopting

Portfolio & P&L Management

● Own the regional P&L narrative for the hills category — revenue, cost-to-serve, and NBV

— and present waterfall/variance analysis in QBRs, tying performance back to playbook

adoption

● Prioritize which playbook interventions to push into which hotels, based on

impact-to-effort

● Partner with acquisition/onboarding teams to apply category learnings to new hotel

signings in high-potential hill destinations

Cross-functional Execution

● Work closely with central Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, OTA/Listing, Operations, and

Category teams — both to gather the inputs the playbook needs and to get playbook

guidance actually adopted

● Represent the hills category in AMJ/quarterly business reviews — own the narrative,

data, and playbook evolution

● Maintain the knowledge base and playbook as living documents, versioned and updated

as new evidence comes in

**What We're Looking For**

● 4–8 years of experience in revenue management, commercial strategy, or program

management in hospitality/ travel, or a marketplace/platform business preferred

● Strong analytical instincts: comfortable moving from raw performance data to "here's

the underlying reason" rather than stopping at the dashboard

● Demonstrated experience building frameworks, playbooks, or SOPs that other teams

adopted and used — not just one-off analyses

● Strong quantitative fluency: comfortable working with RevPAR, ARR, NBV, occupancy,

and P&L waterfalls without hand-holding

● Working knowledge of revenue management levers beyond pricing, OTA distribution

dynamics, and hospitality marketing/policy — enough to know what questions to ask,

even without owning execution of each

● Demonstrated ability to translate data into a clear commercial narrative for senior

stakeholders

● Advanced Excel/Sheets skills; comfort with dashboards (Mixpanel or similar) is a plus

● Willingness to travel periodically to hill-station clusters to validate playbook assumptions

on the ground

● Curious and rigorous by disposition — treats every intervention as something to be

tested and documented, not just executed

**What Success Looks Like (First 2 Quarters)**

● A first version of the Hills Category Playbook live and shared with commercial

leadership, covering demand planning, inventory strategy, marketing, and policy by

cluster

● A knowledge base documenting the specific factors that separate top- and

bottom-performing Hill hotels, with evidence behind each claim

● At least 2–3 playbook recommendations piloted with a measurable before/after read

(e.g., a promotion format, a policy change, a listing fix)

● A repeatable, cluster-level QBR reporting structure adopted by commercial leadership,

framed around playbook adoption and impact

title: Head of Product
description:
**Head of Product — Sitrep Technologies**

**About Sitrep Technologies**

Sitrep Technologies is a new, independent clinical technology company commercialising a proven Electronic Data Capture (EDC) / eCRF platform originally built and battle-tested inside a working CRO. We are turning that internal system into a standalone software product for CROs, cosmetic and FMCG companies, biotech, and pharma — organisations that need compliant, configurable data capture without the cost and overhead of the incumbent enterprise tools.

We are small, lean, and building deliberately. This is a founding-team role with real ownership.

**The role**

As
**Head of Product**
, you own the transformation of a working internal tool into a commercial, multi-customer software product — and then its roadmap as we grow. You set product direction, translate customer needs into what gets built, own the compliance and validation documentation that regulated buyers demand, and work hand-in-hand with the Technical Lead to ship. In practice, you will operate as the senior day-to-day product and delivery leader of the business.

You report to the Founder, who holds strategic direction and governance.

**What you will own**

* **Productisation.**
  Define what it takes to move the platform from an internal tool to a sellable, multi-tenant, configurable product — and drive it to done.
* **Roadmap and prioritisation.**
  Own the product roadmap. Decide what gets built, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand against engineering capacity.
* **Customer requirements.**
  Turn conversations with CROs, sponsors, cosmetic/FMCG and pharma buyers into clear, prioritised product requirements.
* **Implementation framework.**
  Build the repeatable process for onboarding and configuring the platform for each new customer.
* **Validation and compliance documentation.**
  Own the product's regulated-software readiness — validation packages (IQ/OQ/PQ), 21 CFR Part 11 alignment, GAMP 5 / computer system validation documentation — working with our quality/compliance consultant.
* **Delivery coordination.**
  Partner closely with the Technical Lead to plan, sequence, and ship releases.

**What success looks like**

* **First 90 days:**
  a clear, costed productisation roadmap agreed with the Founder and Technical Lead; a documented view of the gap between the current internal build and a market-ready product.
* **First 6 months:**
  the platform configurable for an external customer; an implementation framework and core validation documentation in place.
* **First 9–12 months:**
  the product supporting its first external customer(s) beyond the founding CRO, with a prioritised roadmap driving the next phase.

**Must-have experience**

* Proven track record taking a
  **B2B software product from early to commercial**
  as a product owner / product manager / head of product.
* Experience in a
  **regulated or compliance-heavy software domain**
  — clinical, healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, or similar — where validation and audit requirements are part of the product, not an afterthought.
* Working knowledge of regulated-software expectations:
  **21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5 / CSV, data privacy**
  , and what enterprise/pharma procurement demands.
* Enough
  **technical depth**
  to partner credibly with engineering on architecture and trade-offs.
* Comfort operating
  **lean and hands-on**
  in an early-stage, single-product company — setting direction and also doing the work.

**Strong plus**

* Direct experience with
  **EDC, eCRF, CTMS, or clinical data systems**
  .
* Experience selling or supporting software sold to
  **CROs, sponsors, or pharma**
  .
* Exposure to
  **multi-tenant SaaS**
  productisation and configuration.
* Experience standing up a
  **QMS or pursuing SOC 2 / ISO 27001**
  .

**Who this is for**

Someone who wants founding-level ownership of a product with a real head start — a working platform and a first customer — rather than a blank page. You are comfortable being the senior operator who makes the product happen, you think commercially, and you are energised by building the company, not just the backlog.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
* You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
* People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

title: Manager - Thought Leadership & Corporate Voice.
description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
  
  
**InMobi Advertising**
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
  
  
**Glance**
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
  
  
**About InMobi**
InMobi is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses, including independently operated consumer platform Glance, InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., an associate of InMobi Technology Services Pte. Ltd.
  
  
**The InMobi Group**
The InMobi Group is the umbrella under which this ecosystem of businesses comes together. It spans:
  
  

* Consumer brands: Glance, an intelligent shopping agent, and 1Weather, a hyperlocal weather application.
* Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.

Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role helps shape how that group is presented and understood.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Manager, Thought Leadership & Corporate Voice is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. “Group level” means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for building and running the group’s thought leadership programme: the ideas, point of view, and voices through which InMobi takes part in the conversations that matter to its category.
  
  
The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent’s purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the point of view, the content that carries it, and the platforms that give it reach.
  
  
**Target Audiences**

* Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
* Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi’s strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.
* Technology community: engineers, data scientists, and product leaders who follow the work of leading technology teams.
* Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Point of View and Corporate Voice**

* Define InMobi’s point of view on the topics that matter to its category, aligned to the group narrative and to business, talent, and brand priorities.
* Maintain a consistent corporate voice across articles, talks, interviews, and social channels, across businesses and regions.
* Build a thought leadership calendar that ties content and appearances to business milestones, industry moments, and corporate events.

**Thought Leadership Content**

* Write and edit bylined articles, opinion pieces, talk narratives, perspectives, and long-form content in a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.
* Turn expertise from across the business into publishable ideas, with briefs, outlines, and editorial support for contributors.
* Work with the content and design teams to produce video, research-led pieces, and long-form formats.

**Speaking, Media, and Industry Presence**

* Identify and secure speaking slots, panels, podcasts, interviews, and awards that build InMobi’s presence with priority audiences.
* Work with PR and analyst relations partners to place InMobi’s perspectives in relevant media and industry conversations.
* Support participants with briefs, narratives, and preparation for each appearance, and follow through on what it earns.

**Voices and Contributors**

* Identify and develop senior leaders, subject-matter experts, and internal voices across engineering, product, and business functions, using a defined framework for selection and support.
* Partner with the Social Media & Community team to build presence across all handles, not on a single platform.

**Global Collaboration**

* Work with the Corporate Marketing team, the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and regional, talent, finance, and engineering teams across the world to maintain a consistent voice while reflecting local relevance.
* Act as the point of coordination for thought leadership programmes across stakeholders, setting clear timelines, owners, and approvals.

**Partner and Team Leadership**

* Manage agency and external partnerships across PR, content, media training, and production.
* Guide and develop writers and contributors supporting thought leadership programmes.

**Measurement and Reporting**

* Define KPIs across reach, media and speaking outcomes, audience engagement, and brand sentiment.
* Use analytics and social listening to refine the programme and report to senior leadership.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* 8–10 years of experience in corporate communications, thought leadership, content, or brand, within technology, media, or high-growth environments, including at least 2 years leading people or programmes.
* Strong B2B experience, preferably in technology, SaaS, adtech, or martech, with a record of building influence among professional and technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience building thought leadership programmes, including bylines, speaking, and media engagement.
* Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice, including long-form writing.
* Experience with media, analyst, and industry engagement, and with managing PR agencies.
* Experience in video and visual storytelling.
* Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior stakeholders.
* Sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Strategic thinking combined with strong execution.
* Curiosity, courage, initiative, and accountability: the ability to act without waiting for perfect conditions and to learn quickly when an attempt does not succeed.

**Candidate Profile**
InMobi is suited to builders and challengers who are comfortable with ambiguity and who prefer to draw the map rather than wait for one.
  
  
**What InMobi Offers**

* Yours to build: Ambitious, unfinished problems at a scale most companies cannot offer, with the trust to make decisions rather than wait for a brief.
* Shape what’s next: Real authority over decisions, regardless of designation or years of experience.
* Steadfast support: Responsibility that often arrives before a person feels ready for it, backed by support at every stage, in work and beyond.

**The InMobi Culture**
At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
  
  
We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.
  
  
InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.
  
  
Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

title: Director of Product Management-Supply Chain
description:
**The Role**

As Director, Product – Operations, you will own product outcomes across the post-booking execution engine — from order management and project coordination through permit flows, EMI and financing execution, installation, commissioning, and supply chain operations.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a highly execution-driven environment, where product decisions directly affect throughput, cost efficiency, on-ground reliability, and predictability of delivery at scale.

You will operate across multiple PODs and large business units, working closely with PMs, SPMs, engineering, design, and business leaders to frame complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and close cross-functional trade-offs.

While the role has significant scope and leverage, it also requires depth — stepping in to help teams think through workflows, system design, and PRDs when ambiguity, scale, or risk is high.

Scope of Responsibility

* Own product outcomes across the post-booking operations backbone — order management, project coordination, permits, supply chain execution, financing journeys, and installation & commissioning.
* Be accountable for the reliability, throughput, and cost efficiency of the delivery engine, with a mandate to shift real workflow execution into the system and eliminate offline coordination that constrains predictability and scale.
* Own the product surface connecting operational systems to supply chain and ERP infrastructure, ensuring reliable and comprehensive information flows.
* Identify and address structural bottlenecks and failure modes across complex, interdependent systems using operational data, ground signals, and business context.
* Set clear product direction and priorities across multiple PM and SPM-owned areas, focusing on reliability, throughput, cost efficiency, and exception reduction.
* Work hands-on with PMs and SPMs to frame complex, ambiguous problems, shape solution approaches, and raise the quality of PRDs and solution design.
* Drive alignment and close trade-offs across operations, engineering, finance, and business stakeholders, especially where ownership is unclear or incentives conflict.
* Balance short-term execution pressure with long-term system robustness, maintainability, scalability, and resilience.

**What Success Requires**

* 10–14+ years of product management experience, with meaningful exposure to operations, supply chain, logistics, construction, or similarly complex execution-heavy domains.
* Proven ability to exercise system-level judgment in workflow-heavy, execution-critical environments where product decisions have immediate business and operational consequences.
* Experience owning or shaping large, interdependent systems with real throughput constraints, failure modes, and on-ground complexity.
* Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or ERP-adjacent product contexts is a plus.
* Experience managing multi-party workflows with external dependencies — permits, financing partners, third-party vendors, or regulatory bodies.
* Comfort operating across multiple PODs and business units while maintaining depth where decisions are irreversible or high-risk.
* Strong data fluency applied to operational outcomes — understanding bottlenecks, exceptions, unit economics, and second-order effects.
* Hands-on leadership style — willing and able to engage deeply in problem framing, solution design, and PRDs when leverage is highest.
* High credibility with senior operations and engineering leaders, built through judgment and follow-through rather than authority.
* Demonstrated capability to lead, coach, and hold a high bar for PMs and cross-functional teams.
* A collaborative, low-ego working style that reinforces trust, accountability, and a non-toxic execution culture at scale.

title: Associate Manager, Product Planning and Adoption, EIP
description:
**Place of Posting -**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Team :**
Economic Inclusion Program
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
  
  
At The/Nudge Institute, We Have Been Piloting This Program For The Past 3 Years And Are Now Scaling It Across Multiple States. Our Purpose Is To Enable The Most Excluded Individuals To Become Contributing Members Of The Economy. We Will
  
  

* Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
* Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
* Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
* Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
* Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

**Position Overview**
**What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?**

* First principles thinking
* Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach)
* Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
* Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

**What will you do?**
We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.
  
  
This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Planning and program visibility

+ Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
+ Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.

* Adoption and data driven action

+ Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
+ Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
+ Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
+ Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.

* Feedback systems and product improvement

+ Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
+ Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
+ Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
+ Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.

* Stakeholder leadership and communication

+ Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
+ Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
+ Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
+ Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.
  
  
**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Experience and education

+ Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
+ Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
+ Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.

* Core capabilities:

+ Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
+ Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
+ Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
+ Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
+ Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
+ Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
+ Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.

* Good to have:

+ Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
+ Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
+ Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Customer Manager
description:

* Proactive approach to identifying and developing business opportunities
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Ability to influence stakeholders and develop long-term customer partnerships
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills when collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams

* Travel within India is required based on business needs.

We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. You translate growth, retention and loyalty ambitions into segmented, decisioning-driven lifecycle interventions and prove the value they create.

* Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle framework - acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, cross-sell, upsell, retention, loyalty, renewal and win-back.
* Define customer segmentation and treatment strategies across lifecycle stage, value tier, behavioural profile, propensity, risk and engagement level.
* Own the campaign calendar and prioritisation across a complex, multi-channel environment, balancing commercial objectives, customer relevance, contact policy and regulatory requirements.
* Next Best Action & Personalisation:
* Translate business objectives into Next Best Action and Next Best Offer strategies - eligibility, suitability, applicability and prioritisation logic.
* Work with decisioning, data and martech teams to define engagement policies, arbitration rules, contact policy and suppression frameworks.
* Drive the shift from batch campaign execution to trigger-based, event-driven, real-time and always-on engagement.
* Industry-Specific Growth & Retention Programmes:
* Retail: Design lifecycle programmes that drive repeat purchase, purchase frequency, basket growth, loyalty participation, category expansion, omnichannel conversion and customer retention.
* Financial Services: Design onboarding, activation, product adoption, cross-sell, wallet-share, servicing, retention and lifetime-value programmes while accounting for consent, suitability and regulatory controls.
* Software & Platforms: Drive onboarding completion, feature adoption, free-to-paid conversion, usage expansion, subscription renewal, churn prevention and reactivation across user and account lifecycles.
* Life Sciences: Shape compliant HCP and patient engagement journeys, including HCP education, patient support programme enrolment, adherence, persistence and omnichannel engagement, in partnership with medical, legal and regulatory stakeholders.
* Journey & Channel Orchestration:
* Design omnichannel journeys across email, SMS, mobile app, push notifications, web, ecommerce, digital media, contact centre, sales and assisted channels.
* Translate customer behaviours, transactions and business events into automated lifecycle journeys and timely interventions.
* Optimise channel mix, cadence, content relevance and customer experience across touchpoints.
* Generative AI in Customer Engagement:
* Identify and land GenAI use cases across campaign planning, brief development, audience intelligence, content generation, personalisation and performance summarisation.
* Define quality, brand, compliance and human-review guardrails for AI-generated customer communication, with controls appropriate to regulated industries.
* Measurement & Optimisation:
* Own lifecycle performance measurement across acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, loyalty, renewal and customer lifetime value.
* Lead the test-and-learn agenda - control group design, A/B and multivariate testing, and incremental value attribution.
* Present performance read-outs and optimisation recommendations to client marketing and business leadership.
* Team & Delivery Management:
* Lead and coach a team of consultants and analysts; review and sign off on campaign strategy, journey design, build quality and reporting.
* Manage workstream plans, dependencies, risks and client expectations across marketing, sales, service, data, technology and compliance stakeholders.
* Business Development Support:
* Contribute to business cases, solution shaping and proposals; build reusable lifecycle marketing assets, accelerators and industry playbooks.

title: Field Sales & Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: Marketing Manager – School Partnerships & Business Development
  
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (Field-Based / Regional)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time (Monday to Saturday)
  
  
Company: Star Innovators - https://staraiedu.com
  
  
About Star Innovators
  
At Star Innovators, we are transforming education by bringing hands-on AI and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) learning directly into school classrooms across Bangalore. Our experiential learning programs empower young minds through interactive sessions, practical science models, robotics, 3D printing, and aeromodelling. We equip students with the tools and skills needed to thrive in a tech-driven future.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are looking for an energetic, goal-driven, and highly persuasive Marketing Manager (School Partnerships) to expand our presence across schools in assigned territories in Bangalore.
  
  
In this role, you will be the face of Star Innovators. You will visit schools during operating hours, identify key decision-makers (Trustees, Principals, Directors, and Academic Coordinators), deliver compelling presentations, conduct complimentary demo sessions, and successfully close long-term school partnerships.
  
  
Work Schedule & Flexibility
  
Work Days: Monday to Saturday
  
  
Core Field Hours (6 Hours): 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Dedicated to school visits, stakeholder meetings, and live demos on-site).
  
  
Flexible Reporting Hours (2 Hours): Complete daily meeting reports, pipeline updates, and follow-ups at your convenience anytime during the day/evening.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Lead Generation & On-Field School Visits
  
Map out target schools within your assigned geographic territory in Bangalore.
  
  
Conduct regular on-field visits during school hours (10:00 AM – 4:00 PM) to establish direct contact with leadership teams.
  
  
2. Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Building
  
Connect with key decision-makers (Principals, Management, Trustees, and Academic Heads).
  
  
Pitch our end-to-end AI and STEM hands-on learning programs, emphasizing experiential value, hands-on kits, take-home models, and trainer support.
  
  
3. Demos & Conversions
  
Schedule and facilitate complimentary demo sessions for school leadership, teachers, and parents to showcase program impact.
  
  
Present customized offerings and value-driven pricing models to convert prospective leads into active partners.
  
  
4. Deal Closure & Daily Reporting
  
Manage the end-to-end sales cycle—from introductory visits to negotiations and partnership agreements.
  
  
Document daily school interactions, lead status, and visit summaries accurately during your 2 flexible reporting hours each day.
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications
  
Experience: 2–5 years of experience in Educational Sales (EdTech / STEM / B2B Institutional Sales) or On-Field Business Development.
  
  
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
  
  
Skills:
  
  
Strong networking, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  
  
Proven track record of securing meetings with key decision-makers and closing institutional deals.
  
  
Deep geographic understanding of Bangalore’s school ecosystem.
  
  
Mobility: Must have a valid driver’s license and personal vehicle for daily field travel.
  
  
Languages: Fluency in English and Kannada is highly preferred to effectively engage with school management teams across Bangalore.
  
  
What We Offer
  
Competitive Salary: Attractive fixed pay package (₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month depending on experience) + fabulous performance-linked incentives.
  
  
Travel Allowance: Full fuel reimbursement for field visits.
  
  
Flexible Work Culture: Structured field hours with complete flexibility for administrative and reporting tasks.
  
  
Career Growth: Fast-track advancement opportunities as we scale our presence across new regions.
  
  
Meaningful Impact: Direct contribution to advancing hands-on STEM & AI literacy for school students.
  
  
How to Apply
  
Interested candidates can send their updated Resume/CV directly to savio@starinnovators.com or fill out the application form https://forms.gle/j6CJjsaPEq4VRsXs9

**Digital Marketing Manager**

**Regional College of Management Bangalore (RCMB)**

﻿

Join RCMB and help build a rapidly innovating institution where fresh ideas can become real initiatives. RCMB is looking for a hands-on digital marketer to work on admissions lead generation strategy, paid campaigns, improve enquiry quality, and work with the admissions team to connect marketing activity to applications and enrolments. **Key Responsibilities**

* Plan campaigns around admissions priorities, target audiences, geography, intake timelines, and agreed budgets. Recommend channel allocation and explain the expected outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 2 to 4 years of relevant digital or performance marketing experience, with direct responsibility for paid campaigns and measurable lead generation results.
* Hands-on proficiency in Google Ads and Meta Ads, including campaign setup, budget management, optimisation, and reporting.

* Clear written and verbal communication, strong follow-through, and the ability to coordinate interns, admissions staff, and external vendors.
* Creative judgement and the ability to write persuasive ad copy, develop campaign ideas, and guide simple visual and video content.
* Willingness to use and experiment with AI tools, learn new workflows, and evaluate whether they improve quality, speed, or campaign results.
