title: Partner Development Direct, IBM
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Our SI partners play a key role in bringing our customers' data\-backed ambitions to life by implementing and harnessing the power of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud for cutting edge workloads and use cases. Through our partnerships, we enable companies to empower their employees with the data they need when and how they need it to better engage their customers, optimize their operations, and transform their products.
   

  

 The Partner Development Senior Manager role involves driving and nurturing relationships with our System Integrator (SI) partners. Your primary objective is to strengthen and expand the collaboration between Snowflake and these partners to drive growth.
   

  

 In this role you will be responsible for growing the relationship with IBM in the Americas. The success of these partnerships is demonstrated by driving growth with our joint customers, delivering key Go\-To\-Market (GTM) programs, establishing critical executive relationships, enabling partners to grow their Snowflake competency, and delivering customer success.
   

  

 Your success depends on your ability to drive compelling business strategies, GTM motions and relationships with IBM. Strong communication, experienced strategic alliance leadership, and problem\-solving skills are vital to excel in this role.
   

  

 HERE ARE SOME KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS ASSOCIATED WITH:
   

  

* Strategic Go\-to\-Market: Work closely with IBM to build comprehensive joint business plans. Collaborate on joint GTM strategies including strategic objectives and target markets/industries. Define joint industry solutions and offerings with that demonstrates capability while differentiating the partner. Achieve partnership goals including sales quota and marketing activities; this is a quota carrying position.
* Practice Development: Inspire IBM \& Young to grow their practices with Snowflake. Evaluate their expertise, capabilities, and delivery quality and activate the GTM programs accordingly. Define certification growth plans and support enablement of the partner. Cultivate strong and lasting relationships with key Sr executives and decision\-makers at the partner.
* Results\-oriented Partner Management: Effective and proven Partner Management skills will be necessary to manage the alliance development lifecycle. This will require the ability to be a self\-starter focused on building and owning the 360\-degree relationship.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments, such as product development, sales, sales engineering, professional services, legal and marketing, to ensure a seamless partner \& customer experience. Share partner \& customer feedback and insights with relevant teams to drive continuous improvement. This candidate will collaborate with a team of technical experts to drive solution building with our partners.
* Co\-Marketing Initiatives: Coordinate and execute co\-marketing activities, including events, webinars, and content creation, to increase brand visibility and generate leads.
* Deal Support: Assist IBM in navigating Snowflake’s partner program \& sales process, including deal registration, proposal support, reporting and alignment with Sales Leadership. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a smooth and efficient sales cycle.
* Deliver on Performance: Monitor the performance and success of IBM related to specific metrics. It is important to have the ability to shift priorities, take risks and think outside of the box to deliver on key criteria.


 DESIRED EXPERIENCE \<!\[CDATA\[Senior Partner Solution Engineer
   

  

 At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.
   

  

 Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.
   

  

 This role demands a technical expert capable of driving success by aligning with key programs and significantly enhancing partner knowledge of crucial product features. The candidate must effectively present to both technical and executive audiences, utilising methods from whiteboarding to presentations and demonstrations, to cultivating strong mind share among Snowflake Partners across India.
   

  

 We require a candidate with a demonstrable history of successful engagement with major partners and a proven ability to develop technical champions within their organisations. Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.
   

  

 This role requires travel up to 50% within India throughout the quarter to support partner engagement such as enablement, deal support and marketing events.
   

  

**AS A PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**
* Collaborate closely with Snowflake's Partner, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams to promote and implement optimal solutions with our partners.
* Design and deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to upskill partner teams on Snowflake architecture and best practices based on joint business goals.
* Co\-develop industry\-specific solutions and accelerators with partners (e.g., data migration frameworks, industry data models, Power of N motions). Aligning Snowflake's products to maximise impact on their service offerings.
* Present at Snowflake and Partner events, lead hackathons, and drive Snowflake awareness and adoption within partner organisations.
* Partner closely on strategic customer engagements, collaborating with partners to define use cases, deliver compelling presentations, execute successful Proofs of Concept (POCs), and ensure positive outcomes.
* Own the technology roadmap with the partners, to build and scale their Snowflake practices with reference architectures and delivery methodologies.
* Advocate for partner and customer needs with Snowflake product teams.


**OUR IDEAL PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**
* Have 10\+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators, Regional System Integrators, Cloud Service Providers and Technology Partners within the region.
* Developed data domain thought leadership within a partner community.
* Deep comprehension of Partner revenue models, industry priorities and challenges they navigate.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka to ingest data from various systems.
* Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals (cloud DW experience preferred)
* Experience with Snowflake Technology Partners that specialise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Collaboration and Cyber Security.
* Hands\-on technical experience with DevOps and CI/CD processes and tools, such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Google Cloud Build.
* Strong experience with major cloud platforms and tooling, especially Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
* Experience using Big Data or Cloud integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, etc.
* Experience with AI/ML use cases is a plus.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?
   

  

 For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

title: Senior Global Brand Manager
description:
**🚀 About Joveo** 




 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are looking for someone who can help make Joveo a company people turn to for a clear, informed view on AI and the future of hiring.
 



 You will help bring the ideas, expertise and work inside the company into the conversations that matter to our business.
 



  





**🌟 About the role** 




 We are hiring a communications professional with an editor’s instinct for a story and the initiative to make it happen. You can spot an angle in a customer conversation, draw a compelling point of view out of a founder, and earn attention for work that deserves it.
 



 Reporting directly to the
 **Chief of Strategic Initiatives \& Global Supply Officer** 
 , you will lead strategic PR and leadership visibility. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to shape Joveo’s corporate narrative and advise on where we should speak, what we can credibly say and which opportunities deserve our attention.
 



  





**Strategic PR is the primary mandate.** 
 Creative brand campaigns are an important extension of it. We want someone who brings original ideas, understands how different channels work and can turn a strong story into a campaign people remember.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Develop Joveo’s corporate narrative. Get close to our leaders, customers and subject experts. Find the evidence behind the story and turn it into compelling pitches, commentary, contributed articles and briefing material.
* Build a sustained earned\-media program across relevant business, technology, startup and industry publications. Develop relationships with journalists, editors, newsletters and podcasts by understanding their audiences and bringing them useful ideas.
* Strengthen leadership visibility. Develop distinctive points of view, prepare executives for interviews and identify relevant speaking opportunities. Make the message sharper while preserving the person’s voice.
* Lead communications around approved company milestones, product developments and funding announcements when relevant. Prepare FAQs, manage media enquiries and advise leadership when an issue requires a careful response.
* Originate creative campaigns that support our PR priorities. Turn customer insights, company expertise or a timely point of view into an editorial series, collaboration, event or other relevant format. Own the brief and channel choices, coordinating specialists where needed.
* Use paid PR selectively and make the budget work harder. Assess sponsored content, distribution, events and agencies against a clear audience, objective and cost. Find resourceful ways to build visibility through earned and owned channels.
* Measure whether the work is making a difference. Track coverage relevance, message accuracy, audience engagement and attributable inbound interest. Keep paid exposure distinct from earned coverage and use the results to improve the next campaign.



  





**🎯 What we’re looking for** 



* You have personally earned relevant coverage for a technology business, startup or agency client. You can explain how you found the story, pitched it and adapted when the first approach did not work.
* You know India’s business and technology media and have relevant working relationships.
* You write and edit exceptionally well. You can understand a complex product and explain why it matters in language people want to read.
* You are comfortable advising senior leaders, questioning a weak angle and recommending a stronger one.
* You have originated a campaign, collaboration or channel idea that made an impact. You can show your contribution and explain the audience insight behind it.
* You are resourceful with a focused budget and can take an idea through execution. Experience in AI, enterprise technology, corporate milestone communications or international media is useful.



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape the story while it is being formed, with direct access to senior leadership and responsibility for how it reaches the public.
 



 There is room to bring your own editorial judgment and pursue original ideas. Your work will influence how customers, prospective hires and the wider business community understand Joveo, with PR at the centre and creative thinking throughout.

title: Business Head – Expansion
description:
**Job Description: Business Head – Expansion** 




  





 Location: Bangalore
 



 Department: Business / Expansion
 



 Experience: 5–8 Years
 



 Qualification: MBA from a Top\-Tier Business School
 



  





**About the Company** 




 We are one of India’s leading K–12 school networks with a large and rapidly growing presence across the country. As part of our next phase of growth, we are expanding aggressively across existing and new cities through new school launches, takeovers and other expansion formats.
 



  





 We are looking for a high\-calibre
 **Business Head – Expansion** 
 who can take complete business ownership of new schools from the pre\-launch stage through launch, admissions ramp\-up and operational stabilization.
 



  





 This is a high\-impact role requiring a combination of
 **sales orientation, operational excellence, analytical ability and strong execution skills.** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The Business Head – Expansion will be responsible for successfully launching and scaling new schools across India.
 



  





 The individual will work cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Academics, HR, Projects, Finance and other central teams to ensure that every new school is launched on time and achieves its business objectives.
 



  





 The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and ground\-level execution, analysing a market and building a business plan on one day, while solving sales, staffing or operational bottlenecks at a school on another.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. New School Launches** 



* Take end\-to\-end business ownership of new school launches.
* Develop detailed launch plans covering admissions, marketing, manpower, operations and academic readiness.
* Establish clear timelines and milestones for each new school.
* Coordinate with multiple central and regional teams to ensure that schools are operationally ready before launch.
* Identify potential launch bottlenecks early and drive rapid resolution.
* Ensure smooth transition from project/construction stage to fully operational school.



  





**2\. Admissions \& Sales** 



* Own student admission targets for new schools.
* Develop the sales strategy for each new location based on catchment, competition, pricing and market potential.
* Build and manage the initial admissions/sales teams for new campuses.
* Establish lead management, counselling, follow\-up and conversion processes.
* Monitor the complete admissions funnel; leads, appointments, walk\-ins, applications and admissions.
* Review sales performance frequently and intervene wherever conversion or productivity is below expectations.
* Drive a strong target\-oriented sales culture across expansion schools.



  





**3\. Market \& Catchment Analysis** 



* Evaluate the business potential of new school locations.
* Understand catchment demographics, competing schools, fee structures, parent profiles and market positioning.
* Work with internal teams to determine appropriate pricing, positioning and launch strategy for each school.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking and identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Translate market insights into actionable sales and operating plans.



  





**4\. Business Planning \& P\&L** 



* Prepare business plans for new schools covering student ramp\-up, revenue, manpower, operating expenses and profitability.
* Own key financial and operating metrics during the initial years of a school.
* Monitor revenue, admissions, costs and profitability against approved business plans.
* Identify deviations early and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with Finance to review budgets, forecasts and unit economics.
* Drive each school towards targeted enrolment, operational efficiency and profitability.



  





**5\. School Operations** 



* Ensure new schools are operationally ready across all critical areas before opening.
* Establish processes for front office, parent communication, transport, security, housekeeping, facilities and other school operations.
* Ensure high standards of parent and student experience from the first day of operations.
* Monitor operational issues during the stabilization period and drive rapid resolution.
* Ensure company SOPs and operating standards are implemented consistently.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 The Business Head – Expansion will act as the central owner for each new school and coordinate extensively with:
 


* Sales \& Admissions
* Marketing
* Academics
* Recruitment \& HR
* Projects \& Construction
* Procurement
* IT
* Transport
* Finance
* Legal
* School Operations



  





 The individual will be expected to drive these teams towards common launch timelines and business objectives even where the teams do not directly report to them.
 



  





**7\. Team Building \& Leadership** 



* Help identify and build leadership teams for new schools.
* Recruit, mentor and manage sales and operational teams where required.
* Establish clear KPIs and accountability for teams.
* Conduct structured performance reviews and intervene quickly when targets are not being achieved.
* Build a culture of ownership, urgency and execution excellence.



  





**8\. Stabilisation \& Handover** 



* Remain closely involved with new schools through the initial ramp\-up period.
* Establish stable operating processes and management rhythms.
* Ensure admissions, parent experience, academics and operations reach defined performance standards.
* Transition stabilized schools to the appropriate regional/zonal operating leadership based on agreed milestones.
* Capture learnings from each launch and continuously improve the expansion playbook.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for a high\-energy business leader with a strong combination of
 **sales, operations and general management capability.** 




  





 The ideal candidate should:
 


* Have
 **5–8 years of post\-MBA professional experience.**
* Hold an
 **MBA/PGDM from a top\-tier business school** 
 .
* Have substantial experience in
 **Sales and Operations** 
 .
* Have managed meaningful revenue, business targets or P\&L responsibilities.
* Have experience leading sizeable teams and working across multiple functions.
* Be highly analytical and comfortable working with numbers, dashboards and business metrics.
* Have demonstrated ability to operate in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* Be willing to travel extensively across India as required.



  





**Preferred Background** 




 Candidates from high\-growth, multi\-location consumer businesses would be particularly relevant, including:
 



  




* Education / EdTech
* Retail
* Consumer Services
* Hospitality
* Healthcare
* Fitness
* QSR
* Multi\-location businesses
* Start\-ups with strong offline operations



  





 Prior experience in K–12 education is not mandatory, provided the candidate has strong sales and operations experience.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong sales orientation
* Business and commercial acumen
* P\&L understanding
* Operational excellence
* Structured problem\-solving
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Team leadership
* Stakeholder management
* Project management
* High ownership and accountability
* Ability to execute under aggressive timelines
* Strong communication and influencing skills



  





**Why This Role?** 




 This is an opportunity to play a central role in building one of India's largest K–12 school networks.
 



  





 Rather than managing one function, the individual will have exposure to the complete lifecycle of building a new business unit; market assessment, business planning, marketing, sales, hiring, operations, academics, P\&L and scale\-up.
 



  





 The role provides significant ownership and visibility with senior leadership and is particularly suited to someone who wants to develop into a
 **business leader/general manager with end\-to\-end P\&L responsibility.**

title: Underwriting Enablement Manager
description:
**About The Team**
 The Senior Specialist, Frontline Support, Enablement empowers Zillow’s sales teams by designing and delivering enablement programs, training, and resources that drive seller effectiveness and business results. This role leads cross\-functional initiatives to streamline onboarding, continuous learning, and sales playbooks, ensuring sellers have the tools and knowledge needed to excel. Operating with high autonomy, the Senior Specialist partners across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify gaps, optimize processes, and enhance the adoption and impact of enablement strategies.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of sales enablement programs—including playbooks, tools, and resources—to support effective prospecting, pipeline management, and deal execution. \- Develop and maintain sales training content (live, virtual, and asynchronous), ensuring materials are accurate, scalable, and aligned to product updates and go\-to\-market priorities. \- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Analytics to identify seller needs, friction points, and translate insights into enablement strategies and assets that improve productivity and conversion. \- Analyze enablement program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics; diagnose capability gaps and recommend enhancements to content, processes, and delivery channels. \- Act as a subject matter expert on enablement tools and systems, supporting configuration, usage best practices, and change management to ensure easy access and adoption by sales teams. \- Coordinate and facilitate cross\-functional efforts for major sales initiatives (e.g., new product launches, campaign rollouts, sales kickoffs), ensuring timely, cohesive messaging, training, and supporting collateral. \- Mentor and coach less experienced enablement and sales support team members on best practices in content design, training facilitation, and data\-informed decision\-making. \- Document and refine standard operating procedures for enablement programs, including governance for content updates, intake and prioritization of requests, and communication plans to the sales organization.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or a related field. \- 8\+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, revenue programs, or a closely related sales support function, including experience designing and delivering sales training and content for quota\-carrying teams. \- Proven experience using data and sales performance metrics to evaluate enablement impact and inform program improvements. \- Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to support go\-to\-market initiatives and drive seller adoption of tools and processes. \- Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Head of Operations – International Markets
description:
𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 – 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝘀
 



 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗢𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄
 



 You will be responsible for leading and scaling Rubick's international operations function, with end\-to\-end ownership of operational strategy, business performance, client delivery, revenue growth, profitability, quality, and team performance across international markets.
 



 This role focuses on building scalable operating systems, strengthening client relationships, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring high\-quality delivery across Rubick's global customer base.
 



 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Technology, Finance, and Leadership teams to drive international business growth and build a world\-class operations organization. You will be reporting to the VP of operations.
 



  





 The role involves three areas: 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟭: 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗹𝘀 \| 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟮: 𝗔𝗜\-𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗘𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 \| 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟯: 𝗜𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 \& 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻
 



  





 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟭: 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗹𝘀
 



 𝗢𝘄𝗻 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Lead the overall strategy, execution, and performance of Rubick’s international operations across clients, markets, teams, and service lines.

title: Digital Buildings Offer Success, Process owner and Performance leader, Connected Services Hub
description:
A key member of the Connected Services Excellence team responsible for accelerating the integration, adoption and growth of Digital Buildings Connected Services within the CSH ecosystem, locally and globally. The role ensure that Buildings Services are embedded within the CSH operating model and drives global performance, scalability and business outcomes.
   

  

 Lead the CSH readiness and transformation roadmap for Digital services offers such a Ecostruxure Foresight, embedding Buildings Connected Services in a scalable, multi\-module service model across Buildings, Power and Energy.
   

  

 Primary Mission
   

  

 Define, deploy and continuously improve the framework that enables Digital Buildings Connected Services to be successfully designed, built, scaled, measured and optimized within the CSH business model.
   

  

 Drive the CSH operating\-model transformation required for consistent, scalable and cost\-effective Buildings and Ecostruxure Foresight delivery across Buildings, Power and Energy.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Operating Model design, governance and deployment
   

  

 Define the best approach to strengthen Digital Buildings Connected Services into the CSH operating model at local and global levels. Establish governance, processes, roles and ways of working that support sustainable growth and operational excellence.
   

  

* Define how Buildings Services integrate into the broader Foresight operating model, including interfaces with Power, Energy, global and local CSH, countries, technical support and field service.
* Establish the End\-to\-end execution including CSH model, including accountability, handoffs, escalation paths, governance, service levels and customer\-experience standards.


 Offer Success \& Performance
   

  

 Analyse new offers coming from rom line of business and prepare for their readiness from a CSH perspective. Contributes to countries offer launches, attend launch gates, secure deployment success and business performance of Buildings Connected Services.
   

  

 Establish KPIs, performance reviews and continuous improvement mechanisms that deliver measurable outcomes in the run phase
   

  

 Own CSH execution processes for agents, build success books and drives continuous improvement actions to drive the cost to serve down.
   

  

 Country Engagement \& Local CSH Collaboration
   

  

 Act as the primary interface to build strong partnerships with Global, local CSH and countries Buildings organization, understand local needs, support deployment, capture feedback and ensure global standards translate into successful local execution.
   

  

 Defines the operating model and resource planning to execute optimally.
   

  

* Map Local execution capabilities embedded in Buildings country organizations and, with local Buildings leadership and global CSH, articulate their teams, roles and ways of working into the broader CSH operating model and service offers with a clear RACI .
* Define interfaces, governance, role boundaries, competencies, knowledge practices and performance expectations that align Local teams with global standards while retaining local customer proximity.
* Lead the transition from fragmented country practices to a harmonized and global execution model covering offer deployment, support processes, customer experience, performance and cost to serve.


**Foresight Integration \& CSH Transformation**
* Own the CSH readiness and transformation roadmap for Foresight across Buildings, Power and Energy.
* Define the future CSH capability model, including the shift from siloed advisor teams toward shared, cross\-offer or multi\-module capabilities where valuable.
* Establish competency maps and learning roadmaps for CSH agents and advisors supporting multi\-module Foresight services.
* Establish a consistent charge\-back model
* Drive cost\-to serve improvements


 Digital, Analytics \& AI Enablement
   

  

 Define reporting, analytics, automation and AI requirements that improve visibility, scalability and decision\-making.
   

  

 Define associated platforms and tools to execute the offer as well as identify AI use cases to increase value and efficiency.
   

  

 Design the technical support model and knowledge management to cover all offers in the scope.
   

  

 Success Measures
   

  

 Successful integration of Buildings Connected Services into CSH; adoption and growth across countries; achievement of business performance targets; customer satisfaction improvements; productivity gains; and adoption of standard operating practices globally.
   

  

 Leadership Expectations
   

  

 Influence without authority, align global and local stakeholders, represent the voice of Buildings within CSH Excellence, and deliver measurable business outcomes through collaboration and execution excellence.
   

  

 Align local Buildings organizations and global CSH around a harmonized model while preserving appropriate local customer proximity and business context.
   

  

 Experience \& Profile
   

  

 10\+ years in Services (ideally Buildings) , Digital Solutions, Operations, Business Excellence or Transformation. Proven experience leading global cross\-functional initiatives in matrix organizations.
   

  

 Strong communication and influence skills as well as project management track record.
   

  

 Ability to drive change and adoption
   

  

 Rewards designed for you
   

  

 Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. title: RIS Solution Advisory  Manager - Digital Core
description:
**Job Description**
 At Accenture, we believe your career is about what you want to be and who you want to be. It’s about bringing your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. Here, you’ll match your ingenuity with the latest technology to do incredible things. Together, we can create positive, long\-lasting change.
   

  

 We are:
   

  

 Our Solution Advisory team is a specialty sales advisory service within Commercial Services. We are specialists aligned to Accenture’s priority business offerings with expertise in how to go\-to\-market and best position Accenture to win work. We are the sales lab that works with offering leadership, equipping them with relevant market insights, customized sales messages, and curated sales assets to originate, sell, and win.
   

  

 You are:
   

  

 An experienced Manager who is comfortable working with senior Accenture stakeholders. You have an executive presence and deep expertise in some of the Digital Core solutions. You have supported sales pursuits and delivered projects in Tech Strategy \& Transformation or another Digital Core area.
   

  

 The work:
   

  

 As a Solution Advisory Manager, you provide high touch sales support to our Tech Strategy \& Transformation and/or other Digital Core teams, closely partnering with the Digital Core Solution Advisory Lead for the Market. This will include but is not limited to the following:
   

  

 Planning and Origination
   

  

 Support annual planning to outline sales targets, target clients, and enhancement of sales assets.
   

  

 Conduct ongoing research to identify which client accounts or opportunities to target over next 6\-12 months.
   

  

 Conduct sales / pipeline reviews with leaders.
   

  

 Prepare for and support first conversations with potential clients.
   

  

 Proposals / Orals
   

  

 Define proposal response requirements and best sales messaging approach.
   

  

 Bring the latest knowledge and best of content to each opportunity (e.g., industry trends benchmarking, competitive insights, etc.)
   

  

 Help shape the overall solution (approach, team, pricing, differentiators, etc.) to best fit the deal requirements.
   

  

 Prepare for and support orals with innovating ways of selling to help differentiate Accenture.
   

  

 Leverage Claude, Enterprise ChatGPT, and other AI and Agentic AI capabilities Accenture offers in your day\-to\-day work.
   

  

 Content Management / Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Develop go\-to\-market approach / assets.
   

  

 Maintain global repository of sales assets (e.g., proposals, stage 0 decks credentials, etc.)
   

  

 Conduct reviews (loss / delivery) with client teams to understand how we can improve and harvest deliverables.
   

  

 Stay relevant through training, research, client interaction and feedback sessions.
   

  

 Here is what you need:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree.
   

  

 3\+ years functional experience in Digital Core space.
   

  

 3\+ years in in sales or consulting at a top\-tier consulting.
   

  

 English language fluency (oral and written).
   

  

 Must support/mirror working hours for the supported region (with at least 50% overlap), and be flexible with working hours to meet shifting business needs.
   

  

 Must have good internet connectivity and distraction\-free environment for working at home, in accordance with local guidelines.
   

  

 Bonus points if you have:
   

  

 Experience in Sales and Business Development

title: Social Media Manager ( Account Manager) 1-2 Years experience | Indiranagar
description:
Company Description
 



 Skillmate Global Marketing Agency empowers businesses through data\-driven digital marketing strategies that focus on measurable results and growth. The agency specializes in SEO, PPC campaigns (including Google Ads and social media advertising), social media management, and content creation for both organic and paid channels. Skillmate Global also delivers targeted email marketing automation and WhatsApp API solutions to help clients reach audiences more effectively. By combining analytics, creative execution, and automation, the team helps brands attract, engage, and convert their ideal customers.
 



  





  





 Role \& Responsibilities:
 



 1\. As an Account Manager, you will act as the primary point of contact between clients and internal teams, including digital marketing, production, website development, and sales.
 



 2\. Your role will involve end\-to\-end ownership of client accounts, execution coordination, reporting, production planning, and sales support. Your key responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:
 



  





 Client Management \& Servicing:
 



 1\. Manage end\-to\-end client relationships and ensure timely delivery of services across social media, SEO, performance marketing, and website\-related activities.
 



 2\. Act as a single point of contact between clients and internal teams (developers, designers, marketers) to track progress, gather feedback, and ensure timely closures.
 



 3\. Ensure daily communication with clients through calls and updates on ongoing tasks, daily activities, and deliverables.
 



 4\. Maintain detailed records of all client communications, tasks, deliverables, and updates using the company’s prescribed tools or systems.
 



 5\. Conduct mandatory monthly in\-person client meetings to present reports, review performance, and plan upcoming activities.
 



 6\. Visit client locations as required for meetings, coordination, and reviews. The candidate should know how to drive.
 



 7\. Actively work towards client retention by ensuring client satisfaction, addressing concerns proactively, and maintaining long\-term relationships.
 



  





 Digital Marketing \& Production Coordination
 



 1\. Plan, create, and maintain monthly social media content calendars, including basic copywriting and Canva\-based creatives.
 



 2\. Handle production planning, content planning, and script preparation for shoots and campaigns.
 



 3\. Coordinate with designers, video editors, and production teams to ensure timely execution.
 



 4\. Visit client locations and coordinate with the production team during shoots to ensure smooth execution.
 



  





 Website Coordination
 



 1\. Coordinate with website developers to ensure all website\-related updates, tasks, and projects are completed within agreed timelines.
 



 2\. Track website deliverables and communicate progress clearly to clients.
 



  





 Reporting \& Communication
 



 1\. Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports with clients, ensuring clarity and transparency.
 



 2\. Communicate professionally and fluently in English. Knowledge of Hindi and Kannada will be a strong advantage.
 



  





 Sales Support, Upselling \& Revenue Responsibilities
 



 1\. Identify opportunities to upsell additional services or add\-on services to existing clients.
 



 2\. Generate client invoices, manage monthly retainer collections, and follow up onpending payments.
 



  





 Tools \& Systems
 



 Use and manage CRM and invoicing tools such as Salesforce, TeleCRM, Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Zoho invoicing
 



  





 Job Location: Indiranagar, Bengaluru
 



 Joining: Immediate joiners preferred

* Drive user acquisition through app installs and lead generation campaigns with a strong focus on ROI.

 Consumer business, home services. We sell to parents in Bangalore. Just raised. Right now marketing is the founders doing it between everything else, and that stops working next month. You're the first marketing hire.

 You own all things marketing. Paid, organic, content, community, partnerships, brand. If it brings a parent or a caregiver to us, it's yours.

 You'll have the freedom to bring in interns and freelancers when the work needs more hands, and you'll decide who and when.
 



  





 What you'll be measured on is simple. Cost per lead, cost per customer, and how many of those customers stay.
 



  





 High ownership, high agency. The wins are yours and so are the misses. As the team grows, this role is built to become Head of Marketing.
 



  




 You'll do well here if

**Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 Marketing at Datahash runs agent\-first: a marketing head agent plans, content and page agents produce, an inbound agent qualifies, and named humans approve. This seat is for the person who directs that machine: an operator who owns the voice, the partner\-marketing relationships with Meta, Google, Snap and TikTok, and the demand numbers, and who directs the agents rather than replacing them. You will not be asked to build the machine; it exists. You will be asked to make it produce leads and to make Datahash sound like one company.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the number. Marketing\-qualified leads from 25 to 100 a month across eight engines, with the segment, journey and content calendar the agents run reviewed by you weekly.
* Own the voice. Every external asset sounds like Datahash: you set the standard, the agents produce to it, and you are the final human read on anything public.
* Own the partner marketing. Co\-marketing programmes and MDF with the channel partners, from claim to campaign, in partnership with the Growth Manager (Channel Partnerships).
* Direct the agents. Brief them, correct them, measure them: acceptance rate, cost per accepted output and the override log are your management tools.
* Launch. Run the SYNAPSE launch communications and the design\-partner programme to the existing base.


**What Success Looks Like**
* MQL ramp on plan with source and quality tracked.
* Case studies shipping monthly with consent, in the three registers we use.
* Partner co\-marketing live with at least one channel per quarter.
* Agent acceptance rates rising quarter on quarter under your direction.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Five to eight years in B2B marketing for SaaS, adtech or martech with demand and content ownership.
* You have worked with platform partner marketing teams (Google, Meta or similar) and know how co\-marketing funds actually get spent.
* A strong editorial eye and a plain writing style; you can tell AI cadence from a human sentence and fix it.
* Daily, expert use of AI tools; you have already directed AI\-produced content at volume.
* Comfort with analytics: GA4, CRM reporting, attribution.


**Nice to have**
* Experience launching a product to an installed base.
* Experience in a company below 100 people where you were the whole marketing function.


**Probably not a fit if**
* You want a team of humans to manage; the team is mostly agents.
* You would rather write everything yourself than direct production.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About RenewCO2**




 RenewCO2 makes carbon\-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy\-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil\-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.
 



  





 We are venture\-backed with grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, NSF, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale. R\&D is based in the United States; product development and manufacturing happen in India. Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America.
 



  





 This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.
 



  





**The role**




 You will be our first marketing hire in India, owning marketing execution: what we say, where we say it, and whether the market takes us seriously. This is a build job — no playbook, no large budget, no agency doing the thinking.
 



  





 Our buyers are chemical producers, fuel producers, industrial gas companies, EPC contractors, and licensors. They make eight\-figure decisions slowly, with a technical committee in the room. Your job is to make RenewCO2 legible to that audience and make a small team read as the serious technology company it is. You will work with a Brand \& Marketing Designer, hiring in parallel, and directly with technical and commercial leadership in the U.S.
 



  





**What you will do**




*Positioning and messaging* 



* Own the messaging architecture: what RenewCO2 is, what each product line solves, why our approach wins on cost and energy efficiency, and what we can and cannot claim today.
* Turn technical and techno\-economic material into arguments that hold up in front of a process engineer and a CFO in the same meeting.
* Track adjacent CO2 conversion, power\-to\-X, and low\-carbon chemical players, and feed that back into positioning and commercial strategy.



  





*Content* 



* Run the content calendar: technical posts, bylined articles, case notes, explainers, LinkedIn, newsletters.
* Write and place bylines and interviews in the trade press our buyers actually read — chemicals, energy, hydrogen, aviation fuel, and polymers.
* Write and submit award applications; handle analyst and industry\-database relationships.



  





*Website and digital* 



* Run the website as a commercial asset: information architecture, copy, publishing cadence, on\-page SEO, conversion paths. You publish in the CMS directly with the designer.
* Run LinkedIn as our main organic and paid channel, plus targeted email.
* Set up the measurement layer: GA4, CRM hygiene, UTM discipline. Report on what produces qualified conversations.



  





*Events and conferences* 



* Own the conference program: which events, abstract and speaking submissions, booth briefs, pre\-show outreach, meeting scheduling, follow\-up, and cost reporting.
* Prepare spokespeople with slides, talk tracks, likely questions, and clear boundaries on what is public.



  





*Commercial and investor support* 



* Build what the commercial team needs: capability decks, one\-pagers, technical FAQs, objection handling, customer\-specific pitch versions.
* Support fundraising and partner diligence with investor\-grade material, working with the CEO and CTO.
* Coordinate joint communications with partners, including anything tied to the Ohmium joint development agreement, with written approval on both sides.



  





*Team, vendors, and budget* 



* Manage and art\-direct the Brand \& Marketing Designer. Brief and manage outside vendors: PR support, translators, printers, exhibit builders, videographers.
* Own the marketing budget and report on spend and return each quarter.



  





**Required qualifications**



* Five to seven years in B2B marketing, at least three marketing something technical: process technology, capital equipment, specialty chemicals, energy, or industrial hardware.
* You work straight from technical source material — hand you a conference abstract, a techno\-economic analysis, or a process flow diagram and you produce accurate copy without an engineer rewriting it. Bring an example.
* Comfortable with the units our buyers live in: tonnes of CO2 per year, cost per tonne, kWh per kilogram, capacity factor, carbon intensity, life cycle assessment, technology readiness level. You do not need to be an electrochemist. You do need to never publish a wrong number.
* Experience marketing to industrial buyers — procurement, sustainability, corporate development, process engineering — through a sales cycle measured in years.
* You have run a B2B conference program: abstracts and speaking submissions against hard deadlines, booth planning, pre\-show meeting generation, and post\-show reporting. Familiarity with the chemicals, hydrogen, carbon management, sustainable aviation fuel, or polyester and packaging circuits helps.
* Hands\-on with LinkedIn organic and paid, a CRM or marketing automation platform (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo), GA4, and a CMS you can publish in yourself.
* Publication\-quality written English. Your press releases, bylines, and website copy have to convince a chemical engineer and a journalist at once.
* Judgment about claims and confidentiality. Performance data does not go out before a patent is filed. Overstated environmental claims create real legal exposure — we treat this as non\-negotiable.
* Willingness to hold a standing evening overlap with our U.S. team in Eastern Time. Bachelor's degree; chemistry, chemical engineering, materials, or environmental engineering counts for a lot.



  





**Strongly preferred**



* Time at a hard\-tech or climate\-tech company between pilot and first plant — you know the difference between marketing a product that exists and marketing a credible plan to build one.
* Experience on fundraising or diligence material: investor decks, data rooms.
* Exposure to government\-funded program communications: DOE, MNRE and the National Green Hydrogen Mission, DST, or state clean energy programs.
* Working knowledge of what drives our customers' purchasing: ISCC PLUS and mass balance chemistry, CORSIA, RED III, EU ETS and CBAM, 45Q and 45V.
* Experience hiring or art\-directing a designer and holding vendors to a budget.
* Kannada or Hindi alongside English, for local partner, vendor, and press work.



  





**What success looks like in six months**



* One agreed messaging framework in use across the website, decks, and commercial conversations, with claim boundaries written down and respected.
* A rebuilt website our commercial team sends to prospects without being asked, updatable in hours.
* A published event and speaking calendar four quarters out, submissions in, booths budgeted.
* A working content cadence and measurement baseline that shows which activity produces qualified conversations.



  





**This role is probably not for you if...** 



* You need an established brand, a real budget, or a team underneath you to be effective.
* You would rather hand technical content to someone else than get inside it.
* Saying "we do not have that data yet" to a colleague, a journalist, or a prospect makes you uncomfortable.



  





**Location, working pattern, and compensation**




 Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru.
 



 Compensation: ₹17–20 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. A standing overlap with Eastern Time usually costs part of your evening rather than a full shift.
 



  





**What to submit**




 We read work samples closely and CV formatting barely at all. Send three to five pieces, each with a line or two of context and a clear statement of what you did versus what a team or agency did.
 


* Something technical you wrote from primary source material: a byline, white paper, application note, or technical post.
* A positioning document, one\-pager, or deck narrative you authored. We are reading the argument, not the design.
* One campaign or conference program you ran — objective, what you did, the result. Include one that underperformed and what you changed.
* A website or landing page you owned, with a live link and a note on what you changed and why.
* Optional: a press release, award submission, or placement you landed.



  





 Do not send anything under NDA. Redact figures, customer names, and unpublished data, or just describe the work — we will take your description at face value and ask about it in the interview.
 



  





**How to apply**




 Apply at https://www.renewco2\.com/careers?bzid\=6764731291dc.
 



  





*RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.*

description:
**InMobi Advertising** 
 is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150\+ countries and turns real\-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy\-first principles. Trusted by 30,000\+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.
   

  

 Through
 **Glance AI,** 
 we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e\-commerce with inspiration\-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery. Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first\-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.
   

  

 Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.
   

  

 At
 **InMobi Advertising** 
 , you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com
   

  

**Our Culture**
 InMobi’s culture is centered around thinking big, being passionate and accountable, and taking ownership with the freedom to make a difference in a flat organization. You will work with a very capable and ambitious peer group who will welcome you with an open heart and go the extra mile to make you successful. We believe that learning is a lifelong commitment, so we invest significantly in your development using internal and external resources. We also provide a strong career path that can help you grow either in the same or different functions using the InMobi Live Your Potential program.
   

  

 We welcome you to be a part of this exciting journey of reimagining advertising.
   

  

**The Team**
 Striking a perfect balance between creativity and analytical thinking, the content marketing team for APAC ensures to bring forth InMobi’s voice to advertisers and marketers in the region with thoughtful marketing campaigns. The team owns the content marketing strategy, planning and execution, and works with other units for the integrated marketing planning and strategy, design and video production, and digital marketing efforts.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Journalism, English, Communications, or any related field
* 2\-4 years' experience writing B2B2C marketing content with knowledge of advertising, branding, and ad tech.
* Skill in long\-form and short\-form content creation that is derived from and supported by a strong SEO/SEM optimization and PPC strategy
* Ability to consider multiple sources of input for development and refinement of content (including AI tools); comfortable taking constructive input and using it to iterate and improve the finished product
* Excellent writing, editing, and research skills


**Additional Skills We Would Love To Have**
* Great presentation skills with a flair for narration and storytelling
* Strong research and analytical skills
* Understanding of SEO, GEO, and AEO


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Own the APAC side of InMobi Advertising’s social media presence: From content strategy to page management and organic performance reports
* Drive employee advocacy on social media – create a calendar and see it through with our business team
* Communicate the company's offerings through pointed, accurate, and compelling content across blogs, case studies, web pages, emails, ads, reports, search descriptions, and other collateral as needed
* Conduct research to understand and stay abreast of industry trends
* Stay up to date on latest content writing and marketing trends
* Develop product knowledge and understand the nuances of communicating for a fast\-growing technology brand
* Repurpose content into multiple assets for various channels to maximize reach
* Take complete ownership for a project or task and collaborate with multiple teams such as sales, client services/solutions, design, digital, and product marketing


**This Role is Perfect for You If**
* You are a great listener, and you have a knack for asking the right questions to frame the right story.
* You are optimistic, easy to work with, and good at setting the right expectations and boundaries.
* You are good at prioritizing, planning, and taking ownership of tasks.
* You have experience working on essential content and AI tools.
* You love storytelling, words are how you frame your thoughts, and you are obsessed with punctuation and grammar.
* You have a knack to deliver compelling stories, build relevant narratives, and drive real connections with content.
* You have had experience in social media and social media advocacy programs


**The InMobi Culture**
 At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
   

  

 We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.
   

  

 InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.
   

  

 Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

 2\. Demonstration of technical excellence in SEO and digital marketing on the projects and for building the function
 



 3\. Ownership towards learning client business, industry, customer \& competition
 



 4\. Ability to deliver error free and high\-quality output on projects
 



 5\. Guide the team of analysts to follow the SEO framework, processes and templates and contribute to evolving them iQuanti.com
 



 6\. Introduce best practices to the team based on knowledge and expertise in digital marketing and SEO
 



  





 Who You Are
 



 1\. At least 5\-8 years of experience in digital marketing with particular focus on SEO
 



 2\. 3\+ years of recent experience in SEO will be a plus
 



 3\. Prior experience of working in client servicing will be a plus
 



 4\. Experience of content writing for marketing websites, campaigns and articles will be a big plus

 1\.Bachelor’s in quantitative disciplines from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institute.

Beyond campaign strategy, management, and optimization, we engage with clients to understand their business and produce proprietary insights that lead to stronger business results. Through a data science\-led approach to client problem\-solving, we've created a differentiated suite of product\-driven service offerings that we deploy to clients, including a search\-predictive efficacy platform called ALPS. We're 350\+ people strong worldwide, with hubs in Jersey City and Bangalore.

title: Content Marketing Intern
description:
**Content Marketing Intern** 

*6\-month paid internship with a pathway to full\-time employment, contingent on performance.* 




  




**About Zenskar** 


 Zenskar is an AI\-native revenue automation platform built to handle real\-world complexity. It sits between your CRM and ERP, automating everything in between: billing, revenue recognition, collections, usage metering, and analytics — across any pricing model, any entity structure, any currency.
 




**Our vision: Zero\-Touch Finance.** 

 Agents execute. Humans supervise. Finance teams set the rules. Zenskar runs them.
 





 Founded by Apurv Bansal and Saurabh Agarwal — second\-time founders whose previous startups were acquired by Snapdeal and Gaana. The team brings experience from Google, Deutsche Bank, Elevation Capital, IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, and Harvard Business School.
 





 We have 5x'd revenue in the past year and are default alive.
 




**Funding:** 

 We raised $15M in Series A funding in April 2026, led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Shine Capital, and Rho, with participation from Rocketship, J\-Ventures, Future Back Ventures by Bain \& Company, and Converge.
 




  




**What Customers Say** 

*"We're saving 200\+ hours/quarter on invoicing and receivables by completely automating our recurring billing."* 




**— Noy Kalansky, Finance Controller, Pontera** 




*"Zenskar automates revenue recognition accurately for our value\-based billing: agents reducing manual hours by 70%."* 




**— Matt Barnard, VP Finance, Vertice** 




*"Zenskar's agents automated 90% of our billing, integrated with our CRM, and accelerated revenue collection by a month."* 




**— Ming Lui, VP Finance, Yembo** 




*"We launched our product 4 months faster instead of building an in\-house system for our usage\-based pricing."* 




**— Kshitij Gupta, CEO, 100ms** 




  




**About This Role** 


 We're looking for an AI GTM Intern to own end\-to\-end SEO and content marketing workflows, automation, and analytics. This is a Bangalore\-based hybrid role where you'll work closely with the content marketing lead to streamline ops at an early\-stage, fast\-moving startup.
 





 The internship runs for 3 months, with a pathway to full\-time employment, contingent on performance.
 




  






 If you thrive on ownership, rapid experimentation, and turning chaos into scalable systems, this is your chance to shape Zenskar's growth engine from the inside.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

 GTM Engineering (50% of the role)
 
* Build and maintain automation workflows using tools like Claude Code and Cursor to connect HubSpot, Webflow, MailerLite, and other tools in the content marketing stack.
* Experiment with AI agents and LLM\-powered workflows to automate repetitive GTM tasks, including content brief creation, Reddit and community distribution, and organic backlink acquisition.
* Automate weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on organic traffic, social traffic, demos booked, pipeline, and revenue attribution.
* Build a self\-improving product knowledge base using Claude.
* Build content automation workflows that turn ICP insights into high\-converting content.
* Automate keyword research and SEO content briefs.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and build solutions to improve efficiency.



 Core Content Marketing Ops (50% of the role)
 
* Maintain and update the website (Webflow), including content updates, landing pages, SEO changes, forms, and pop\-ups.
* Coordinate content distribution across channels like Reddit and LinkedIn, and identify opportunities to improve social reach, engagement, and referral traffic.
* Build, manage, and optimize campaigns and newsletters in MailerLite and HubSpot.
* Drive customer reviews on G2, Capterra, and SourceForge to build credibility.
* Drive organic backlinks through outreach and partnerships.
* Own and close monthly technical SEO issues and escalations.
* Assist with writing and publishing high\-quality blogs and other SEO\-led content aligned with Zenskar’s ICP and content strategy.



  




**What You Can Expect** 
* Ownership from Day 1: Run content marketing ops like your own startup within Zenskar.
* Growth opportunity: Meaningful work with a clear path to full\-time based on what you build.
* High learning curve: Master ops execution and analytics in a high\-impact, high\-visibility role.
* Cross\-functional exposure: Partner with field, growth, product marketing, and sales teams.



  




**Key Qualifications** 
* 1 year of experience interning running content marketing ops end\-to\-end.
* Content writing experience with a portfolio of SEO\-led content.
* Familiarity with GTM engineering: building automations, integrations, or lightweight AI pipelines is a strong differentiator.
* Proven ownership: Takes full accountability and proactively fixes issues before being asked.
* Ops proficiency: Familiar with (or fast to learn) HubSpot, MailerLite, Webflow, Looker Studio.
* Strong analytics mindset: Tracks metrics like conversion rates, pipeline impact, and review volume — and presents findings clearly.
* Not taking yourself too seriously :)



  




**Location** 
* Bangalore (or willing to relocate to Bangalore once you convert to a full\-time hire). The internship itself can be remote.
* Hybrid — 2\-3 days per week
* Office: Indiranagar, Bengaluru — 3rd Floor, A Wing, No. 1, Carlton Towers, HAL Old Airport Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Bengaluru 560008\.

title: Social media executive
description:
Social Media Executive – Content \& Creative
   

  

 Company: BookMyPoojaLocation: Bengaluru
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| Work From Office

 Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
   

 Compensation: ₹3 LPA \+ Performance\-Based Incentives
   

  

 About BookMyPooja
   

  

 BookMyPooja is a technology\-enabled platform connecting families with verified pandits and traditional Hindu puja services across India.
   

  

 We are looking for a creative and hands\-on Social Media Executive who can turn real pujas, rituals, temples, festivals, and cultural moments into engaging digital content.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys shooting videos, editing, brainstorming ideas, travelling to puja locations, and understanding Indian/Hindu traditions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🎥 Video Shooting \& Cinematic Content
   

  

 \* Shoot high\-quality videos and reels at puja ceremonies, homes, temples, events and other locations.
   

 \* Capture cinematic shots of rituals, pandits, decorations, samagri and important moments.
   

 \* Plan shots, angles, sequences and storytelling before and during shoots.
   

 \* Create short\-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.
   

 \* Travel to different puja locations, customer homes, temples and events for content creation.
   

  

 ✂️ Video Editing
   

  

 \* Independently edit engaging short\-form videos and reels.
   

 \* Add music, transitions, subtitles, voiceovers, sound effects and storytelling elements.
   

 \* Create content that feels authentic, premium and culturally appropriate.
   

 \* Repurpose long\-form footage into multiple social media assets.
   

 \* Maintain consistent visual quality and brand identity.
   

  

 💡 Content \& Brainstorming
   

  

 \* Generate new and creative content ideas around:
   

  

 \* Hindu rituals \& traditions
   

 \* Pujas and festivals
   

 \* Hindu mythology
   

 \* Pandit stories and experiences
   

 \* Behind\-the\-scenes content
   

 \* Customer experiences
   

 \* Temple and cultural content
   

 \* Educational/religious content
   

 \* Research trending formats, sounds and content styles and adapt them appropriately.
   

 \* Participate actively in weekly content brainstorming sessions.
   

 \* Develop concepts from idea → shoot → edit → publish.
   

 🎨 Designing \& Social Media
   

  

 \* Create basic social media creatives, thumbnails, posters and stories.
   

 \* Design content using tools such as Canva, Photoshop or similar software.
   

 \* Assist with maintaining BookMyPooja's social media calendar.
   

 \* Write basic captions, hooks and content copy.
   

 \* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content.
   

  

  

 🛕 Cultural \& Religious Understanding
   

  

 The candidate should have a genuine interest in Hindu rituals, traditions and Indian culture.
   

  

 You should be comfortable understanding and correctly representing:
   

  

 \* Different Hindu pujas and rituals
   

 \* Festival traditions
   

 \* Basic Sanskrit/Hindu terminology
   

 \* Regional variations in rituals and customs
   

 \* Temple etiquette and cultural sensitivities
   

  

 Prior experience in religious/cultural content is an advantage.
   

  

  

 🚗 Travel \& On\-Site Work
   

  

 This is not a desk\-only social media role.
   

  

 You will regularly travel to:
   

  

 \* Customer homes
   

 \* Puja locations
   

 \* Temples
   

 \* Apartment societies
   

 \* Religious events
   

 \* Festivals
   

 \* BookMyPooja events
   

  

 You should enjoy being on the ground, meeting people, carrying out shoots and finding interesting stories.
   

  

 Local travel for shoots will be part of the role.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 Must Have
   

  

 \* Strong video shooting skills
   

 \* Strong video editing skills
   

 \* Good understanding of Instagram Reels \& YouTube Shorts
   

 \* Creative thinking and brainstorming ability
   

 \* Good sense of framing, composition and storytelling
   

 \* Basic graphic designing skills
   

 \* Ability to shoot using a smartphone/camera
   

 \* Understanding of social media trends
   

 \* Willingness to travel for shoots
   

 \* Interest in Hindu culture and rituals
   

 \* Ability to work independently from concept to final content
   

  

 Software / Tools
   

  

 Experience with one or more of:
   

  

 \* Adobe Premiere Pro
   

 \* After Effects
   

 \* DaVinci Resolve
   

 \* CapCut
   

 \* Canva
   

 \* Photoshop
   

 \* Lightroom
   

  

 Strong editing and shooting ability is more important than knowing every software tool
   

  

 Who We Are Looking For
   

  

 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

 \* Thinks like a content creator, not just a social media manager.
   

 \* Can take an ordinary puja and turn it into an engaging story.
   

 \* Is comfortable approaching people and shooting real moments.
   

 \* Has a strong eye for cinematic visuals.
   

 \* Can come up with ideas independently.
   

 \* Is comfortable travelling for shoots.
   

 \* Understands that religious content requires respect, accuracy and sensitivity.

 Performance \& KPIs

 \* Growth in social media followers
   

 \* Video views and watch time
   

 \* Creative campaign performance
   

 \* Timely execution of the content calendar
   

 \* Lead/enquiry contribution from social media
   

 \* Successful execution of on\-ground shoots and campaigns

 Experience
   

  

 Experience:1–3 years preferred.
   

  

 Freshers with an exceptional portfolio in video editing, cinematic shooting, content creation or social media may also be considered.
   

  

 Portfolio Required
   

  

 Candidates should share examples of:

 \* Social media campaigns or pages handled

 Portfolio quality will be given significant importance.
   

  

 Why Join BookMyPooja?
