title: Marketing Strategist
description:
* **RetainIQ**
* **Bangalore**
* **1\-2 years experience**
* **₹8\-10 LPA (based on experience)**



  






 If you've been doing marketing for a few years and find yourself more interested in the strategy and craft of customer retention than another Meta ads dashboard, read on.
   





**About us** 


 RetainIQ is a tech\-first retention marketing company based in Bangalore. We've built our own personalization platform that powers email and SMS programs for D2C brands across the US; candle companies, supplement brands, apparel labels, outdoor gear, pet products. Our SaaS tooling sits at the core of how we deliver retention outcomes that our clients can measure directly in revenue.
 





 We're hiring across the marketing team this year as we grow. This is one of the most important roles in the company; the person in this seat is the brain behind every brand's marketing program.
   





**What you'll actually do** 


 You'll own marketing strategy for 5\-6 D2C brand accounts. The work spans:
 



* Build the quarterly retention strategy for each brand you own. Where the revenue is coming from, where the gaps are, what to fix next.
* Translate strategy into monthly campaign calendars. Promotional sends, lifecycle flows, A/B tests, segmentation experiments.
* Write campaign briefs that designers and copywriters execute against. Some weeks you'll write copy yourself.
* Run weekly client calls. Read their data, present what's working and what's not, recommend the next move. These are senior\-level conversations with founders and marketing leads.
* Audit existing email and SMS programs. Find what's broken or missing and build a plan to fix it.
* Use our internal personalization platform, Klaviyo, Hiro Analytics, and a deep AI tooling stack to move 3\-5x faster than a traditional marketer.
* Work alongside a Designer, a Pod Lead, and a Customer Success Associate. Strong collaboration is the default mode.


**What we're looking for** 
* 1\-2 years in marketing of any flavor. Performance marketing, content marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, all relevant. Email marketing experience specifically is a plus but not a requirement.
* Comfortable with data. You should be able to look at a campaign report or a funnel chart, form a hypothesis about why the numbers look the way they do, and recommend a next step.
* Strong written communication. Briefs, copy, client emails, internal docs. Writing is most of the job. Strong writing is non\-negotiable.
* The ability to think in systems. Lifecycle marketing isn't a sequence of campaigns; it's an interconnected engine. We need someone who can see the engine.
* Comfortable on calls with US\-based clients. Confident, warm, articulate. You should be able to hold your own with founders and marketing leads.
* Klaviyo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, MoEngage, or any modern ESP experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you our stack.
* Service mindset paired with a strong point of view. You like clients and want them to win, but you also push back when they're wrong.


**What we're not looking for** 
* Pure media buyers who haven't done strategic or lifecycle work.
* Marketers who define themselves by which platform they ran ads on. We care how you think, not what platforms you've touched.
* People who think marketing is about creativity alone, with no patience for spreadsheets, performance data, or process. The role is 60% rigor, 40% craft.
* Candidates who view agency work as a stepping stone they want to leave in 12 months. The best growth here comes from staying long enough to own a real book of business.


**What you get** 
* ₹8\-10 LPA based on experience. The Specialist vs Strategist title is decided at offer based on level.
* Real ownership from week one. You'll be the named lead on 4\-5 brand accounts, not a junior on someone else's account.
* Exposure to 50\+ US D2C brands across categories. Few marketing roles in India offer this.
* AI\-augmented workflow. We invest heavily in tooling, including our own platform, and you'll come out of this knowing how to leverage AI for marketing better than 99% of marketers.
* Growth path: Senior Strategist, Pod Lead are the real next steps for the right person.
* Hybrid working out of our Bangalore office.



  





**How to Apply:** 




  





 Please fill this form \-\>
 **https://forms.gle/CS2AU27C6Wwmvy6K8** 




  





**Selection Process:** 



1. Apply via form
2. Assignment
3. L1 interview with a senior marketing strategist
4. L2 interview with marketing head

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Pune — on\-site
 



 This regional real\-estate developer has always sold through brokers and word of mouth in its home city. Its next project is in a second city where it has no existing broker network and no name recognition, which means digital is now the primary way it will reach buyers rather than a supporting channel. The company has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Digital Marketing Manager to own that shift.
 



**What you'd be building** 




 You will set up and run digital demand generation for a project launch from close to zero: paid search and social aimed at homebuyers researching a new city, a landing page and lead\-capture flow, and a retargeting sequence for people who visit a show apartment but do not book on the spot. Real estate lead cycles are long and this is not a lead\-farming role — you will be measured on qualified site visits and bookings, not raw form fills.
 



**How the launch team runs** 



* You report to the head of sales and marketing and work alongside the on\-ground sales team that handles site visits
* You manage the budget and agency relationship for paid media directly
* You track cost per qualified lead and cost per booking, and adjust spend weekly based on what sales is closing



**Who this role needs** 




 Two to seven years in digital or performance marketing, ideally with some real\-estate, high\-ticket, or long\-cycle\-purchase experience. You should be comfortable owning a paid budget directly, reading a CRM to understand what is actually converting to bookings rather than just leads, and working closely with an on\-ground sales team rather than at arm's length from them.
 


* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, including landing\-page and retargeting setup
* Comfort with a CRM and basic funnel reporting



**What you'd get out of it** 




 You would be the first owner of a real digital budget at this company, not inheriting someone else's dashboards, with direct visibility into what converts to actual bookings and a straight line to the head of sales and marketing.
 



**How this moves** 




 A short case exercise on the launch, one round with the head of sales and marketing, and a decision within two weeks.
 



 This application also puts you forward for other digital marketing roles we are currently hiring for.

description:

 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e\-commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.
 



  





 Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M\+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000\+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India \- and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry\-free.
 



  





 Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.
 



 Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.
 



  





**The Role:**

You’ll bring together consumer research, brand tracking, competitive intelligence and data to help Snapmint better understand its consumers and make sharper brand and business decisions.

**Department:** 
 Marketing

 Fulltime

 3 \-5 Yrs.

 Bangalore

 Work from Office – 5 Days per Week

**What You Own:** 



* Build a deep understanding of Snapmint’s consumers — personas, needs, behaviours, motivations and attitudes.
* Own quarterly brand tracking and brand health across awareness, consideration, preference, recall, trust and key brand metrics.
* Lead qualitative and quantitative consumer research across brand, product, communication and CX.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Track competitors, category trends and emerging consumer opportunities.
* Turn research and data into sharp, actionable insights for Brand, Product, Marketing and Business teams.
* Manage research agencies, partners and vendors end\-to\-end.

**What You Bring:** 



* 3–5\+ years in Brand Strategy, Consumer Insights, Market Research or Brand Research.

* Experience in fintech, payments, e\-commerce or consumer internet.

* Solve Hard Problems \- Work on meaningful, high\-impact challenges.
* Own the Outcome \- Take ownership and make things happen.
* Move Fast, Build Fast \- Turn ideas into action, not backlogs.

* Grow with Snapmint \- Take on bigger challenges as we scale.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**BrandCrest Holdings** 
 is a diversified business group committed to building agile, high\-impact brands across India’s evolving business landscape. We operate through three key verticals:
 


* **AdCrest –** 
 Our ATL\-led integrated marketing agency, planning and owning large\-scale outdoor, transit, cinema, radio, and digital OOH campaigns, integrating BajuGali for BTL execution and TrendLabs for digital marketing.
* **FinCrest –** 
 Our niche CFO services firm for startups and SMEs, offering virtual CFO leadership, financial reporting, compliance, taxation, and business process automation.
* **DigitalSME –** 
 Our AI\-powered SaaS suite, building business automation and workflow software, including invoicing and payroll/HR tools, with more products on the way.



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're hiring a Growth Manager to own and scale user acquisition, activation, and revenue growth across DigitalSME's product portfolio. DigitalSME is BrandCrest's newest vertical, currently commercializing its invoicing and payroll/HR software, so this is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role for someone who has done this before in an early\-stage B2B SaaS environment — someone who can build a growth engine from the ground up, not just run campaigns inside an existing one. You will report directly to the founding team.
 



 You'll work closely with the founding team, product, and sales to turn DigitalSME's product suite into a predictable pipeline of qualified SME/professional\-services customers, across both live products and upcoming launches. In the first few months, the priority is building repeatable acquisition and activation for the live products, before scaling across the full portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the growth strategy and roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion for DigitalSME's SaaS products.
* Build and manage multi\-channel demand generation — SEO, paid (search/social), content, email/lifecycle, partnerships, and outbound — with a clear eye on CAC and payback period.
* Define and instrument the growth funnel (awareness → demo → trial/signup → activation → paid → expansion), and own the metrics that matter: MQL/SQL conversion, CAC, LTV, activation rate, churn.
* Run structured, high\-velocity experimentation (A/B tests, landing pages, messaging, pricing/packaging) to find and scale what works.
* Partner with Product to improve onboarding and activation flows, using product\-led growth tactics where relevant.
* Work with Sales to ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads and tighten the marketing\-to\-sales loop.
* Build positioning and messaging for DigitalSME's live product lines (Invoice, Payroll \& HR), tailored to their specific buyer personas, and extend this to new lines (Advertising ERP, CA/Accounting ERP, Fraud Detection) as they launch.
* Set up and own growth reporting/dashboards; report results and learnings to leadership regularly.
* Manage growth budget and any external agencies/freelancers/tools.



  





**Specification:** 



* 2–3 years in a growth, performance marketing, or demand generation role, with a significant portion spent at a B2B SaaS company (early\-to\-growth stage strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of owning a growth funnel end\-to\-end and moving core metrics — CAC, activation, conversion, retention — with numbers to show for it.
* Strong hands\-on experience with paid acquisition, SEO, lifecycle/email marketing, and marketing/growth analytics tools (e.g., GA4, HubSpot/Zoho, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Meta/Google Ads).
* Comfortable with both strategy and execution — you're equally happy building a quarterly growth plan and personally shipping a landing page or campaign.
* Data\-driven and experiment\-led: you form hypotheses, test fast, and kill what doesn't work.
* Understanding of SME and professional\-services buyer behavior is a strong plus (agencies, accounting firms, consultancies).
* Excellent written communication — you'll be shaping positioning and messaging directly.
* Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and building processes rather than inheriting them.



  





**Qualification:** 



* Experience growing a product from early stage to a defined GTM motion.
* Exposure to product\-led growth (PLG) models alongside sales\-assisted motions.
* Familiarity with vertical SaaS or workflow/operations software for SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.



  





**Perks \& Benefits:**

* Mentorship
* Flexible Hours

* Compensatory Offs
* Travel \& Expense Reimbursement
* Accidental Insurance

title: Brand Manager (Marketing)
description:
**About KisanKraft** 





 KisanKraft Limited is a leading Bengaluru\-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, dedicated to empowering farmers across India with modern, affordable farm mechanization solutions. With a 46\-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore, 14 branch offices, a dealer network of 5,000\+ partners across the country, and exports to 19\+ countries, KisanKraft is committed to driving productivity and innovation in the agricultural sector.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 We're looking for an energetic, versatile, and strategic Brand Manager to drive the company's brand presence across ATL, BTL, Digital Marketing, and PR. The role calls for a strong blend of creative thinking, strategic planning, and hands\-on execution to build brand visibility, positioning, and engagement across farmer, dealer, and institutional audiences.
 




  






 The ideal candidate has a genuine interest in the agricultural sector and rural economy and is willing to travel to calibrate branding efforts on the ground. You should be a self\-motivated leader, comfortable managing your own team, collaborating across divisions, and working with external agencies on PR and branding.
 




  






 You will lead all digital marketing activities for the brand — SEO, performance marketing, social media, influencer and affiliate marketing, and content creation — with an in\-house team of graphic designers and videographers, external support for performance marketing, and backing from our sales, service, CRM, and management teams.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Brand Strategy \& Creative Direction** 



* Own creative and strategic decisions that align with company goals, objectives, and budget.
* Lead idea development to create compelling, motivating campaigns that drive audience response.
* Develop branding collateral for digital platforms (graphics, videos, articles) and traditional formats (catalogues, brochures, diaries, calendars, wall paintings, signboards, flex banners, posters).
* Conceptualize campaigns for in\-store and exclusive\-store branding, including product branding, logo placement, colour schemes, packaging, and user manuals.
* Ensure consistent branding across online and offline channels.



  





**2\. Digital Marketing, E\-commerce \& Performance** 



* **Performance Marketing \& SEO:** 

 Execute and scale paid ad campaigns across Google and Meta; use keyword research and Google Search Console to monitor and improve search visibility.
* **E\-commerce \& Web Optimization:** 

 Manage website aesthetics and user experience — page layouts, imagery, and copywriting — to improve conversion rates.
* **Social Media \& Brand Growth:** 

 Plan and execute a consistent social media calendar to expand community reach and organic engagement.



  





**3\. Offline Retail \& BTL Execution** 



* Manage setup operations for new retail outlet openings.
* Participate in branding activities such as online campaigns, mobile showroom (display truck) tours, field demonstrations, exhibitions, TV/radio ads, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end design and nationwide fulfilment of physical print materials for regional teams.
* Support company events — season kick\-offs, annual dealer meetings, technician and farmer meetings, press meetings, etc.
* Visit dealers regularly to strengthen in\-store and neighbourhood branding.



  





**4\. Team Leadership** 



* Manage the in\-house creative pod — two graphic designers and one video editor — directing day\-to\-day operations and workflows.
* Work with external agencies on ATL, BTL, digital, and PR activities to strengthen KisanKraft's image among farmers, dealers, and government stakeholders.
* Build the team: recruit, train, and continuously raise the bar.



  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Market Intelligence** 



* Align the organization around a consistent marketing direction and product line strategy.
* Analyze brand positioning through market research, dealer and exhibition visits, consumer insights, and competitor tracking to identify opportunities and issues.
* Partner closely with the sales team to map branding activities to crops and seasons, ensuring strategy stays in sync with crop data across regions.



  





**6\. Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Track and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns and branding activities, including progress of your team and external agencies, to management.
* Stay flexible to take on new assignments as business priorities shift.



  





**Travel** 





 Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, customers, and farmer events.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
 


  


 Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI\-powered automation software within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state\-of\-the\-art Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
 


  


 Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales\-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
 


  


**What you'll own:** 



  


**Pipeline generation** 



  

  
* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
  
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
  
* Build and run account\-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
  
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent\-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
  


  


**Funnel ownership and conversion** 



  

  
* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed\-won, and diagnose where it leaks
  
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
  
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
  
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
  


  


**Marketing operations and measurement** 



  

  
* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
  
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
  
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
  


  


**Website ownership** 



  

  
* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
  
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
  
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
  
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
  
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
  
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
  
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
  
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market\-level site structure
  
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required
  


  


**Programmes and partners** 



  

  
* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
  
* Build co\-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
  
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
  
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
  


  

 Requirements

* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self\-serve motions
  
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself

* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
  
* Strong written English

**Strongly preferred** 



  

  
* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
  
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
  
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
  
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
  
* Experience in a company scaling from founder\-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
  


  


**How we’ll know you are the right fit**

 Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest\-potential channels prioritised and resourced.

 Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.
  


  

 Benefits

 – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.
  


  


 This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Content Marketing Manager
description:

 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.**
 We're currently working with
 **5000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 At BiteSpeed, marketing isn't about being the loudest voice in the room. It's about saying something worth listening to. We've built a product customers genuinely love, and now we're looking for someone who can tell that story in a way that educates, earns trust and makes people want to be a part of what we're building.
   

  

 As our
 **Content Marketer** 
 , you'll own our content engine end to end. From founder\-led thought leadership and product storytelling to SEO, customer stories and campaign content, you'll shape how thousands of marketers discover, learn about and remember BiteSpeed. If you're the kind of person who obsesses over a headline as much as a growth chart, you'll fit right in.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own BiteSpeed's content strategy across channels, ensuring everything we publish contributes to awareness, pipeline or customer education.
* Write and edit high\-quality content including blogs, case studies, product launches, newsletters, website copy, sales enablement content and thought leadership pieces.
* Partner closely with founders and subject matter experts to turn their ideas into content people actually want to read and share.
* Build and execute an SEO roadmap to drive sustainable organic growth while maintaining a high bar for quality.
* Develop customer stories, playbooks and educational content that showcase the value our customers create using BiteSpeed.

* Build systems, processes and eventually a team that can help scale BiteSpeed's content function for the next stage of growth.


**What Makes You a Good Fit**
* You believe great content teaches first and sells second.
* You're an exceptional writer who can simplify complex ideas without making them simplistic.
* You have 3\+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial or B2B SaaS marketing.
* You have experience building content strategies that have driven measurable business outcomes, whether that's organic traffic, pipeline, customer engagement or brand awareness.
* You enjoy talking to customers, understanding their problems and turning those conversations into compelling stories.
* You're highly opinionated about quality, but pragmatic enough to ship, learn and iterate instead of chasing perfection.
* You have a strong sense of ownership and don't wait for someone else to tell you what needs to be done.


**Salary and Location**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team

 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
   

  

**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-**
* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together

 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
   

  

**We have 5 core values:\-**
* Go Above And Beyond
* Making Things Happen
* Say It Like It Is
* Progress Over Perfection
* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**About Bizom** 




 Bizom is the retail intelligence platform of choice for more than 750\+ global brands helping them improve their channel, manpower and process efficiency.
 



  





 Every day, our systems run the heartbeat of modern distribution, including salesforce automation, distributor management, retail execution, trade marketing, and AI\-driven insights, reaching millions of retail outlets and field users across emerging markets.
 



  





 Excited to know more about us? Learn more about
 
 Bizom
 
 here and discover what makes our culture truly people\-first:
 
 Algorithmic Jugaad
 
 .
 



  





**The Role** 




**Growth Marketing, A stepping stone towards Entrepreneurship** 




 We at Bizom don’t believe in drawing boundaries around talent. We are looking for a hungry \& passionate marketer who is focused on growth. It is a role for someone who wants to be an entrepreneur one day. At Bizom, you will be running your show and learning along the way.
 



 If you are not scared of roadblocks, failures, and seemingly unachievable goals then you should read on.
 



  





 Growth Marketer at Bizom is kind of a solopreneurship journey but with a major twist. You will have a stack of mature products and an existing user base of over 700 CPG brands to talk about. We are looking for people who relish the grind and get maniacally focused on their end goals. If you enjoy solving complex problems with simple solutions then you have found your home planet in Bizom.
 



  





 You will develop business acumen and learn ways to deliver the maximum value to maximum prospects at minimum cost and in minimum time. As a cohort owner you will be working closely with the sales team, in collaboration with other customer\-facing teams to create specific marketing plans. Your cohort will be your market, and all the required marketing will be your responsibility
 



  





**Your primary responsibilities:** 



* Building GTM for your cohort
* Run ABM campaigns
* Creating top quality content
* Chasing the customer’s voice
* Setting up ICPs and user journey maps
* Providing the Sales team with air cover using content
* Running Lead Nurturing \& acquisition campaigns
* Acing customer experiences \& brand interactions



  





**Attitude \& Skills \| Things that Matter** 



* Clear articulation and communication skills
* Excel in fundamental marketing skills such as writing, designing, editing, messaging
* Knows tools like Google analytics, hubspot, Zapier, Paperflite, etc
* Knows how to create rich content: website, blog, case studies, video scripts
* Plan: fast, Execution: faster, lesson absorption: Fastest
* Collaborate, Act, Refine with other teams
* Take charge and run as if it is your own business

**What is it like to work with the Marketing Team** 



* We have one philosophy, whatever we do, we don’t cut corners.
* The team is ROI\-focused and acts only when there is utmost clarity
* You will be working with a set of experts who will support your growth
* Drive Bizom’s GTM through its strategies
* Learning everything SaaS and selling to enterprises
* Building the world’s best: Account based Marketing team
* A chance to dabble with every aspect of marketing and push it as you see fit.
* Your coworkers will be operating from a high\-risk, high\-reward perspective



  





**Why Bizom?** 



* We are happy Souls, working together and having each other’s back! People, Product and Profit is our motto.
* Fly beyond your imagination as we believe in giving wings to your passion.
* No Kinder\-garden, We fall, We learn and we stick together like a chewing\-gum.
* We trust in our association and allow free rein to our employees. To act and explore themselves while delivering the best and sustainable results.
* We celebrate success hard and failures harder, It's always a collective success or collective failure. We enjoy our learnings more with a sip of our poison;)
* Have Buddies, Mentors But be your own boss. It goes hand in hand.
* Know your people, Talk, Chat, learn and Share \- have access anytime to reach anyone in the family.
* Stay Quiet \- Stay Foolish. We are courageous people who speak and do right things keeping in heart to serve best to our clients and our company.
* We believe in rolling our sleeves up, getting our hands dirty, dreaming and achieving together.



  





**What Will you get while working with Bizom?** 



* Work is Fun \- We believe work is fun\-and we go the extra mile to make sure you



 enjoy what you do every single day.
 


* Design Your Own Role \- You don’t just fit into a job\-we let you shape it. Take up



 what excites you, and we’ll back you with trust and responsibility.
 


* Freedom to Own Your Work \- Less rules, more trust. You get the freedom to figure things out your way\-with the right support when needed.
* Take Full Ownership \- It’s your ship. You steer it. You own it. You make things happen.
* Grow into a Leader \- This isn’t just a job\-it’s your launchpad to becoming a strong, independent leader.
* People Come First \- Always. We back our people through thick and thin. That’s our culture.
* Stay Fit \& Feel Good \- We care about your health\-with fitness activities, sports, and regular wellness sessions to keep you balanced.
* Happy Tummy, Happy You \- Enjoy fresh, tasty meals every day at our very own in\- house cafeteria. We take food seriously!



  





**What will you not get?** 



* Punch In, Punch Out Culture \- We hate login\-logout rules. Du\-uh, we’re not in school! We care about outcomes, not clock\-watching.
* Spoon\-Feeding \- No hand\-holding here. You’ll get all the support you need\-but you’re expected to take charge and carve your own path.



  





 Mobisy Technologies is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Chief of Staff, Marketing & Growth
description:
**About This Role**
 We're looking for a Chief of Staff to the Marketing \& Growth function who can bring structure, pace, and clarity to how the team operates and executes. This role sits at the center of the function — connecting strategy to execution, keeping cross\-functional workstreams on track, and ensuring leadership has the visibility and context needed to make good decisions fast.
   

  

 You'll work closely with marketing, sales, and revenue stakeholders to drive alignment across priorities, remove execution friction, and help the function scale with discipline.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Strategic Operations \& Execution**
* Translate leadership priorities into structured execution plans with clear owners, timelines, and milestones
* Track progress across key marketing and growth initiatives and surface blockers early
* Prepare leadership for key reviews, business meetings, and cross\-functional planning cycles


**Cross\-Functional Alignment**
* Act as a coordination layer between marketing, sales, revenue, and product teams
* Facilitate alignment on shared goals, pipeline targets, and GTM priorities across functions
* Represent the marketing and growth leadership in operational forums when needed


**Planning \& Rhythm of Business**
* Own the operating cadence for the function — quarterly planning, team reviews, and business reporting cycles
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting structures that give leadership clear visibility into function health and performance
* Drive the annual and quarterly planning process in close partnership with marketing leads


**Special Projects \& Leadership Support**
* Own discrete high\-priority projects that fall outside standard team structures
* Identify process gaps and build frameworks that improve how the team works and scales
* Support leadership on org\-level decisions, communication, and change management


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4–8 years of experience in marketing operations, strategy, consulting, or a Chief of Staff function
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and growth motions — demand generation, GTM planning, pipeline contribution
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross\-functional workstreams with multiple stakeholders
* Comfortable working with funnel data, marketing analytics, and performance reporting
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to synthesize complexity and communicate clearly upward and across teams
* Proven ability to operate with minimal direction and hold multiple priorities simultaneously


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in a SaaS or technology\-led B2B environment
* Exposure to international GTM planning across APAC, EMEA, or Americas
* Prior experience in a marketing\-adjacent Chief of Staff or strategy role


 What Makes You a Strong Fit
   

  

* You're a strong systems thinker who can see both the detail and the bigger picture without losing either
* You operate with calm and structure in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments
* You earn trust quickly with peers and leadership by following through consistently
* You communicate with precision — in writing, in meetings, and in how you frame trade\-offs
* You treat execution as a discipline and bring the same rigor to operations that a marketer brings to campaigns


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 Marketing and growth functions move fast and span many workstreams — demand generation, GTM expansion, analytics, operations, and more. Without strong operational leadership at the center, execution becomes fragmented and leadership context gets lost. This role directly improves the function's ability to prioritize well, move fast, and scale with clarity.
   

  

 Why Join Us
   

  

* Work at the center of a marketing and growth function with real international scope and business impact
* Collaborate directly with senior leadership across marketing, sales, and revenue
* Operate with meaningful ownership over how the function runs and scales
* Join a team that values data, pace, and clear thinking over hierarchy and process
* Grow in a role with high visibility and direct influence on how the business evolves

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 2\+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

* Ability to take an idea and turn it into a practical execution plan

* Comfortable managing multiple activations, partners and timelines
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment

Your day balances building innovative capabilities with maintaining operational excellence — participating in architecture and code reviews, using AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, and ensuring systems perform reliably at scale. Our scope spans personalized onsite experiences to large\-scale marketing integrations — including social media platforms, YouTube, and emerging digital channels — driving Prime acquisition, retention, and engagement for millions of EU customers.  At Assembly, we help brands find the change to fuel business growth. We are an award\-winning global brand performance agency, home to 1,600 talented people across 25 offices globally. We create unique data, technology and media solutions that enable faster and smarter problem solving and an inspired, collaborative workplace culture.
   

  

 At Assembly we embody three core values: Show Up \- actively contribute to a space of personal and collective growth; Make Change \- embrace obstacles as opportunities, taking intentional steps to drive positive change; and Win Well \- approach success with integrity, responsibility, and a commitment to collaboration, understanding that the journey is as important as the destination. Together, we create an environment that fosters continuous learning, adaptability, and a shared passion for making a meaningful impact.
   

  

 We stay ahead of what’s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas. We’re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges—in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming. Together, we create with confidence
   

  

**Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Go\-to\-Market (GTM) Manager to lead commercialization initiatives for our Identity Graph platform and data products. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and Strategic Partnerships to successfully launch new data capabilities, onboard data vendors, negotiate commercial agreements, and drive successful product adoption.
   

  

 As this role involves daily collaboration with US\-based customers, data partners, legal teams, vendors, and cross\-functional stakeholders, the candidate must be comfortable working primarily during US business hours to ensure effective communication and timely decision\-making.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has prior experience in the AdTech, MarTech, Data, or Identity ecosystem and understands how audience data, identity resolution, measurement, enrichment, and privacy\-first solutions are commercialized and delivered to customers.
   

  

**( This role offers work from home, work timings: 5:30pm to 2:30am IST)**
**Responsibilities**
**Go\-to\-Market Strategy**
* Define and execute GTM strategies for new ID Graph capabilities, datasets, APIs, and platform features.
* Build launch plans for new data partnerships and product releases.
* Develop positioning, messaging, pricing recommendations, and commercial packaging.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to create customer\-facing collateral.


**Vendor \& Partner Management**
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic data vendors and technology partners.
* Lead commercial conversations with data providers, identity partners, measurement vendors, and technology platforms.
* Own vendor relationships from discovery through contract execution, launch, and renewal.
* Drive quarterly business reviews and monitor vendor performance against commercial and operational KPIs.


**Commercial Contract Management**
* Lead commercial negotiations with external vendors and strategic partners.
* Review and negotiate:

description:
Embassy Group, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Bangalore, is one of Indias leading real estate developers with a diversified portfolio spanning commercial office spaces, luxury residential projects, hospitality,retail, and education. It is known for landmark developments such as Manyata Business Park and Embassy GolfLinks, and for pioneering Indias first listed REIT Embassy Office Parks REIT With a strong focus on sustainability, renewable energy, and community development, Embassy Group continues to shape Indias urban landscape while maintaining global standards in design and execution
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




  





 To drive product marketing strategies for luxury residential developments by understanding customer preferences, market trends, and competitive offerings. The role is responsible for developing compelling product concepts, creating go\-to\-market strategies, managing integrated marketing campaigns, supporting project launches, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to maximize brand visibility and sales performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Product Strategy \& Market Research** 



* Conduct market research to understand customer profiles, buying behaviour, lifestyle preferences and evolving expectations within the luxury residential segment.
* Analyse competitor projects, market trends, neighbourhood developments, infrastructure, pricing and customer offerings to identify market opportunities.
* Partner with Design and Projects teams to evaluate market feasibility and develop differentiated product concepts.
* Develop concept presentations, positioning documents and business cases to support product development and decision\-making.
* Work with Design Consultants and internal stakeholders on product concept finalization, detailing and budget considerations.
* Identify emerging customer and market trends and translate insights into actionable product and marketing strategies.



  





**Marketing Strategy \& Campaign Management** 



* Develop annual marketing strategies, campaign calendars and budgets aligned with business, brand and sales objectives.
* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, outdoor, direct marketing, channel partners and events.
* Develop clear product positioning, messaging and value propositions aligned with the target customer segment.
* Drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and contribute towards sales conversion.
* Track campaign performance, KPIs and ROI and continuously optimize marketing initiatives.
* Ensure all marketing communication is aligned with brand guidelines and applicable RERA and regulatory requirements.
* Develop innovative marketing initiatives to enhance project visibility, customer engagement and market differentiation.



  





**Product Launch \& Go\-to\-Market Execution** 



* Develop and execute end\-to\-end Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategies for new residential projects and product launches.
* Coordinate with Projects, Design and Sales teams for the development of marketing offices, experience centres, mock\-up apartments, project models, walkthroughs, renders, brochures and other marketing collaterals.
* Plan and execute project launches, pre\-launches, sales events, promotions and customer engagement initiatives.
* Develop launch communication and marketing plans aligned with project milestones and sales requirements.
* Support product training and communication for Sales teams and channel partners to ensure effective articulation of the product proposition.
* Ensure consistency of product positioning and customer experience across all project touchpoints.



  





**Agency \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Manage relationships with advertising, creative, digital, media, market research, production and other external agencies and consultants.
* Brief agencies on project requirements, review creative concepts and ensure timely delivery of campaigns and marketing materials.
* Evaluate agency outputs against agreed objectives, timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on project positioning, communication and launch plans.
* Manage channel partner relationships from a marketing and communication perspective to support project visibility and lead generation.
* Ensure effective coordination across multiple stakeholders for seamless campaign and launch execution.
* Identify brand partnerships / associations which aid with product positioning across all media platforms, including on ground events.



  





**Digital Marketing \& Brand Management** 



* Work closely with Digital Marketing and Channel Sales teams to strengthen project and brand awareness.
* Drive development and enhancement of project websites, digital assets and online platforms.
* Support digital campaigns aimed at improving project visibility, lead generation, customer engagement and conversions.
* Ensure consistency of brand identity and communication across digital and offline touchpoints.
* Coordinate with PR, Corporate Communications and Events teams for project branding, media visibility and customer engagement initiatives.
* Identify relevant digital and content opportunities to enhance the overall customer journey and project experience.



  





**Budget \& Performance Management** 



* Develop and manage marketing budgets in line with project requirements and approved business plans.
* Monitor campaign expenditures and ensure effective utilization of marketing budgets.
* Track lead generation, campaign effectiveness, customer engagement, conversion and other relevant performance metrics by maintaining weekly / monthly product dashboards and reports to provide a comprehensive overview of marketing initiatives
* Prepare regular MIS, dashboards, performance reports and management presentations.
* Analyse marketing performance and recommend corrective actions and optimization opportunities.
* Identify process improvements and innovative approaches to improve marketing effectiveness and ROI.
* Work with procurement and finance teams to ensure timely issuing of purchase orders and payments to vendor partners.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Partner closely with Sales, Design, Projects, Digital Marketing, CRM, Corporate Communications, PR and Finance teams to achieve project objectives.
* Act as a key marketing interface between business and functional stakeholders for residential projects.
* Drive alignment on product positioning, customer proposition, campaign strategy and launch execution.
* Support strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing customer experience, brand differentiation and business growth.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination across teams throughout the product lifecycle.

* Drive the marketing web technology roadmap by participating in onboarding of new web platforms including requirements definition, implementation, integration, execution, testing and validation, data and security compliance review, and training of end user teams.

Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Have the ability to work with other engineering team’s code and systems to deliver new features that have impact across the company.
* You love driving cross\-functional, technical and sophisticated web programs to achieve business outcomes.
* An ability to take large, complex features, and break them down in deliverables that focus on value\-realization for the end user/customer.
* Improve management decision\-making by delivering data\-driven recommendations that are aligned with organizational strategy and quarterly goals.
* You are passionate about championing great work and advocate effectively on behalf of what’s best for the customer/user.
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem\-solve, scope technical requirements, and prioritize tasks.
* Highly effective communicator that enables you to earn trust at all levels and engage effectively with senior leaders.
* Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Gravitate toward the detail but can keep the big picture in focus.
* Highly analytical approach, using data to drive step\-change results.
* Exhibit a collaborative working style with a strong focus on execution and results.

title: Product Marketing Growth
description:
**About Finrep:** 




 Finrep is building AI\-powered financial reporting for CFO teams at public and pre\-IPO companies. Finance, accounting, investor relations, and legal teams use us to get their SEC filings done faster: the 10\-K and 10\-Q (the annual and quarterly reports every US public company has to file), plus proxies, S\-1s, and 8\-Ks. Work that takes them hours today, like finding how other companies worded a similar disclosure, takes seconds with us.
 



  





**We are early, backed by Accel, and growing quickly.** 




  





**The Role:** 




 Our marketing systems already work. We are hiring you to push past them: open channels we have not tried, run growth experiments, and scale the ones that earn it.
 



  





**You will sit inside the GTM team and own product marketing and growth as one job:** 
 how we describe the product, where that description shows up, and whether it moves numbers. That covers positioning, LinkedIn, the blog, use case pages, paid experiments, and SEO. You get the current playbook to build on, and the freedom to break the parts that have stopped working.
 



 The range here is real. If your experiments land, GTM operations is yours to run.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**•** 
 Own Finrep's positioning: what we say we do, who we say it to, and how that shows up across every channel.
 



 • Write LinkedIn content that a technical accountant would actually stop for. This audience spots shallow content instantly, so every piece is grounded in real filings, FASB updates, or SEC comment letter data.
 



 • Run content and growth experiments across LinkedIn, Twitter, and YouTube. Set the hypothesis, ship it, read the numbers, kill what does not work.
 



 • Own paid experiments end to end: copy, creative, targeting, and the honest call on whether a channel deserves more budget.
 



 • Drive SEO enrichment: backlinks, affiliates, and partner outreach.
 



 • Write and optimise use case pages, blog posts, and landing pages for both search engines and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
 



 • Track competitors and turn the gaps in how they position themselves into angles we can own.
 



 • Grow the top of the funnel and scale whatever works.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 • Prior marketing experience with a portfolio or personal site we can read. Show us the work, not the job titles.
 



 • Product thinking. You can look at Finrep, work out what an SEC reporting lead is actually trying to get done that week, and write from there.
 



 • Basic engineering literacy. You know what a server does, roughly how a website is built and deployed, and you can read code without panicking. You will be shipping pages and wiring up tools yourself.
 



 • Fluency with AI and agentic tools such as Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT. You should already be building with them daily, not testing them on weekends.
 



 • Self\-direction. You see the gap, propose the experiment, and ship it without waiting for a brief.
 



 • Genuine excitement about a lean team where what you ship on Monday is live by Wednesday.
 



  





**Major Pluses:** 




 • Startup experience, especially at the early stage.
 



 • SEO, AEO, or GEO work you can point to and explain.
 



 • A track record of B2B content that earned real engagement from a professional audience.
 



 • Curiosity about finance, accounting, or regulation. You do not need domain knowledge on day one. You need the appetite to build it fast.
 



 • Comfort with Figma, Canva, Semrush, or HubSpot.
 



  





**What This Is Not:** 




 • Not a scheduling role. You create original content, not reposts and templates.
 



 • Not a role with a brief waiting for you every Monday. You propose the work.
 



 • Not a place to learn marketing from scratch. The team is small and the bar is practitioner grade.
 



  





**Why This Role:** 




  





 • You own the entire content and growth surface from day one: writing, web, paid, partnerships, and experimentation.
 



 • Direct access to the founders. Your ideas reach the decision table the same day.
 



 • A clear path to owning GTM operations if you perform.
 



 • A product solving a real, painful problem for an audience that rewards substance over flash.

title: Associate Marketing Manager, RBS Retail Efficiency
description:
**Description**
 Are you customer centric, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, entrepreneurial, and passionate about protecting brands? Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and most innovative brand protection businesses? Are you interested in a high impact, high ownership role that sits at the intersection of product authenticity, brand trust, and customer confidence? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. Come join our team and help define the course of Amazon's product authenticity and brand protection business.
   

  

 Amazon's vision is to be Earth's most customer\-centric company and the most trusted place for brands to grow and protect their business. We build programs and solutions that help brand owners verify product authenticity, secure their supply chain through serialization, and build customer trust — delighting millions of brands and customers every day.
   

  

 We are looking for a smart, metrics and results\-oriented Associate Manager \- Product Marketing to independently own our most important brand\-facing product authenticity initiatives — the "big rocks" that move the business. You will set the go\-to\-market and adoption roadmap for our product authenticity and serialization programs, build and scale marketing campaigns across the funnel, and define the dashboards and mechanisms that track enrollment, adoption, engagement, and retention.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Owning and driving the biggest, product marketing initiatives for brand protection and authenticity programs end to end — from strategy through execution and measurable business impact.
* Designing and scaling account\-based marketing (ABM) programs that target high\-value brands and segments with tailored, high\-touch messaging around supply chain integrity and anti\-counterfeiting solutions.
* Owning the full marketing funnel — awareness, lead generation, enrollment, activation, and retention — and independently driving conversion improvements at each stage.
* Building and scaling lifecycle and nurture programs (email, social, webinars, outbound, onboarding journeys) that move brands from awareness to active adoption of authenticity solutions.
* Leading go\-to\-market strategy for major new feature and program launches, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, and cross\-program placements.
* Defining the metrics, dashboards, and mechanisms used to measure program health (enrollment rates, serialization adoption, scan rates, brand engagement), and reporting performance and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Developing content and thought\-leadership strategies (case studies, playbooks, webinars, brand\-facing events) that drive awareness and enrollment at scale for product authenticity programs.
* Establishing best practices and reusable playbooks, and mentoring peers and junior team members to raise the bar across the org.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience in a marketing role


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with a Content Management System (e.g. Wordpress, Drupla, Joomla, etc.)
* Experience using integrated campaigns to solve brand/business challenges

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About BiteSpeed**




  





 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.** 




  





 We're currently working with
 **5000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!** 




**Check out more about us here** 
 \-
 
 https://www.bitespeed.co/
 
 and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
 



  





 We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 At BiteSpeed, marketing isn't about being the loudest voice in the room. It's about saying something worth listening to. We've built a product customers genuinely love, and now we're looking for someone who can tell that story in a way that educates, earns trust and makes people want to be a part of what we're building.
 



  





 As our
 **Product Marketer** 
 , you'll own our content engine end to end. From founder\-led thought leadership and product storytelling to SEO, customer stories and campaign content, you'll shape how thousands of marketers discover, learn about and remember BiteSpeed. If you're the kind of person who obsesses over a headline as much as a growth chart, you'll fit right in.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Own BiteSpeed's
 **content strategy** 
 across channels, ensuring everything we publish contributes to awareness, pipeline or customer education.
* Write and edit high\-quality content including blogs, case studies, product launches, newsletters, website copy, sales enablement content and thought leadership pieces.
* Partner closely with founders and subject matter experts to turn their ideas into content people actually want to read and share.
* Build and execute an
 **SEO roadmap** 
 to drive sustainable organic growth while maintaining a high bar for quality.
* Develop customer stories, playbooks and educational content that showcase the value our customers create using BiteSpeed.
* Measure content performance, identify what resonates and continuously refine the strategy based on data and customer feedback.
* Build systems, processes and eventually a team that can help scale BiteSpeed's content function for the next stage of growth.



  





**What makes you a good fit**




  




* You believe
 **great content teaches first and sells second.**
* You're an exceptional writer who can simplify complex ideas without making them simplistic.
* You have
 **3\+ years of experience** 
 in content marketing, editorial or B2B SaaS marketing.
* You have experience building content strategies that have driven measurable business outcomes, whether that's organic traffic, pipeline, customer engagement or brand awareness.
* You enjoy talking to customers, understanding their problems and turning those conversations into compelling stories.
* You're highly opinionated about quality, but pragmatic enough to ship, learn and iterate instead of chasing perfection.
* You have a strong sense of ownership and don't wait for someone else to tell you what needs to be done.



  





**Salary and Location**




  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
 



  





**Our Way Of Life**
 \- https://www.notion.so/bitespeed/Way\-Of\-Life\-At\-BiteSpeed\-44d9b9614d9641419da910189b1e9f8e.
 



  





**Our Purpose**




  





 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
 



  





**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-** 




  




* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together



  





**Our Values**




  





 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
 



  





**We have 5 core values:\-** 



* Go Above And Beyond
* Making Things Happen
* Say It Like It Is
* Progress Over Perfection
* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously



  





**Perks \& Benefits**




  





 Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning \& keep things fun:\-
 



  




* **Health Insurance \-** 
 Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* **Quarterly Off\-sites \-** 
 Quarterly off\-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off\-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* **Cult Fitness Membership \-** 
 All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* **Personal Development \-** 
 We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* **Salary In Advance \-** 
 Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.



  





**How to apply?**




  





 If this sounds interesting
 **drop a personal note** 
 with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
 **talent@bitespeed.co.** 




  





 Know someone who might be a great fit?
 **Refer them to us** 
 , if they end up joining we'll send you an
 **Apple Airpods Pro** 
 as a gesture of thanks!
 



  





 For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

title: Product Marketing
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Marketing Specialist to drive the growth and market positioning of assigned business units. The candidate should be capable of working independently with Business Unit leaders to plan, execute, and track end\-to\-end marketing initiatives that strengthen both business growth and brand health. The role requires close collaboration with sales, product, and subject matter experts to deliver impactful go\-to\-market strategies, demand generation campaigns, and sales enablement programs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Build and execute GTM plans for products, solutions, and services aligned with business unit objectives, ensuring successful product launches and market adoption.
* Content Development: Create and manage high\-quality marketing and sales content, including brochures, presentations, solution briefs, case studies, emailers, campaign assets, website content, and thought leadership materials.
* Campaign Execution: Plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across digital, email, webinars, events, social media, and partner channels to drive brand awareness, demand generation, and pipeline growth.
* Funnel Management: Own and monitor the end\-to\-end marketing funnel, tracking key conversion metrics from awareness to qualified pipeline. Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and marketing contribution to revenue.
* Sales Enablement: Develop sales enablement assets such as pitch decks, battle cards, competitive positioning, solution briefs, and objection\-handling guides. Partner with sales teams to ensure they have the right messaging, content, and insights to accelerate deal closure.
* Win\-Loss Analysis: Conduct win\-loss analysis by gathering feedback from sales teams and customers to understand buying decisions, competitive dynamics, and market trends. Translate insights into actionable recommendations to refine product positioning, messaging, campaigns, and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Market Research: Conduct market research to understand customer needs, industry trends, analyst insights, and regulatory developments, enabling informed marketing and business decisions.
* Competitive Analysis: Continuously monitor competitor offerings, positioning, messaging, pricing, and go\-to\-market strategies to strengthen SISA's market differentiation.
* Marketing Performance \& Reporting: Track and analyze marketing KPIs, campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and ROI. Provide regular performance reports and recommend optimization strategies based on data\-driven insights.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with business units, product teams, sales, customer success, analysts, and subject matter experts to ensure alignment across product messaging, campaigns, customer engagement, and business objectives.

title: Manager - Content and Marketing

The role is responsible for shaping how IIS is positioned and represented across media, digital platforms, athlete storytelling, institutional communications and key sporting moments. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, working closely with athletes, coaches, leadership, partners, donors, agencies and internal teams.
 



  





 The role will serve as a key custodian of the IIS brand narrative — defining what we say, how we say it, where we say it and how we build sustained visibility for IIS, its athletes, programmes and impact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Media, Communications \& Brand Strategy** 



* Develop and lead the annual media, communications and content strategy for IIS, aligned with organisational priorities, sporting calendars and long\-term brand objectives.
* Own IIS's external narrative across earned media, digital, social, institutional and stakeholder communications.
* Develop proactive media strategies around major sporting milestones, athlete achievements, institutional announcements and strategic initiatives.
* Build and maintain relationships with relevant national and sports media, publishers and other communication stakeholders.
* Lead communications around high\-profile sporting events, including the Commonwealth Games, Asian Games and LA 2028 journey.
* Identify and manage reputational and communications risks, including crisis and sensitive communications where required.



**2\. Content \& Storytelling** 



* Own the overall content strategy and editorial direction across IIS's digital and social ecosystem.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice, tone and visual/editorial language across platforms.
* Develop content narratives around athletes, coaches, programmes, sporting achievements, institutional milestones and IIS's wider impact.
* Lead the ideation and execution of content across formats including video, social, long\-form storytelling, photography, graphics, web and editorial content.

 \*\*Education:\*\* Graduation Required
   

  

 \#\# About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an enthusiastic and result\-oriented \*\*Influencer Marketing \& Sales Executive\*\* to join our remote team.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential brands and clients, reaching out to them, explaining our influencer marketing services, understanding their marketing requirements, and converting potential leads into successful business opportunities.
   

  

 This role is a combination of \*\*Influencer Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Client Communication, and Relationship Management\*\*. The ideal candidate should be confident in communication, comfortable with sales conversations, and interested in the digital marketing and influencer marketing industry.
   

  

 \#\# Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \* Identify and research potential brands and companies that may require influencer marketing services.
   

 \* Generate new leads through LinkedIn, Instagram, email, WhatsApp, calls, and other relevant channels.
   

 \* Reach out to potential clients and introduce our influencer marketing and digital marketing services.
   

 \* Understand the client's marketing objectives, target audience, campaign requirements, and budget.
   

 \* Prepare and share relevant influencer marketing proposals with potential clients.
   

 \* Communicate with brand managers, marketing teams, founders, and decision\-makers.
   

 \* Follow up with leads regularly and maintain proper communication throughout the sales process.
   

 \* Convert qualified leads into clients and achieve monthly sales/business targets.
   

 \* Coordinate with the internal influencer marketing team for creator shortlisting, campaign planning, costing, and execution.
   

 \* Maintain a database of potential clients and keep lead status updated.
   

 \* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with brands and clients.
   

 \* Stay updated with influencer marketing trends, social media platforms, creators, and digital marketing opportunities.
   

 \* Handle client queries professionally and provide timely responses.
   

 \* Negotiate commercials and campaign requirements with clients when required.
   

 \* Work towards increasing the company's client base and overall business revenue.
   

  

 \#\# What We Are Looking For
   

  

 \* Graduate in any discipline.
   

 \* Good communication skills in \*\*English and Hindi\*\*.
   

 \* Should be confident while speaking with clients and business owners.
   

 \* Good convincing and negotiation skills.
   

 \* Basic understanding of \*\*Influencer Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Digital Marketing, Instagram, and YouTube\*\*.
   

 \* Comfortable with sales, lead generation, cold outreach, and follow\-ups.
   

 \* Good knowledge of LinkedIn, Instagram, email, WhatsApp, and other communication platforms.
   

 \* Ability to understand client requirements and communicate solutions clearly.
   

 \* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently in a remote environment.
   

 \* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
   

 \* Target\-oriented and willing to work towards monthly sales goals.
   

 \* Freshers with good communication and a strong interest in sales/marketing can also apply.
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Skills
   

  

 Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:
   

  

 \* Influencer Marketing
   

 \* Digital Marketing
   

 \* Brand Partnerships
   

 \* B2B Sales
   

 \* Business Development
   

 \* Lead Generation
   

 \* Agency Sales
   

 \* Social Media Marketing
   

 \* Creator/Influencer Management
   

 \* Client Servicing
   

  

 \#\# Who Should Apply?
   

  

 This role is suitable for someone who enjoys \*\*talking to people, finding new business opportunities, convincing potential clients, and closing deals\*\*.
   

  

 If you are confident in communication, have a sales mindset, and want to build your career in \*\*Influencer Marketing and Digital Marketing\*\*, this can be a good opportunity for you.
   

  

 \#\# Work From Home
   

  

 This is a \*\*fully remote position\*\*, so you can work from anywhere in India.
   

  

 The candidate should have:
   

  

 \* A laptop/desktop and stable internet connection.
   

 \* A professional setup for calls and client communication.
   

 \* Availability during working hours for client follow\-ups and team coordination.
   

 \* Good discipline and responsibility while working remotely.
   

  

 \#\# Performance \& Growth
   

  

 The role will involve performance\-based targets and growth opportunities. Candidates who consistently generate quality leads, close clients, and contribute to business growth can take on greater responsibilities within the organization.
   

  

 \*\*If you are passionate about Sales, Marketing, Influencer Marketing, and Business Development, we would love to hear from you.\*\*
   

  

 \*\*Apply Now and become a part of our growing Influencer Marketing team.\*\*
