description:
**🚀 We’re Hiring: Business Development Manager – Influencer Marketing** 




  





**📍 Locations: Bangalore \| Mumbai \| Delhi** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 Ripple Links is looking for a driven and commercially strong Business Development Manager to lead new business acquisition and grow strategic brand partnerships across our Influencer Marketing and Content business.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the influencer ecosystem, digital marketing, social media and branded content, along with a proven track record of building relationships with senior marketing stakeholders and closing high\-value business opportunities.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role where you will be responsible for building the sales pipeline, acquiring new brands, growing existing accounts and driving revenue across the influencer marketing ecosystem.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 🔹 Business Development \& Revenue Growth
 



  





 Lead new business acquisition for Ripple Links across brands, agencies and digital\-first companies.
 



 Identify high\-potential brands, categories and emerging business opportunities.
 



 Own monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets and consistently build a healthy sales pipeline.
 



 Drive the complete sales cycle — from prospecting and initial conversations to pitching, negotiation and closure.
 



 Build a strong network of marketing leaders, brand teams, agencies and decision\-makers.
 



  





 🔹 Brand Partnerships \& Client Relationships
 



  





 Build and maintain strong relationships with CMOs, Marketing Heads, Brand Managers, Founders and Agency Leaders.
 



 Develop long\-term strategic partnerships rather than one\-off campaign relationships.
 



 Understand client objectives and identify relevant influencer\-led marketing solutions.
 



 Manage key accounts and identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling and cross\-selling.

 Identify opportunities across influencer campaigns, branded content and integrated creator\-led solutions.
 



 Stay updated on influencer trends, platform developments, creator ecosystems and market pricing.
 



  





 🔹 Pitches, Proposals \& Commercials
 



  





 Own the preparation and presentation of business proposals, pitch decks and customized influencer marketing solutions.
 



 Lead commercial discussions around pricing, scope, timelines and deliverables.
 



 Negotiate high\-value opportunities while balancing client expectations and business profitability.
 



 Take ownership of opportunities from the first conversation through final closure and onboarding.
 



  





 🔹 Account Growth \& Partnerships
 



  





 Grow revenue from existing accounts through repeat campaigns, larger engagements and new business opportunities.
 



 Identify opportunities to expand relationships across categories, brands and marketing requirements.
 



 Conduct regular business conversations with clients to understand upcoming marketing priorities and opportunities.
 



 Build partnerships that contribute to long\-term revenue growth for Ripple Links.
 



  





 🔹 Market Intelligence \& Sales Strategy
 



  





 Track competitor activity, market trends, influencer pricing and evolving brand requirements.
 



 Identify new categories, brands and markets that can contribute to business growth.
 



 Share market insights with leadership and recommend new business opportunities.
 



 Maintain accurate sales pipeline, opportunity tracking and revenue forecasts.
 



  





 🔹 Team Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  





 Work closely with Strategy, Creator Partnerships, Creative, Campaign Management and Finance teams to ensure smooth conversion of business opportunities.
 



 Mentor and guide junior members of the Business Development team.
 



 Support the team with prospecting, pitching, negotiation and client relationship management.
 



 Represent Ripple Links at brand meetings, industry events, networking forums and pitch presentations.
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 5\+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Brand Partnerships, Strategic Partnerships or Client Acquisition.
 



 Minimum 1\+ year of experience in Influencer Marketing / Creator Economy / Digital Marketing.
 



 Proven track record of acquiring new clients and consistently achieving revenue targets.
 



 Experience handling or closing ₹2–5 Cr\+ in annual business.
 



 Strong understanding of influencer marketing, social media platforms, content formats, creator ecosystems and digital marketing.
 



 Experience managing pan\-India brand portfolios and multiple senior client relationships.
 



 Strong network among Marketing Heads, Brand Managers, CMOs and digital/media agency leaders is a strong advantage.
 



 Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
 



 Strong commercial understanding with experience in proposals, pricing and negotiations.
 



 Ability to work independently, build a pipeline from scratch and take complete ownership of business outcomes.
 



 Experience mentoring or managing junior sales/BD professionals will be an added advantage.
 



 Good to Have
 



 Strong relationships with marketing heads and digital/media agency leaders.
 



 Existing network across brands, agencies and digital\-first companies.
 



 Client references or recommendations from previous partnerships.
 



 Good understanding of influencer rates, engagement benchmarks and creator performance.
 



 Strong knowledge of emerging creators, content trends and social platforms.
 



  





**💡 About Ripple Links** 




  





 Ripple Links is an award\-winning influencer marketing agency focused on influencer\-first strategies and campaigns.
 



  





 We believe that the right mix of creativity, technology and passionate people drives the most impactful collaborations.
 



  





 We work with leading brands and creators across fashion, food, lifestyle, comedy, entertainment and multiple consumer categories, building influencer\-led campaigns that create meaningful brand impact.
 



  





 If you are someone who enjoys building relationships, cracking new business, closing high\-value deals and shaping the future of influencer marketing, this is an opportunity to take ownership and grow with us.
 



  





**🚀 Why Join Ripple Links?** 




 Work with leading brands and creators across India.
 



 Build high\-impact influencer and content partnerships.
 



 High ownership and autonomy in your role.
 



 Work closely with experienced leadership and cross\-functional teams.
 



 Opportunity to grow with a fast\-moving influencer marketing company.
 



 Be part of a team shaping the next phase of creator\-led marketing.
 



 📩 Interested?
 



  





 If you're passionate about Influencer Marketing, Brand Partnerships and Business Development and have a proven record of closing high\-value business opportunities, we'd love to hear from you!
 



  





 Apply now or reach out to:
 



 📧 praveen@ripplelinks.com

title: D2C and Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 




 Sriveda Sattva Private Limited is a consumer\-focused organization specializing in direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) products and digital\-first initiatives. The company emphasizes quality, transparency, and customer trust in all aspects of its operations. It leverages digital platforms and data\-driven strategies to reach and serve a broad audience. Team members can expect a fast\-paced environment that values innovation, collaboration, and measurable impact on brand growth.
 



**Role Description** 
 The D2C and Digital Marketing Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for planning and executing digital campaigns across paid and organic channels to drive traffic, conversions, and customer engagement on D2C platforms. Day\-to\-day activities include managing social media accounts, coordinating content creation for web and social channels, monitoring campaign performance, and optimizing based on web analytics. The Executive will work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure consistent brand messaging, support product launches, and improve customer acquisition and retention through targeted marketing initiatives.
 



  





**Primary Key Responsibilities** 




 • End\-to\-End D2C Platform Management: Oversee daily store operations on Shopify/WooCommerce, ensuring smooth product cataloging, live promotional banners, pricing consistency, and stock synchronisation with logistics.
 



 • Performance Marketing Execution: Plan, manage, and monitor paid user acquisition campaigns across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (Search, PMax, Shopping, YouTube), and affiliate marketing channels.
 



 • Agency Relationship \& Campaign Delivery: Act as key liaison for external digital marketing, creative, and performance agencies; set clear performance briefs, track SLA delivery, and enforce CAC/ROAS targets.
 



 • Funnel \& UX Optimization (CRO): Audit user drop\-off points, design and execute A/B tests for landing pages, simplify checkout workflows, and drive higher on\-site conversion rates.
 



 • Retention \& Lifecycle Marketing: Implement automated email, SMS, and WhatsApp marketing journeys (welcome, abandoned cart, win\-back, replenishment) using CRM tools to boost repeat purchase rates.
 



 • Content \& Promotional Strategy: Coordinate seasonal sales, bundle offers, subscription programs, and content marketing initiatives (health blogs, wellness newsletters, and community campaigns).
 



 • Data Analysis \& Reporting: Track and interpret core e\-commerce KPIs (Blended CAC, ROAS, AOV, MER, LTV, and bounce rates) via GA4; deliver structured monthly growth reviews with actionable takeaways.
 



  





**Desired Technical \& Professional Skills** 




 • Experience with CRM \& marketing automation tools (HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, WebEngage, or CleverTap).
 



 • Solid understanding of on\-page SEO, SEM keyword strategies, and persuasive ad copywriting.
 



 • Strong analytical reasoning and data synthesis skills; proficient with MS Excel/Google Sheets dashboards.
 



 • Excellent communication, agency steering, and cross\-functional project management abilities.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager** 




 Own Growth. Drive Visibility. Turn Traffic into Business.
 



  





**Salary Offered:** 
 8 LPA \- 10 LPA
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 For most customers, the journey with Zolo starts online. Whether someone is searching for co\-living, student housing, hotels, or short stays, search remains one of the most powerful acquisition channels available to the business. As Zolo continues to scale, we need a growth\-focused marketer who can ensure that customers discover us before they discover our competitors. This role exists to build and scale a predictable acquisition engine through SEO and Google Ads.
 



 A strong hire will help us:
 


* Increase qualified website traffic
* Improve search visibility across key categories
* Generate high\-quality leads at efficient costs
* Improve conversion from traffic to bookings
* Build sustainable growth beyond paid dependency



 If this role is strong, customer acquisition becomes scalable and measurable.
 



 If this role is weak, traffic stagnates, acquisition costs increase, and growth becomes inconsistent.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own SEO performance across Zolo businesses
* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns end\-to\-end
* Drive growth in organic traffic and lead generation
* Improve conversion rates across landing pages and campaigns
* Maximize marketing ROI through continuous optimization
* Build a data\-driven growth engine through experimentation and analysis



 This is not a campaign execution role.
 



 It is end\-to\-end ownership of search visibility, paid acquisition performance, and growth outcomes.
 



  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**1\.Own SEO Growth** 



* Drive on\-page, off\-page, and technical SEO initiatives
* Improve keyword rankings across priority business categories
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis
* Identify opportunities to grow organic visibility and traffic
* Work closely with content, product, and technology teams to improve search performance



**2\.Own Google Ads Performance** 



* Manage Google Search, Display, and Performance Max campaigns
* Optimize campaigns for traffic, leads, and conversions
* Improve campaign efficiency and return on ad spend
* Monitor budgets, bidding strategies, and keyword performance
* Ensure continuous improvement in acquisition metrics



**3\.Drive Traffic\-to\-Conversion Performance** 



* Improve landing page performance and conversion rates
* Partner with design and product teams to optimize user journeys
* Run A/B tests and growth experiments
* Identify and remove conversion bottlenecks



**4\.Use Data to Drive Decisions** 



* Track traffic, lead generation, conversion, and acquisition metrics
* Monitor CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, and keyword performance
* Build performance dashboards and business insights
* Take decisions based on data rather than assumptions



**5\.Own Growth Experiments** 



* Identify new acquisition opportunities
* Test channels, landing pages, messaging, and audience strategies
* Scale successful experiments and eliminate low\-performing activities
* Continuously improve marketing efficiency



**6\. Stakeholder \& Agency Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners
* Work with agencies, freelancers, and vendors where required
* Ensure alignment between marketing activities and business goals



**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Significant improvement in organic traffic and keyword rankings
* Improved Google Ads efficiency and ROI
* Higher volume of qualified leads and bookings
* Reduced customer acquisition costs
* Strong reporting visibility across growth channels
* Consistent contribution to business growth through digital channels



 The role delivers predictable traffic, measurable growth, and efficient customer acquisition.
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy solving growth problems through data and experimentation
* You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just activities
* You think in traffic, leads, conversions, and revenue
* You enjoy identifying opportunities others miss
* You are analytical, curious, and execution\-focused
* You like continuously testing, learning, and improving performance



  





**Experience we value** 



* 2–5 years of experience in SEO, Performance Marketing, or Growth Marketing
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads
* Good understanding of technical SEO and search fundamentals
* Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, and reporting tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Experience in startups, consumer internet, e\-commerce, travel, hospitality, or high\-growth businesses preferred



 A marketing degree is not mandatory.
 



 Strong execution capability, curiosity, and ownership matter more.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* You directly influence customer acquisition and business growth
* You help customers discover Zolo through search
* You improve marketing efficiency and ROI
* You build scalable growth channels that contribute to long\-term revenue growth



  





**Why join now** 




 Zolo is entering its next phase of growth across multiple business lines.
 



 Search and performance marketing will play a critical role in:
 


* Customer acquisition
* Revenue growth
* Brand visibility
* Long\-term scalability



 This role offers a direct path toward Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing Leadership, and broader Business Growth roles.

description:
**What is Findem:**
 Findem is the only talent data platform that combines 3D data with AI. It automates and consolidates top\-of\-funnel activities across your entire talent ecosystem, bringing together sourcing, CRM, and analytics into one place.
   

  

 Only 3D data connects people and company data over time — making an individual's entire career instantly accessible in a single click, removing the guesswork, and unlocking insights about the market and your competition that no one else can.
   

  

 Powered by 3D data, Findem's automated workflows across the talent lifecycle are the ultimate competitive advantage. Enabling talent teams to deliver continuous pipelines of top, diverse candidates while creating better talent experiences, Findem transforms the way companies plan, hire, and manage talent.
   

  

 Learn more at www.findem.ai
   

  

**About The Role.**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Digital Marketing Manager — Paid Media \& Digital Execution** 
 to own the execution and optimization of paid media campaigns across Findem's business.
   

  

 This is a highly execution\-focused role. You will partner closely with Growth Engineers and marketing stakeholders who define campaign strategy, while you bring that strategy to life by building, launching, managing, and optimizing campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, retargeting, and other paid channels.
   

  

 You will also own paid media performance visibility and reporting, execute newsletters and always\-on nurture programs in HubSpot, and support Growth Engineers with campaign\-level workflow setup.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands\-on in advertising platforms, optimizing campaigns, solving execution challenges, and ensuring marketing programs run smoothly and reliably.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**What You Will Do**
**Paid Media Execution \& Optimization**
* Build, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, retargeting, and other relevant paid channels
* Translate campaign strategies and briefs into high\-quality, live campaigns
* Manage campaign setup, targeting execution, budget pacing, bidding, creative testing, and ongoing optimization
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve platform\-level efficiency
* Ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on time, and with appropriate quality checks
* Manage and optimize campaigns against agreed campaign objectives and performance benchmarks
* Support multiple business units and campaigns while effectively managing competing priorities


**Paid Media Performance \& Reporting**
* Maintain clear, accurate, and up\-to\-date reporting on paid media performance
* Track and communicate key channel and campaign metrics, including spend, CPC, CTR, efficiency, quality signals, and other relevant performance indicators
* Ensure Growth Engineers and marketing stakeholders have a clear and trustworthy view of paid media performance
* Surface platform\-level performance insights, benchmarks, and cost data to support advertising and budget discussions
* Monitor campaign and tracking hygiene and flag potential issues impacting campaign performance or visibility


**HubSpot, Newsletter \& Nurture Execution**
* Build and send company newsletters using content provided by the Content and Marketing teams
* Manage general and always\-on nurture programs in HubSpot
* Build and maintain lists, segmentation, campaign sends, and workflows
* Support Growth Engineers with campaign\-specific HubSpot workflow setup and maintenance
* Monitor workflows and troubleshoot execution issues when required
* Ensure reliable campaign and nurture delivery, including attention to deliverability and engagement


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with Growth Engineers to execute paid media strategies and campaign briefs
* Work with the GTM Engineer to ensure campaigns follow established tagging and tracking standards
* Flag tracking, campaign hygiene, and execution issues to the appropriate stakeholders
* Partner with the Content Manager and Marketing team to execute newsletters, nurture programs, and paid campaigns
* Manage relationships with advertising platforms and vendor representatives, including Google, Meta, and LinkedIn


**Campaign Operations \& Quality**
* Ensure accurate campaign setup, tracking, and tagging across paid media platforms
* Apply established campaign tracking and attribution standards
* Perform campaign quality checks before and after launch
* Troubleshoot platform, workflow, delivery, and execution\-related issues
* Maintain organized documentation and processes related to recurring campaign activities
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign execution, reporting, and operational efficiency


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience managing and optimizing paid media campaigns
* Strong experience working with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads
* Experience managing paid media campaigns with real budget and optimization responsibility
* Strong understanding of paid media metrics, including CPC, CTR, conversion metrics, budget pacing, and channel efficiency
* Hands\-on experience launching, monitoring, testing, and optimizing campaigns
* Working experience with HubSpot, including campaign setup, workflow building, list segmentation, and email sends
* Experience supporting retargeting and multi\-channel paid media campaigns
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring, deadline\-driven work
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working as an execution partner and translating campaign strategy into high\-quality execution


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience working in an agency environment or managing an external paid media agency
* Experience working in B2B SaaS or high\-growth technology companies
* Experience supporting multiple business units, products, or marketing teams
* Familiarity with campaign tracking and tagging practices
* Experience working closely with Growth, Demand Generation, GTM, or Marketing Operations teams
* Experience managing relationships with advertising platform representatives and vendors
* Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM workflows beyond basic HubSpot campaign execution


**What Success Looks Like**
* Paid media campaigns are launched accurately, efficiently, and on time across active channels
* Paid media performance is clearly tracked and reported, giving stakeholders a trustworthy view of spend and channel performance
* Platform\-level efficiency and campaign execution meet or exceed established benchmarks
* Newsletter and always\-on nurture programs run reliably and consistently
* Growth Engineers can execute campaign strategies without being slowed down by campaign setup and workflow execution
* Campaign tracking and tagging consistently follow established standards

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Head of Marketing** 




**Location** 
 : Bengaluru,India
 



 Reports to the Chief Product Officer
 



  





**About Deep Cognition** 




 Deep Cognition builds AI automation for freight forwarding and customs brokerage. Freight forwarding runs on people and paperwork. We build the AI that handles the repetitive work so teams can focus on customers.We have two products. Agentic TMS is a transportation management system run by AI agents. The agents handle quoting, booking, customs filing, and invoicing across the shipment lifecycle. PaperEntry AI is intelligent document processing. It reads commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and customs entries with 99 percent or better accuracy. Together they let a forwarder or broker move 5 to 10 times more volume with the same team.Our customers include C.H. Robinson, Maersk, JAS Worldwide, Dachser, and Rohlig Logistics.  We are an early stage company with a small, fast team. Our headquarters is in Dallas, Texas. Our engineering and marketing teams are in Bengaluru. Our customers are in the US, Canada, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





**The role :** 




 We are hiring a Head of Marketing to own our pipeline. You will report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently leads marketing. Your job is simple to state. Grow the number of qualified leads. Turn those leads into sales meetings. Make our brand the one forwarders and brokers think of when they think about AI for logistics. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the strategy. You will also run campaigns yourself. You will manage a small in house team and a bench of external contractors and agencies.

* Localization \& Global Synergy: Work in tandem with global program teams to execute the "local flavor" of global campaigns. Localize messaging, digital properties (website, landing pages), and assets to optimize SEO/AEO for the Indian market.
* Partner \& Ecosystem Marketing: Collaborate closely with regional Partner Managers to increase local brand awareness, drive joint partner pipeline, and support partner enablement through tailored campaign toolkits.
* Budget \& ROI Management: Take full ownership of the regional field and partner marketing budget. Rigorously track program spending, assess campaign effectiveness, and continuously optimize for maximum Return on Investment (ROI).

* Customer Advocacy: Partner with the Corporate Communications team and local agencies to craft compelling local customer success stories that resonate in the Indian market.


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for a highly results\-focused, energetic professional who combines strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of the B2B technology sales process in India.
   

  

* Professional Experience: 8\+ years of experience in Field Marketing, Demand Generation, or a related B2B marketing role, specifically within the IT/Software (SaaS/PaaS) industry in India.
* Market Expertise (GCC Focus): Proven experience marketing to Global Capability Centres (GCCs) or running GCC\-focused marketing programs is a massive advantage, given their critical and growing significance within India's enterprise ecosystem.
* Campaign Mastery: Demonstrated experience building and executing multi\-channel marketing programs to drive pipeline, with hands\-on expertise in ABM, event management, and digital content adaptation.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. The ability to confidently present to cross\-functional leaders, absorb feedback gracefully, and align local sales teams with global marketing directives.
* Analytical Rigor: Highly analytical mindset with prior experience managing end\-to\-end budgets and reporting on complex marketing KPIs to senior leadership.
* Drive \& Agility: A self\-starter with a growth mindset. Adept at working independently on multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment, acting with urgency, and demonstrating an energetic, resourceful attitude.


**What We Offer**

description:
**About Hector Beverages Pvt. Ltd.**
 Established in 2010 in India, Hector Beverages rose to prominence with its signature brand, the Paper Boat, a ready\-to\-drink beverage that encapsulates the essence of traditional Indian flavors. The inception of Hector Beverages was driven by the founders' vision to bridge the market void for traditional Indian drinks and to present the world with a taste of India's rich cultural beverages.
   

  

 L ocation
   

  

 Headquartered in Whitefield, Bengaluru.
   

  

 Current Standings
   

  

 Over the past decade, Hector Beverages has expanded its product line to include fruit juices, coconut water, and iconic Indian beverages such as Aam panna and Jal\-jeera and foods \& dry fruits which includes products such as Chikki, Aam Papad, range of raw, roasted, and flavored dry fruits that includes mix of nuts, berries \& seeds. The brand is synonymous with distinctive flavors and premium ingredients. Furthermore, the firm's commitment to quality and innovation is evidenced by its extensive infrastructure of nine dedicated factories (and counting) for Paper Boat products, providing direct employment to approximately 900 individuals and indirect employment to another 2000\.
   

  

 Organizational Culture
   

  

 At its core, Hector Beverages thrives on a culture rooted in innovation, creativity, and collaboration. The company's flat organizational structure promotes open dialogue, empowering employees to lead their projects passionately. Hector Beverages is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. The organization is dedicated to fostering high\-performing teams. Moreover, the culture of celebrating both minor and major achievements, nurture a motivated and committed workforce, driving exponential growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Paper Boat is looking for an Influencer Marketing Intern to join our brand team for a 6\-month, full\-time internship based out of our Bangalore office. This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants real exposure to how a FMCG brand builds and runs creator\-led campaigns from the ground up. You'll work with the Creative Team on Paper Boat's influencer marketing engine — from creator selection to content review to campaign tracking — and get a front\-row seat to how a Gen Z\-first beverage brand builds culture\-relevant marketing.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Creator sourcing \& vetting: Help identify and shortlist nano, micro, and macro creators aligned with Paper Boat audience and brand personality.
* Agency coordination: Liaise with our roster of influencer marketing agency partners on brief distribution, creator go\-lives, and timely reporting.
* Content review: Review creator content drafts against brand briefs, tone\-of\-voice guidelines, and ASCI disclosure norms before go\-live approval.
* Campaign tracking: Maintain and update the Influencer campaign tracker — creator status, go\-live dates, content links, and performance data.
* Reporting \& analysis: Help compile weekly/monthly campaign performance summaries and flag high performing content for amplification.
* Ad\-hoc brand support: Assist with other Paper Boat marketing initiatives as they come up — this role will evolve with the brand's needs.


**What We're Looking For**
* Genuine interest in social media, creator culture, and how brands show up on Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Sharp eye for funny, witty content — you can tell good creator content from generic content.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets/trackers; no prior tool experience required, we'll train you.
* Strong written communication — you'll be reviewing briefs and creator content daily.
* Organized and detail\-oriented — juggling multiple agencies and creators requires it.
* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — this is a startup\-paced brand team, not a big\-company internship.


**Internship Details Duration\- 6 months**
**Location\- Bangalore (Hector Beverages office)**
**Work Mode\- Full\-time,**
**Start Date\- Immediate**

**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





 This is an
 **in\-office, high\-ownership** 
 role for a sharp, ambitious individual looking to dive deep into the mechanics of B2B SaaS marketing strategy, with a heavy emphasis on digital execution and data analytics. You won't just be assisting; you’ll be contributing to core business outcomes.
 



  





**Your Mission: Drive Strategy \& Execution** 




 You will be embedded within our dynamic marketing team, gaining hands\-on experience across the strategic and tactical layers of a global marketing organization.
 



  





**1\. Digital Strategy \& Campaign Management** 



* Own the execution and initial analysis of digital marketing campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google Ads, and emerging B2B platforms.
* Learn to optimize advertising performance by tracking key metrics, gathering actionable insights, and preparing comprehensive campaign reports.
* Explore the strategic principles of programmatic advertising, advanced audience targeting, and rigorous A/B testing to inform future strategy.



  





**2\. Data\-Driven Engagement \& Retention** 



* Assist in building, testing, and deploying email and SMS re\-engagement campaigns that directly impact our lead nurture funnel.
* Focus on optimization—from template readability and mobile responsiveness to ensuring impeccable quality control (grammar, spelling, and formatting).
* Track detailed campaign performance and translate results into concrete recommendations for improving audience engagement.



  





**3\. Marketing Analytics \& Business Intelligence** 



* Become proficient with core marketing tools: Google Analytics, CRM (Salesforce/Hubspot), and advanced Excel for data manipulation and reporting.
* Help synthesize raw data into clear, concise reports and strategic insights that influence executive decision\-making.
* Develop a foundational understanding of SEO, SEM, and crucial marketing performance metrics (CPA, ROAS, LTV) within a B2B context.



  





**4\. Cross\-Functional Strategic Support** 



* Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, and Content teams to support high\-priority, ongoing marketing initiatives.
* Maintain critical marketing documentation, track project deliverables, and ensure strategic alignment across all projects.
* Conduct high\-value research, including deep competitor analysis and market trends, to inform content and strategic planning.



  





**The Tech Stack You'll Master:** 




 Get hands\-on experience with the tools that power a high\-growth tech company:
 


* **Core Platforms:** 
 Excel, CRM, Google Analytics, Advanced Email \& SMS marketing platforms.
* **Ad Platforms:** 
 Direct exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager.
* **Analytics \& SEO** 
 : Learn the ropes with top\-tier SEO/SEM tools like SEMRush.



  





**Who You Are:** 




 This role is for the
 **future marketing leader** 
 —someone who is curious, results\-oriented, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
 


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related analytical field.
* A data\-driven mindset is non\-negotiable—you love solving problems with data and are fascinated by digital platforms.
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and communication skills (written and verbal).
* Highly adaptable and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, high\-growth environment.
* Bonus: Any prior exposure to digital marketing (personal projects, coursework, previous internships) is a plus, but your raw potential and drive are what matter most.



  





**What You’ll Gain:** 
 Your Acceleration Path
 


* **Real\-World Impact:** 
 You'll work on live, global campaigns that directly contribute to Joveo's growth. No busy work.
* **Advanced Toolset:** 
 Master cutting\-edge ad technologies and marketing analytics tools used by top B2B firms.
* **Mentorship:** 
 Learn the ropes from industry experts and work within a collaborative, fast\-moving marketing team.
* **Career Pipeline:** 
 This internship is a highly visible, performance\-based opportunity with a clear and strong potential pathway to a full\-time role.



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

**Manager, Content Platform Governance**
**Position Summary**
 The Program Manager, Content Platform Governance will execute the day\-to\-day operating model of the company’s sales enablement content ecosystem, with Highspot as the primary platform. This role ensures sellers can quickly find trusted, relevant, current content within their workflow and that content owners follow consistent standards for publishing, metadata, lifecycle management, and measurement.
   

  

 The role is responsible for applying established governance standards and operating processes to ensure sales content is accurate, current, discoverable, properly tagged, and managed consistently. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable coordinating across content owners, publishers, Sales, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and IT.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Operate and maintain the established Highspot governance model, including content structure, navigation, metadata, publishing standards, and lifecycle processes.
* Administer daily platform activities, including user access, publisher support, Spot and page updates, publishing coordination, and issue resolution.
* Review content submissions for required metadata, ownership, naming conventions, approvals, and alignment to publishing standards.
* Coordinate content lifecycle activities, including scheduled reviews, content updates, archival, retirement, and remediation of outdated or duplicate materials.
* Maintain accurate content records, governance trackers, publisher lists, and documentation of standards and operating procedures.
* Conduct routine platform\-health and content\-quality audits; identify gaps and coordinate remediation with publishers and content owners.
* Support content owners and publishers with training, guidance, and practical assistance in using Highspot and following governance requirements.
* Produce recurring reporting on content health, metadata completion, publishing activity, aging content, platform usage, and publisher compliance.
* Help translate reporting insights into clear action lists for content owners, business groups, and governance reviews.
* Coordinate platform change requests, integrations, and technical issues with IT, Digital Transformation, and platform support teams.
* Partner with content\-strategy and seller\-experience teams to ensure governed content is easy for sellers to find and use.
* Maintain operational continuity and document key decisions, risks, and outstanding actions.
* Interface with Highspot including vendor relationship and contract


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in sales enablement, content operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, digital platforms, or a related field.
* Experience working with a content\-management, knowledge\-management, sales enablement, or digital experience platform.
* Experience managing operational processes involving content publishing, metadata, taxonomy, approvals, or content lifecycle management.
* Strong organizational and project\-coordination skills, with the ability to manage detailed work across multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to quality control, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Comfortable using reports and data to identify issues, track progress, and communicate operational performance.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Highspot or a similar sales enablement platform.
* Experience supporting global sales, marketing, or enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with CRM, learning platforms, digital content systems, or enterprise collaboration tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Qlik, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Experience providing end\-user support, training, or publisher enablement.

title: Senior Partnerships Manager - US
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 We're hiring a
 **Partnership Manager** 
 to build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem. This role is about creating long\-term revenue through strategic partnerships, not just managing existing relationships.
   

  

 You'll identify, recruit, and enable consulting firms, channel partners, resellers, system integrators, and managed service providers who can take Sprinto to new customers and markets. From building the partner pipeline to driving joint go\-to\-market initiatives and co\-selling opportunities, you'll own the partner journey end to end.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships are built on mutual growth. Someone who can influence senior stakeholders, create repeatable partner programs, and turn relationships into predictable pipeline and revenue.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem by recruiting consulting firms, MSPs, MSSPs, system integrators, resellers, and channel partners
* Own the end\-to\-end partner lifecycle, from prospecting and qualification to onboarding, enablement, and long\-term success
* Design and execute joint go\-to\-market strategies, including co\-selling, co\-marketing, and partner\-led growth initiatives
* Develop partner enablement assets, business plans, sales collateral, and value proposition decks to help partners sell Sprinto effectively
* Partner closely with Sales teams on strategic opportunities and participate in customer conversations alongside partners
* Track partner health through pipeline generation, deal registrations, win rates, deal velocity, and overall revenue contribution
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align on business goals, performance, and growth opportunities
* Own partner operations, including CRM and PRM hygiene, partner tiering, deal registration processes, and reporting
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to launch partner programs and campaigns that accelerate growth


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* 5–8 years of overall experience, including 3\+ years in SaaS partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles
* Must have recent experience building and scaling partner programs across US
* Strong understanding of partner\-led GTM motions, channel sales, and indirect revenue models
* Proven ability to recruit, enable, and grow strategic partners that contribute measurable pipeline and revenue
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or participating in enterprise sales cycles
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills across executive and operational stakeholders
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams
* Highly organized, self\-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment


 This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who
   

  

  

* Enjoys building partnerships from scratch instead of simply managing existing accounts
* Thinks beyond partner recruitment and focuses on long\-term partner success and revenue generation
* Can balance strategic relationship\-building with operational excellence
* Loves collaborating across teams to create scalable GTM programs
* Is energized by building new markets and expanding partner ecosystems
* Measures success by partner\-generated pipeline, revenue, and long\-term business impact


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

title: Growth Champion
description:
**About Be Limitless** 


 Be Limitless is a feature\-rich job search marketplace — built as a hybrid of Naukri.com, Instagram, and LinkedIn. The platform brings together customers (employers and recruiters) and candidates (job seekers) in one place, with the discovery and engagement layer of a social platform and the intent\-driven matching of a job board.
 





 We are well\-funded and putting real capital behind scaling this platform aggressively.
 



**The Opportunity** 


 We've built the product. What we haven't cracked yet is the classic marketplace cold\-start problem: getting both sides — customers and candidates — active on the platform at the same time, and keeping them there.
 





 This role exists to solve exactly that. There is no existing playbook to execute — the person in this role will build one from scratch, through direct hustle, before it becomes a repeatable growth motion for a wider team to scale.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

 •     Own early\-stage growth across both sides of the marketplace — customers and candidates — as a single, accountable owner of the cold\-start problem.
 



 •     Personally drive acquisition of the first 100 customers and the first 1 lakh candidates through direct outreach, partnerships, community\-building, and hands\-on growth tactics.
 



 •     Design and run unconventional, low\-cost go\-to\-market experiments; double down on what works and kill what doesn't.
 



 •     Build the early acquisition and retention playbook — the foundation a growth team will scale once traction is proven.
 



 •     Work closely with product and marketing to turn direct market feedback into fast platform improvements.
 



 •     Track and report on growth metrics, and iterate quickly based on data rather than assumption.
 



 •     Act as the face of Be Limitless in the market during this early phase — building direct relationships with founding customers and candidate communities.
 



  




**What We're Looking For** 

 •     Proven experience scaling a two\-sided marketplace or platform from zero to meaningful traction — ideally in job search, recruitment, social, or consumer tech.
 



 •     A genuinely entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable without a playbook, biased toward action over process.
 



 •     Strong sales and business development instincts, with a track record of personally closing early customers.
 



 •     A young, high\-energy, hands\-on operator — this is a builder role first, not a management role, in its early phase.
 



 •     Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a startup\-like environment.
 



 •     Excellent communication skills — equally credible speaking to a corporate customer and a first\-time job seeker.
 



  




**Nice to Have** 

 •     Experience in recruitment, HR\-tech, job search, or talent marketplace businesses.
 



 •     A track record in growth hacking, community\-led growth, or content/influencer\-driven acquisition.
 



 •     An existing network among employers, recruiters, and/or job seekers in India.
 



  




**What You'll Get** 

 •     Genuine ownership of strategy and execution — not implementation of someone else's plan.
 



 •     The chance to build a category\-defining platform from the ground up, backed by serious capital.
 



 •     Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives tied to the growth you drive.
 



 •     Direct access to, and mentorship from, the founding leadership team.
 



  




**How to Apply** 


 Send your resume along with a short note on how you've solved a similar cold\-start problem before — what you did, and what the results were — to \[add application email / link].
